-- External-admin bootstrap compatibility. Optional executor helpers must be
-- defined before the first service lookup.
cloneref = cloneref or function(o) return o end
getcustomasset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
gethiddengui = get_hidden_gui or gethui
request = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)

local Debris = cloneref(game:GetService("Debris"))
local CoreGui = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))

local Util = {}

Util.RandomString = function(length)
	length = length or math.random(32, 256)
	local str = ""
	for _=1, length do
		str ..= string.char(math.random(32, 126))
	end
	return str
end
Util.DeepcopyTable = function(t)
	local c = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		if type(v) == "table" then
			v = Util.DeepcopyTable(v)
		end
		c[k] = v
	end
	return c
end
Util.ParseHex = function(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
	s = s:gsub("%s+", ""):gsub("^#", "")
	if #s == 3 then
		s = s:sub(1, 1):rep(2) .. s:sub(2, 2):rep(2) .. s:sub(3, 3):rep(2)
	end
	if not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
end
Util.Notify = function(text)
	-- [custom] Util.FX.Cfg (Customization page) decides where notifications go
	local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
	if cfg then
		if cfg.NotifMode == 4 then return end
		if cfg.NotifMode == 2 and Util.UINotify then
			if pcall(Util.UINotify, text) then return end
		end
	end
	StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
		Title = (cfg and cfg.NotifTitle ~= "" and cfg.NotifTitle) or "Nooby's uh modded reanimation v1.1.1",
		Text = text,
		Duration = (cfg and cfg.NotifDuration + 1) or 5
	})
end

local function ismissing(func)
	return not func or type(func) ~= "function"
end

-- Optional executor capabilities are recorded rather than hard-failing the
-- entire script. Commands which need a missing API can then report their own error.
Util.Capabilities = {
	request = not ismissing(request),
	customasset = not ismissing(getcustomasset),
	filesystem = not (ismissing(readfile) or ismissing(writefile) or ismissing(delfile) or ismissing(isfile) or ismissing(isfolder) or ismissing(makefolder) or ismissing(listfiles)),
	firetouch = not ismissing(firetouchinterest),
	hiddenproperty = not ismissing(gethiddenproperty),
	setscriptable = not ismissing(setscriptable),
	replicatesignal = not ismissing(replicatesignal),
}
if ismissing(isfile) then isfile = function() return false end end
if ismissing(isfolder) then isfolder = function() return false end end
if ismissing(listfiles) then listfiles = function() return {} end end

-- Correct fallback for sethiddenproperty when setscriptable is available.
if ismissing(sethiddenproperty) and not ismissing(setscriptable) and not ismissing(isscriptable) then
	sethiddenproperty = function(inst, prop, value)
		local ok, old = pcall(isscriptable, inst, prop)
		if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, true) end
		local success, err = pcall(function() inst[prop] = value end)
		if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, false) end
		return success, err
	end
end

-- Protected-call compatibility. Capture native functions before shadowing.
local _native_pcall = pcall
local _native_xpcall = xpcall
local pcall = function(func, ...)
	return _native_pcall(func, ...)
end
local xpcall = function(func, handler, ...)
	return _native_xpcall(func, handler, ...)
end
local b_getfenv = getfenv

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	local notLoaded = Instance.new("Message")
	xpcall(function()
		notLoaded.Parent = CoreGui
	end, function()
		notLoaded.Parent = workspace
	end)
	notLoaded.Text = "Nooby's uh modded reanimation v1.1.1 is waiting for the game to load"
	game.Loaded:Wait()
	for i=1, 60 do
		while task.wait() > 1 / 10 do end
	end
	notLoaded:Destroy()
end

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
	local newCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if newCamera ~= nil then
		Camera = newCamera
	end
end)
Util._scrsiz = Vector2.new(512, 512)
Util.GetScreenSize = function()
	if Camera ~= nil then
		Util._scrsiz = Camera.ViewportSize
	end
	return Util._scrsiz
end

--[[ ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Util.FX = (function()
	local FX = {}
	local RealTweenService = TweenService
	local Lighting = cloneref(game:GetService("Lighting"))

	-- ═════════════ [v34] LOW END UI MODE ═════════════
	-- One saved switch (Cfg.LowEnd, Main page > Performance). While it is ON, reads of the effect settings go
	-- through the two proxies below and return a "light" value (effects off, 3D triangle simplified, minigames
	-- locked). The user's REAL values live in RawSettings / RawCfg and are never overwritten, so turning the mode
	-- OFF brings back exactly what they had before.
	local RawCfg = {}
	local RawSettings = {Blur = true, Transitions = true, ExtraSounds = true, Ambient = true}
	local LOWEND_SETTINGS = {Blur = false, Transitions = false, ExtraSounds = false, Ambient = false}
	local LOWEND_CFG = {
		UIParticles = false, UIGradient = false, UITrail = false, UIGlow = false, RbxIconTheme = false, RbxBarTheme = false, ChatStyle = false,
		TriNodes = false, TriFaces = true, TriExplode = false, TriMusic = false,
		UIAnimSpeed = 3, NotifSpeed = 3,
	}
	FX.LowEndTriFPS = 30 -- 3D triangles update at this rate in low end mode
	FX.LowEndUIFPS = 30  -- UI colour / animation hooks update at this rate in low end mode
	FX.LowEndHooks = {}
	function FX.IsLowEnd()
		return RawCfg.LowEnd == true
	end
	function FX.OnLowEnd(fn)
		FX.LowEndHooks[#FX.LowEndHooks + 1] = fn
	end
	FX.Settings = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if RawCfg.LowEnd == true and LOWEND_SETTINGS[k] ~= nil then
				return LOWEND_SETTINGS[k]
			end
			return RawSettings[k]
		end,
		__newindex = function(_, k, v)
			RawSettings[k] = v
		end,
	})

	local Quint, Quad, Back, Linear =Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
	local Bounce = Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce
	local EOut, EIn, EInOut = Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
	FX.Expo = Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential -- [v41]
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	-- ═════════════ CUSTOMIZATION (saved in SaveData.Custom) ═════════════
	-- 10 triangle + 10 intro + 10 notification + 5 extra UI options.
	-- Everything below reads FX.Cfg live, so changes apply instantly.
	local DEFAULT_CFG = {
		-- triangle
		TriColorMode = 1, TriColor = "#FFFFFF", TriSize = 1, TriSpin = 1, TriFaceTr = 0.38, TriEdge = 1,
		TriNodes = true, TriFaces = true, TriMusic = true, TriExplode = true,
		-- intro
		IntroTitle = "STEVETHEREALONE", IntroSub = "", IntroMarquee = "", IntroColorMode = 4, IntroColor = "#FFFFFF",
		IntroStars = true, IntroRays = true, IntroScan = true, IntroHud = true, IntroIntensity = 1,
		-- notifications
		NotifMode = 1, NotifDuration = 4, NotifTitle = "Nooby's uh modded reanimation v1.1.1", NotifPos = 1, NotifWidth = 300,
		NotifSize = 18, NotifProgress = true, NotifColor = "", NotifSound = false, NotifSpeed = 1,
		-- extra ui
		UIBgTr = 0, UIBorder = 1, UIRound = 8, UIGlow = true, UIAccent = "",
		-- command triangle (floating button that opens the command bar)
		AdminTriHidden = false,
		AdminTriTab = true,   -- tiny restore tab at the top edge while the triangle is hidden
		AdminTriPos = "",     -- saved triangle position ("x,y" screen fractions, empty = top centre)
		-- [v24] dynamic colour system
		AccentMode = 1, HarmonyMode = 1, ColorSpeed = 1, ColorSat = 1, ColorBright = 1,
		-- [v24] extra ui options
		UIScale = 1, UIFont = 1, UIAnimSpeed = 1, UIParticles = true, UIGradient = true, UITrail = true,
		-- [settings] Roblox icon + chat visuals (follow the UI theme)
		RbxIconTheme = true, RbxBarTheme = true, ChatStyle = true, ChatTextSize = 14, ChatBgTr = 0.3, ChatWinW = 1, ChatWinH = 1, BubbleDur = 15, BubbleDist = 100, BubbleTail = true,
		-- [v24] minigames
		MiniControls = 1,
		-- [v34] low end UI mode (simple 3D triangle, basic UI, minigames disabled)
		LowEnd = false,
		-- [v51] Delta bridge (only used when the executor is positively identified as Delta)
		DeltaLogo = true, DeltaMotion = true, DeltaBlur = true, DeltaIntro = true, DeltaSpeed = 1, DeltaSource = "", DeltaEnabled = true,
	}
	-- FX.Cfg is a proxy: reads return the low end override while LowEnd is on, writes always go to RawCfg.
	FX.Cfg = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if RawCfg.LowEnd == true then
				local o = LOWEND_CFG[k]
				if o ~= nil then
					return o
				end
			end
			return RawCfg[k]
		end,
		__newindex = function(_, k, v)
			RawCfg[k] = v
		end,
	})
	for k, v in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do
		FX.Cfg[k] = v
	end
	FX.CfgDefaults = DEFAULT_CFG
	function FX.InitCustom(SaveData)
		if type(SaveData.Custom) ~= "table" then
			SaveData.Custom = {}
		end
		FX.Store = SaveData.Custom
		for k, d in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do
			local v = FX.Store[k]
			if type(v) ~= type(d) then
				v = d
			end
			FX.Cfg[k] = v
		end
	end
	function FX.SetCfg(key, value)
		FX.Cfg[key] = value
		if FX.Store then
			FX.Store[key] = value
		end
	end
	function FX.ResetCfg()
		for k, d in pairs(DEFAULT_CFG) do
			if k ~= "LowEnd" then -- "Reset customization" must not silently flip the performance mode
				FX.SetCfg(k, d)
			end
		end
	end
	-- [v34] turn Low End UI Mode on / off. Every module that needs to react registers FX.OnLowEnd(fn(on)).
	function FX.SetLowEnd(on)
		on = on == true
		if RawCfg.LowEnd == on then
			return false
		end
		FX.SetCfg("LowEnd", on)
		for _, fn in ipairs(FX.LowEndHooks) do
			local ok, err = pcall(fn, on)
			if not ok then
				warn("[LowEnd] hook failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	function FX.TriColor(t)
		local C = FX.Cfg
		if C.TriColorMode == 2 then
			return Util.ParseHex(C.TriColor) or WHITE
		elseif C.TriColorMode == 3 then
			return Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.2) % 1, 0.8, 1)
		elseif C.TriColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
			return Util.Color.Palette(t).Secondary
		end
		return FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or Color3.fromHSV((t / 10) % 1, 0.8, 1)
	end
	function FX.MarqueeText(fallback)
		local m = FX.Cfg.IntroMarquee
		if type(m) == "string" and m ~= "" then
			return (m:gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")) .. string.rep(" ", 24)
		end
		return fallback
	end

	-- ───────────────────────── helpers ─────────────────────────
	local function tween(obj, time, style, dir, props)
		local t = RealTweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1), style or Quint, dir or EOut), props)
		t:Play()
		return t
	end
	local function easeOutCubic(x)
		return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
	end
	local function easeInOut(x)
		if x < 0.5 then
			return 4 * x * x * x
		end
		return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
	end
	local function easeOutBack(x)
		local c1 = 1.70158
		local c3 = c1 + 1
		return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
	end
	local function isPress(input)
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end

	-- ───────────────────────── screen blur ─────────────────────────
	local Blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
	Blur.Name = Util.RandomString(16)
	Blur.Size = 0
	do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			Blur.Parent = Lighting
		end)
		if not ok then
			pcall(function()
				Blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
			end)
		end
	end
	local blurToken = 0
	function FX.BlurPulse(peak, inTime, outTime)
		if not FX.Settings.Blur then return end
		blurToken = blurToken + 1
		local my = blurToken
		inTime = inTime or 0.15
		tween(Blur, inTime, Quad, EOut, {Size = peak})
		task.delay(inTime, function()
			if my ~= blurToken then return end
			tween(Blur, outTime or 0.45, Quad, EIn, {Size = 0})
		end)
	end

	-- ───────────────────────── sounds ─────────────────────────
	FX.UISound = nil
	-- {pitch, volume}. Built from the script's own click sound so it follows themes + mute.
	local presets = {
		click = {1, 1}, tick = {1.9, 0.2}, release = {1.5, 0.28}, open = {0.75, 0.85}, back = {0.62, 0.85},
		close = {1.3, 0.8}, boom = {0.42, 1.4}, reform = {1.6, 0.9}, hit = {1.2, 0.9},
	}
	function FX.Play(kind, pitchMul, volMul)
		if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
		local U = FX.UISound
		local base = U and U.Click
		if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
		local p = presets[kind] or presets.click
		local s = base:Clone()
		s.PlaybackSpeed = p[1] * (pitchMul or 1) * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
		s.Volume = base.Volume * p[2] * (volMul or 1)
		s.Parent = base.Parent
		s:Play()
		Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
	end

	-- ───────────────────────── tiny fx: rings + sparks ─────────────────────────
	function FX.Ring(parent, color, size, time, thick, pos)
		if RawCfg.LowEnd == true then return end -- [v34] low end: no decorative rings
		local r = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
		r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		r.Position = pos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
		r.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		r.BorderSizePixel = 0
		r.ZIndex = 30
		r.Interactable = false
		Util.Instance("UICorner", r).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", r)
		s.Color = color
		s.Thickness = thick or 3
		s.Transparency = 0.1
		tween(r, time, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)})
		tween(s, time, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
		Debris:AddItem(r, time + 0.1)
		return r
	end
	function FX.Sparks(parent, color, n, dist, time)
		if RawCfg.LowEnd == true then return end -- [v34] low end: no spark particles
		for _ = 1, n do
			local f = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = color
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.ZIndex = 30
			f.Interactable = false
			local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local d = dist * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.55)
			tween(f, time, Quint, EOut, {
				Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * d, 0.5, math.sin(a) * d),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
			})
			Debris:AddItem(f, time + 0.1)
		end
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ 3D TRIANGLE ENGINE ═════════════════════════
	local TET_E = 2
	local TET_R = TET_E / math.sqrt(3)
	local TET_H = TET_E * math.sqrt(2 / 3)
	local TET = {
		Vector3.new(0, TET_H * 0.75, 0),
		Vector3.new(TET_R, -TET_H * 0.25, 0),
		Vector3.new(TET_R * math.cos(math.rad(120)), -TET_H * 0.25, TET_R * math.sin(math.rad(120))),
		Vector3.new(TET_R * math.cos(math.rad(240)), -TET_H * 0.25, TET_R * math.sin(math.rad(240))),
	}
	local TET_FACES = {{2, 3, 4}, {1, 2, 3}, {1, 3, 4}, {1, 4, 2}}
	local TET_EDGES = {{1, 2}, {1, 3}, {1, 4}, {2, 3}, {3, 4}, {4, 2}}
	local ACTIONS = {"SPIN", "PULSE", "FLIP", "PRISM", "BLOOM"}
	local FAR = CFrame.new(0, 1e4, 0)

	local function newPart(class, parent)
		local p = Instance.new(class)
		p.Name = Util.RandomString(12)
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.Parent = parent
		return p
	end
	local function rndUnit()
		local v = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
		if v.Magnitude < 0.05 then v = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
		return v.Unit
	end
	local function rndOut(base)
		local d = base.Magnitude > 0.01 and base.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		return (d * 1.4 + rndUnit()).Unit
	end

	-- draws a triangle (a,b,c) with two thin wedges
	local function drawTri(a, b, c, w1, w2, th)
		local ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
		if ac:Cross(ab).Magnitude < 1e-5 then
			w1.CFrame = FAR
			w2.CFrame = FAR
			return
		end
		local abd, acd, bcd = ab:Dot(ab), ac:Dot(ac), bc:Dot(bc)
		if abd > acd and abd > bcd then
			c, a = a, c
		elseif acd > bcd and acd > abd then
			a, b = b, a
		end
		ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
		local right = ac:Cross(ab).Unit
		local up = bc:Cross(right).Unit
		local back = bc.Unit
		local height = math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
		w1.Size = Vector3.new(th, math.max(height, 0.001), math.max(math.abs(ab:Dot(back)), 0.001))
		w1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, right, up, back)
		w2.Size = Vector3.new(th, math.max(height, 0.001), math.max(math.abs(ac:Dot(back)), 0.001))
		w2.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((a + c) / 2, -right, up, -back)
	end

	function FX.NewTriangle3D(parent, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		local CFG = FX.Cfg
		local T = {
			scaleBase = 1, chargeVis = 0, baseSpin = 0.9,
			yaw = 0.6, pitch = 0.35, yawVel = 3,
			flipBase = 0, flipAngle = 0, flipT = nil,
			pulse = 0, pulseAmt = 0, prism = 0, bloomT = nil, bloomEnv = 0,
			charge = 0, holdT = 0, hot = 0, holding = false, dragging = false,
			phase = "idle", phaseT = 0, env = 0, extra = 0,
			clickN = 0, active = true, pop = nil, popScale = 1,
			pressAmt = 0, hoverAmt = 0, hover = false, trackX = 0, trackY = 0, lastLoud = 0,
			color = WHITE,
		}
		local conns = {}

		local layer = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
		layer.AnchorPoint = opts.LayerAnchor or Vector2.zero
		layer.Position = opts.LayerPos or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		layer.Size = opts.LayerSize or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
		layer.ZIndex = opts.ZIndex or 3
		-- NOTE: never set Interactable=false here. Interactable is inherited by descendants, which is
		-- exactly what used to kill the hit-button (taps / the 5s hold never registered).
		layer.Active = false
		T.Layer = layer

		-- soft layered glow that sits under the viewport (theme coloured, scales with the shape)
		local halo = {}
		if opts.Halo ~= false then
			for i, hd in ipairs({{0.95, 0.955}, {0.68, 0.925}, {0.44, 0.88}}) do
				local fr = Util.Instance("Frame", layer)
				fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				fr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				fr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hd[1], hd[1])
				fr.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
				fr.BackgroundTransparency = hd[2]
				fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
				fr.ZIndex = 0
				fr.Interactable = false -- leaf frame only; never set this on the layer itself (see note above)
				Util.Instance("UICorner", fr).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				local ar = Util.Instance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", fr)
				ar.AspectRatio = 1
				ar.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
				halo[i] = {fr = fr, k = hd[1], tr = hd[2]}
			end
		end

		local vp = Util.Instance("ViewportFrame", layer)
		vp.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
		vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 178)
		vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 232)
		vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.45, -0.8, -0.55)
		local cam = Util.Instance("Camera", vp)
		cam.FieldOfView = 35
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 5.4)
		vp.CurrentCamera = cam
		local model = Util.Instance("Model", vp)

		-- pieces
		local faces, edges, nodes = {}, {}, {}
		for i, idx in ipairs(TET_FACES) do
			local a, b, c = TET[idx[1]], TET[idx[2]], TET[idx[3]]
			local nrm = (b - a):Cross(c - a).Unit
			if nrm:Dot((a + b + c) / 3) < 0 then nrm = -nrm end -- always point away from the centre
			faces[i] = {v = {a, b, c}, n = nrm, center = (a + b + c) / 3, w1 = newPart("WedgePart", model), w2 = newPart("WedgePart", model)}
		end
		for i, pair in ipairs(TET_EDGES) do
			local a, b = TET[pair[1]], TET[pair[2]]
			local part = newPart("Part", model)
			part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder -- rounded edges instead of boxes (axis = X, set up in draw)
			part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			edges[i] = {a = a, b = b, mid = (a + b) / 2, part = part}
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local part = newPart("Part", model)
			part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			nodes[i] = {pos = TET[i], part = part}
		end
		-- inner glow core: one neon ball inside the translucent faces gives the shape real depth
		local core = newPart("Part", model)
		core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		core.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		local function reseed()
			for _, f in ipairs(faces) do
				f.dir, f.axis, f.spin = rndOut(f.center), rndUnit(), (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 7
			end
			for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
				e.dir, e.axis, e.spin = rndOut(e.mid), rndUnit(), (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 11
			end
			for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
				n.dir = rndOut(n.pos)
			end
		end
		reseed()

		-- [v34] LOW END UI MODE: keep only the 4 translucent faces (8 wedges). The 6 neon edges and the 4 node
		-- balls are taken out of the ViewportFrame, so it renders 8 parts instead of 18. Turning the mode off puts
		-- them straight back (the parts are only un-parented, never destroyed).
		local lowApplied = false
		local function applyQuality(low)
			if low == lowApplied then return end
			lowApplied = low
			for _, ed in ipairs(edges) do
				ed.part.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
			end
			for _, nd in ipairs(nodes) do
				nd.part.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
			end
			core.Parent = (not low) and model or nil
		end

		-- ── optional segmented charge ring (the hold gauge) ──
		local RING_N = 40
		local ringHost, ringSegs = nil, {}
		if opts.Ring then
			ringHost = Util.Instance("Frame", layer)
			ringHost.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			ringHost.Position = opts.HitPos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			local rs = opts.RingSize or 190
			ringHost.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rs, rs)
			ringHost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ringHost.BorderSizePixel = 0
			ringHost.ZIndex = 4
			for i = 1, RING_N do
				local a = (i - 1) / RING_N * math.pi * 2 - math.pi / 2
				local s = Util.Instance("Frame", ringHost)
				s.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				s.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + math.cos(a) * 0.5, 0, 0.5 + math.sin(a) * 0.5, 0)
				s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
				s.Rotation = math.deg(a)
				s.BorderSizePixel = 0
				s.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
				s.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
				s.ZIndex = 4
				ringSegs[i] = s
			end
		end

		-- ── render the current state ──
		-- Lighting is computed per face from its real normal (lambert body, soft specular, glassy rim), edges are
		-- rounded cylinders, and everything is depth-cued (far parts thinner / dimmer) so the shape reads as 3D.
		local D = 2.3
		local LIGHT = Vector3.new(-0.45, 0.8, 0.55).Unit -- direction TO the light: upper left, in front
		local lastLow = nil
		local function draw(t)
			local low = CFG.LowEnd == true -- [v34]
			applyQuality(low)
			if low ~= lastLow then
				lastLow = low
				for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
					h.fr.Visible = not low
				end
			end
			local e = T.env + T.bloomEnv * 0.28
			local ae = math.min(1, math.abs(e))
			local S = math.max(0.001, T.scaleBase * T.popScale * (1 + T.pulseAmt) * (1 - 0.08 * T.pressAmt) * (1 + 0.07 * T.hoverAmt) * CFG.TriSize)
			local bob = low and 0 or math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.08 * (1 - ae) -- gentle float
			local roll = low and 0 or (0.05 * math.sin(t * 0.9) - T.trackX * 0.07) -- subtle sway + lean toward the cursor
			local M = CFrame.Angles(T.pitch + T.flipAngle, T.yaw, roll) + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)
			local sh = T.hot * T.hot * 0.07
			if sh > 0 and not low then
				M = M + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * sh * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * sh * 2, 0)
			end
			local spinMul = 1 + 0.5 * T.extra
			local th = (0.045 + T.hot * 0.05) * CFG.TriEdge
			local base = T.color
			local hue = (t * 0.8) % 1
			local fadeOut = e > 0 and math.min(1, e) * 0.12 or 0

			if not low then
				local glow = base:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2)
				local hs = S * (1 + 0.22 * T.hot + 0.5 * math.max(0, math.min(1, e)))
				for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
					local sz = math.min(h.k * hs, 1.6)
					h.fr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
					h.fr.BackgroundColor3 = glow
					h.fr.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(h.tr - T.hot * 0.08 - T.hoverAmt * 0.02, 0, 1)
				end
			end

			for i, f in ipairs(faces) do
				local rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(f.axis, f.spin * e * spinMul)
				local c = f.center
				local off = f.dir * (D * e)
				local p1 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[1] - c)) * S)
				local p2 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[2] - c)) * S)
				local p3 = M * ((c + off + rot * (f.v[3] - c)) * S)
				drawTri(p1, p2, p3, f.w1, f.w2, 0.03)
				local nv = M:VectorToWorldSpace(rot:VectorToWorldSpace(f.n))
				local lam = math.max(0, nv:Dot(LIGHT))
				local rim = 1 - math.abs(nv.Z)
				local col = base
				if T.prism > 0 and not low then
					col = Color3.fromHSV((hue + i * 0.22) % 1, 0.75, 1):Lerp(base, 1 - T.prism)
				end
				local k = 0.6 + 0.4 * lam
				col = Color3.new(col.R * k, col.G * k, col.B * k):Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, lam * lam * 0.4 + rim * 0.05 + T.hot * 0.5))
				local tr = CFG.TriFaces and math.clamp(CFG.TriFaceTr - T.hot * 0.22 + fadeOut - rim * 0.07, 0, 1) or 1
				f.w1.Color, f.w2.Color = col, col
				f.w1.Transparency, f.w2.Transparency = tr, tr
			end

			if low then return end -- [v34] low end: faces only, edges + nodes + core are not rendered

			local zr = S * 2.4 -- depth range used for depth cueing
			local edgeCol = WHITE:Lerp(base, 0.3 * (1 - T.hot))
			for _, ed in ipairs(edges) do
				local rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ed.axis, ed.spin * e * spinMul)
				local off = ed.dir * (D * e * 1.15)
				local a = M * ((ed.mid + off + rot * (ed.a - ed.mid)) * S)
				local b = M * ((ed.mid + off + rot * (ed.b - ed.mid)) * S)
				local len = (b - a).Magnitude
				local part = ed.part
				if len < 1e-3 then
					part.CFrame = FAR
				else
					local front = math.clamp(((a.Z + b.Z) * 0.5) / zr + 0.5, 0, 1)
					local w = th * (0.7 + 0.6 * front)
					part.Size = Vector3.new(len, w, w)
					part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- cylinder axis is X
					part.Color = edgeCol:Lerp(base, (1 - front) * 0.5)
					part.Transparency = (1 - front) * 0.3
				end
			end

			local nodeSize = 0.15 + T.hot * 0.12 + T.pulse * 0.06
			for _, nd in ipairs(nodes) do
				if CFG.TriNodes then
					local p = M * ((nd.pos + nd.dir * (D * e * 1.3)) * S)
					local front = math.clamp(p.Z / zr + 0.5, 0, 1)
					local ns = nodeSize * (0.8 + 0.4 * front)
					nd.part.Size = Vector3.new(ns, ns, ns)
					nd.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p)
					nd.part.Color = base:Lerp(WHITE, 0.45 + 0.4 * front)
				else
					nd.part.CFrame = FAR
				end
			end

			if CFG.TriFaces then
				local cs = math.clamp((0.3 + 0.1 * T.pulse + 0.18 * T.hot) * S * (1 - math.min(1, e)), 0.001, 1.5)
				core.Size = Vector3.new(cs, cs, cs)
				core.CFrame = CFrame.new(M.Position)
				core.Color = base:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, 0.55 + 0.3 * T.hot))
				core.Transparency = math.clamp(0.3 - T.hot * 0.2, 0, 1)
			else
				core.CFrame = FAR
			end
		end

		-- ── actions ──
		local function caption(name, n)
			if opts.OnAction then opts.OnAction(name, n) end
		end
		function T:Bloom()
			self.bloomT = 0
		end
		function T:PopIn()
			self.pop = 0
			self.popScale = 0.001
		end
		function T:Explode()
			if self.phase ~= "idle" then return end
			reseed()
			self.phase, self.phaseT = "explode", 0
			self.holding, self.holdT, self.charge = false, 0, 1
			FX.BlurPulse(11, 0.08, 0.9)
			FX.Play("boom")
			FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 320, 0.8, 4)
			FX.Ring(layer, WHITE, 200, 0.55, 2)
			FX.Sparks(layer, self.color, 22, 150, 0.9)
			caption("OVERLOAD", 0)
		end
		function T:Reformed()
			FX.Play("reform")
			FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.06, 0.5)
			FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 240, 0.7, 3)
			FX.Sparks(layer, WHITE, 14, 110, 0.7)
			self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 9
			self.pulse = 1
			caption("REFORMED", 0)
		end
		function T:Finale()
			self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 18
			self.pulse = 1
			FX.Ring(layer, self.color, 260, 0.7, 3)
			FX.Play("reform", 1.1)
		end
		function T:Click()
			if self.phase ~= "idle" then return end
			self.clickN = (self.clickN % 5) + 1
			local n = self.clickN
			local c = self.color
			if n == 1 then -- SPIN
				self.yawVel = self.yawVel + 15
				FX.Play("click", 1.25)
			elseif n == 2 then -- PULSE
				self.pulse = 1
				FX.Ring(layer, c, 180, 0.6, 3)
				FX.Play("click", 0.8)
			elseif n == 3 then -- FLIP
				self.flipT = 0
				FX.Play("hit", 0.9)
			elseif n == 4 then -- PRISM
				self.prism = 1
				FX.Sparks(layer, c, 16, 120, 0.8)
				FX.Play("hit", 1.5)
			else -- BLOOM
				self.bloomT = 0
				FX.Ring(layer, WHITE, 220, 0.7, 2)
				FX.Play("open", 1.2)
			end
			caption(ACTIONS[n], n)
		end

		-- ── per-frame simulation ──
		function T:Step(dt)
			if not self.active then return end
			local t = os.clock()
			self.color = FX.TriColor(t)

			local explodeHot = 0
			if self.phase == "explode" then
				self.phaseT = self.phaseT + dt
				self.env = easeOutCubic(math.min(1, self.phaseT / 0.85))
				self.extra = math.min(1, self.phaseT / 1.2)
				explodeHot = math.max(0, 1 - self.phaseT / 1.0) * 0.8
				if self.phaseT >= 1.15 then
					self.phase, self.phaseT = "reform", 0
				end
			elseif self.phase == "reform" then
				self.phaseT = self.phaseT + dt
				local u = math.min(1, self.phaseT / 1.1)
				self.env = 1 - easeOutBack(u)
				self.extra = 1 - u
				if u >= 1 then
					self.phase, self.env, self.extra = "idle", 0, 0
					self:Reformed()
				end
			end

			if self.holding and self.phase == "idle" and CFG.TriExplode then
				self.holdT = self.holdT + dt
				self.charge = math.min(1, self.holdT / 5)
				if self.holdT >= 5 then
					self:Explode()
				end
			else
				self.charge = math.max(0, self.charge - dt * 1.4)
			end

			if self.flipT then
				self.flipT = self.flipT + dt / 0.75
				if self.flipT >= 1 then
					self.flipBase = (self.flipBase + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2)
					self.flipT = nil
				end
			end
			self.flipAngle = self.flipBase + (self.flipT and easeOutBack(self.flipT) * math.pi or 0)

			self.pulse = math.max(0, self.pulse - dt * 1.8)
			self.pulseAmt = 0.3 * self.pulse * math.cos((1 - self.pulse) * math.pi * 3)
			self.prism = math.max(0, self.prism - dt / 2.2)
			if self.bloomT then
				self.bloomT = self.bloomT + dt / 0.9
				if self.bloomT >= 1 then
					self.bloomT, self.bloomEnv = nil, 0
				else
					self.bloomEnv = math.sin(self.bloomT * math.pi)
				end
			end
			if self.pop then
				self.pop = self.pop + dt / 0.8
				if self.pop >= 1 then
					self.pop, self.popScale = nil, 1
				else
					self.popScale = easeOutBack(self.pop)
				end
			end

			local pTarget = (self.holding and self.phase == "idle") and 1 or 0
			self.pressAmt = self.pressAmt + (pTarget - self.pressAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
			self.hoverAmt = self.hoverAmt + ((self.hover and 1 or 0) - self.hoverAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-9 * dt))
			if opts.Music and CFG.TriMusic and self.phase == "idle" then
				local pbl = opts.Music.PlaybackLoudness
				if pbl - self.lastLoud > 24 then
					self.pulse = math.max(self.pulse, 0.5)
				end
				self.lastLoud = pbl
			end
			self.hot = math.max(self.charge, self.chargeVis, self.pulse * 0.5, explodeHot, self.hoverAmt * 0.22)
			if opts.Track and self.phase == "idle" then
				local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
				local ap, as = layer.AbsolutePosition, layer.AbsoluteSize
				local tx = math.clamp((m.X - (ap.X + as.X * 0.5)) / 240, -1, 1)
				local ty = math.clamp((m.Y - (ap.Y + as.Y * 0.5)) / 160, -1, 1)
				self.trackX = self.trackX + (tx - self.trackX) * (1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
				self.trackY = self.trackY + (ty - self.trackY) * (1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
			end
			if not self.dragging then
				local spinTarget = self.baseSpin * CFG.TriSpin + self.trackX * 1.1
				self.yawVel = spinTarget + (self.yawVel - spinTarget) * math.exp(-1.5 * dt)
				self.yaw = self.yaw + self.yawVel * dt * (1 + self.hot * 2)
				local basePitch = 0.35 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 1.2) + self.trackY * 0.45
				self.pitch = self.pitch + (basePitch - self.pitch) * (1 - math.exp(-1.5 * dt))
			end
			local lowRing = CFG.LowEnd == true -- [v34] low end: the 40-segment hold gauge is hidden and not updated
			if ringHost and ringHost.Visible == lowRing then
				ringHost.Visible = not lowRing
			end
			if ringHost and not lowRing then
				ringHost.Rotation = (t * (6 + self.hot * 40)) % 360
				local lit = math.floor(self.charge * RING_N + 0.5)
				if self.phase ~= "idle" then lit = RING_N end
				local litCol = self.color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3 + self.hot * 0.4)
				for i = 1, RING_N do
					local seg = ringSegs[i]
					if i <= lit then
						seg.BackgroundColor3 = litCol
						seg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
						seg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
					else
						seg.BackgroundColor3 = self.color
						seg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88 - self.hoverAmt * 0.3
						seg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2)
					end
				end
			end
			draw(t)
		end

		-- ── input (drag / click / hold) ──
		-- FIXED: the hit-button used to sit under an Interactable=false layer (dead input), and the hold
		-- was cancelled by accumulated mouse PATH LENGTH (normal hand jitter killed the 5s charge).
		-- Now the drag deadzone is NET displacement and each press is tracked by its input object.
		if opts.Interactive then
			local hit = Util.Instance("TextButton", layer)
			hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			hit.Position = opts.HitPos or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			hit.Size = opts.HitSize or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			hit.BorderSizePixel = 0
			hit.Text = ""
			hit.AutoButtonColor = false
			hit.Active = true
			hit.Selectable = false
			hit.ZIndex = 20
			T.Hit = hit
			local press = {down = false, t0 = 0, disp = Vector2.zero, moved = false, input = nil}
			local DEADZONE = 28

			local function samePress(input)
				if not press.input then return false end
				if input == press.input then return true end
				return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and press.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			end
			local function endPress(cancel)
				if not press.down then return end
				press.down = false
				local dur = os.clock() - press.t0
				local wasHold = T.holdT
				T.dragging = false
				T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0
				FX.TriangleDown = false
				FX.TriangleLast = os.clock()
				if cancel or T.phase ~= "idle" then return end
				if not press.moved and dur < 0.6 then
					T:Click()
				elseif not press.moved and wasHold > 0.6 then
					-- released a charge early: fizzle so the player knows it needs the full 5s
					FX.Play("release", 0.8)
					FX.Ring(layer, T.color, 120, 0.4, 2, opts.HitPos)
					caption("HOLD LONGER", 0)
				end
			end

			hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not isPress(input) or press.down then return end
				if T.phase ~= "idle" then return end
				press.down, press.t0, press.disp, press.moved, press.input = true, os.clock(), Vector2.zero, false, input
				T.holding, T.holdT = true, 0
				FX.TriangleDown = true
				FX.TriangleLast = os.clock()
				FX.Play("tick", 0.9)
			end)
			hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				T.hover = true
				T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse, 0.3) -- tiny springy "boing" when the cursor lands on it
			end)
			hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				T.hover = false
			end)
			conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not press.down then return end
				local ty = input.UserInputType
				if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
				if ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input ~= press.input then return end
				local d = input.Delta
				press.disp = press.disp + Vector2.new(d.X, d.Y)
				if not press.moved and press.disp.Magnitude > DEADZONE then
					press.moved = true
					T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0 -- a real drag cancels the hold
				end
				if press.moved and T.phase == "idle" then
					T.dragging = true
					T.yaw = T.yaw + d.X * 0.012
					T.pitch = math.clamp(T.pitch + d.Y * 0.012, -1.3, 1.3)
					T.yawVel = math.clamp(d.X * 0.6, -16, 16)
				end
			end)
			conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if press.down and samePress(input) then
					endPress(false)
				end
			end)
			-- safety net: losing window focus mid-press must never leave the hold stuck
			conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
				endPress(true)
			end)
		end

		function T:SetActive(a)
			self.active = a
			vp.Visible = a
			if ringHost then ringHost.Visible = a end
			for _, h in ipairs(halo) do
				h.fr.Visible = a and CFG.LowEnd ~= true
			end
			if not a then
				self.holding, self.holdT, self.charge = false, 0, 0
				self.hover = false
			end
		end
		function T:Destroy()
			for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
				c:Disconnect()
			end
			FX.TriangleDown = false
			layer:Destroy()
		end

		local lowAcc = 0
		conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if opts.IsVisible and not opts.IsVisible() then
				if T.holding then T.holding, T.holdT = false, 0 end
				return
			end
			-- [v34] low end: simulate + redraw at a capped rate (default 30 fps) instead of every frame
			if CFG.LowEnd == true then
				lowAcc = lowAcc + dt
				if lowAcc < 1 / FX.LowEndTriFPS then return end
				dt, lowAcc = lowAcc, 0
			else
				lowAcc = 0
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(T.Step, T, dt)
			if not ok then
				T.active = false
				warn("[UhhhhhhFX] triangle disabled: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)
		return T
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ BUTTON FX ═════════════════════════
	-- [v40] UI POLISH: shared "skin" helpers. One light Heartbeat loop (10 Hz, 2.5 Hz in low end) keeps every
	-- decorative rounded corner in sync with the Corner Roundness setting and tints the 3D button lips with the
	-- live accent colour. It is created on first use and entries are dropped when their instances are destroyed.
	local Skin = {corners = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), lips = {}, conn = nil, round = nil, acc = 0}
	local function skinTick(dt)
		Skin.acc = Skin.acc + dt
		if Skin.acc < (RawCfg.LowEnd == true and 0.4 or 0.1) then return end
		Skin.acc = 0
		local round = FX.Cfg.UIRound
		if round ~= Skin.round then
			Skin.round = round
			for c, d in pairs(Skin.corners) do
				if c.Parent then
					c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(0, round + d))
				else
					Skin.corners[c] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		for lip, paint in pairs(Skin.lips) do
			if lip.Parent then
				paint()
			else
				Skin.lips[lip] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	local function skinStart()
		if not Skin.conn then
			Skin.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(skinTick)
		end
	end
	-- a UICorner that follows the Corner Roundness setting (delta = pixels added to the global radius)
	function FX.RoundCorner(frame, delta)
		delta = delta or 0
		local c = Util.Instance("UICorner", frame)
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound + delta))
		Skin.corners[c] = delta
		skinStart()
		return c
	end
	-- glossy bevel inside a stylized frame: top highlight, hairline rim light, soft bottom shade.
	-- Sits behind the label (ZIndex 0). Returns the gloss + shade frames so callers can animate them.
	function FX.Bevel(b)
		local host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
		host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		host.BorderSizePixel = 0
		host.ZIndex = 0
		host.ClipsDescendants = true
		host.Interactable = false
		FX.RoundCorner(host)
		local gloss = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		gloss.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.52)
		gloss.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84
		gloss.BorderSizePixel = 0
		gloss.Interactable = false
		local gg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", gloss)
		gg.Rotation = 90
		gg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		local rim = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		rim.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		rim.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 1)
		rim.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 1)
		rim.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		rim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
		rim.BorderSizePixel = 0
		rim.Interactable = false
		local shade = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		shade.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		shade.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		shade.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.42)
		shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		shade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
		shade.BorderSizePixel = 0
		shade.Interactable = false
		local sg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", shade)
		sg.Rotation = 90
		sg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
		return gloss, shade
	end

	local rippleHosts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local btnScale = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local function ripple(b, input)
		local host = rippleHosts[b]
		if not host or not host.Parent then
			host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
			host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			host.BorderSizePixel = 0
			host.ZIndex = 0
			host.ClipsDescendants = true
			host.Interactable = false
			FX.RoundCorner(host)
			rippleHosts[b] = host
		end
		local mp
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			mp = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		else
			mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		end
		local rel = mp - host.AbsolutePosition
		local c = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(rel.X, 0, host.AbsoluteSize.X), math.clamp(rel.Y, 0, host.AbsoluteSize.Y))
		c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		c.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
		c.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
		c.BorderSizePixel = 0
		c.Interactable = false
		Util.Instance("UICorner", c).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local big = math.max(host.AbsoluteSize.X, 60) * 2.2
		tween(c, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(big, big), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		Debris:AddItem(c, 0.6)
	end
	local sheenFns = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	function FX.Sheen(b)
		local f = sheenFns[b]
		if f then f() end
	end
	-- staggered pop-in + light-sweep across the first buttons of a page as it enters (v30: bubbly pop)
	function FX.Cascade(page, onlyVisible)
		if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
		local n = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("TextButton") and d:GetAttribute("FXB") and (not onlyVisible or Util.IsGuiVisible(d)) then
				n = n + 1
				if n > 14 then break end
				local sc = btnScale[d]
				if sc and sc.Parent then
					sc.Scale = 0.001
				end
				-- [v41] accelerating stagger (the gaps shrink) + alternating twist that untwists: snap-open, no wobble
				local tilt = (n % 2 == 0) and 2.5 or -2.5
				task.delay(0.08 + 0.36 * (1 - 0.86 ^ n), function()
					if sc and sc.Parent then
						d.Rotation = tilt
						tween(sc, 0.42, FX.Expo, EOut, {Scale = 1})
						tween(d, 0.5, FX.Expo, EOut, {Rotation = 0})
					end
					FX.Sheen(d)
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	function FX.EnhanceButton(b)
		if b:GetAttribute("FXB") then return end
		b:SetAttribute("FXB", true)
		local container = b.Parent
		local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", b)
		local stroke = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		local hover, down = false, false

		-- [v41] REGISTER LOCK on press: an accent outline is knocked out of register, release snaps it home (Expo)
		local echo
		local function echoKnock()
			if echo or RawCfg.LowEnd == true then return end
			echo = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
			echo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			echo.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, -3)
			echo.BackgroundTransparency, echo.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
			echo.ZIndex, echo.Interactable = b.ZIndex + 3, false
			local bc = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			Util.Instance("UICorner", echo).CornerRadius = bc and bc.CornerRadius or UDim.new(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound)
			local es = Util.Instance("UIStroke", echo)
			es.Color, es.Thickness, es.Transparency = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE, 1.5, 0.25
		end
		local function echoSnap()
			local e = echo
			if not e then return end
			echo = nil
			tween(e, 0.26, FX.Expo, EOut, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)})
			local es = e:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if es then tween(es, 0.3, Quad, EIn, {Transparency = 1}) end
			Debris:AddItem(e, 0.4)
		end

		-- scale / tilt around the button's centre (the layout default anchors it top-left, which made it grow sideways)
		if b.AnchorPoint == Vector2.zero and b.Size.X.Scale == 1 and b.Position.X.Scale == 0 then
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local basePos = b.Position

		-- depth: soft vertical gradient (multiplies the themed colour; the label is a child so it is unaffected)
		local depth = Util.Instance("UIGradient", b)
		depth.Rotation = 90
		depth.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205))

		-- 3D slab: an accent-tinted lip under the face (sibling behind the button), glossy bevel on the face
		local lip, lipSc, lipK = nil, nil, 0.6
		if container and container:IsA("GuiObject") then
			lip = Util.Instance("Frame", container)
			lip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			lip.Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
			lip.Size = b.Size + UDim2.fromOffset(-2, 0)
			lip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			lip.BorderSizePixel = 0
			lip.ZIndex = b.ZIndex - 1
			lip.Interactable = false
			lip.Visible = b.Visible
			FX.RoundCorner(lip)
			lipSc = Util.Instance("UIScale", lip)
			Util.LinkDestroyI2I(b, lip)
			local function paintLip()
				lip.BackgroundColor3 = (stroke and stroke.Color or WHITE):Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lipK)
			end
			paintLip()
			Skin.lips[lip] = paintLip
			skinStart()
			-- the lip follows every scale / tilt / visibility change of the face (hover, press, page pop-in cascade...)
			sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
				lipSc.Scale = sc.Scale
			end)
			b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Rotation"):Connect(function()
				lip.Rotation = b.Rotation
			end)
			b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				lip.Visible = b.Visible
			end)
		end
		local gloss, shade = FX.Bevel(b)

		-- lazily built: diagonal light streak + accent edge bar
		local rec = nil
		local function getRec()
			if rec and rec.host.Parent then return rec end
			local host = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
			host.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			host.BorderSizePixel = 0
			host.ZIndex = 0
			host.ClipsDescendants = true
			host.Interactable = false
			FX.RoundCorner(host)
			local streak = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
			streak.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			streak.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
			streak.BorderSizePixel = 0
			streak.Interactable = false
			local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", streak)
			g.Rotation = 25
			g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.72),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
			g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
			local bar = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
			bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			bar.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
			bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 0)
			bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
			bar.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
			bar.Interactable = false
			rec = {host = host, grad = g, bar = bar}
			return rec
		end
		local function sheen()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			local r = getRec()
			r.grad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
			tween(r.grad, 0.6, Quad, EOut, {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)})
		end
		sheenFns[b] = function()
			pcall(sheen)
		end

		btnScale[b] = sc
		-- [v30] BUBBLY MOTION + [v40] 3D: hover lifts the face and overshoots, press compresses it onto the lip,
		-- release springs back elastic. The tilt is deliberately small so the lip stays visually glued to the face.
		local function refresh(style, time)
			local s, rot, lift = 1, 0, 0
			if down then
				s, rot, lift = 0.95, 0.5, 2.5
			elseif hover then
				s, rot, lift = 1.045, -0.7, -1.5
			end
			tween(sc, time, style, EOut, {Scale = s})
			tween(b, time, style, EOut, {Rotation = rot, Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, lift)})
			if lip then
				tween(lip, time, style, EOut, {Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3 + ((hover and not down) and 1 or 0))})
				lipK = down and 0.5 or (hover and 0.3 or 0.6)
				lip.BackgroundColor3 = (stroke and stroke.Color or WHITE):Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), lipK)
			end
			tween(gloss, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.93 or (hover and 0.72 or 0.84)})
			tween(shade, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.6 or 0.78})
		end
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			hover = true
			refresh(Back, 0.24)
			if stroke then tween(stroke, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 2}) end
			local r = getRec()
			r.bar.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
			tween(r.bar, 0.28, Back, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -8)})
			sheen()
			FX.Play("tick")
		end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not hover and not down then return end -- [v34] low end: no hover animation was started
			hover, down = false, false
			echoSnap()
			refresh(Back, 0.32)
			if stroke then tween(stroke, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 1}) end
			if rec then tween(rec.bar, 0.18, Quad, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 0)}) end
		end)
		b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			down = true
			refresh(Quad, 0.07)
			echoKnock()
			ripple(b, input)
			FX.Ring(b, FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE, 52, 0.35, 2)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sheen() end
		end)
		b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not down then return end
			down = false
			echoSnap()
			refresh(RawCfg.LowEnd == true and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, RawCfg.LowEnd == true and 0.1 or 0.55) -- [v34] low end: plain quick release
			FX.Play("release")
		end)
	end

	-- [v40] toggles: glossy bead that pops in / shrinks out with overshoot, squishy hover + press on the box.
	-- hit = the full-row button, sw = the toggle box, dot = the "on" bead, lever = the BoolValue.
	function FX.EnhanceSwitch(hit, sw, dot, lever)
		if sw:GetAttribute("FXS") then return end
		sw:SetAttribute("FXS", true)
		-- scale around the centre instead of the right edge
		if sw.AnchorPoint == Vector2.new(1, 0.5) then
			sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			sw.Position = UDim2.new(sw.Position.X.Scale, math.floor(sw.Position.X.Offset - sw.Size.X.Offset / 2), sw.Position.Y.Scale, sw.Position.Y.Offset)
		end
		local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", sw)
		local dsc = Util.Instance("UIScale", dot)

		-- box: soft top shine; bead: round, shaded, with a glint
		local shine = Util.Instance("Frame", sw)
		shine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		shine.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2)
		shine.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.4, 0)
		shine.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		shine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
		shine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		shine.ZIndex = 0
		shine.Interactable = false
		FX.RoundCorner(shine, -3)
		local sgr = Util.Instance("UIGradient", shine)
		sgr.Rotation = 90
		sgr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})

		dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15)
		local dc = dot:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if dc then dc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0) end
		local bead = Util.Instance("UIGradient", dot)
		bead.Rotation = 90
		bead.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190))
		local glint = Util.Instance("Frame", dot)
		glint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		glint.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.3)
		glint.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.26)
		glint.Rotation = -25
		glint.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		glint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
		glint.BorderSizePixel = 0
		glint.Interactable = false
		Util.Instance("UICorner", glint).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

		local token = 0
		lever.Changed:Connect(function()
			token = token + 1
			local my = token
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then
				dsc.Scale = 1
				return
			end
			if lever.Value then
				dot.Visible = true
				dsc.Scale = 0.15
				tween(dsc, 0.34, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1})
				FX.Ring(sw, FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE, 38, 0.4, 2)
				FX.Play("tick", 1.3)
			else
				-- the original handler hides the bead instantly; keep it visible while it shrinks away
				task.defer(function()
					if my == token then dot.Visible = true end
				end)
				tween(dsc, 0.18, Quad, EIn, {Scale = 0.01})
				task.delay(0.2, function()
					if my == token and not lever.Value then
						dot.Visible = false
						dsc.Scale = 1
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		local hov, dn = false, false
		local function squish(style, time)
			tween(sc, time, style, EOut, {Scale = dn and 0.86 or (hov and 1.1 or 1)})
		end
		hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			hov = true
			squish(Back, 0.22)
		end)
		hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if not hov and not dn then return end
			hov, dn = false, false
			squish(Back, 0.3)
		end)
		hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			dn = true
			squish(Quad, 0.07)
		end)
		hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not dn then return end
			dn = false
			squish(RawCfg.LowEnd == true and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, RawCfg.LowEnd == true and 0.1 or 0.5)
		end)
	end

	-- [v40] slider knob: shaded bead with a glint that grows when grabbed and springs back on release.
	-- track = the full-width drag button, knob = the handle frame (already centred on its anchor).
	function FX.EnhanceKnob(track, knob)
		if knob:GetAttribute("FXK") then return end
		knob:SetAttribute("FXK", true)
		local sc = Util.Instance("UIScale", knob)
		local bead = Util.Instance("UIGradient", knob)
		bead.Rotation = 90
		bead.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(195, 195, 195))
		local glint = Util.Instance("Frame", knob)
		glint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		glint.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.36, 0.3)
		glint.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.24)
		glint.Rotation = -25
		glint.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		glint.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
		glint.BorderSizePixel = 0
		glint.Interactable = false
		Util.Instance("UICorner", glint).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local hov, dn = false, false
		local function grow(style, time)
			tween(sc, time, style, EOut, {Scale = dn and 1.3 or (hov and 1.15 or 1)})
		end
		track.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			hov = true
			grow(Back, 0.2)
		end)
		track.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if not hov then return end
			hov = false
			if not dn then grow(Back, 0.25) end
		end)
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			dn = true
			grow(Back, 0.15)
		end)
		-- released anywhere (the drag keeps going outside the track)
		local conn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not dn or not isPress(input) then return end
			dn = false
			grow(RawCfg.LowEnd == true and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, RawCfg.LowEnd == true and 0.1 or 0.5)
		end)
		knob.Destroying:Once(function()
			conn:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	-- [v40] text fields: soft inner gloss + a springy focus glow (border thickens, gloss brightens).
	function FX.EnhanceField(box, tb)
		if box:GetAttribute("FXF") then return end
		box:SetAttribute("FXF", true)
		local stroke = box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		local gloss = FX.Bevel(box)
		gloss.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
		tb.Focused:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			if stroke then tween(stroke, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Thickness = math.max(2, FX.Cfg.UIBorder + 1)}) end
			tween(gloss, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.8})
		end)
		tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			if stroke then tween(stroke, 0.25, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = FX.Cfg.UIBorder}) end -- UpdateGrads only re-syncs on change
			tween(gloss, 0.25, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92})
		end)
	end

	-- [v40] dropdown list rows: soft hover / press highlight (white veil above the themed row colour)
	function FX.EnhanceItem(item)
		if item:GetAttribute("FXI") then return end
		item:SetAttribute("FXI", true)
		local hl = Util.Instance("Frame", item)
		hl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hl.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hl.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hl.Interactable = false
		local hover = false
		item.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			hover = true
			tween(hl, 0.12, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.88})
			FX.Play("tick", 1.2)
		end)
		item.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hover = false
			tween(hl, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end)
		item.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			tween(hl, 0.06, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.78})
		end)
		item.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) then return end
			tween(hl, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = hover and 0.88 or 1})
		end)
		-- the list hides without a MouseLeave: clear the veil so it never reopens stuck highlighted
		local list = item.Parent
		if list then
			list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				if not list.Visible then
					hover = false
					hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- [v40] lighter treatment for buttons whose anchor / size is managed elsewhere (dropdown selector):
	-- glossy bevel + depth gradient, hover tilt + lift, press dip. Position / Rotation only, so layout code is unaffected.
	function FX.EnhanceLite(b)
		if b:GetAttribute("FXL") then return end
		b:SetAttribute("FXL", true)
		local depth = Util.Instance("UIGradient", b)
		depth.Rotation = 90
		depth.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205))
		local gloss, shade = FX.Bevel(b)
		local basePos = b.Position
		local hover, down = false, false
		local function refresh(style, time)
			local rot, lift = 0, 0
			if down then
				rot, lift = 0.4, 1.5
			elseif hover then
				rot, lift = -0.7, -1
			end
			tween(b, time, style, EOut, {Rotation = rot, Position = basePos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, lift)})
			tween(gloss, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.93 or (hover and 0.72 or 0.84)})
			tween(shade, time, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = down and 0.6 or 0.78})
		end
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			hover = true
			refresh(Back, 0.22)
			FX.Play("tick", 1.1)
		end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if not hover and not down then return end
			hover, down = false, false
			refresh(Back, 0.3)
		end)
		b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not FX.Settings.Transitions then return end
			down = true
			refresh(Quad, 0.07)
		end)
		b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) or not down then return end
			down = false
			refresh(RawCfg.LowEnd == true and Quad or Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, RawCfg.LowEnd == true and 0.1 or 0.5)
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ PAGE TRANSITIONS ═════════════════════════
	local CENTER = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	local PageStyle = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local Rigs = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local Active = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local styleOrder = {1, 7, 3, 9, 4, 8, 5, 10, 6, 2, 11, 13, 12, 15, 14}
	local styleCount = 0
	local veil, veilToken = nil, 0

	local function assignStyle(page, forced)
		if forced then
			PageStyle[page] = forced
			return forced
		end
		styleCount = styleCount + 1
		local s = styleOrder[(styleCount - 1) % #styleOrder + 1]
		PageStyle[page] = s
		return s
	end
	local function getRig(page)
		local r = Rigs[page]
		if r and r.scale.Parent then return r end
		r = {scale = Util.Instance("UIScale", page)}
		r.scale.Scale = 1
		Rigs[page] = r
		return r
	end
	local function resetVeilGeometry()
		if not veil then return end
		veil.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		veil.Position = CENTER
		veil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	end
	local function getVeil()
		if not veil or not veil.Parent then
			veil = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
			veil.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			veil.BorderSizePixel = 0
			veil.ZIndex = 100
			veil.Interactable = false
			veil.Active = false
			FX.VeilInstance = veil
			resetVeilGeometry()
		end
		veil.BackgroundColor3 = FX.GetBG and FX.GetBG() or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		return veil
	end

	local Styles = {}
	-- 1 · SLIDE+ : quint slide with a soft flash
	Styles[1] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			tween(R.veil, 0.5, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			tween(page, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Position = goal})
			task.wait(0.55)
		else
			tween(R.veil, 0.4, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.6})
			tween(page, 0.42, Quint, EIn, {Position = goal})
			task.wait(0.42)
			tween(R.veil, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	-- 2 · ZOOM : push-in / pull-out
	Styles[2] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			R.scale.Scale = 1.28
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			tween(R.scale, 0.55, Quint, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			tween(R.veil, 0.5, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			task.wait(0.55)
		else
			tween(R.scale, 0.4, Quint, EIn, {Scale = 0.72})
			tween(R.veil, 0.38, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
			task.wait(0.4)
			if not R.alive() then return end
			page.Position = goal
			R.scale.Scale = 1
			tween(R.veil, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	-- 3 · DROP : falls in with a bounce, drops out
	Styles[3] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal + UDim2.fromOffset(0, -260)
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
			tween(R.veil, 0.5, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			tween(page, 0.7, Bounce, EOut, {Position = goal})
			task.wait(0.7)
		else
			tween(page, 0.4, Back, EIn, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 260)})
			tween(R.veil, 0.38, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.5})
			task.wait(0.4)
			if not R.alive() then return end
			page.Position = goal
			tween(R.veil, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	-- 4 · SPIN : tilt + scale with overshoot
	Styles[4] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			page.Rotation = -14
			R.scale.Scale = 0.8
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
			tween(page, 0.6, Back, EOut, {Rotation = 0})
			tween(R.scale, 0.6, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			tween(R.veil, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			task.wait(0.6)
		else
			tween(page, 0.4, Quad, EIn, {Rotation = 16})
			tween(R.scale, 0.4, Quad, EIn, {Scale = 0.7})
			tween(R.veil, 0.38, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
			task.wait(0.4)
			if not R.alive() then return end
			page.Position = goal
			page.Rotation = 0
			R.scale.Scale = 1
			tween(R.veil, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	-- 5 · GLITCH : jitter + flicker, then settle
	Styles[5] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			for i = 1, 7 do
				if not R.alive() then return end
				page.Position = goal + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-22, 22), math.random(-3, 3))
				page.Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4
				R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = (i % 2 == 0) and 0.2 or 0.85
				task.wait(0.04)
			end
			page.Rotation = 0
			tween(page, 0.18, Quint, EOut, {Position = goal})
			tween(R.veil, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			task.wait(0.2)
		else
			for i = 1, 5 do
				if not R.alive() then return end
				page.Position = CENTER + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-26, 26), math.random(-3, 3))
				page.Rotation = (math.random() - 0.5) * 3
				R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85 - i * 0.14
				task.wait(0.045)
			end
			page.Position = goal
			page.Rotation = 0
			tween(R.veil, 0.16, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end
	-- 6 · CURTAIN : wipe reveal / wipe cover
	Styles[6] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		local v = R.veil
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5)
			v.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			tween(v, 0.55, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)})
			task.wait(0.55)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		else
			v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
			v.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			tween(v, 0.4, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
			task.wait(0.4)
			if not R.alive() then return end
			page.Position = goal
			tween(v, 0.18, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end

	-- ── helpers for the multi-piece transitions ──
	local function bgColor()
		return FX.GetBG and FX.GetBG() or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local function accentColor()
		return FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
	end
	local function dropCells(cells)
		for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
			tween(c, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			Debris:AddItem(c, 0.3)
		end
	end
	local function makeGrid(cols, rows, startTransparency)
		local cells = {}
		local bg = bgColor()
		for y = 0, rows - 1 do
			for x = 0, cols - 1 do
				local c = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
				c.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x / cols, y / rows)
				c.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / cols + 0.003, 1 / rows + 0.003)
				c.BackgroundColor3 = bg
				c.BackgroundTransparency = startTransparency
				c.BorderSizePixel = 0
				c.ZIndex = 100
				c.Interactable = false
				cells[#cells + 1] = c
				Debris:AddItem(c, 2)
			end
		end
		return cells
	end

	-- 7 · BLINDS : venetian slats snap shut / open (NEW)
	Styles[7] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		local N = 8
		local full = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0)
		local none = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		local slats = {}
		local bg = bgColor()
		for i = 1, N do
			local s = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
			s.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, (i - 1) / N)
			s.Size = entering and full or none
			s.BackgroundColor3 = bg
			s.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			s.BorderSizePixel = 0
			s.ZIndex = 100
			s.Interactable = false
			slats[i] = s
			Debris:AddItem(s, 2)
		end
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			for i, s in ipairs(slats) do
				task.delay((i - 1) * 0.04, function()
					tween(s, 0.3, Quad, EOut, {Size = none})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.3 + N * 0.04)
		else
			for i, s in ipairs(slats) do
				task.delay((i - 1) * 0.03, function()
					tween(s, 0.22, Quad, EIn, {Size = full})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.22 + N * 0.03)
			if not R.alive() then
				dropCells(slats)
				return
			end
			page.Position = goal
			dropCells(slats)
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end

	-- 8 · PIXEL DISSOLVE : a grid of tiles flickers in / out in random order (NEW)
	Styles[8] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		local cells = makeGrid(8, 5, entering and 0 or 1)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
				task.delay(math.random() * 0.32, function()
					tween(c, 0.2, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.55)
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
				task.delay(math.random() * 0.22, function()
					tween(c, 0.16, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.42)
			if not R.alive() then
				dropCells(cells)
				return
			end
			page.Position = goal
			for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
				task.delay(math.random() * 0.12, function()
					tween(c, 0.16, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.3)
		end
	end

	-- 9 · ELASTIC : springy slide-in, snappy back-ease out (NEW)
	Styles[9] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal + UDim2.fromOffset(380, 0)
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
			tween(R.veil, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			tween(page, 0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Position = goal})
			task.wait(0.85)
		else
			tween(R.veil, 0.35, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.5})
			tween(page, 0.38, Back, EIn, {Position = goal})
			task.wait(0.38)
			tween(R.veil, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end

	-- 10 · SCAN SWEEP : a bright scan line wipes the page in / out (NEW)
	Styles[10] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		local v = R.veil
		local line = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor()
		line.ZIndex = 101
		line.Interactable = false
		Debris:AddItem(line, 1.2)
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
			v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
			v.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			tween(v, 0.6, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)})
			tween(line, 0.6, Quint, EInOut, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)})
			task.wait(0.6)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			tween(line, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		else
			v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
			v.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
			v.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			tween(v, 0.4, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
			tween(line, 0.4, Quint, EInOut, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)})
			task.wait(0.4)
			if not R.alive() then
				line:Destroy()
				return
			end
			page.Position = goal
			tween(line, 0.15, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			tween(v, 0.18, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
		end
	end

	-- 15 · WAVE : strips ripple away top-to-bottom, then ripple back (NEW v30)
	Styles[15] = function(page, entering, goal, R)
		local N = 7
		local bg = bgColor()
		local strips = {}
		for i = 1, N do
			local s = Util.Instance("Frame", FX.Content)
			s.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			s.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, (i - 1) / N, 0)
			s.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0)
			s.BackgroundColor3 = bg
			s.BackgroundTransparency = entering and 0 or 1
			s.BorderSizePixel = 0
			s.ZIndex = 100
			s.Interactable = false
			strips[i] = s
			Debris:AddItem(s, 2)
		end
		if entering then
			page.Position = goal
			for i, s in ipairs(strips) do
				task.delay((i - 1) * 0.05, function()
					tween(s, 0.34, Quint, EInOut, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(0.001, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0),
					})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.34 + N * 0.05)
		else
			for i, s in ipairs(strips) do
				s.Size = UDim2.new(0.001, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0)
				task.delay((i - 1) * 0.04, function()
					tween(s, 0.26, Quint, EInOut, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 0,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 / N + 0.004, 0),
					})
				end)
			end
			task.wait(0.26 + N * 0.04)
			if not R.alive() then
				dropCells(strips)
				return
			end
			page.Position = goal
			dropCells(strips)
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end

	-- Tween-like handle so the script's  tween:Play() / tween.Completed:Connect()  keep working
	local function pageTween(page, props)
		local goal = props.Position
		local entering = goal.X.Offset == 0 and goal.Y.Offset == 0
		local styleId = PageStyle[page] or assignStyle(page)
		local handle = {PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Begin}
		local done = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
		handle.Completed = done.Event
		local started, cancelled = false, false

		local function run()
			local token = (Active[page] or 0) + 1
			Active[page] = token
			local rig = getRig(page)
			local R = {scale = rig.scale, veil = getVeil()}
			R.alive = function()
				return Active[page] == token and not cancelled
			end
			veilToken = veilToken + 1
			local myVeil = veilToken
			resetVeilGeometry()
			R.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			FX.BlurPulse(entering and 7 or 5, 0.14, 0.5)
			FX.Play(entering and "open" or "back")
			if entering then pcall(FX.Cascade, page) end
			local ok, err = pcall(Styles[styleId] or Styles[1], page, entering, goal, R)
			if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] transition error: " .. tostring(err)) end
			if not R.alive() then return false end
			page.Position = goal
			page.Rotation = 0
			R.scale.Scale = 1
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				if veilToken == myVeil then
					resetVeilGeometry()
				end
			end)
			return true
		end
		function handle:Play()
			if started then return end
			started = true
			self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
			task.defer(function()
				local completed = run()
				if completed and not cancelled then
					self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
					done:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Completed)
				end
			end)
		end
		function handle:Cancel()
			cancelled = true
			self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
		end
		function handle:Pause() end
		function handle:Destroy()
			cancelled = true
		end
		return handle
	end

	-- replace the script's TweenService with a proxy that upgrades page transitions
	local Proxy = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			local v = RealTweenService[k]
			if type(v) == "function" then
				return function(_, ...)
					return v(RealTweenService, ...)
				end
			end
			return v
		end,
	})
	function Proxy.Create(_, obj, info, props)
		if props and typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
			if FX.Settings.Transitions and FX.Content and props.Position and next(props, (next(props))) == nil
				and obj.Parent == FX.Content and obj ~= FX.VeilInstance then
				return pageTween(obj, props)
			end
			if obj == FX.Window then
				FX.BlurPulse(6, 0.12, 0.5)
				local small = props.Size and props.Size.X.Offset < 200
				FX.Play(small and "close" or "open")
			end
		end
		return RealTweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
	end
	TweenService = Proxy

	-- ═════════════════════════ REMASTERED INTRO ═════════════════════════
	local NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE"

	local function glyphs(n)
		local s = ""
		for _ = 1, n do
			local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
			s = s .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
		end
		return s
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ REMASTERED INTRO v4 : 60 SECOND ACTION-MOVIE OPENING ═════════════════════════
	-- Locked to the theme song (measured: 126.02 BPM, bar = 1.905 s, first downbeat 0.18 s, the drop lands on bar 4).
	-- Acts (seconds into the song):
	--   0-4 COLD OPEN (slow push-in)  |  4-15.4 AWAKEN (crane + dutch build, DROP slam at 7.8, orbit)
	--   15.4-28.8 THE CREATOR (7 cards, one camera shot / cut per bar)  |  28.8-40.2 THE CREW (tracking shots + whip pans)
	--   40.2-53.5 CHAOS DROP (rapid cuts on the beat)  |  53.5-61.1 TITLE (extreme push-in, FINAL REVEAL at 57.3, READY 59.2, hand-off flash peaks on the bar-32 downbeat at 61.1)
	-- Groove: kick on every beat, clap on beats 2 + 4 (zoom hit); phrase hits at 23.0 s (new layer) and 38.3 s (lift).
	-- The "camera" is virtual: ONE controller moves / zooms / rolls the intro's own `world` layer (pan, push-in, dutch,
	-- orbit, cuts). It never touches workspace.CurrentCamera, so there is no game camera to fight with or restore.
	-- Beat engine: with the theme song the cinematic clock is locked to Sound.TimePosition and the beat grid is exact.
	-- With any other track it is audio-reactive (PlaybackLoudness onsets, 128 BPM metronome fallback). Never blocks the
	-- UI: it is run from its own thread and has a SKIP button (top right) that jumps straight to the UI.
	FX.IntroActive = false
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false -- one cinematic camera controller at a time
	FX.IntroLength = 0.18 + 32 * 4 * 60 / 126.02 -- [v50] the hand-off flash peaks on the bar-32 downbeat (61.12 s)
	FX.IntroData = {
