	function FX.Intro(MainFrame, Music, marquee, opts)
		if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end -- [v48] never run two cinematic camera controllers at once
		FX.IntroCamBusy = true
		opts = opts or {}
		local CFG = FX.Cfg
		local DATA = FX.IntroData
		local DUR = FX.IntroLength
		local INTENSITY = CFG.IntroIntensity or 1
		local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20)
		if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
		local CREATOR = "STEVETHEREALONE"
		local began = os.clock()
		local wall0 = os.clock() -- wall-clock failsafe: the intro can never outlive its length even if the audio stalls
		local conns, E = {}, {}
		FX.IntroActive = true

		-- ── small helpers ──
		local function clamp01(x)
			return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
		end
		local function lerp(a, b, k)
			return a + (b - a) * k
		end
		local function accent(speed)
			if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
				return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
			elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
				return WHITE
			elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
				return Util.Color.Cur
			end
			return Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * (speed or 0.12) * 4) -- [v48] disco palette (matches the theme song's mood)
		end
		local function mk(class, parent, props)
			local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
			if props then
				for k, v in pairs(props) do
					o[k] = v
				end
			end
			return o
		end
		local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
			return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextColor3 = WHITE,
				TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "",
				TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
			})
		end
		local function spaced(s)
			return (s:gsub("(.)", "%1 "):gsub("%s+$", ""))
		end
		local function scr(s, frac)
			local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
			if n >= #s then return s end
			local out = s:sub(1, n)
			for i = n + 1, #s do
				local ch = s:sub(i, i)
				if ch == " " then
					out = out .. " "
				else
					local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
					out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
				end
			end
			return out
		end
		local function loudness()
			local ok, v = pcall(function()
				return Music.PlaybackLoudness
			end)
			if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
			return 0
		end
		local function modStatus()
			local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
			if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
			local ok, s = pcall(f)
			if ok and type(s) == "string" then return s end
			return ""
		end
		-- [v30] tiny UI ticks during the intro, pitched off the script's own click sound
		local function itick(pitch, vol)
			if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
			local base = opts.ClickSnd
			if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
			pcall(function()
				local s = base:Clone()
				s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
				s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
				s.Parent = base.Parent
				s:Play()
				Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
			end)
		end

		-- ── stage ──
		local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
		})
		local world = mk("Frame", stage, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false,
		})
		-- [v48] virtual cinematic camera: the ONLY controller of `world` (pan x / y in px, zoom z, roll r in degrees).
		-- punch / rollKick / flashK are short impact layers that decay to 0 on top of the current shot.
		local worldZoom = Util.Instance("UIScale", world)
		local cam = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1, r = 0}
		local punch, rollKick, flashK = 0, 0, 0
		-- [v58] weighted camera (damped spring + overshoot, X.spring), random crash zooms, visible handheld drift, typography depth planes (title /
		-- captions parallax against each other), title motion echoes, liquid RGB split; camera speed (X.sp) also feeds the lens: edge fringe,
		-- anamorphic streak, smear, jitter, whooshes, bokeh swell, ember + star streaks.
		-- [v58b] 3D: every layer sits at its own depth d (haze 5, stars 2.4, title 1.07, captions .86, motes .74, foreground .6) and is scaled /
		-- shifted by a pinhole camera (X.plane): dolly = parallax scale, truck = parallax shift, orbit (X.bx / X.by) swings the layers against a
		-- title-locked subject, dolly-zoom (X.dd) stretches the world around a steady title; the title is an extruded slab (E.ext) that follows the
		-- camera angle. Action shots: arc / vertigo / jaws / rise / slam with speed ramps (X.ramp); handheld energy per act (X.hsk).
		-- [v57] cinematic rig state (one table, so the big function stays under Luau's local limit): smooth noise shake, cut-settle,
		-- handheld sway, depth layers, lens light. XI scales every extra layer with the Intro Intensity option (0 = off).
		local X = {
			seed = 13.37 + math.random() * 50, cut = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, r = 0}, prev = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1, r = 0}, cutHit = false,
			sp = 0, sd = 1, vk = 0, ready = false, crash = 0, crashR = 0, crashAt = -10, dd = 0, bx = 0, by = 0, sdd = 0, sbx = 0, sby = 0, pdd = 0, pbx = 0, pby = 0, hitch = 0, hitchAt = 10, leak = 0, leakAt = 8.2, leakDir = 1, leakRot = 0, lastW = 0,
		}
		local XI = math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1.5)
		X.n = function(a, b) return math.noise(a, X.seed + b, 0.31) * 2 end -- smooth noise, roughly -1..1
		-- [v58] damped spring (w = stiffness in rad/s, z = damping ratio; z < 1 overshoots), sub-stepped so any frame time stays stable
		X.follow = function(st, target, w, z, dt)
			local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
			local h = dt / n
			for _ = 1, n do
				st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
				st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
			end
			return st[1]
		end
		X.spring = function(x, y, z, r, dd, bx, by, dt, scene)
			local S = X.spr
			if not S then
				S = {{x, 0}, {y, 0}, {z, 0}, {r, 0}, {dd, 0}, {bx, 0}, {by, 0}}
				X.spr = S
			end
			local m, k = scene == 5 and 1.3 or 1, math.min(1, XI) -- the chaos act is stiffer so its rapid cuts still land on the beat
			return lerp(x, X.follow(S[1], x, 15 * m, 0.58, dt), k), lerp(y, X.follow(S[2], y, 15 * m, 0.58, dt), k),
				lerp(z, X.follow(S[3], z, 10 * m, 0.62, dt), k), lerp(r, X.follow(S[4], r, 11 * m, 0.42, dt), k),
				lerp(dd, X.follow(S[5], dd, 9 * m, 0.7, dt), k), -- the dolly / orbit channels are softer: the depth layers float a beat behind the subject
				lerp(bx, X.follow(S[6], bx, 8 * m, 0.66, dt), k), lerp(by, X.follow(S[7], by, 8 * m, 0.66, dt), k)
		end
		-- [v58b] speed ramp for action shots: a slow creep, a sudden burst, a long settle
		X.ramp = function(u)
			if u < 0.28 then
				local a = u / 0.28
				return 0.06 * a * a
			end
			return 0.06 + 0.94 * (1 - (1 - (u - 0.28) / 0.72) ^ 5)
		end
		X.hsk = {0.5, 0.85, 1.15, 1.0, 1.9, 1.4} -- handheld energy per act (cold open ... final push)
		-- [v58b] pinhole depth plane: a layer at depth d (title = 1) under dolly dz. dz = 1 -> no parallax; dz > 1 the near layers rush past and
		-- the far ones barely move; dz < 1 the reverse. (ox, oy) is the camera truck / orbit offset, (fx, fy) a layer's own float.
		X.plane = function(f, sc, d, ox, oy, dz, fx, fy)
			local k = 1 / d - 1
			f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ox * k + (fx or 0), 0.5, oy * k + (fy or 0))
			sc.Scale = math.clamp(d / math.max(0.22, 1 + dz * (d - 1)), 0.4, 2.4)
		end

		local skipped = false
		local function doSkip()
			skipped = true
		end
		conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
			if os.clock() - began < 0.4 then return end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
				local k = input.KeyCode
				if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
					doSkip()
				end
			end
		end)

		-- ── [v57] depth + lens rig: far haze (behind the stars), foreground bokeh / embers / whoosh streaks (in front), lens light on the stage ──
		E.fog, E.bokeh, E.embers, E.whoosh, E.streak, E.fringe = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
		do
			local kp = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
			local function layer(z, scale)
				local f = mk("Frame", world, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(scale, scale),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
				})
				return f, Util.Instance("UIScale", f)
			end
			-- far layer: lags the pan and barely zooms. Near layer: over-shoots the pan and zooms harder (see the depth block in the loop)
			E.bg, E.bgS = layer(1, 1.9)
			E.fgL, E.fgS = layer(8, 1.6)
			for i = 1, (XI > 0 and 3 or 0) do -- slow haze banks
				local f = mk("Frame", E.bg, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.14 + 0.05 * i), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Interactable = false,
				})
				local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
				g.Rotation = 90
				g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 1), kp(0.5, 0.88), kp(1, 1)})
				E.fog[i] = {f = f, y = 0.28 + 0.2 * i, ph = math.random() * 6.28}
			end
			for i = 1, math.floor(8 * XI) do -- out-of-focus lens orbs
				local d = math.random(26, 96)
				local f = mk("Frame", E.fgL, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Interactable = false,
				})
				Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				local st = mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 1})
				E.bokeh[i] = {
					f = f, st = st, d = d, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), ph = math.random() * 6.28, i = i,
					vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.012, vy = -0.004 - math.random() * 0.01,
				}
			end
			for i = 1, math.floor(14 * XI) do -- rising embers
				local f = mk("Frame", E.fgL, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Interactable = false,
				})
				E.embers[i] = {
					f = f, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), v = 0.03 + math.random() * 0.07, sw = 0.01 + math.random() * 0.02,
					ph = math.random() * 6.28, fl = 3 + math.random() * 5,
				}
			end
			for i = 1, (XI > 0 and 3 or 0) do -- passing foreground streaks (spawned by impacts / cuts)
				local f = mk("Frame", E.fgL, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
				})
				local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
				g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 1), kp(0.5, 0.1), kp(1, 1)})
				E.whoosh[i] = {f = f, life = 0, dur = 1, y = 0.5, dir = 1, len = 0.5}
			end
			X.spawn = function(k, dir)
				local now = os.clock()
				if now - X.lastW < 0.22 or math.random() > 0.3 + 0.45 * k then return end
				for _, w in ipairs(E.whoosh) do
					if w.life <= 0 then
						X.lastW = now
						w.dur = 0.28 + math.random() * 0.26
						w.life = w.dur
						w.y = 0.25 + math.random() * 0.5
						w.dir = dir or (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1)
						w.len = 0.35 + 0.35 * math.random() + 0.2 * k
						return
					end
				end
			end
			-- lens light (stage level): anamorphic streak + glow at the focal point, chromatic edge fringes, a sweeping light leak
			for i = 1, (XI > 0 and 2 or 0) do
				local f = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1.3, 0, 0, i == 1 and 2 or 18), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
				})
				Util.Instance("UIGradient", f).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 1), kp(0.5, 0), kp(1, 1)})
				E.streak[i] = f
			end
			for i = 1, (XI > 0 and 2 or 0) do
				local f = mk("Frame", stage, {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(i - 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(i - 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 80),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
				})
				local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
				g.Rotation = i == 1 and 0 or 180
				g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 0.2), kp(1, 1)})
				E.fringe[i] = f
			end
			if XI > 0 then

					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1.8, 0),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
				})
				Util.Instance("UIGradient", E.leakF).Transparency = NumberSequence.new({kp(0, 1), kp(0.5, 0), kp(1, 1)})
			end
		end

		E.stars, E.rays = {}, {}
		for i = 1, (CFG.IntroStars and 48 or 0) do

				BackgroundTransparency = 1, Interactable = false,

		end

		E.motes = {}

		end

		E.grain = {}
		for i = 1, 9 do
			E.grain[i] = mk("Frame", world, {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, Visible = false, Interactable = false,

		end

			local f = mk("Frame", world, {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1, Visible = false, Interactable = false,

			local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
			g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
			E.rays[i] = {f = f, i = i, a = (i / 12) * math.pi * 2, w = ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1) * (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.04), th = 2 + (i % 3)}

			tri.Layer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

			mtext = marquee

				E.marqRatio = m.Size.X.Offset / math.max(1, m.Size.Y.Offset)
			end
		end

		-- ── glitch bars + scanline ──
		E.tear = {}
		for i = 1, 6 do
			E.tear[i] = mk("Frame", world, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9, Visible = false, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Interactable = false,

		end
		local scan = mk("Frame", world, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
		})

		local scanLine = mk("Frame", scan, {

		local plate = mk("Frame", world, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Interactable = false,

			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5, Visible = false, Interactable = false,
		})
		local boxScale = Util.Instance("UIScale", box)
		local function big(z, color)

		local lblR = big(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 80))

		local ul = mk("Frame", world, {

		})

			r.name = txt(world, 7, Enum.Font.Arcade, 0, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, 24), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)

		-- ── [v58] typography depth planes: title + plate on one plane, every caption on another; same coordinate space as `world`, so the scene

		do

		local function bar(ay)

			})
		end

		-- [v30] cinematic vignette: the frame edges fall off into darkness
		local function softEdge(ax, ay, pos, size, rot)

				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),

		softEdge(1, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0), 180)

		local function hudText(ax, ay, pos, w)

		local skipBtn = mk("TextButton", stage, {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false,
		})

		-- [v30] bubbly skip button: overshoot hover, squish press, elastic release
		local skipScale = Util.Instance("UIScale", skipBtn)

		end)
		skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			tween(skipStroke, 0.25, Quad, EOut, {Thickness = 1})
		end)
		skipBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if isPress(input) then
				tween(skipScale, 0.07, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.88})
			end
		end)
		skipBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if isPress(input) then
				tween(skipScale, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1})
			end
		end)
		local flash = mk("Frame", stage, {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
		})

		-- ── beat engine ──
		local pulse, beatN, lastBeat, avgL, lastLoudAt = 0, 0, -1, 40, 0
		local shake, glitch = 0, 0
		local invert, edgeFlash = 0, 0
		local lastScene = 0
		local grid, lastGrid = nil, -1 -- [v48] theme-song beat grid {Period, Offset} (set once the song is ready)
		-- [v48] effect budget: rings / sparks draw from a small refilling bucket, so the chaos stays occasional, varied
		-- and cheap no matter how fast the beats come.
		local fxTokens = 3
		local function spend(n)
			if INTENSITY <= 0 or fxTokens < n then return false end
			fxTokens = fxTokens - n
			return true
		end
		-- camera jolt: shake + small zoom punch + roll twitch (creates no instances)
		local function jolt(k)
			shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 9 * k)
			punch = math.max(punch, 0.02 + 0.03 * k)
			rollKick = rollKick + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.8 + 1.6 * k)
			X.spawn(k) -- [v57] occasional foreground streak whips past on the hit
		end
		-- impact: jolt + lighting flash + glitch + shockwave ring + sparks (k = 0..2; the last two are budgeted)
		local function impact(k, col)
			jolt(k)
			flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
			glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
			if spend(1) then FX.Ring(world, col, 300 + 220 * k, 0.6, 2 + k) end
			if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(world, col, math.floor(6 + 6 * k), 130 + 90 * k, 0.6) end
		end
		local function beatNow(t, strength, bp)
			beatN = beatN + 1
			lastBeat = t
			pulse = 1
			local bpos = bp or (beatN % 4) -- bar position 0..3 (0 = downbeat); loudness / metronome fallback counts its own
			edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.4 + 0.45 * (strength or 1))
			if bpos == 0 then invert = 1 end
			tri.pulse = math.max(tri.pulse or 0, 0.55)
			if t < 1.5 then return end -- the cold open stays quiet
			-- [v49] the CLAPS land on beats 2 and 4: a light zoom hit + edge kick (no instances), so the cuts breathe with the backbeat
			if grid and (bpos == 1 or bpos == 3) and lastScene >= 2 then
				punch = math.max(punch, bpos == 1 and 0.03 or 0.02)
				edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.9)
			end
			if lastScene == 5 then -- chaos act: every beat kicks, downbeats hardest
				jolt(bpos == 0 and 1 or 0.35)
				glitch = math.max(glitch, bpos == 0 and 0.6 or 0.3)
			elseif bpos == 0 and lastScene >= 2 then -- elsewhere: ONE varied effect per downbeat, never all at once
				local k = (beatN // 4) % 4
				if k == 0 then
					impact(0.7, accent())
				elseif k == 1 then
					jolt(0.8)
					flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.16)
				elseif k == 2 then
					glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.7)
					jolt(0.4)
				elseif spend(1) then
					FX.Sparks(world, accent(), 8, 150, 0.7)
				end
			end
			-- [v58] unpredictable crash zoom: some downbeats slam the lens in (the camera spring gives it the whip, the overshoot and the settle)
			if XI > 0 and bpos == 0 and lastScene >= 3 and t - X.crashAt > 2.2 and math.random() < (lastScene == 5 and 0.55 or 0.4) then
				X.crashAt = t
				X.crash = (lastScene == 5 and 0.17 or 0.1) + 0.07 * math.random()
				X.crashR = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (2 + 3 * math.random())
			end
		end
		local function pollBeat(dt, t)
			if grid then -- theme song: exact 126 BPM beat grid instead of loudness guessing
				if t >= grid.Offset then
					local n = math.floor((t - grid.Offset) / grid.Period)
					if n ~= lastGrid then
						lastGrid = n
						-- [v49] measured groove: downbeat strongest, beat 2 = loudest clap, beat 4 = clap, beat 3 = kick only
						local bp = n % 4
						beatNow(t, (bp == 0 and 1.5) or (bp == 1 and 1.2) or (bp == 3 and 1.0) or 0.6, bp)
					end
				end
				return
			end
			local l = loudness()
			if l > 1 then lastLoudAt = t end
			avgL = avgL + (l - avgL) * math.min(1, dt * 2.5)
			if t - lastLoudAt < 1.5 and l > 1 then
				if l > math.max(avgL * 1.28, 45) and t - lastBeat > 0.2 then
					beatNow(t, math.min(1.5, l / math.max(avgL, 1) - 0.6))
				end
			elseif t > 1.5 and t - lastBeat > 0.469 then
				beatNow(t, 0.8) -- metronome fallback (128 BPM)
			end
		end

		-- ── scene helpers ──
		local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
		local sy = sw.Y
		local function setBig(s)
			lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
		end
		local function placeBig(cyScale, hPx, wScale)
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * cyScale)
			box.Size = UDim2.new(wScale or 0.92, 0, 0, hPx)
		end
		local function bigAlpha(a, extra)
			lblM.TextTransparency = a
			lblR.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
			lblB.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 0.35 + a * 0.65 + (extra or 0))
		end
		local function chroma(off)
			off = off + X.vk -- [v58] camera-speed lens split (X.vk is 0 when Intro Intensity is 0)
			local ly = X.n(os.clock() * 0.9, 11) * 3.5 * XI -- liquid drift: the two colour layers float vertically + tilt against each other
			lblR.Position, lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -off, 0.5, ly), UDim2.new(0.5, off, 0.5, -ly)
			lblR.Rotation, lblB.Rotation = ly * 0.12, -ly * 0.12
		end
		local function layoutTri(k)
			pcall(function()
				local L = tri.Layer
				local sm = sy * 0.4
				L.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sw.X, sm, k), lerp(sw.Y, sm, k))
				L.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -cam.x * 0.18, lerp(0.5, 0.27, k), -cam.y * 0.18) -- [v57] the emblem sits behind the text: it lags the pan
			end)
		end
		local function hideCardStuff()
			plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			roleL.TextTransparency = 1
			detL.TextTransparency = 1
			ul.Visible = false
		end
		local function hideRows()
			for _, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
				r.role.TextTransparency = 1
				r.name.TextTransparency = 1
			end
			hdr.TextTransparency = 1
		end
		local function showCard(card, lt, len, col)
			local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.3))
			local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.2)) / 0.2)
			local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
			local bigH = math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 92)
			local cy = sy * 0.66
			placeBig(0.66, bigH, 0.94)
			box.Visible = true
			local s = scr(card.name, lt / 0.35)
			setBig(s)
			bigAlpha(a)
			chroma((1 - e) * 16 + pulse * 5 + (math.random() < 0.05 and 7 or 0))
			boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.7 + pulse * 0.04 + ex * 0.35
			plate.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy)
			plate.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bigH * 1.55)
			plate.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(0.45, a)
			roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy - bigH * 0.5 - 16)
			roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))
			roleL.Text = spaced(scr(card.role, lt / 0.3))
			roleL.TextColor3 = col
			roleL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.2), ex)
			detL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.5 + 18)
			detL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 17))
			detL.Text = scr(card.detail, (lt - 0.25) / 0.5)
			detL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225)
			detL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01((lt - 0.2) / 0.25), ex)
			ul.Visible = true
			ul.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, cy + bigH * 0.8)
			ul.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.5)) * (1 - ex), 0, 0, 2)
			ul.BackgroundColor3 = col
		end
		local function showPage(page, lt, len, col)
			local ex = clamp01((lt - (len - 0.25)) / 0.25)
			local rowH = math.clamp(sy * 0.075, 17, 34)
			local step = rowH * 1.3
			local y0 = sy * 0.52 + 22
			hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.52)
			hdr.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
			hdr.Text = spaced("THE CREW")
			hdr.TextColor3 = col
			hdr.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - clamp01(lt / 0.25), ex)
			for i, r in ipairs(E.rows) do
				local data = page[i]
				if data then
					local st = 0.12 + (i - 1) * 0.33
					local k = clamp01((lt - st) / 0.3)
					local e = easeOutCubic(k)
					local a = math.max(1 - e, ex)
					local y = y0 + (i - 1) * step
					local slide = (1 - e) * sw.X * 0.25
					r.role.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -10 - slide, 0, y)
					r.name.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10 + slide, 0, y)
					r.role.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH * 0.8)
					r.name.Size = UDim2.new(0.46, 0, 0, rowH)
					r.role.Text = scr(data[1], k)
					r.name.Text = scr(data[2], k)
					r.name.TextColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or col
					r.role.TextTransparency = math.min(1, a + 0.1 * (1 - e))
					r.name.TextTransparency = a
				else
					r.role.TextTransparency = 1
					r.name.TextTransparency = 1
				end
			end
		end

		-- ── [v48] shot library: every move is a pure function of its progress u (0..1), so a cut is simply "start the next shot" ──
		local function shot(kind, u, dir)
			u = clamp01(u)
			local e = easeInOut(u)
			local k = math.clamp(sy / 450, 0.55, 1.6) -- pan distances follow the screen size (phones included)
			if kind == "push" then return 0, 0, 1 + 0.16 * e, dir * 1.5 * e -- push-in
			elseif kind == "pull" then return 0, 0, 1.2 - 0.2 * e, dir * 2 * (1 - e) -- pull-out
			elseif kind == "sweep" then return dir * (-1 + 2 * e) * 110 * k, 0, 1.08, dir * (1 - 2 * e) * 4 -- camera sweep
			elseif kind == "track" then return dir * (1 - 2 * u) * 90 * k, 0, 1.06, dir * 3 -- tracking shot (constant-speed dolly)
			elseif kind == "crane" then return 0, dir * (1 - 2 * e) * 70 * k, 1.1, dir * 2 -- crane move
			elseif kind == "dutch" then return dir * -24 * u * k, 0, 1.06 + 0.1 * e, dir * (10 + 3 * u) -- dutch angle
			elseif kind == "orbit" then -- orbital arc around the subject
				local a = dir * (-1 + 2 * e)
				X.bx = math.sin(a) * 170 * k -- [v58b] the camera really circles the subject: layers at other depths slide against it
				return math.sin(a) * 45 * k, (1 - math.cos(a)) * -40 * k, 1.1 + 0.06 * e, -a * 7
			elseif kind == "whip" then -- whip pan that settles
				local w = 1 - easeOutCubic(math.min(1, u * 1.6))
				return dir * 420 * w * k, 0, 1 + 0.1 * w, dir * 6 * w
			elseif kind == "arc" then -- [v58b] title-locked orbit on a speed ramp: the depth layers swing against the subject
				local r = X.ramp(u)
				local a = dir * (-1 + 2 * r)
				X.bx, X.by = a * 210 * k, math.sin(a * 1.6) * 40 * k
				return 0, 0, 1.06 + 0.1 * r, -a * 6
			elseif kind == "vertigo" then -- dolly zoom: the title holds while the world stretches around it
				local r = X.ramp(u)
				X.dd, X.bx = 0.6 * r, dir * 40 * k * r
				return 0, 0, 1.03 + 0.04 * r, dir * 2.5 * r
			elseif kind == "jaws" then -- the reverse: the world squeezes in behind the title
				local r = X.ramp(u)
				X.dd = -0.4 * r
				return 0, 0, 1.04 + 0.04 * r, dir * -2 * r
			elseif kind == "rise" then -- hero crane-up: starts low, looking up, and lifts into frame
				local r = X.ramp(u)
				X.by = -140 * k * r
				return 0, -(1 - r) * 70 * k, 1.22 - 0.16 * r, dir * 3 * (1 - r)
			elseif kind == "slam" then -- impact push: slams in tight, rebounds and settles
				local w = 1 - easeOutCubic(math.min(1, u * 1.8))
				X.dd = 0.5 * w
				return dir * 40 * w * k, 0, 1.08 + 0.4 * w, dir * 7 * w
			end
			return 0, 0, 1, 0
		end
		local CARD_SHOTS = {"arc", "vertigo", "whip", "rise", "slam", "jaws", "dutch"} -- one per credit card
		local CUTS = { -- chaos-act framings {x, y, zoom, roll}: rapid cuts walk through them on the beat
			{0, 0, 1.0, 0}, {-70, 18, 1.28, -9}, {85, -26, 1.38, 7}, {10, -44, 1.62, -3}, {-95, 36, 1.18, 12}, {40, 12, 1.7, 5},
		}

		-- ── timeline ──
		-- [v50] bar-aligned: 126.02 BPM, bar = 1.9045 s, first downbeat 0.18 s (sharpest transient attacks of 100+ beats sit at 0.179 s +/- 1 ms), bar(k) = 0.18 + 1.9045 * k
		local BAR = 4 * 60 / 126.02
		local function barT(k) return 0.18 + BAR * k end
		local T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 = barT(2), barT(8), barT(15), barT(21), barT(28) -- bar starts: 4.0 | 15.4 | 28.8 | 40.2 | 53.5 s
		local CARD_LEN, PAGE_LEN = BAR, BAR * 2 -- one card per bar, one crew page per two bars
		local CUE, REVEAL, READYT = barT(4), barT(30), barT(31) -- DROP slam 7.8 | FINAL REVEAL 57.3 | READY stamp 59.2
		-- [v49] musical changes measured from the MP3 that the scene cuts do not already cover (the drop = CUE, bar 8 = T2, bar 28 = T5):
		-- bar 12 (23.0 s): a new layer enters (+4 dB mids / highs, the biggest change after the drop) -> strong hit
		-- bar 20 (38.3 s): the track lifts again -> lighter hit
		local PHRASES = {{barT(12), 1.5}, {barT(20), 1}}
		local phraseN = 0
		-- [v50] real pauses measured in the MP3 (the sound cuts out, then slams back on the beat): {from, to, depth}. The lights go down and the
		-- lens breathes in while the track is silent; everything releases into the hit (flash + zoom punch) the moment it returns.
		local HOLDS = {
			{barT(4) - 0.4, barT(4) - 0.12, 0.45}, -- 7.40-7.68 s: riff gate before the drop (sound returns 0.12 s before the drop kick)
			{barT(12) - 0.34, barT(12), 0.8}, -- 22.70-23.03 s: FULL STOP, the new layer / vocal slams in on bar 12
			{barT(19) + BAR / 2, barT(20), 0.3}, -- 37.3-38.3 s: breath before the bar-20 lift (mids drop ~6 dB, the kick keeps going)
		}
		local holdK, holdPeak = 0, 0
		local tEnd, flashLen = DUR, 0.5
		local termLines = {
			"UH//BIOS " .. tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "  by " .. CREATOR,
			"CHECKING MEMORY ........ OK",
			"MOUNTING UhhhhhhReanim/ ........ OK",
			"LOADING CREATOR.EXE",
			"> " .. CREATOR,
			"> ORIGINAL CREATOR DETECTED",
			"> INITIATING CINEMATIC",
		}
		local lastWord, wordT, chaosWord = 0, 0, DATA.chaos[1]
		local bloomed, slammed, readyFired = false, false, false
		local bootLines, lastCard, lastPage, revealFired, lastCut = 0, 0, 0, false, -1

		local function songClock() -- [v48] with the theme song the cinematic clock is locked to the audio itself
			local t = os.clock() - began
			if grid then
				local ok, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if ok and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local d = pos - t
					if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
						began = os.clock() - pos -- seek / stall: hard resync
					else
						began = began - d * 0.2 -- gentle drift correction
					end
					t = os.clock() - began
				end
			end
			return t
		end

		local function run()
			do -- wait for the song to actually start (first run: incl. the one-time download), so the cinematic begins on the first note
				local w0 = os.clock()
				local lim = opts.ReadyWait or 3.2
				while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not skipped do
					local prog = Util.ThemeSong and Util.ThemeSong.Progress
					term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
						.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
					term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.045), 11, 20)
					term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.22)
					term.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, sy * 0.5)
					term.TextColor3 = accent()
					term.TextTransparency = 0.3
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				term.Text = ""
				began = os.clock()
				wall0 = began
				if opts.Theme then
					local okT, th = pcall(opts.Theme)
					if okT and type(th) == "table" and th.Period and th.Offset then grid = th end
				end
			end
			while true do
				local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				local t = songClock()
				fxTokens = math.min(3, fxTokens + dt * 2.5)
				if skipped and tEnd == DUR then
					tEnd = t + 0.35
					flashLen = 0.35
				end
				if t >= tEnd or t > DUR + 8 or os.clock() - wall0 > DUR + 10 then break end
				sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
				sy = sw.Y
				local col = accent()
				local maxR = math.sqrt(sw.X * sw.X + sw.Y * sw.Y) * 0.5
				pollBeat(dt, t)
				while grid and phraseN < #PHRASES and t >= PHRASES[phraseN + 1][1] do -- [v49] phrase hit on a real musical change
					phraseN = phraseN + 1
					if t - PHRASES[phraseN][1] < 0.4 then -- never fires late after a stall / seek
						local k = PHRASES[phraseN][2]
						impact(k, col)
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.2 + 0.12 * k)
						shake = math.max(shake, 10 + 8 * k)
						FX.Ring(world, WHITE, 520 + 120 * k, 0.8, 3 + k)
						pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6 + 3 * k, 0.05, 0.45)
						itick(1.25, 0.7)
					end
				end
				pulse = math.max(0, pulse - dt * 7)
				invert = math.max(0, invert - dt * 9)
				glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 3)
				edgeFlash = math.max(0, edgeFlash - dt * 3.2)
				do -- [v50] musical pauses: lights down while the track is silent, flash + punch the instant it returns
					local hk = 0
					for _, h in ipairs(HOLDS) do
						if t >= h[1] and t < h[2] then
							hk = math.max(hk, h[3] * math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1) * easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - h[1]) / 0.06)))
						end
					end
					if hk > 0 then
						holdPeak = math.max(holdPeak, hk)
					elseif holdK > 0.1 then
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.3 * holdPeak)
						punch = math.max(punch, 0.07 * holdPeak)
						holdPeak = 0
					else
						holdPeak = 0
					end
					holdK = hk
				end

				local scene = (t < T1 and 1) or (t < T2 and 2) or (t < T3 and 3) or (t < T4 and 4) or (t < T5 and 5) or 6
				if scene ~= lastScene then
					lastScene = scene
					if scene >= 2 then
						X.cutHit = scene ~= 4 -- [v57] act changes ease in (the crew act opens with its own whip pan, so it keeps the hard start)
						shake = math.max(shake, 14)
						glitch = 1
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.22) -- lighting flash on every act change
						FX.Ring(world, col, 620, 0.8, 4)
						pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.06, 0.5)
					end
					if scene ~= 3 then hideCardStuff() end
					if scene ~= 4 then hideRows() end
					if scene == 5 then tri.yawVel = 22 end
				end

				-- stage background: black, strobing in the chaos act
				if scene == 5 and invert > 0.5 then
					stage.BackgroundColor3 = col
				else
					stage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end

				-- warp field
				local warp = ({0.4, 1.6, 1.0, 0.8, 5.5, 3.0})[scene] + pulse * 2.2 + X.sp * 3
				for _, s in ipairs(E.stars) do
					s.r = s.r + s.v * dt * (0.5 + warp)
					if s.r > 1.05 then
						s.r = math.random() * 0.05
						s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
					end
					local d = s.r * maxR
					-- [v48] parallax: the far star layer lags the camera pan, the dust motes (near layer) overshoot it
					s.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(s.a) * d - cam.x * 0.55, 0.5, math.sin(s.a) * d - cam.y * 0.55)
					s.f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
					s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + s.r * warp * 14, 2)
					s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, s.r * 3) * (scene == 1 and 0.3 or 0.75)
					s.f.BackgroundColor3 = (s.i % 5 == 0) and col or WHITE
				end

				-- [v30] dust motes drift
				for _, m in ipairs(E.motes) do
					m.x = (m.x + m.vx * dt) % 1
					m.y = (m.y + m.vy * dt) % 1
					m.f.Position = UDim2.new(m.x, math.sin(t * 1.6 + m.ph) * 7 + cam.x * 0.35, m.y, cam.y * 0.35)
					m.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(m.s, m.s)
					m.f.BackgroundColor3 = (m.s == 2) and col or WHITE
					m.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.62 + 0.28 * math.sin(t * 2.2 + m.ph) - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1)
				end

				-- [v30] film grain flicker
				local gAmt = 0.05 + glitch * 0.3 + (scene == 5 and 0.14 or 0)
				for _, f in ipairs(E.grain) do
					if math.random() < gAmt then
						f.Visible = true
						f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(), math.random())
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.15
					else
						f.Visible = false
					end
				end

				-- rays
				local rayOn = CFG.IntroRays and (scene == 2 or scene == 5 or scene == 6)
				local rayK = rayOn and (0.55 + 0.45 * pulse) or 0
				for _, r in ipairs(E.rays) do
					r.f.Visible = rayK > 0.01
					if rayK > 0.01 then
						r.f.Rotation = math.deg(r.a + t * r.w * (scene == 5 and 3 or 1))
						r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxR * rayK, r.th)
						r.f.BackgroundColor3 = (r.i % 3 == 0) and col or WHITE
					end
				end

				-- scanline + letterbox
				if CFG.IntroScan then
					local sp = (t % 2.6) / 2.6
					scan.Visible = scene ~= 1
					scan.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, sp * 1.15 - 0.1, -60)
					scan.BackgroundColor3 = col
					local b = (0.085 + 0.012 * pulse) * easeOutCubic(math.min(1, t / 0.8))
					barTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, b, 0)
					barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, b, 0)
				else
					scan.Visible = false
				end

				-- triangle layout / behaviour per scene
				local emblemK = 0
				if scene == 3 or scene == 4 then
					emblemK = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - (scene == 3 and T2 or T3)) / 0.6))
					if scene == 4 then emblemK = 1 end
				elseif scene == 5 then
					emblemK = 1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T4) / 0.4))
				elseif scene == 2 then
					emblemK = 0
				end
				layoutTri(emblemK)
				pcall(function()
					tri.Layer.Visible = t >= 2.6
				end)
				if scene <= 2 then
					local asm = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T1) / 2.4))
					tri.env, tri.extra = 1 - asm, 1 - asm
					tri.yawVel = 2 + (1 - asm) * 14 + ((t >= CUE) and 6 or 0)
					if t >= CUE then tri.pitch = 0.35 + 0.5 * math.sin((t - CUE) * 0.8) end -- [v48] orbital sweep after the drop
					tri.scaleBase = 0.6 + 0.4 * asm
					tri.chargeVis = clamp01((t - 4.2) / 1.6)
				elseif scene == 3 or scene == 4 then
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.05 + 0.18 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 0.3
				elseif scene == 5 then
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.0 + 0.9 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T4) / 0.5)) + 0.5 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 1
					tri.pitch = 0.35 + 0.6 * math.sin(t * 2.2) -- [v48] orbiting the model through the cuts
				else
					tri.env, tri.extra = 0, 0
					tri.scaleBase = 1.1 + (t - T5) * 0.06 + 0.2 * pulse
					tri.chargeVis = 0.6
					if t < REVEAL then -- [v48] build: the spin accelerates while the camera crawls in
						local bu = clamp01((t - T5) / (REVEAL - T5))
						tri.yawVel = 8 + 36 * bu * bu
						tri.pitch = 0.35 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 1.3)
					else
						tri.yawVel = 4
					end
				end

				-- ═════ scene 1 : BOOT ═════
				if scene == 1 then
					local shown = {}
					for i, line in ipairs(termLines) do
						local st = barT(0) + (i - 1) * (BAR / 4) -- [v50] one boot line per beat
						local n = math.floor((t - st) * 38)
						if n > 0 then
							shown[#shown + 1] = line:sub(1, n)
						end
					end
					if #shown > bootLines then -- [v30] tick as each boot line lands
						bootLines = #shown
						itick(1.9, 0.35)
					end
					local cursor = (math.floor(t * 6) % 2 == 0) and "_" or " "
					term.Text = table.concat(shown, "\n") .. cursor
					term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.045), 11, 20)
					term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.22)
					term.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, sy * 0.5)
					term.TextColor3 = col
					term.TextTransparency = clamp01((t - (T1 - 0.6)) / 0.5)
				else
					term.Text = ""
				end

				-- ═════ scene 2 : AWAKEN ═════
				if scene == 2 then
					placeBig(0.78, math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90), 0.94)
					if t < CUE then
						box.Visible = false
						roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.8)
						roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 20))
						roleL.Text = spaced(scr("A SCRIPT BY", (t - T1 - 0.6) / 2.4))
						roleL.TextColor3 = col
						roleL.TextTransparency = 1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - T1 - 0.4) / 0.9))
					else
						if not slammed then
							slammed = true
							FX.Ring(world, WHITE, 760, 0.8, 5)
							FX.Ring(world, col, 520, 0.9, 4)
							FX.Sparks(world, col, 16, 260, 0.8)
							pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.07, 0.7)
							shake = 24
							glitch = 1
							flashK = 0.55 -- [v48] the DROP: lighting flash + camera punch + dutch snap
							punch = 0.16
							rollKick = -4
						end
						if not bloomed and t >= CUE then
							bloomed = true
							pcall(function() tri:Bloom() end)
						end
						local lt = t - CUE
						local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.35))
						local ex = clamp01((t - (T2 - 0.25)) / 0.25)
						box.Visible = true
						setBig(scr(NAME, lt / 0.5))
						bigAlpha(math.max(1 - e, ex))
						chroma((1 - e) * 20 + pulse * 6 + (math.random() < 0.06 and 8 or 0))
						boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.6 + pulse * 0.05 + ex * 0.5
						roleL.Text = spaced("THE ORIGINAL CREATOR")
						roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.78 + math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90) * 0.6 + 12)
						roleL.TextTransparency = math.max(1 - easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.7) / 0.5)), ex)
						ul.Visible = true
						ul.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.78 + math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 90) * 0.5 + 2)
						ul.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * easeOutCubic(clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.7)) * (1 - ex), 0, 0, 2)
						ul.BackgroundColor3 = col
					end
				end

				-- ═════ scene 3 : THE CREATOR (cards) ═════
				if scene == 3 then
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.cards, math.floor((t - T2) / CARD_LEN) + 1)
					local lt = (t - T2) - (idx - 1) * CARD_LEN
					if idx ~= lastCard then -- [v30] card change: sparkle burst + tick + pip counter
						lastCard = idx
						if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(world, col, 12, 150, 0.7) end
						itick(1.5, 0.5)
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.14) -- [v48] every card is a camera cut on the downbeat
						glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.6)
						jolt(0.5)
					end
					showCard(DATA.cards[idx], lt, CARD_LEN, col)
					chyron.Text = spaced(string.format("%d / %d", idx, #DATA.cards))
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.035, 10, 15))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.9)
					chyron.TextColor3 = col
					chyron.TextTransparency = 0.4
				end

				-- ═════ scene 4 : THE CREW ═════
				if scene == 4 then
					box.Visible = false
					ul.Visible = false
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1
					detL.TextTransparency = 1
					plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.pages, math.floor((t - T3) / PAGE_LEN) + 1)
					local lt = (t - T3) - (idx - 1) * PAGE_LEN
					if idx ~= lastPage then -- [v48] page change = whip-pan cut (the shot itself is in the camera block)
						lastPage = idx
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.14)
						glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.6)
						jolt(0.5)
						if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(world, col, 10, 170, 0.6) end
						itick(1.3, 0.4)
					end
					showPage(DATA.pages[idx], lt, PAGE_LEN, col)
					chyron.Text = spaced("ORIGINAL CREATOR  /  " .. CREATOR)
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.1)
					chyron.TextColor3 = col
					chyron.TextTransparency = (math.random() < 0.04) and 0.7 or 0.15
				else
					if scene ~= 3 and scene ~= 6 and scene ~= 5 then chyron.Text = "" end
				end

				-- ═════ scene 5 : CHAOS DROP ═════
				if scene == 5 then
					hideRows()
					plate.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1
					detL.TextTransparency = 1
					ul.Visible = false
					if beatN ~= lastWord or t - wordT > 0.5 then
						lastWord = beatN
						wordT = t
						chaosWord = DATA.chaos[math.random(1, #DATA.chaos)]
						box.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.random(-24, 24), 0, sy * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.22))
						boxScale.Scale = 0.75 + math.random() * 0.5
					end
					local h = math.clamp(sy * 0.2, 40, 120)
					box.Size = UDim2.new(0.98, 0, 0, h)
					box.Visible = true
					setBig(chaosWord)
					bigAlpha(0)
					lblM.TextColor3 = (invert > 0.5) and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or WHITE
					chroma(6 + pulse * 22 + (math.random() < 0.3 and 10 or 0))
					boxScale.Scale = boxScale.Scale + (1 - boxScale.Scale) * math.min(1, dt * 6) + pulse * 0.02
					chyron.Text = spaced("ORIGINAL CREATOR  /  " .. CREATOR)
					chyron.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					chyron.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.1)
					chyron.TextColor3 = (invert > 0.5) and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or col
					chyron.TextTransparency = (math.floor(t * 8) % 2 == 0) and 0 or 0.6
					glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.35)
					if E.marq then
						local mh = sy * 0.1
						E.marq.Visible = true
						E.marq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mh * E.marqRatio, mh)
						local wpx = mh * E.marqRatio
						local x = sw.X - ((t - T4) * sy * 1.8) % (wpx + sw.X)
						E.marq.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.86, 0)
					end
				else
					if E.marq then E.marq.Visible = false end
					lblM.TextColor3 = WHITE
				end

				-- ═════ scene 6 : TITLE + HAND-OFF ═════
				if scene == 6 and t < REVEAL then -- [v48] build: the title is held back while the camera crawls into the triangle
					chyron.TextTransparency = 1
					box.Visible = false
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1
					detL.TextTransparency = 1
					hdr.TextTransparency = 1
					ul.Visible = false
				end
				if scene == 6 and t >= REVEAL then -- [v48] FINAL REVEAL: pull-back + title slam, READY stamp on the last downbeat
					chyron.TextTransparency = 1
					local lt = t - REVEAL
					if not revealFired then
						revealFired = true
						impact(2, col)
						flashK = 0.7
						punch = 0.2
						shake = math.max(shake, 26)
						FX.Ring(world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 5)
						pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.06, 0.8)
						pcall(function() tri:Bloom() end)
						tri.pulse = 1
					end
					local e = easeOutCubic(clamp01(lt / 0.4))
					local h = math.clamp(sy * 0.15, 34, 92)
					box.Visible = true
					placeBig(0.5, h, 0.96)
					setBig(scr("NOOBY'S UH MODDED REANIMATION V1.1.1", lt / 0.7))
					bigAlpha(1 - e)
					chroma((1 - e) * 18 + pulse * 5)
					boxScale.Scale = 1 + (1 - e) * 0.8 + pulse * 0.03
					roleL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 + h * 0.5 + 16)
					roleL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.045, 12, 19))
					local subText = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80))
						or ("REMASTERED  //  " .. tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "  //  ORIGINAL BY " .. CREATOR)
					roleL.Text = scr(subText, (lt - 0.4) / 0.6)
					roleL.TextColor3 = col
					roleL.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((lt - 0.3) / 0.3)
					detL.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 + h * 0.5 + 40)
					detL.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.04, 11, 16))
					detL.Text = "UI READY  -  MODULES LOAD IN THE BACKGROUND  -  YOU CAN REANIMATE NOW"
					detL.TextColor3 = WHITE
					detL.TextTransparency = (lt > 1.2) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 0 or 0.45) or 1
					-- [v30] READY stamp slams in on the last downbeat, just before the hand-off
					if t >= READYT then
						if not readyFired then
							readyFired = true
							FX.Ring(world, col, 420, 0.6, 3)
							jolt(1.2)
							flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.3)
							itick(0.7, 0.9)
						end
						local rp = easeOutBack(clamp01((t - READYT) / 0.35))
						hdr.Text = "READY"
						hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, sy * 0.5 - h * 0.5 - 34)
						hdr.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, math.clamp(sy * 0.055, 15, 26) * math.max(0.05, rp))
						hdr.TextColor3 = col
						hdr.TextTransparency = 0
					else
						hdr.TextTransparency = 1
					end
					ul.Visible = false
				end

				-- glitch tears
				local g = math.max(glitch, pulse * 0.15) -- [v48] restrained: beats alone only whisper, impacts / cuts drive the glitch
				for i, f in ipairs(E.tear) do
					if g > 0.05 and math.random() < g * 0.5 then
						f.Visible = true
						f.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.random(-30, 30) * g, 0, math.random(0, math.max(1, math.floor(sy))))
						f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 3 + math.floor(26 * g)))
						f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and col or WHITE
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
					else
						f.Visible = false
					end
				end

				-- ═════ [v48] virtual camera: the shot for this moment (pan / push-in / dutch / orbit / cuts) ═════
				local kpx = math.clamp(sy / 450, 0.55, 1.6)
				local cx, cy, cz, cr = 0, 0, 1, 0
				X.dd, X.bx, X.by = 0, 0, 0 -- [v58b] dolly-zoom / orbit channels: set by the shot, if it uses them
				if scene == 1 then -- cold open: slow push-in with a lazy crane down
					cx, cy, cz, cr = shot("push", t / T1, 1)
					cy = cy + (1 - t / T1) * 30 * kpx
				elseif scene == 2 then
					if t < CUE then -- build: crane move + a dutch angle that tightens as the riser climbs into the drop
						local u = (t - T1) / (CUE - T1)
						cx, cy, cz, cr = shot("crane", u, 1)
						cz = cz + 0.1 * u
						cr = cr + 11 * u * u
					else -- the drop: snap the dutch the other way, then orbit the name
						cx, cy, cz, cr = shot("orbit", (t - CUE) / (T2 - CUE), -1)
						cr = cr - 3
					end
				elseif scene == 3 then -- rapid cuts: a new shot every bar, on the downbeat
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.cards, math.floor((t - T2) / CARD_LEN) + 1)
					cx, cy, cz, cr = shot(CARD_SHOTS[(idx - 1) % #CARD_SHOTS + 1], ((t - T2) - (idx - 1) * CARD_LEN) / CARD_LEN, (idx % 2 == 0) and -1 or 1)
				elseif scene == 4 then -- crew: constant-speed tracking shots, a whip pan on every page change
					local idx = math.min(#DATA.pages, math.floor((t - T3) / PAGE_LEN) + 1)
					local lt = (t - T3) - (idx - 1) * PAGE_LEN
					local dir = (idx % 2 == 0) and -1 or 1
					cx, cy, cz, cr = shot(idx == 2 and "orbit" or "track", lt / PAGE_LEN, dir)
					if lt < 0.7 then
						local wx, _, wz, wr = shot("whip", lt / 0.7, -dir)
						cx, cz, cr = cx + wx, cz + (wz - 1), cr + wr
					end
				elseif scene == 5 then -- chaos: rapid cuts on the beat (twice as fast through the last bar before the title)
					local step = ((T5 - t) < BAR) and (BAR / 8) or (BAR / 4)
					local cutN = math.floor((t - T4) / step)
					if cutN ~= lastCut then -- the cut itself: a short lighting flash + a glitch tick
						lastCut = cutN
						X.cutHit = true
						flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.09)
						glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.35)
					end
					local c = CUTS[(cutN * 5) % #CUTS + 1] -- stride 5 over 6 framings: varied order, no immediate repeats
					cx, cy, cz, cr = c[1] * kpx, c[2] * kpx, c[3] + ((t - T4) - cutN * step) * 0.12, c[4]
					X.bx, X.dd = (((cutN * 3) % 5) - 2) * 55 * kpx, (cutN % 2 == 0) and 0.28 or -0.18 -- every cut also changes the camera's depth angle
				else -- scene 6
					if t < REVEAL then -- extreme push-in with a tightening dutch angle and a rising vibration
						local u = clamp01((t - T5) / (REVEAL - T5))
						local e = u * u
						cz, cr = 1 + 1.1 * e, -14 * e
						cx = math.sin(t * 9) * 4 * e * kpx
					else -- the reveal pulls back and levels the horizon (small overshoot)
						local u = clamp01((t - REVEAL) / 1.6)
						local e = 1 - (1 - u) ^ 4
						cz = 2.1 - 1.1 * e
						cr = -14 * (1 - e) + math.sin(u * 9) * (1 - u) * 1.5
					end
				end
				-- impact layers + shake on top of the shot. This is the ONLY place that writes world's transform.
				shake = math.max(0, shake - dt * 40)
				punch = math.max(0, punch - dt * 4.5)
				rollKick = rollKick * math.exp(-9 * dt)
				flashK = math.max(0, flashK - dt * 3.2)
				-- [v57] cut settle: act changes and the chaos-act cuts ease in as a fast whip-settle instead of snapping; the card / page
				-- shots (which already start displaced on purpose) and every continuous move are untouched
				local cs, pv = X.cut, X.prev
				if X.cutHit then
					X.cutHit = false
					cs.x, cs.y, cs.z = (pv.x + cs.x - cx) * 0.8, (pv.y + cs.y - cy) * 0.8, (pv.z + cs.z - cz) * 0.8
					cs.r = math.clamp((pv.r + cs.r - cr) * 0.8, -14, 14)
					if XI > 0 then cs.x, cs.y, cs.z, cs.r = 0, 0, 0, 0 end -- [v58] the camera spring does the whip-settle instead
				end
				-- [v57] signal dropout: an unpredictable micro-hitch (every 2.4-5.8 s, never inside a musical hold or on the final reveal)
				if XI > 0 and scene >= 2 and holdK < 0.01 and t >= X.hitchAt and t < tEnd - 1.5 and not (scene == 6 and t >= REVEAL - 0.5) then
					X.hitchAt = t + 2.4 + math.random() * 3.4
					X.hitch = 1
					glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.75)
					edgeFlash = math.max(edgeFlash, 0.8)
					cs.x = cs.x + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (18 + math.random() * 28) * kpx * XI
					cs.r = cs.r + (math.random() - 0.5) * 3
					X.spawn(0.6)
				end
				local cd = math.exp(-12 * dt)
				cs.x, cs.y, cs.z, cs.r = cs.x * cd, cs.y * cd, cs.z * cd, cs.r * cd
				pv.x, pv.y, pv.z, pv.r = cx, cy, cz, cr
				-- [v58] weighted camera: the shot is only the TARGET and the lens follows it on a damped spring (overshoot, a floaty zoom, a wobbling roll),
				-- so cuts become whips that settle instead of rigid keyframes. Crash zooms ride the same spring; the signal-dropout hitch is added after the spring, so it stays a hard snap.
				X.crash, X.crashR = X.crash * math.exp(-3.4 * dt), X.crashR * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
				if XI > 0 then
					cx, cy, cz, cr, X.sdd, X.sbx, X.sby = X.spring(cx, cy, cz + X.crash, cr + X.crashR, X.dd, X.bx, X.by, dt, scene)
				end
				cx, cy, cz, cr = cx + cs.x, cy + cs.y, cz + cs.z, cr + cs.r
				-- [v58] camera speed (0..1, fast attack / ~0.15 s release): pans, cuts, whips and zooms drive the lens response below
				local vdx, vdy = cx - cam.x, cy - cam.y
				if X.ready and dt > 0.001 and dt < 0.25 then
					X.sp = math.max(math.min(1, (math.sqrt(vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy) / sy + math.abs(cz - cam.z) * 0.8 + (math.abs(X.sbx - X.pbx) + math.abs(X.sby - X.pby)) / sy * 0.6 + math.abs(X.sdd - X.pdd) * 0.5) / dt / 3), X.sp * math.exp(-7 * dt))
					if math.abs(vdx) > 0.5 then X.sd = vdx > 0 and 1 or -1 end
				end
				X.ready = true
				X.pbx, X.pby, X.pdd = X.sbx, X.sby, X.sdd
				cam.x, cam.y, cam.z, cam.r = cx, cy, cz, cr
				-- [v57] shake = smooth two-octave noise (no per-frame random jitter), scaled to the screen and capped, plus a slow handheld sway
				local amp = math.min(shake * INTENSITY * (0.6 + 0.4 * kpx) * 0.9 + X.sp * 4 * kpx * XI, sy * 0.05)
				local hs = XI * X.hsk[scene] * (1 - 0.7 * holdK)
				local nx = (X.n(t * 21, 0) + 0.5 * X.n(t * 53, 1)) * 0.67
				local ny = (X.n(t * 19, 2) + 0.5 * X.n(t * 47, 3)) * 0.57
				world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + amp * nx + hs * kpx * (16 * X.n(t * 0.55, 5) + 4.5 * X.n(t * 1.4, 6)),
					0.5, cy + amp * ny + hs * kpx * (12 * X.n(t * 0.5, 7) + 3.5 * X.n(t * 1.7, 8)))
				world.Rotation = cr + rollKick * INTENSITY + amp * 0.07 * X.n(t * 17, 4) + hs * 1.1 * X.n(t * 0.45, 9)
				worldZoom.Scale = math.max(0.5, cz * (1 + punch * INTENSITY + 0.018 * hs * X.n(t * 0.8, 10)) * (1 - 0.05 * holdK))
				local sq = (math.min(0.045, punch * 0.3) + X.sp * 0.025) * XI -- anamorphic squash on every impact (a touch wider, a touch flatter)
				world.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 + sq, 1 - sq * 0.5)
				-- [v58b] 3D depth stack: every layer is a plane at its own distance (see X.plane); dolly scales them in perspective, truck / orbit shift them
				-- by depth, so a push flies through the layers and an arc swings them against the title. Captions and title also float on slow drifts.
				if XI > 0 then
					local fl = XI * kpx
					local dz = math.max(0.3, cz + X.sdd)
					local ox, oy = cx - X.sbx, cy - X.sby
					X.plane(E.bg, E.bgS, 5, ox, oy, dz)
					X.plane(E.pS, E.pSS, 2.4, -X.sbx, -X.sby, dz) -- the stars already follow the pan themselves
					X.plane(E.pT, E.pTS, 1.07, ox, oy, dz, -X.sd * X.sp * 5 * fl + math.sin(t * 0.8) * 2.5 * fl, math.cos(t * 0.65) * 2 * fl)
					X.plane(E.pC, E.pCS, 0.86, ox, oy, dz, X.sd * X.sp * 12 * fl + math.sin(t * 1.1 + 1) * 4 * fl, math.cos(t * 0.9 + 2) * 3 * fl)
					X.plane(E.pM, E.pMS, 0.74, -X.sbx, -X.sby, dz) -- the motes already follow the pan themselves
					X.plane(E.fgL, E.fgS, 0.6, ox, oy, dz)
					-- extruded title: a slab of dark layers behind the type; its depth direction follows the camera angle, so the name reads as a solid object
					local onE = box.Visible
					local ex = math.clamp(X.sbx * 0.1 + cx * 0.04, -20, 20) * fl + 4 * kpx
					local ey = math.clamp(X.sby * 0.1 + cy * 0.04, -12, 12) * fl + 3 * kpx
					local tx = lblM.Text
					for i, l in ipairs(E.ext) do
						l.Visible = onE
						if onE then
							local u = i / #E.ext
							if l.Text ~= tx then l.Text = tx end
							l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ex * u, 0.5, ey * u)
							l.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45 + 0.5 * u)
							l.TextTransparency = 1 - (1 - lblM.TextTransparency) * 0.85
						end
					end
					for i, l in ipairs(E.echo) do
						local on = box.Visible and X.sp > 0.05
						l.Visible = on
						if on then
							l.Text, l.TextColor3 = lblM.Text, (i == 1) and col or WHITE
							l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -X.sd * X.sp * 30 * i * fl, 0.5, 0)
							l.TextTransparency = math.min(1, 1 - (1 - lblM.TextTransparency) * math.min(0.55, X.sp * 0.7) / i)
						end
					end
				end

				-- ═════ [v57] depth layers, particles and lens light ═════
				if XI > 0 then
					X.hitch = math.max(0, X.hitch - dt * 6)
					X.vk = X.sp * 9 * kpx * XI
					if X.sp > 0.3 and scene >= 2 then X.spawn(X.sp, X.sd) end -- foreground streaks whip past in the direction of the pan
					-- (haze / stars / title / captions / motes / foreground are placed in perspective by X.plane, above)
					local lit = (scene == 1 and 0.55 or 1) * clamp01((t - 0.6) / 2.4)
					for _, f in ipairs(E.fog) do
						f.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.sin(t * 0.09 + f.ph) * 0.07, f.y + math.sin(t * 0.23 + f.ph) * 0.025)
						f.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
						f.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, lit * (0.5 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 0.5 + f.ph) + 0.5 * pulse + flashK))
					end
					for _, b in ipairs(E.bokeh) do
						b.x, b.y = (b.x + b.vx * dt) % 1, (b.y + b.vy * dt) % 1
						local d = b.d * kpx * (1 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + b.ph) + 0.12 * pulse + 0.35 * X.sp)
						local bc = (b.i % 2 == 0) and col or WHITE
						b.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
						b.f.Position = UDim2.new(b.x, math.sin(t * 0.7 + b.ph) * 12 * kpx, b.y, 0)
						b.f.BackgroundColor3, b.st.Color = bc, bc
						b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - lit * (0.05 + 0.08 * pulse + 0.2 * flashK)
						b.st.Transparency = 1 - lit * (0.18 + 0.2 * pulse)
					end
					local emK = lit * (scene >= 2 and 1 or 0.3) * (scene == 5 and 1.5 or 1)
					for _, m in ipairs(E.embers) do
						m.y = m.y - m.v * dt * (1 + pulse * 2.5)
						if m.y < -0.05 then m.y, m.x = 1.05, math.random() end
						m.f.Position = UDim2.new(m.x + math.sin(t * 1.2 + m.ph) * m.sw, 0, m.y, 0)
						m.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, 2 * kpx), (4 + 8 * pulse + 14 * X.sp) * kpx)
						m.f.BackgroundColor3 = (m.ph > 3.14) and col or Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)
						m.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(0.95, emK * clamp01(0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * m.fl + m.ph)) * clamp01(math.sin(m.y * math.pi)) * 0.9)
					end
					for _, w in ipairs(E.whoosh) do
						if w.life > 0 then
							w.life = w.life - dt
							local u = 1 - clamp01(w.life / w.dur)
							local sn = math.sin(u * math.pi)
							w.f.Visible = w.life > 0
							w.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(w.dir > 0 and (-0.1 + 1.2 * u) or (1.1 - 1.2 * u), w.y)
							w.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sw.X * w.len * (0.4 + 0.6 * sn), math.max(1, math.floor(2 * kpx)))
							w.f.BackgroundColor3 = (w.dir > 0) and col or WHITE
							w.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.55 * sn
						end
					end
					-- lens light: anamorphic streak + glow riding the focal point (the title when there is one), flaring on beats / impacts
					local sk = clamp01(pulse * 0.3 + flashK * 1.1 + glitch * 0.2 + X.hitch * 0.4 + X.sp * 0.3)
					local fy = box.Visible and box.Position.Y.Offset or sy * 0.5
					local scrY = sy * 0.5 + cy + (fy - sy * 0.5) * cz
					for i, f in ipairs(E.streak) do
						f.Visible = scene >= 2
						f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx * 0.4, 0, scrY)
						f.Size = UDim2.new(1.3 * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.min(1, sk * 2)), 0, 0, math.max(1, math.floor((i == 1 and 2 or 18) * kpx)))
						f.BackgroundColor3 = (i == 1) and WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.4) or col
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ((i == 1) and math.min(0.9, 0.1 * (1 - holdK) + sk) or math.min(0.3, 0.03 + sk * 0.3))
					end
					-- chromatic fringe on the frame edges: blooms with glitches, impacts and shake
					local fk = clamp01(glitch * 0.8 + punch * 3.5 + shake / 40 + X.hitch + X.sp * 0.6)
					for _, f in ipairs(E.fringe) do
						f.Visible = fk > 0.04
						f.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.floor((3 + 34 * fk) * kpx), 1, 0)
						f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(0.7, (0.08 + 0.55 * fk) * XI)
					end
					-- light leak: a warm sweep across the frame at random intervals
					if scene >= 2 and holdK < 0.01 and X.leak <= 0 and t >= X.leakAt then
						X.leak = 1
						X.leakAt = t + 3.5 + math.random() * 4.5
						X.leakDir = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
						X.leakRot = math.random(-26, 26)
					end
					if X.leak > 0 then
						X.leak = X.leak - dt / 1.7
						local u = 1 - math.max(0, X.leak)
						E.leakF.Visible = X.leak > 0
						E.leakF.Rotation = X.leakRot
						E.leakF.Position = UDim2.fromScale(X.leakDir > 0 and (-0.2 + 1.4 * u) or (1.2 - 1.4 * u), 0.5)
						E.leakF.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.5):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), 0.35)
						E.leakF.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.2 * math.sin(u * math.pi) * math.min(1, XI)
					end
				end

				-- HUD
				local hin = easeOutCubic(clamp01((t - 0.2) / 0.9))
				local inset = 22 + (1 - hin) * 80
				for _, b in ipairs(E.hud) do
					b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
					b.host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30 + pulse * 7, 30 + pulse * 7) -- [v57] corner brackets breathe with the beat
					local tr = 1 - hin
					if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
					b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
					b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
				end
				local hudA = 1 - hin * 0.85
				tcL.Text = string.format("REC  %05.2f / %05.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
				nowL.Text = "NOW PLAYING: " .. string.upper(grid and grid.Title or "Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit)")
				ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / DUR) * 100))
				modL.Text = modStatus()
				for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
					l.TextColor3 = col
					l.TextTransparency = hudA
				end
				progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / DUR), 0, 1, 0)
				progFill.BackgroundColor3 = col
				skipStroke.Color = col
				skipBtn.TextColor3 = col
				-- [v30] glowing progress head, breathing skip button, beat edge-flash
				progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col
				progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1)
				local dotS = 6 + pulse * 5
				progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dotS, dotS)
				skipStroke.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3)
				for _, f in ipairs(E.edge) do
					f.BackgroundColor3 = col
					f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - edgeFlash * 0.55
					f.Visible = edgeFlash > 0.02
				end

				-- hand-off flash
				local fa = clamp01((t - (tEnd - flashLen)) / flashLen)
				-- [v48] lighting flashes (beat / cut / impact) tinted with the accent; the hand-off flash stays white
				local flashA = math.max(fa * math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0.4, 1), math.min(0.8, flashK * math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1.2)))
				if holdK > 0.01 and flashA < 0.05 then -- [v50] the track is silent: lights down until it slams back in
					flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
					flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - holdK * 0.7
				else
					flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa))
					flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - flashA
				end
			end
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(run)
		if not ok then
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
		end

		-- finale: always runs (even after a skip or an error)
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
			pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
		end
		pcall(function() -- [v48] hand the camera back: neutral transform, then the whole layer dies with the stage
			world.Position, world.Rotation, worldZoom.Scale = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), 0, 1
		end)
		pcall(function() tri:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
		FX.IntroCamBusy = false
		FX.IntroActive = false
		pcall(function()
			local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(INTENSITY, 0, 1) * 0.9,
				BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
			})
			tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
			Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
			FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
			FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
			FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ 3D LOADING SCREEN ═════════════════════════
	function FX.BuildLoader(host, env)
		local L = {Visible = false, p = 0, target = 0}
		local showToken = 0
		local capT = 0

		local root = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
		root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		root.BorderSizePixel = 0
		root.Visible = false
		root.ZIndex = 40
		root.ClipsDescendants = true

		local function label(size, ax, ay, pos, sz)
			local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", root)
			l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
			l.Position = pos
			l.Size = sz
			l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
			l.TextSize = size
			l.TextColor3 = env.UITextColor and env.UITextColor.Value or WHITE
			l.ZIndex = 5
			l.Text = ""
			return l
		end
		local hint = label(12, 0.5, 0, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
		hint.Text = "tap anywhere to open the UI now  ·  triangle: drag / tap / hold 5s"
		hint.TextTransparency = 0.55
		local cap = label(14, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -50), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
		local status = label(13, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
		status.Text = "Loading modules..."
		if env.UITextColor then
			env.UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				hint.TextColor3, cap.TextColor3, status.TextColor3 = v, v, v
			end)
		end

		local chargeTrack = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
		chargeTrack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		chargeTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -44)
		chargeTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 2)
		chargeTrack.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chargeTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chargeTrack.ZIndex = 5
		local chargeFill = Util.Instance("Frame", chargeTrack)
		chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		chargeFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chargeFill.ZIndex = 6

		local track = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
		track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		track.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -10)
		track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 3)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
		track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.ZIndex = 5
		local fill = Util.Instance("Frame", track)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.ZIndex = 6

		local tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(root, {
			Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, RingSize = 176,
			HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
			IsVisible = function() return root.Visible end,
			OnAction = function(name, n)
				cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
				capT = 1.4
				cap.TextTransparency = 0
			end,
		})
		tri:SetActive(false)
		L.Triangle = tri

		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not L.Visible and root.BackgroundTransparency >= 0.999 then return end
			local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
			if env.GetUIBGColor then root.BackgroundColor3 = env.GetUIBGColor(t) end
			local c = env.GetUIColor and env.GetUIColor(t) or WHITE
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
			chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
			L.p = L.p + (L.target - L.p) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
			fill.Size = UDim2.new(L.p, 0, 1, 0)
			local ch = tri.charge
			chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(ch, 0, 1, 0)
			chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0 or 1
			chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0.8 or 1
			if ch > 0.03 and tri.phase == "idle" then
				cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(ch * 100))
				capT = 0.4
			end
			capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
			cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
		end)

		function L.Show()
			if L.Visible then return end
			L.Visible = true
			showToken = showToken + 1
			L.p, L.target = 0, 0
			root.Visible = true
			tri:SetActive(true)
			tri.scaleBase = 1
			tri:PopIn()
			tween(root, 0.35, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08})
			FX.BlurPulse(6, 0.12, 0.4)
			FX.Play("open", 1, 0.8)
		end
		function L.Hide()
			if not L.Visible then return end
			L.Visible = false
			showToken = showToken + 1
			local my = showToken
			L.target = 1
			tri:Finale()
			FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.1, 0.5)
			task.delay(0.45, function()
				if my ~= showToken then return end
				tween(root, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
				task.delay(0.5, function()
					if my ~= showToken then return end
					root.Visible = false
					tri:SetActive(false)
				end)
			end)
		end
		function L.SetStatus(text, prog)
			if typeof(text) == "string" then status.Text = text end
			if type(prog) == "number" then
				L.target = math.clamp(prog, 0, 1)
			end
		end
		return L
	end
	function FX.LoaderStatus(text, prog)
		if FX.Loader and FX.Loader.Visible then
			FX.Loader.SetStatus(text, prog)
		end
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ HOME-SCREEN HERO TRIANGLE ═════════════════════════
	-- The cool-scene triangle is now the real interactive 3D one: tap = 5 actions (cycles),
	-- drag = rotate, hold 5s = overload -> explode -> reform. Leans toward the cursor and
	-- pulses with the music. Click anywhere ELSE on the scene to enter (as before).
	function FX.MountHero(frame, textColor, music)
		local cap = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
		cap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		cap.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 7)
		cap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		cap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cap.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		cap.TextSize = 14
		cap.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
		cap.TextTransparency = 1
		cap.Text = ""
		cap.ZIndex = 6
		cap.Interactable = false
		if textColor then
			textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				cap.TextColor3 = v
			end)
		end

		-- HUD: corner brackets + live FPS readout
		local brackets = {}
		for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
			local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
			for k = 1, 2 do
				local f = Util.Instance("Frame", frame)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
				f.Position = UDim2.new(ax, ax == 0 and 6 or -6, ay, ay == 0 and 6 or -6)
				f.Size = (k == 1) and UDim2.fromOffset(14, 1) or UDim2.fromOffset(1, 14)
				f.BorderSizePixel = 0
				f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
				f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
				f.ZIndex = 6
				f.Interactable = false
				brackets[#brackets + 1] = f
			end
		end
		local stat = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
		stat.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		stat.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8)
		stat.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 12)
		stat.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		stat.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		stat.TextSize = 11
		stat.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		stat.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
		stat.TextTransparency = 0.5
		stat.Text = ""
		stat.ZIndex = 6
		stat.Interactable = false
		if textColor then
			textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
				stat.TextColor3 = v
			end)
		end
		local fps, fpsT = 60, 0

		local capT, used = 0, false
		local hero
		hero = FX.NewTriangle3D(frame, {
			Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, Music = music,
			RingSize = 176,
			HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
			IsVisible = function()
				return Util.IsGuiVisible(frame)
			end,
			OnAction = function(name, n)
				used = true
				cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
				capT = 1.6
			end,
		})

		local stuck = 0
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not frame.Parent then return end
			-- watchdog: a page transition whose Completed never fired used to leave this scene
			-- permanently Interactable=false (dead triangle + dead click-to-start)
			if frame.Visible and not frame.Interactable and frame.Position == UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) then
				stuck = stuck + dt
				if stuck > 0.9 then
					frame.Interactable = true
					stuck = 0
				end
			else
				stuck = 0
			end
			if not Util.IsGuiVisible(frame) then return end
			fps = fps + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3) - fps) * 0.08
			fpsT = fpsT + dt
			if fpsT > 0.25 then
				fpsT = 0
				stat.Text = string.format("%d FPS", math.floor(fps + 0.5))
			end
			local accent = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
			for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do
				f.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			end
			if hero.charge > 0.03 and hero.phase == "idle" then
				cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(hero.charge * 100))
				capT = 0.4
			end
			capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
			if capT > 0 then
				cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
			elseif not used then
				cap.Text = "tap  ·  drag  ·  hold 5s"
				cap.TextTransparency = 0.55 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.12
			else
				cap.TextTransparency = 1
			end
		end)
		hero:PopIn()
		FX.Hero = hero
		return hero
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ WINDOW BOOT-UP ═════════════════════════
	-- PreBoot collapses the window to a small title bar the moment it is created (no one-frame flash);
	-- Chrome then expands it. Failsafe restores the size if anything goes wrong.
	function FX.PreBoot(win)
		FX.BootFull = win.Size
		win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30)
		task.spawn(function() -- [v23] the intro now runs in parallel, so the safety net only starts once it is over
			while FX.IntroActive do task.wait(0.25) end
			task.wait(12)
			if win.Parent and win.Size.X.Offset == 44 and win.Size.Y.Offset == 30 then
				win.Size = FX.BootFull
			end
		end)
	end

	-- ═════════════════════════ CHROME / AMBIENT LAYER ═════════════════════════
	-- [v41] outline plate that sits beside the window (same anchor / rounding) - the building block of the register motif
	function FX.Plate(win, color, thick, tr, size, pos)
		local p = Util.Instance("Frame", win.Parent)
		p.AnchorPoint, p.Position, p.Size = win.AnchorPoint, pos or win.Position, size or win.Size
		p.BackgroundTransparency, p.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
		p.ZIndex, p.Interactable = 90, false
		Util.Instance("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, FX.Cfg.UIRound)
		local s = Util.Instance("UIStroke", p)
		s.Color, s.Thickness, s.Transparency = color, thick, tr
		Debris:AddItem(p, 6) -- safety net if anything errors later
		return p, s
	end

	-- [v41] WINDOW FOLD - minimize / open choreography, same register motif as the boot reveal but its own shape.
	--   MINIMIZE: the window peels away from two trailing outline ghosts: height snaps shut first (Expo), the width narrows
	--             into the pill after (Quint, bar -> pill morph) while the ghosts lag behind and fold into the dock; tick on arrival.
	--   OPEN:     a laser plate shoots wider than the pill, a tall plate crosses it, the window unfolds width-first, then both
	--             plates close down onto the frame as the height opens, buttons snap open behind it, the world rack-focuses.
	-- Returns the duration (the caller releases its toggle lock then) or nil to fall back to the plain tween.
	function FX.WindowFold(win, content, closing, pos, full)
		if not FX.Settings.Transitions or not win.Parent then return nil end
		local Expo, Cubic = FX.Expo, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic
		local k = 1 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1)
		local total = 1 -- seconds, before the UI animation speed option; the beats below were written for 0.6s / 0.8s and are stretched to it
		local T = total / (closing and 0.6 or 0.8)
		local function tw(o, t, style, dir, props) return tween(o, t * T, style, dir, props) end
		local function after(t, fn) task.delay(t * T * k, fn) end
		local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
		local pill = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30)
		local dest = pos or win.Position
		local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
		local function fade(p, s, t)
			tw(s, t, Quad, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
			Debris:AddItem(p, t * T * k + 0.2)
		end
		if closing then
			local from = win.Size
			local g1, s1 = FX.Plate(win, col, 1.5, 0.15, from)
			local g2, s2 = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1, 0.5, from)
			FX.Play("close", 0.9)
			tw(win, 0.5, Cubic, EOut, {Position = dest})
			tw(win, 0.24, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(from.X.Offset, 30)})
			after(0.2, function()
				tw(win, 0.34, Quint, EInOut, {Size = pill})
			end)
			after(0.04, function()
				tw(g1, 0.46, Quint, EOut, {Size = pill, Position = dest})
				after(0.16, function() fade(g1, s1, 0.28) end)
			end)
			after(0.1, function()
				tw(g2, 0.4, Quint, EOut, {Size = pill, Position = dest})
				after(0.12, function() fade(g2, s2, 0.24) end)
			end)
			after(0.48, function()
				FX.Ring(win.Parent, col, 66, 0.4, 2, dest)
				FX.Play("tick", 0.8)
			end)
			return total * k
		end
		local a, sa = FX.Plate(win, col, 2, 0.1, pill)
		local b, sb = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1.5, 0.3, pill)
		FX.Play("open", 0.85)
		tw(win, 0.5, Cubic, EOut, {Position = dest})
		tw(a, 0.5, Cubic, EOut, {Position = dest})
		tw(b, 0.5, Cubic, EOut, {Position = dest})
		tw(a, 0.3, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 56, 34)})
		after(0.06, function()
			FX.BlurPulse(10, 0.06, 1)
			tw(b, 0.34, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, fy + 40)})
		end)
		after(0.08, function()
			tw(win, 0.3, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)})
		end)
		after(0.34, function()
			tw(win, 0.46, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
			tw(a, 0.24, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
			tw(b, 0.3, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
			FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
			pcall(FX.Cascade, content, true) -- buttons collapse (still clipped) and snap open as the height opens
		end)
		after(0.62, function()
			FX.Ring(win.Parent, col, math.max(fx, fy) * 1.1, 0.5, 2, dest)
			fade(a, sa, 0.3)
			fade(b, sb, 0.3)
		end)
		return total * k
	end

	-- [v41] SIGNATURE MOTION - "REGISTER LOCK". The window leaves its pill as three misregistered outline plates (laser bar,
	-- tall bar, twisted dark echo) on different axes / easings, they hang for a beat, then lock onto the real frame one
	-- after another with a hard Expo snap while the world blur racks out. Stillness -> burst -> lock -> stillness.
	function FX.RegisterLock(win, full, content)
		local Expo, parent = FX.Expo, win.Parent
		local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
		local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
		local plates = {}
		local function plate(color, thick, tr)
			local p, s = FX.Plate(win, color, thick, tr, UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30))
			plates[#plates + 1] = {p, s}
			return p
		end
		local a = plate(col, 2, 0.1)
		local b = plate(WHITE, 1.5, 0.3)
		local c = plate(col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5), 3, 0.35)
		FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1) -- world drops out of focus, racks back as the plates lock
		task.wait(0.14) -- stillness before the burst
		FX.Play("open", 0.8)
		tween(a, 0.34, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 64, 34)})
		tween(b, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, fy + 56)})
		tween(c, 0.5, Quint, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx * 0.74, fy * 0.74), Rotation = -5})
		task.wait(0.12)
		tween(win, 0.34, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)})
		task.wait(0.3) -- hang: the plates hold their misregistration
		FX.Cascade(content, true) -- buttons collapse (still clipped) and snap open in an accelerating stagger as the frame opens
		tween(win, 0.5, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
		tween(a, 0.2, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
		tween(b, 0.26, Expo, EOut, {Size = full})
		tween(c, 0.34, Expo, EOut, {Size = full, Rotation = 0})
		FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
		task.wait(0.2)
		FX.Ring(parent, col, math.max(fx, fy) * 1.25, 0.55, 2, win.Position)
		FX.Sparks(parent, col, 10, math.max(fx, fy) * 0.55, 0.5)
		for _, pr in ipairs(plates) do
