-- [v48] the theme song is always entry 1 (also when a custom Muzik folder replaced the built-in list)
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {Util.ThemeSong.Path, Util.ThemeSong.Title, Theme = true})
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
MusicPlayer.UserPicked = false -- [v48] set by the manual song pickers: the default theme never overrides a manual choice
MusicPlayer.Last = 1
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic = function(i)
	if MusicPlayer.Switching then return end
	MusicPlayer.Switching = true
	local last = MusicPlayer.LastMusic
	if not i and MusicPlayer.Sequential and last then i = last % #MusicPlayer.Database + 1 end -- [v60] shuffle off = list order
	if not i then
		i = last
		while i == last or (MusicPlayer.Database[i].Theme and not Util.ThemeSong.Cached()) do -- random never picks a missing theme
			i = math.random(1, #MusicPlayer.Database)
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	MusicPlayer.LastMusic = i
	local hi = MusicPlayer.Database[i]
	local soundid, soundname = hi[1], hi[2]
	if hi.Theme then pcall(Util.ThemeSong.Ensure, 40) end -- [v48] picked before the one-time download finished: wait for it
	local s, id = pcall(isfile, soundid)
	if s and id then
		s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, soundid)
		if s then
			soundid = id
		else
			soundid = ""
		end
	else
		soundid = ""
	end
	if #soundid == 0 then
		MusicPlayer.Switching = false
		return MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
	end
	UISound.Music.SoundId = soundid
	UISound.Music.Name = soundname
	UISound.Music:Stop()
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
	task.wait()
	UISound.Music:Play()
	task.wait()
	MusicPlayer.Switching = false
end
MusicPlayer.PlayDefault = function() -- [v48] startup music: the theme song when available, otherwise the old random pick
	if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
	local ok = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40)
	if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end -- a song was picked by hand while the download was running
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(ok and 1 or nil)
end
UISound.Music.Ended:Connect(function()
	MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
end)

-- ═════ DYNAMIC COLOUR SYSTEM (v24) ═════
-- One live palette (Accent / Secondary / Tertiary / Bg / Text) that every UI element, the minigame HUDs and the Arcade follow.
-- Modes: 1 Theme, 2 Picked, 3 Rainbow, 4 Harmony cycle, 5 Aurora, 6 Music reactive, 7 Day/Night.  No hex typing needed: use the colour picker.
Util.Color = (function()
	local C = {}
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
	C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
	C.Cur = WHITE
	C.ThemeCol = WHITE
	local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
	local function hsv(c) return c:ToHSV() end
	local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
	local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
		local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
		return (a + d * k) % 1
	end
	function C.Init()
		local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
		if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
			Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2) -- v23 users who had picked an accent keep it
		end
	end
	function C.Base()
		local c = cfg()
		return Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
	end
	function C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
		elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
		elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
		elseif m == 5 then return {h}
		end
		return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
	end
	local function music()
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
			if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
			return 0
		end)
		return ok and v or 0
	end
	-- t = time, theme = the colour the selected UI theme would use. Returns the accent colour for this frame.
	function C.Resolve(t, theme)
		local c = cfg()
		C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
		local mode = c.AccentMode or 1
		local sp = c.ColorSpeed or 1
		local out = C.ThemeCol
		local base = C.Base()
		local bh, bs, bv = base:ToHSV()
		if mode == 2 then
			out = Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
		elseif mode == 3 then
			out = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.1 * sp) % 1, 0.8, 1)
		elseif mode == 4 then
			local hues = C.HarmonyHues(bh)
			local pos = (t * 0.12 * sp) % #hues
			local i = math.floor(pos)
			local k = pos - i
			k = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
			local h = hueLerp(hues[i + 1], hues[(i + 1) % #hues + 1], k)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(bs, 0.55), math.max(bv, 0.85))
		elseif mode == 5 then
			local h = bh + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.5 * sp) + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 0.31 * sp + 1.7)
			out = Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.9 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 0.8 * sp))
		elseif mode == 6 then
			local l = clamp(music() / 700, 0, 1)
			C._ml = (C._ml or 0) + (l - (C._ml or 0)) * 0.25
			out = Color3.fromHSV((bh + C._ml * 0.28) % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.7 + 0.3 * C._ml)
		elseif mode == 7 then
			local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) + tonumber(os.date("%M")) / 60
			local stops = {{0, 0.64, 0.7}, {5, 0.62, 0.8}, {7, 0.06, 1}, {12, 0.53, 1}, {17, 0.08, 1}, {19.5, 0.92, 0.9}, {22, 0.7, 0.75}, {24, 0.64, 0.7}}
			local a, b = stops[1], stops[2]
			for i = 1, #stops - 1 do if hr >= stops[i][1] and hr <= stops[i + 1][1] then a, b = stops[i], stops[i + 1] end end
			local k = (hr - a[1]) / math.max(0.001, b[1] - a[1])
			out = Color3.fromHSV(hueLerp(a[2], b[2], k), 0.75, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k)
		end
		if (c.ColorSat or 1) == 1 and (c.ColorBright or 1) == 1 then C.Cur = out return out end
		local h, s, v = out:ToHSV()
		out = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * (c.ColorSat or 1), 0, 1), clamp(v * (c.ColorBright or 1), 0, 1))
		C.Cur = out
		return out
	end
	function C.Palette(t)
		local a = C.Cur
		local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
		local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
		local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
		local sec, ter
		if m == 5 then
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
		else
			sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
			ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
		end
		return {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
	end
	return C
end)()


Util.FX.InitCustom(SaveData) -- [custom] load saved customization before the intro runs
pcall(Util.Color.Init)

-- [uh admin ext] FLOATING COMMAND TRIANGLE (standalone launcher)
-- Built right here, BEFORE the intro / module loading / admin core, so it can never be blocked by them.
-- It is its own ScreenGui, completely outside the reanimation UI: it works before, during and after reanimating.
-- tap = open the command bar | drag = move (mouse + touch) | hold ~0.7s = hide (tab at the top edge brings it back)
do
	local okL, errL = pcall(function()
		local FX = Util.FX
		Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
			Tris = {},
			State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
		}
		local U = Util.UhAdmin
		U.Tris = U.Tris or {}
		U.State = U.State or {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false}
		local S = U.State
		local SIZE, TRI = 56, 42
		local UIS = UserInputService

		local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		sg.Name = "UhAdminButton"
		sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
		sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		sg.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
		pcall(function() sg.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false end)
		pcall(function() sg.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)
		local parented = false
		if gethiddengui then
			parented = pcall(function() sg.Parent = gethiddengui() end)
		end
		if not parented then
			parented = pcall(function() sg.Parent = CoreGui end)
		end
		if not parented then
			sg.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		end
		U.ButtonGui = sg

		-- themed objects (colors are refreshed by the driver below)
		local accents, bgs, texts = {}, {}, {}
		local function mk(class, props, parent, theme)
			local o = Instance.new(class)
			for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
			o.Parent = parent
			if theme == "accent" then accents[#accents + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "bg" then bgs[#bgs + 1] = o
			elseif theme == "text" then texts[#texts + 1] = o end
			return o
		end
		local function round(parent, r)
			mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(1, 0)}, parent)
		end

		local root = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "UhTriRoot", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE, SIZE), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false,
		}, sg)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, root)

		-- pulsing aura + faint orbit ring behind the button
		local aura = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Aura", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE + 14, SIZE + 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1,
		}, root, "accent")
		round(aura)
		local orbit = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Orbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE + 8, SIZE + 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
		}, root)
		round(orbit)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, orbit, "accent")

		-- the button: dark disc with a comet border that keeps circling
		local btn = mk("TextButton", {
			Name = "UhAdminButton", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Active = true, ZIndex = 3,
		}, root, "bg")
		round(btn)
		local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, btn, "accent")
		local grad = mk("UIGradient", {
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 0.8),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
			}),
		}, stroke)

		-- three dots orbiting the button
		local dots = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local px = i == 1 and 6 or 4
			local d = mk("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
			}, root, "accent")
			round(d)
			dots[i] = d
		end

		-- name tag under the triangle
		local label = mk("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Label", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 12),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 12, Text = "UH ADMIN  \u{2022}  tap = commands  \u{2022}  hold = hide", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5,
		}, root, "text")
		local function flashLabel(secs)
			task.spawn(function()
				TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
				task.wait(secs)
				TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
			end)
		end

		-- fallback glyph (only shown if the 3D triangle engine fails, so something is ALWAYS visible)
		local glyph = mk("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Glyph", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{25B2}", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 28, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Visible = false, ZIndex = 9,
		}, btn)

		-- the 3D triangle (same engine as the hero triangle on the home page)
		local tri
		local okTri, errTri = pcall(function()
			tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(btn, {
				Interactive = false,
				ZIndex = 9,
				LayerAnchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				LayerPos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				LayerSize = UDim2.fromOffset(TRI, TRI),
				IsVisible = function() return S.shown end,
			})
			tri.baseSpin = 1.2
			tri.scaleBase = 1.2
			table.insert(U.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = 1, scale = 1.2})
			U.ButtonTri = tri
		end)
		if not okTri or not tri then
			glyph.Visible = true
			warn("[UhAdmin] 3D triangle failed, using the flat one: " .. tostring(errTri))
		end

		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() S.hover = true end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() S.hover = false end)

		-- ── position / drag (mouse + touch) ──
		local function vpSize()
			local v = sg.AbsoluteSize
			if v.X < 50 or v.Y < 50 then v = Util.GetScreenSize() end
			return v
		end
		local function placeAt(cx, cy) -- pixel centre, clamped so the triangle can never be lost off screen
			local v = vpSize()
			local half = SIZE / 2 + 10
			cx = math.clamp(cx, half, math.max(half, v.X - half))
			cy = math.clamp(cy, half, math.max(half, v.Y - half - 14))
			root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(cx / v.X, cy / v.Y)
		end
		local function loadPos()
			local sx, sy = tostring(FX.Cfg.AdminTriPos or ""):match("^([%d%.]+),([%d%.]+)$")
			sx, sy = tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy)
			if sx and sy then
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(sx, 0.03, 0.97), math.clamp(sy, 0.03, 0.95))
			else
				root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) -- default: middle of the screen
			end
		end
		U.ResetTriPos = function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", "")
			loadPos()
		end
		loadPos()

		local function isPress(i)
			return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		end
		local dragInput, dragStart, startCX, startCY
		local moved, swallow, holdToken, suppressUntil = false, false, 0, 0

		btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not isPress(input) then return end
			local v = vpSize()
			dragInput, dragStart, moved, swallow = input, input.Position, false, false
			startCX = root.Position.X.Scale * v.X
			startCY = root.Position.Y.Scale * v.Y
			holdToken += 1
			local mine = holdToken
			task.delay(0.7, function() -- held still = hide the triangle
				if holdToken == mine and dragInput == input and not moved then
					dragInput, moved, swallow = nil, true, true
					FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", true)
					pcall(Util.Notify, FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
						and "Command triangle hidden. Tap the little tab at the top edge (or type showtri) to bring it back."
						or "Command triangle hidden. Type showtri (prefix + showtri) or use the Customization page to bring it back.")
				end
			end)
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)
			if not same then return end
			local d = input.Position - dragStart
			if not moved and d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
			if moved then placeAt(startCX + d.X, startCY + d.Y) end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if not dragInput then return end
			local same = input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
			if not same then return end
			holdToken += 1
			if moved then
				suppressUntil = os.clock() + 0.3 -- a drag never counts as a tap
				FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", string.format("%.4f,%.4f", root.Position.X.Scale, root.Position.Y.Scale))
			end
			dragInput = nil
		end)

		-- tap = open the command bar (the admin core plugs U.OpenBar in once it is ready)
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if swallow or os.clock() < suppressUntil then return end
			if U.OpenBar then
				local ok, e = pcall(U.OpenBar)
				if not ok then warn("[UhAdmin] open bar failed: " .. tostring(e)) end
			else
				S.shake = 1
				if U.CoreError then
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands failed to load at '" .. tostring(U.Stage) .. "': " .. tostring(U.CoreError):sub(1, 180))
				else
					pcall(Util.Notify, "Commands are still loading (" .. tostring(U.Stage or "waiting") .. "), tap again in a moment.")
				end
			end
		end)

		-- tiny restore tab at the top edge while the triangle is hidden
		local tab = mk("TextButton", {
			Name = "UhRestoreTab", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false,
			Text = "\u{25BC}", TextSize = 9, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 3,
		}, sg, "accent")
		round(tab, UDim.new(0, 8))
		U.RestoreTab = tab
		tab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", false)
		end)

		-- hide / show (cfg AdminTriHidden: Customization switch + hidetri / showtri / tri commands)
		S.applied = nil
		local function applyHidden(hidden)
			if S.applied == hidden then return end
			local first = S.applied == nil
			S.applied = hidden
			if hidden then
				S.shown = false
				S.hover = false
				if first then
					scale.Scale = 0
					root.Visible = false
					if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
				else
					TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0}):Play()
					task.delay(0.37, function()
						if S.applied == true then
							root.Visible = false
							if tri then tri:SetActive(false) end
						end
					end)
				end
			else
				root.Visible = true
				S.shown = true
				if tri then
					tri:SetActive(true)
					tri:PopIn()
				end
				TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
				pcall(FX.Ring, btn, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 90, 0.6, 2)
				flashLabel(3)
			end
		end

		-- live theme (follows the UI color / accent override)
		local themeT = 0
		local function applyTheme(t)
			if t - themeT < 0.05 then return end
			themeT = t
			local cfg = FX.Cfg
			local a, b, c
			if U.GetTheme then
				local ok, x, y, z = pcall(U.GetTheme, t)
				if ok and x then a, b, c = x, y, z end
			end
			a = a or Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1)
			b = b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			c = c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			if cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then a = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or a end
			for _, o in ipairs(accents) do
				if o:IsA("UIStroke") then o.Color = a else o.BackgroundColor3 = a end
			end
			for _, o in ipairs(bgs) do o.BackgroundColor3 = b end
			for _, o in ipairs(texts) do o.TextColor3 = c end
		end

		-- one driver for everything that moves (also drives the command bar's comet border + scan line)
		local drvAcc = 0
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			-- [v34] low end: the launcher / command bar animations update at a capped rate (default 30 fps)
			if FX.IsLowEnd() then
				drvAcc = drvAcc + dt
				if drvAcc < 1 / FX.LowEndUIFPS then return end
				dt, drvAcc = drvAcc, 0
			else
				drvAcc = 0
			end
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock()
				applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
				local showTab = S.applied == true and FX.Cfg.AdminTriTab ~= false
				tab.Visible = showTab
				if showTab then
					tab.Position = UDim2.new(root.Position.X.Scale, 0, 0, 0)
					tab.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.15
				end
				applyTheme(t)

				S.boost = math.max(0, S.boost - dt * 1.6)
				S.flash = math.max(0, S.flash - dt * 2.2)
				S.shake = math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 3)

				-- every registered triangle (button + bar logo) spins faster the more is going on
				local want = 0.9 + (S.hover and 1.1 or 0) + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 2.5 + S.flash * 3
				for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
					local T = e.tri
					if T and T.active then
						T.baseSpin = T.baseSpin + (want * e.mult - T.baseSpin) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
						T.scaleBase = e.scale * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.12 * S.flash)
					end
				end

				if S.shown then
					local speed = 1.4 + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 3 + S.flash * 5
					U.orbitA = (U.orbitA or 0) + dt * speed
					local R = (SIZE + 8) / 2
					for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
						local a = U.orbitA + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
						d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R)
					end
					U.btnGrad = ((U.btnGrad or 0) + dt * (90 + S.boost * 220 + (S.open and 120 or 0))) % 360
					grad.Rotation = U.btnGrad
					local pulse = SIZE + 14 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + S.flash * 18
					aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pulse, pulse)
					aura.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - S.flash * 0.35 - (S.open and 0.07 or 0)
					btn.Rotation = S.shake > 0 and math.sin(t * 55) * 7 * S.shake or 0
					if glyph.Visible then glyph.Rotation = (t * 80 * want) % 360 end
				end

				-- command bar: rotating comet border, thicker while typing / running, scan line while open
				local g, bs = U.BarGrad, U.BarStroke
				if g and g.Parent then
					U.barGradA = ((U.barGradA or 0) + dt * (70 + (S.open and 90 or 0) + S.boost * 260)) % 360
					g.Rotation = U.barGradA
					bs.Thickness = 1.4 + S.boost * 1.2 + S.flash * 1.4
				end
				local sc = U.BarScan
				if sc and sc.Parent and S.open then
					U.scanT = ((U.scanT or 0) + dt / 1.5) % 1
					sc.Position = UDim2.new(0, -70 + U.scanT * 320, 1, 0)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and not U.tickWarned then
				U.tickWarned = true
				warn("[UhAdmin] driver error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end)

		applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
	end)
	if not okL then
		warn("[UhAdmin] triangle launcher failed: " .. tostring(errL))
	end
end

-- [uh admin ext] COMMAND CORE now starts right here (on its own thread), BEFORE the intro / module loading,
-- so the triangle can open the command bar immediately instead of waiting for them.
 --[=[ NAMELESS ADMIN CORE — UH MOD INTEGRATION ]=]--
 -- spawned on its own thread so the mod's loading/websocket loops never block the admin core
 Util.UhAdmin.Stage = "core: starting"
 task.spawn(function()
 local okCore, errCore = xpcall(function()

 --[============================================================================[]--
   NAMELESS ADMIN x NOOBY'S UH MODDED REANIMATION — integrated core
   • Full Nameless Admin command set (every cmd) running inside the Uh mod
   • Nameless Admin UI stripped & rebuilt from scratch with the Uh mod theme
     (live animated accent / dark background, follows the Customization page)
   • Nameless Admin logo PNG replaced by the mod's dynamic 3D triangle
   • Discord startup notification removed
   • Storage forwarded: Nameless-Admin/* -> UhhhhhhReanim/*
 --[]============================================================================]--

 -- [uh integration] notifications routed through the mod's own notification system
 local Notification = {}
 Notification.Notify = function(t)
	 t = t or {}
	 local desc = tostring(t.Description or "")
	 local title = tostring(t.Title or "")
	 local msg = desc
	 if title ~= "" and title ~= "Nameless Admin" then
		 msg = title .. ": " .. desc
	 end
	 pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
 end
 local Notify = Notification.Notify

 -- [uh admin ext] shared state + helpers for the command triangle, command-bar FX, fling removal, hide/show.
 -- Everything lives in Util.UhAdmin so the admin core doesn't gain extra locals (Lua's 200-local limit).
 Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
	 Tris = {},
	 State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
 }
 -- extra command names to drop on top of the "anything with 'fling' in its name" rule below
 Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds = {punch = true}
 -- theme colours (accent, background, text). Uses the mod's live theme once it exists, a rainbow/black/white fallback before.
 Util.UhAdmin.Theme = function(t)
	 local th = Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme
	 if th then
		 local ok, a, b, c = pcall(th, t)
		 if ok and a then return a, b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	 end
	 return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked = function(aliases)
		 local allowed = {walkfling = true, wfling = true, unwalkfling = true, unwfling = true}
		 for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do
			 local l = tostring(n):lower()
			 if Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds[l] then return true end
			 if l:find("fling", 1, true) and not allowed[l] then return true end
		 end
		 return false
	 end
	 Util.UhAdmin.RegisterTri = function(tri, mult, scale)
	 if tri then
		 table.insert(Util.UhAdmin.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = mult or 1, scale = scale or 1})
	 end
 end
 -- events from the bar / list: open, close, type, run, unknown. Every registered triangle reacts.
 Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
	 local U = Util.UhAdmin
	 local S = U.State
	 local function each(f)
		 for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
			 if e.tri and e.tri.active then pcall(f, e.tri) end
		 end
	 end
	 if ev == "open" then
		 S.open = true
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 8 t.pulse = math.max(t.pulse, 0.7) end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "open", 1.2)
	 elseif ev == "close" then
		 S.open = false
	 elseif ev == "type" then
		 S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
	 elseif ev == "run" then
		 S.flash = 1
		 each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
	 elseif ev == "unknown" then
		 S.shake = 1
		 each(function(t)
			 t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
			 if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
		 end)
		 pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
	 end
 end

 -- [uh integration] live theme engine for the rebuilt admin UI.
 -- Uses CollectionService tags so cloned template elements (autofill entries,
 -- command list rows, chat log lines) keep following the theme automatically.
 local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
 local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
 local UH_TAG_BG     = "UhAdmin_BG"
 local UH_TAG_TEXT   = "UhAdmin_Text"
 local function uhTag(obj, kind)
	 local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
	 UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
 end
 do
	 local uhThemeLast = 0
	 game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		 local now = os.clock()
		 if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
		 uhThemeLast = now
		 local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
		 local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
		 if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
			 accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_ACCENT)) do
			 if o:IsA("UIStroke") then
				 o.Color = accent
			 elseif o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_BG)) do
			 if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
				 o.BackgroundColor3 = bg
			 end
		 end
		 for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(UH_TAG_TEXT)) do
			 if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
				 o.TextColor3 = textCol
			 end
		 end
	 end)
 end

 -- [uh integration] programmatic rebuild of the Nameless Admin UI in the Uh theme.
 -- Keeps the exact instance hierarchy the command logic expects
 -- (CmdBar.CenterBar.Input, CmdBar.Autofill.Cmd, ChatLogs.Container.Logs, ...)
 -- so every original gui.* function works untouched, minus the remote UI model.
 local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
	 local o = Instance.new(class)
	 for k, v in pairs(props) do
		 o[k] = v
	 end
	 o.Parent = parent
	 return o
 end

 function BuildAdminUI()
	 local sg = uhNew("ScreenGui", {
		 Name = "UhAdmin",
		 IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		 ResetOnSpawn = false,
		 ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		 DisplayOrder = 2147483646,
	 })
	 local adminScale=uhNew("UIScale",{Scale=1},sg)
	 local function refreshAdminScale()
		 local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
		 if not cam then return end
		 local shortest=math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X,cam.ViewportSize.Y)
		 adminScale.Scale=math.clamp(shortest/720,0.78,1)
	 end
	 refreshAdminScale()
	 if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refreshAdminScale) end

	 -- tooltip that follows the mouse (command descriptions)
	 local description = uhNew("TextLabel", {
		 Name = "Description",
		 Visible = false,
		 BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		 BorderSizePixel = 0,
		 Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		 TextSize = 14,
		 Text = "",
		 ZIndex = 60,
	 }, sg)
	 uhTag(description, "bg") uhTag(description, "text")
	 uhTag(uhNew("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, description), "accent")
	 uhNew("UICorner", {}, description)
	 description.TextWrapped = true
	 description.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	 uhNew("UIPadding", {
		 PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8),
		 PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5),
	 }, description)

	 -- invisible strip the command bar animates on
	 local cmdBar = uhNew("Frame", {
		 Name = "CmdBar",

 --[[ COMMAND FUNCTIONS ]]--
 commandcount = 0
 cmd = {}
 cmd._lastError = nil
 cmd.add = function(...)
	local vars = {...}
	local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
	if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then return false end
	local primary = aliases[1]
	if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
	if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then
		cmd._blocked = cmd._blocked or {}
		for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do cmd._blocked[tostring(n):lower()] = true end
		return false
	end
	-- info[1]/info[2] are read as strings by the command list + autocomplete; a missing one used to abort them
	local meta = {}
	if type(info) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(info) do meta[k] = v end end
	meta[1] = tostring(meta[1] or primary)
	meta[2] = tostring(meta[2] or "")
	primary = primary:lower()
	local registration = {func, meta, aliases = {}}
	if Commands[primary] == nil then commandcount = commandcount + 1 end
	Commands[primary] = registration
	for i = 2, #aliases do
		local alias = aliases[i]
		if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then
			Aliases[alias:lower()] = registration
			registration.aliases[#registration.aliases + 1] = alias:lower()
		end
	end
	return true
 end

 cmd.run = function(args)
	cmd._lastError = nil
	if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
	if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
	local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
	if not registration then
		cmd._lastError = (cmd._blocked and cmd._blocked[caller]) and ("Command is disabled: " .. tostring(args[1])) or ("Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]))
		return false, cmd._lastError
	end
	local arguments = {}
	for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
	local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
	if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
	return true
 end
 
 --[[ LIBRARY FUNCTIONS ]]--

	 return coroutine.wrap(f)()
 end

 local wait = function(int)
	 if not int then int = 0 end
	 local t = tick()
	 repeat
		 RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
	 until (tick() - t) >= int
	 return (tick() - t), t
 end

 -- [[ FUNCTION TO GET A PLAYER ]] --
 local getPlr = function(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
	if query == "" then return nil end
	local prefixMatch, containsMatch
	for _, x in ipairs(players) do
		local user = x.Name:lower()
		local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
		if user == query or display == query then return x end
		if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
		if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
	end
	return prefixMatch or containsMatch
end

function sFLY(vfly, requestedSpeed)
	speedofthefly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthefly) or 10, 1, 200)
	speedofthevfly = math.clamp(tonumber(requestedSpeed) or tonumber(speedofthevfly) or 10, 1, 200)
	pcall(unvfly)

	local player = cmdlp or Players.LocalPlayer
	if not player then return false end

	local keyboardControl = {F = 0, B = 0, L = 0, R = 0, Q = 0, E = 0}
	local jumpUntil = 0
	local activeSpeed = tonumber(vfly and speedofthevfly or speedofthefly) or 10

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then return end
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = -1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 1
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = -1
		end
	end)

	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local k = input.KeyCode
		if k == Enum.KeyCode.W then keyboardControl.F = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.S then keyboardControl.B = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.A then keyboardControl.L = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 0
		elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = 0
		end
	end)

	local function getChar()
		local char = player.Character
		return char, char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local function apply(root, hum)
		local bg = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyGyro") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "UHAdminFlyGyro"
		bg.P = 100000
		bg.D = 1000
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bg.Parent = root

		local bv = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "UHAdminFlyVelocity"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		bv.P = 10000
		bv.Parent = root

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cf = camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame

		local move = Vector3.zero
		move = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then move = move.Unit else move = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
		if right.Magnitude > 0.001 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
		move = move * (keyboardControl.F + keyboardControl.B)
			+ right * (keyboardControl.R + keyboardControl.L)
			+ Vector3.new(0, keyboardControl.Q + keyboardControl.E, 0)

		if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			bv.Velocity = move.Unit * activeSpeed
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		local flatLook = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			flatLook = flatLook.Unit
		else
			flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		end
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)

		hum.AutoRotate = false
		if not vfly then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end

	FLYING = true
	_G.__UH_FLY_MODE = "standard"

	_G.__UH_FLY_STEP = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not FLYING then return end
		local char, hum, root = getChar()
		if char and hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
			apply(root, hum)
		end
	end)

	local _, hum, root = getChar()
	if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
	if root then apply(root, hum) end

	return true
end

function unvfly()
	FLYING=false
	if _G.__UH_FLY_MODE == "standard" then _G.__UH_FLY_MODE = nil end
	pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED then _G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP then _G.__UH_FLY_JUMP:Disconnect() end end); pcall(function() if _G.__UH_FLY_STEP then _G.__UH_FLY_STEP:Disconnect() end end)
	_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_BEGAN,_G.__UH_FLY_INPUT_ENDED,_G.__UH_FLY_JUMP,_G.__UH_FLY_STEP=nil,nil,nil,nil
	local char=cmdlp and cmdlp.Character; local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.PlatformStand=false end
	local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if root then for _,n in ipairs({"UHAdminFlyGyro","UHAdminFlyVelocity","VelocityHandler","GyroHandler"}) do local obj=root:FindFirstChild(n); if obj then obj:Destroy() end end end
end

 -- [[ LIB FUNCTIONS ]] --
 lib.lock = function(instance, par)
	 locks[instance] = true
	 instance.Parent = par or instance.Parent
	 instance.Name = "RightGrip"
 end
 lock = lib.lock
 locks = {}
 
 lib.find = function(t, v)	-- mmmmmm
	 for i, e in pairs(t) do
		 if i == v or e == v then
			 return i
		 end
	 end
	 return nil
 end
 
 lib.parseText = function(text, watch)
	local parsed = {}
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return parsed end
	local delimiter = tostring(watch or " ")
	if delimiter == "" then return {text} end
	local token, quote, escape = {}, nil, false
	local function push() if #token > 0 then parsed[#parsed + 1] = table.concat(token); token = {} end end
	for i=1,#text do
		local ch=text:sub(i,i)
		if escape then token[#token+1]=ch; escape=false
		elseif ch=="\\" and quote then escape=true
		elseif quote then if ch==quote then quote=nil else token[#token+1]=ch end
		elseif ch=="'" or ch=='"' then quote=ch
		elseif delimiter==opt.prefix and ch==delimiter then push()
		elseif delimiter==opt.tupleSeparator and ch==delimiter then push()
		elseif delimiter==" " and ch:match("%s") then push()
		else token[#token+1]=ch end
	end
	push(); return parsed
end

lib.parseCommand = function(text, requirePrefix)
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return false end
	local prefix=tostring(opt.prefix or ";")
	if prefix == "" then prefix = ";" end
	local source=text
	if requirePrefix and source:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return false end
	while source:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix do source=source:sub(#prefix+1) end
	if source:match("^%s*$") then return false end
	local segments,current,quote={}, {}, nil
	for i=1,#source do
		local ch=source:sub(i,i)
		if ch=="'" or ch=='"' then if quote==ch then quote=nil elseif not quote then quote=ch end; current[#current+1]=ch
		elseif ch==";" and not quote then segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current); current={}
		else current[#current+1]=ch end
	end
	segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current)
	local ran=false
	for _,segment in ipairs(segments) do
		local args=lib.parseText(segment," ")
		if #args>0 then local ok,err=cmd.run(args); if ok then ran=true else Util.Notify("Command failed: "..tostring(err)) end end
	end
	return ran
end

	 connections[name .. tostring(math.random(1000000, 9999999))] = connection
	 return connection
 end
 
 lib.disconnect = function(name)
	 for title, connection in pairs(connections) do

			 connection:Disconnect()
		 end
	 end
 end

 --[[ PLAYER FUNCTIONS ]]--
 argument = {}
 argument.getPlayers = function(str)
	 local playerNames, players = lib.parseText(str, opt.tupleSeparator), {}
	 for _, arg in pairs(playerNames or {"me"}) do
		 arg = arg:lower()
		 local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()
		 if arg == "me" or arg == nil then
			 table.insert(players, localPlayer)
			 
		 elseif arg == "all" then
			 for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
				 table.insert(players, plr)
			 end
			 
		 elseif arg == "others" then
			 for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
				 if plr ~= localPlayer then
					 table.insert(players, plr)
				 end
			 end
			 
		 elseif arg == "random" then
			 if #playerList > 0 then table.insert(players, playerList[math.random(1,#playerList)]) end
			 
		 elseif arg:find("%%") == 1 then
			 local teamName = arg:sub(2)
			 for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
				 local team=plr.Team
					if team and tostring(team.Name):lower():find(teamName,1,true)==1 then
					 table.insert(players, plr)
				 end
			 end
			 
		 else
			 for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
				 if plr.Name:lower():find(arg) == 1 or (plr.DisplayName and plr.DisplayName:lower():find(arg) == 1) or (tostring(plr.UserId):lower():find(arg) == 1) then
					 table.insert(players, plr)
				 end
			 end
		 end
	 end
	 return players
 end

 local function SaveAdminPrefix(value)
	local PrefixChange = tostring(value or "")
	PrefixChange = PrefixChange:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if PrefixChange == "" or PrefixChange == "p" or PrefixChange == "[" or PrefixChange == "P" then return false end
	opt.prefix = PrefixChange
	if FileSupport then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) and delfile then delfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) end
			writefile(NA_PREFIX_FILE, PrefixChange)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

end)

						 handle.BodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(handle.Position + Vector3.new(0, handle.Position.Y, 0), Root.Position)
	 
						 if NormalSpin == true then
							 handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos + Vector3.new(x + Target.Humanoid.MoveDirection.X, Height, z + Target.Humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
						 end
	 
						 if EditingPos == false then
							 TargetPos = Target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position
						 end
					 end
				 end
			 end
	 
			 local myWrappedCoroutine = coroutine.wrap(myCoroutine)
	 
			 myWrappedCoroutine()
		 end
	 
		 function Mode2()
			 if Mode == 2 then
				 local Angle = math.pi * 2 / #hats -- number of hats in the circle
	 
				 function Loop()
					 if Mode == 2 then
						 -- Get the orientation of the root part
						 local RootOrientation = Target.Humanoid.RootPart.CFrame - Target.Humanoid.RootPart.Position
						 local RootRotation = RootOrientation
	 
						 for i, Hat in ipairs(hats) do
							 local HatRotation = RootRotation.Y + Angle * (i - 1) + Speed * tick()
							 local x = math.sin(HatRotation) * Offset
							 local z = math.cos(HatRotation) * Offset
	 
							 local HatPos = TargetPos + RootOrientation * Vector3.new(x, z, -Height)
							 Hat.Handle.BodyPosition.Position = HatPos
						 end
	 
						 wait()
						 Loop()
					 end
				 end
	 
				 Loop()
	 
				 for i, Hat in ipairs(hats) do
					 local Handle = Hat.Handle
	 
					 Hat.Handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos
				 end
			 end
		 end

		 function Mode5 ()
			 local spiralPitch = 0
			 local spiralAngle = 0
	 
			 function Loop ()
				 if Mode == 5 then
					 spiralAngle = spiralAngle + Speed / 300
					 if spiralAngle >= math.pi * 10 then
						 spiralAngle = 0
					 end
	 
					 for i, hat in ipairs(hats) do
						 local handle = hat.Handle
						 if handle then
							 local x = math.sin(spiralAngle + i * spiralPitch) * (i * Offset / 8)
							 local y = i * (Height / 3)
							 local z = math.cos(spiralAngle + i * spiralPitch) * (i * Offset / 8)
							 handle.BodyPosition.Position = TargetPos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) + Vector3.new(x, y, z)
						 end
					 end
				 end
				 spiralPitch += Speed / 70
				 task.wait()
				 Loop()
			 end
	 
			 Loop()
		 end

 cmd.add({"clickfling", "mousefling"}, {"mousefling (clickfling)", "Fling a player by clicking them"}, function()
	 local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	 local Mouse = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
	 
	 Mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
		 local Target = Mouse.Target
		 if Target and Target.Parent and Target.Parent:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent) then
			 local PlayerName = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent).Name
	 local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	 local Targets = {PlayerName}
	 
	 local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	 local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
	 
	 local AllBool = false
	 
	 local GetPlayer = function(Name)
		Name = Name:lower()
		if Name == "all" or Name == "others" then
			AllBool = true
			return
		elseif Name == "random" then
			local GetPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
			if table.find(GetPlayers,Player) then table.remove(GetPlayers,table.find(GetPlayers,Player)) end
			return GetPlayers[math.random(#GetPlayers)]
		elseif Name ~= "random" and Name ~= "all" and Name ~= "others" then
			for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
				if x ~= Player then
					if x.Name:lower():match("^"..Name) then
						return x;
					elseif x.DisplayName:lower():match("^"..Name) then
						return x;
					end
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	 end
	 
	 local Message = function(_Title, _Text, Time)
print(_Title)
print(_Text)
print(Time)
	 end
	 
	 local SkidFling = function(TargetPlayer)
		local Character = Player.Character
		local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart
	 
		local TCharacter = TargetPlayer.Character
		local THumanoid
		local TRootPart
		local THead
		local Accessory
		local Handle
	 
		if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		end
		if THumanoid and THumanoid.RootPart then
			TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
		end
		if TCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			THead = TCharacter.Head
		end
		if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") then
			Accessory = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
		end
		if Accessoy and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
			Handle = Accessory.Handle
		end
	 
		if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
			if RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
				getgenv().OldPos = RootPart.CFrame
			end
			if THumanoid and THumanoid.Sit and not AllBool then
			end
			if THead then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THead
			elseif not THead and Handle then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Handle
			elseif THumanoid and TRootPart then
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THumanoid
			end
			if not TCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end
			
			local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
				RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
				Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
				RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
				RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
			end
			
			local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
				local TimeToWait = 2
				local Time = tick()
				local Angle = 0
	 
				repeat
					if RootPart and THumanoid then
						if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
							Angle = Angle + 100
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle),0 ,0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
						else
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
							
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5 ,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
							task.wait()
	 
							FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
							task.wait()
						end
					else
						break
					end
				until BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 or BasePart.Parent ~= TargetPlayer.Character or TargetPlayer.Parent ~= Players or not TargetPlayer.Character == TCharacter or THumanoid.Sit or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or tick() > Time + TimeToWait
			end
			
			workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
			
			local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			BV.Name = "EpixVel"
			BV.Parent = RootPart
			BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
			BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
			
			Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
			
			if TRootPart and THead then
				if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - THead.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then
					SFBasePart(THead)
				else
					SFBasePart(TRootPart)
				end
			elseif TRootPart and not THead then
				SFBasePart(TRootPart)
			elseif not TRootPart and THead then
				SFBasePart(THead)
			elseif not TRootPart and not THead and Accessory and Handle then
				SFBasePart(Handle)
			else
			end
			
			BV:Destroy()
			Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
			workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
			
			repeat
				RootPart.CFrame = getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0)
				Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0))
				Humanoid:ChangeState("GettingUp")
				table.foreach(Character:GetChildren(), function(_, x)
					if x:IsA("BasePart") then
						x.Velocity, x.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(), Vector3.new()
					end
				end)
				task.wait()
			until (RootPart.Position - getgenv().OldPos.p).Magnitude < 25
			workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().FPDH
		else
		end
	 end
	 
	 getgenv().Welcome = true
	 if Targets[1] then for _,x in next, Targets do GetPlayer(x) end else return end
	 
	 if AllBool then
		for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
			SkidFling(x)
		end
	 end
	 
	 for _,x in next, Targets do
		if GetPlayer(x) and GetPlayer(x) ~= Player then
			if GetPlayer(x).UserId ~= 1414978355 then
				local TPlayer = GetPlayer(x)
				if TPlayer then
					SkidFling(TPlayer)
				end
			else
			end
		elseif not GetPlayer(x) and not AllBool then
		end
	 end
		 end
	 end)
 end)

 -- [uh admin ext] triangle visibility + the external walkfling command.
 -- Wrapped in a function so its locals never count against the admin core's local limit.
 Util.UhAdmin.RegisterCmds = function()
	 local function setHidden(v)
		 Util.FX.SetCfg("AdminTriHidden", v and true or false)
	 end
	 cmd.add({"hidetri", "hidetriangle"}, {"hidetri (hidetriangle)", "Hides the floating command triangle. Bring it back with showtri (or the Customization page)"}, function()
		 setHidden(true)
		 Notify({Description = "Command triangle hidden. Open the bar with '" .. opt.prefix .. "' and type showtri to bring it back.", Title = "Uh Admin", Duration = 5})
	 end)
	 cmd.add({"showtri", "showtriangle"}, {"showtri (showtriangle)", "Shows the floating command triangle again"}, function()
		 setHidden(false)
		 Notify({Description = "Command triangle is back.", Title = "Uh Admin", Duration = 3})
	 end)
	 cmd.add({"resettri", "triposition"}, {"resettri (triposition)", "Moves the floating command triangle back to the top centre of the screen"}, function()
		 if Util.UhAdmin.ResetTriPos then Util.UhAdmin.ResetTriPos() end
	 end)
	 cmd.add({"tri", "toggletri"}, {"tri (toggletri)", "Hides / shows the floating command triangle"}, function()
		 setHidden(not Util.FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden)
	 end)

	 -- walkfling is the only fling command exposed by the external Uh Admin.
	 -- The other fling variants are selectable only from the main Fling Method dropdown.
	 local WalkFling = {Enabled = false, Running = false}
	 Util.UhAdmin.WalkFling = WalkFling

	 local function setWalkFling(enabled)
		 WalkFling.Enabled = enabled and true or false
		 if not WalkFling.Enabled or WalkFling.Running then return end
		 WalkFling.Running = true
		 task.spawn(function()
			 local movel = 0.1
			 while WalkFling.Enabled do
				 RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				 if not WalkFling.Enabled then break end
				 local c = Player.Character
				 local hrp = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
				 if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
					 local vel = hrp.Velocity
					hrp.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
					RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
					if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
						hrp.Velocity = vel
					end
					RunService.Stepped:Wait()
					if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
						hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
						movel = movel * -1
					end
				end
			end
			WalkFling.Running = false
		end)
	 end

	 cmd.add({"walkfling", "wfling"}, {"walkfling (wfling)", "Enable walkfling"}, function()
		 setWalkFling(true)
		 Notify({Description = "Walkfling enabled", Title = "Uh Admin", Duration = 5})
	 end)

	 cmd.add({"unwalkfling", "unwfling"}, {"unwalkfling (unwfling)", "Disable walkfling"}, function()
		 setWalkFling(false)
		 Notify({Description = "Walkfling disabled", Title = "Uh Admin", Duration = 5})
	 end)
 end
 Util.UhAdmin.RegisterCmds()

	 });

 --[ LOCALPLAYER ]--
 local function respawn()
 cf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
 game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
 player.CharacterAdded:wait(1); wait(0.2);
	 character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame = cf
	 end
 
 local function refresh()
 cf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
 game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
 player.CharacterAdded:wait(1); wait(0.2);
	 character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame = cf
 end
 
 local abort = 0
 local function getTools(amt)
	 if not amt then amt = 1 end
	 local toolAmount, grabbed = 0, {}
	 local lastCF = character.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	 local ab = abort
	 
	 for i, v in pairs(localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren()) do
		 if v:IsA("BackpackItem") then
			 toolAmount = toolAmount + 1
		 end
	 end
	 if toolAmount >= amt then return localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren() end
	 if not localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem") then return end
	 
	 repeat
		 repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
		 backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
		 wrap(function()
			 repeat wait() until backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem")
			 for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
				 if #grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort then break end
				 if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
					 tool.Parent = localPlayer
					 table.insert(grabbed, tool)
				 end
			 end
		 end)
		 
		 respawn()
		 wait(.1)
	 until
		 #grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort
	 
	 repeat wait() until localPlayer.Character and tostring(localPlayer.Character) ~= "respawn_" and localPlayer.Character == character
	 wait(.2)
	 
	 repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
	 local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
	 for _, tool in pairs(grabbed) do
		 if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
			 tool.Parent = backpack
		 end
	 end
	 wrap(function()
		 repeat wait() until character.PrimaryPart
		 wait(.2)
		 character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(lastCF)
	 end)
	 wait(.2)
	 return grabbed
 end

		 Connections = {};
		 Output = {
			 Enabled = true;
			 Prefix = "[NETWORK] ";
			 Send = function(Type,Output,BypassOutput)
				 if typeof(Type) == "function" and (Type == print or Type == warn or Type == error) and typeof(Output) == "string" and (typeof(BypassOutput) == "nil" or typeof(BypassOutput) == "boolean") then
					 if Network["Output"].Enabled == true or BypassOutput == true then
						 Type(Network["Output"].Prefix..Output);
					 end;
				 elseif Network["Output"].Enabled == true then
					 error(Network["Output"].Prefix.."Output Send Error : Invalid syntax.");
				 end;
			 end;
		 };
		 CharacterRelative = false;
	 }
 
	 Network["Output"].Send(print,": Loading.")
	 Network["Velocity"] = Vector3.new(14.46262424,14.46262424,14.46262424); --exactly 25.1 magnitude
	 Network["RetainPart"] = function(Part,ReturnFakePart) --function for retaining ownership of unanchored parts
		 assert(typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(workspace),Network["Output"].Prefix.."RetainPart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg1 (Part) must be a BasePart which is a descendant of workspace.")
		 assert(typeof(ReturnFakePart) == "boolean" or typeof(ReturnFakePart) == "nil",Network["Output"].Prefix.."RetainPart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg2 (ReturnFakePart) must be a boolean or nil.")
		 if not table.find(Network["BaseParts"],Part) then
			 if Network.CharacterRelative == true then
				 local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
				 if Character and Character.PrimaryPart then
					 local Distance = (Character.PrimaryPart.Position-Part.Position).Magnitude
					 if Distance > 1000 then
						 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as it is more than "..gethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer,"MaximumSimulationRadius").." studs away.")
						 return false
					 end
				 else
					 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as the LocalPlayer Character's PrimaryPart does not exist.")
					 return false
				 end
			 end
			 table.insert(Network["BaseParts"],Part)
			 Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,0,0,0,0)
			 Network["Output"].Send(print,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..".")
			 if ReturnFakePart == true then
				 return FakePart
			 end

			 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as it already active.")
			 return false
		 end
	 end
 
	 Network["RemovePart"] = function(Part) --function for removing ownership of unanchored part
		 assert(typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart"),Network["Output"].Prefix.."RemovePart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg1 (Part) must be a BasePart.")
		 local Index = table.find(Network["BaseParts"],Part)
		 if Index then
			 table.remove(Network["BaseParts"],Index)
			 Network["Output"].Send(print,"RemovePart Output: PartOwnership removed from BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..".")

							 if Network.CharacterRelative == true then
								 local Character = LocalPlayer.Character;
								 if Character and Character.PrimaryPart then
									 local Distance = (Character.PrimaryPart.Position - Part.Position).Magnitude
									 if Distance > 1000 then
										 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"PartOwnership Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as it is more than "..gethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer,"MaximumSimulationRadius").." studs away.")
										 Lost = true;
										 Network["RemovePart"](Part)
									 end
								 else
									 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"PartOwnership Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as the LocalPlayer Character's PrimaryPart does not exist.")
								 end
							 end
							 Part.Velocity = Network["Velocity"]+Vector3.new(0,math.cos(tick()*10)/100,0) --keep network by sending physics packets of 30 magnitude + an everchanging addition in the y level so roblox doesnt get triggered and fuck your ownership
						 else
							 Network["RemovePart"](Part)
						 end
					 end)()
				 end
			 end)
			 Network["Output"].Send(print,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership enabled.")
		 else
			 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership already enabled.")
		 end
	 end)
	 Network["PartOwnership"]["Disable"] = coroutine.create(function()
		 if Network["PartOwnership"]["Connection"] then
			 Network["PartOwnership"]["Connection"]:Disconnect()
			 LocalPlayer.ReplicationFocus = Network["PartOwnership"]["PreMethodSettings"].ReplicationFocus
			 sethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer,"SimulationRadius",Network["PartOwnership"]["PreMethodSettings"].SimulationRadius)
			 Network["PartOwnership"]["PreMethodSettings"] = {}
			 for _,Part in pairs(Network["BaseParts"]) do
				 Network["RemovePart"](Part)
			 end
			 Network["PartOwnership"]["Enabled"] = false
			 Network["Output"].Send(print,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership disabled.")
		 else
			 Network["Output"].Send(warn,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership already disabled.")
		 end
	 end)
	 Network["Output"].Send(print,": Loaded.")
 end

 cmd.add({"blockspam"}, {"blockspam [amount]", "Spawn blocks by the given amount"}, function(amt)
	 amt = tonumber(amt) or 1
	 local hatAmount, grabbed = 0, {}
	 local lastCF = character.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	 character:ClearAllChildren()
	 respawn()
	 repeat
		 if character.Name ~= "respawn_" then
			 local c = character
			 repeat wait() until c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accoutrement")
			 c:MoveTo(lastCF.p)
			 wait(1)
			 for i, v in pairs(c:GetChildren()) do
				 if v:IsA("Accoutrement") then
					 v:WaitForChild("Handle")
					 v.Handle.CanCollide = true
					 if v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("DataModelMesh", true) then
						 v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("DataModelMesh", true):Destroy()
					 end
					 v.Parent = workspace
					 table.insert(grabbed, v)
				 end
			 end
			 hatAmount = hatAmount + 1
		 end
		 character:ClearAllChildren()
		 respawn()
		 wait()
	 until
		 hatAmount >= amt
	 
	 repeat wait() until tostring(localPlayer.Character) ~= "respawn_" and localPlayer.Character
	 wait(0.5)
	 
	 spawn(function()
		 repeat wait() until character.PrimaryPart
		 wait(0.2)
		 character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(lastCF)
		 
		 for _, item in pairs(grabbed) do
			 if item:IsA("Accoutrement") and item:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
				 item.Parent = workspace
				 wait()
			 end
		 end
	 end)
 end)

		 else
			 Name = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
			 for _, x in next, game.Players:GetPlayers() do
				 if x.Name:lower():match(Name) then
					 return x
				 elseif x.DisplayName:lower():match("^" .. Name) then

				 end
			 end
		 end

		 return
	 end
 
	 if THumanoid.Sit then
		 return

	 Tool.Parent = workspace

	 repeat
		 if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - RootPart.CFrame.p).Magnitude < 500 then
			 Tool.Grip = CFrame.new()
			 Tool.Grip = Handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(TRootPart.CFrame):Inverse()

		 firetouchinterest(Handle, TRootPart, 1)

		   until Tool.Parent ~= Character or not TPlayer or not TRootPart or THumanoid.Health <= 0 or os.time() > Timer + .20
			wait(0.4)

			 Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = OldCFrame

		 if not LoopKill then
			 Kill()
		 else
			 while LoopKill do
				 Kill()
			 end
		 end

			 repeat
				 if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - RootPart.CFrame.p).Magnitude < 500 then
					 Tool.Grip = CFrame.new()
					 Tool.Grip = Handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(TRootPart.CFrame):Inverse()
				 end
				 firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,0)
				 firetouchinterest(Handle,TRootPart,1)
				 game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
			 until Tool.Parent ~= Character or not TPlayer or not TRootPart or THumanoid.Health <= 0 or os.time() > Timer + .20
			 Player.Character = nil
			 NewHumanoid.Health = 0
			 player.CharacterAdded:wait(1)
			 repeat game:FindService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait() until Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			 Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = OldCFrame
 end
	   
		 if not LoopKill then
			 Kill()
		 else
			 while LoopKill do
				 Kill()
			 end
		 end
		  end
 end)

 cmd.add({"fpsbooster", "lowgraphics", "boostfps", "lowg"}, {"fpsbooster (lowgraphics, boostfps, lowg)", "Low graphics mode if the game is laggy"}, function()
	 local decalsyeeted = true
	 local g = game
	 local w = g.Workspace
	 local l = g.Lighting
	 local t = w.Terrain
	 sethiddenproperty(l,"Technology",2)
	 sethiddenproperty(t,"Decoration",false)
	 t.WaterWaveSize = 0
	 t.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
	 t.WaterReflectance = 0
	 t.WaterTransparency = 0
	 l.GlobalShadows = 0
	 l.FogEnd = 9e9
	 l.Brightness = 0
	 settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = "Level01"
	 for i, v in pairs(w:GetDescendants()) do
		 if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsA("MeshPart") then
			 v.Material = "Plastic"
			 v.Reflectance = 0
		 elseif (v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture")) and decalsyeeted then
			 v.Transparency = 1
		 elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then
			 v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
		 elseif v:IsA("Explosion") then
			 v.BlastPressure = 1
			 v.BlastRadius = 1
		 elseif v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
			 v.Enabled = false
		 elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.Material = "Plastic"
			 v.Reflectance = 0
			 v.TextureID = 10385902758728957
		 elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") and decalsyeeted  then
			 v.TextureId=0
		 elseif v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.Graphic=0
		 elseif (v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants")) and decalsyeeted then
			 v[v.ClassName.."Template"]=0
		 end
	 end
	 for i = 1,#l:GetChildren() do
		 e=l:GetChildren()[i]
		 if e:IsA("BlurEffect") or e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or e:IsA("BloomEffect") or e:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
			 e.Enabled = false
		 end
	 end
	 w.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
		 wait()--prevent errors and shit
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsA("MeshPart") then
			 v.Material = "Plastic"
			 v.Reflectance = 0
		 elseif v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.Transparency = 1
		 elseif v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") then
			 v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
		 elseif v:IsA("Explosion") then
			 v.BlastPressure = 1
			 v.BlastRadius = 1
		 elseif v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then
			 v.Enabled = false
		 elseif v:IsA("MeshPart") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.Material = "Plastic"
			 v.Reflectance = 0
			 v.TextureID = 10385902758728957
		 elseif v:IsA("SpecialMesh") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.TextureId=0
		 elseif v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") and decalsyeeted then
			 v.ShirtGraphic=0
		 elseif (v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants")) and decalsyeeted then
			 v[v.ClassName.."Template"]=0
		 end
	 end)

 local FindTeams = function()
	 local CC1 = false
	 local CC2 = false
	 
 if PlayerTeam ~= nil and Neutral == false then
		 if #game:GetService("Teams"):GetTeams() > 0 then
		 CC1 = true
		 for i, v in pairs(game:GetService("Teams"):GetTeams()) do
			 if #v:GetPlayers() > 0 and v ~= PlayerTeam and CC1 == true then
				 CC2 = true
			 elseif #v:GetPlayers() <= 0 and CC1 == true then
				 return "FFA"
			 end
		 end
		 elseif #game:GetService("Teams"):GetTeams() <= 0 then
			 return "FFA"
		 end
 elseif Neutral == true then
	 return "FFA"	
 elseif PlayerTeam == nil then
	 return "FFA"
 end
 if CC1 == true and CC2 == true then
	 return "TEAMS"
 end
 end

 function Click()
	 mouse1click()

 function CastRay(Mode)
	 local RaySPTR = Camera:ScreenPointToRay(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y) --Hence the var name, the magnitude of this is 1.
	 local NewRay = Ray.new(RaySPTR.Origin, RaySPTR.Direction * 9999)
	 local Target, Position = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(NewRay, {Char,workspace.CurrentCamera})
	 if Target and Position and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent) and Target.Parent.Humanoid.Health > 0 or Target and Position and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent.Parent) and Target.Parent.Parent.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
		 local TPlayer = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent) or game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent.Parent)
		 if TPlayer.Team ~= PlayerTeam and Mode ~= "FFA" and TPlayer ~= Player then
			 Click()
		 elseif TPlayer.Team == PlayerTeam and TPlayer ~= Player then
			 if Mode == "FFA" then
				 Click()
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end

	 local MobileCameraFramework = {}
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
	local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	
	uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	ismobile = uis.TouchEnabled
	
	local MAX_LENGTH = 900000
	local active = false
	local ENABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(1.7, 0, 0)
	local DISABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(-1.7, 0, 0)
	local function UpdateAutoRotate(BOOL)
		humanoid.AutoRotate = BOOL
	end
	local function GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(ROOT, CAMERA)
		return CFrame.new(root.Position, Vector3.new(CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.X * MAX_LENGTH, root.Position.Y, CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.Z * MAX_LENGTH))
	end
	local function EnableShiftlock()
		local player = players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
		UpdateAutoRotate(false)
		root.CFrame = GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(root, camera)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * ENABLED_OFFSET
	end
	local function DisableShiftlock()
		local player = players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
		UpdateAutoRotate(true)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * DISABLED_OFFSET
		pcall(function()
			active:Disconnect()
			active = nil
		end)
	end
	active = false
	function ShiftLock()
		local player = players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
		if not active then
			active = runservice.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
				EnableShiftlock()
			end)
		else
			DisableShiftlock()
		end
	end

 local roles
 function CreateAllHighlight(p)

		 if v ~= LP and v.Character and not v.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight") then
			 Instance.new("Highlight", v.Character)           
		 end
	 end
 end
 function UpdateAllHighlights()
	 for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
		 if v ~= LP and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight") then
			 Highlight = v.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
				 Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 0)

		 end
	 end

	 function CreateHighlight(p)
		for i, v in pairs(p:GetChildren()) do
			if v ~= LP and v.Character and not v.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight") then
				Instance.new("Highlight", v.Character)           
			end
		end
	end
	function UpdateHighlights(p)

				Highlight = v.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
					Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 225, 0)
				end
			end
		end

 function IsAlive(Player)
	 for i, v in pairs(roles) do
		 if Player.Name == i then
			 if not v.Killed and not v.Dead then
				 return true
			 else
				 return false
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end
 CreateAllHighlight()
	 UpdateAllHighlights(game.Players)

	 Players = game.Players
COREGUI = game.CoreGui

for i,plr in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
for i,v in pairs(COREGUI:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == plr.Name..'_ESP' then
				v:Destroy()
			end
if plr.Character and plr.Name ~= Players.LocalPlayer.Name and not COREGUI:FindFirstChild(plr.Name..'_ESP') then
			local ESPholder = Instance.new("Folder")
			ESPholder.Name = plr.Name..'_ESP'
			ESPholder.Parent = COREGUI

			if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild('Head') then
				local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				BillboardGui.Adornee = plr.Character.Head
				BillboardGui.Name = plr.Name
				BillboardGui.Parent = ESPholder
				BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 150)
				BillboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
				TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -50)
				TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
				TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
				TextLabel.TextSize = 17
				TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(12, 4, 20)
				TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
				TextLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
				TextLabel.Text = '@'..plr.Name .. ' | ' .. plr.DisplayName .. ''
				TextLabel.ZIndex = 10
				local espLoopFunc
				local teamChange
				local addedFunc
				end
end
end

	addedFunc = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		wait(2)
		CreateHighlight(plr)
		UpdateHighlights(plr)
					if ESPenabled then
						espLoopFunc:Disconnect()
						teamChange:Disconnect()
						ESPholder:Destroy()
						repeat wait(1) until plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						ESP(plr)
					else
						addedFunc:Disconnect()
					end
				end)
end
	 end)
 
		 cmd.add({"unesp"}, {"unesp", "Disables esp"}, function()
			addedFunc:Disconnect()
 for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do

		 local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")

		 end
	 end
 end

				 wait()
				 lib.disconnect("noclip")
				 
	 end)

		 v.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	 end
	 
	 for _,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
		 if v.ClassName == "Tool" then
	 x = Instance.new("Attachment")
	 s = Instance.new("RopeConstraint")
	 v.Handle.CanCollide = true
	 x.Parent = v.Handle
	 s.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	 s.Attachment1 = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character["Right Arm"].RightGripAttachment
	 s.Attachment0 = v.Handle.Attachment
	 s.Length = 100
	 s.Visible = true
	 wait()
	 end
	 end
	 for _,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
		 if v.Name == "RightGrip" then
			 v:Destroy()
		 end
	 end
	 
	 while wait() do
		 for _,v in pairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
			 if v.ClassName == "Tool" then
				 v.Handle.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-100, 100), 5, math.random(-100, 100))
			 end
		 end
	 end
 end)

 cmd.add({"admin"}, {"admin", "whitelist someone to allow them to use commands"}, function(...)
	 function ChatMessage(Message, Whisper)	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(Message, Whisper or "ALl")
	 end
	 local Player = getPlr(...)
	 if Player ~= nil and not Admin[Player.UserId] then
		 Admin[Player.UserId] = {Player = Player}
		 ChatMessage("/w "..Player.Name.." [Nameless Admin] You've got admin. Prefix: ';'")
		 wait(0.2)
		 ChatMessage("/w "..Player.Name.." [Nameless Admin Commands] glue, unglue, fcd, fti, fpp, fireremotes, holdhat")
		 ChatMessage("/w "..Player.Name.." reset, commitoof, seizure, unseizure, toolorbit, lay, fall, toolspin, hatspin, sit, joke, kanye")
		 Notify({
			 Description = "" .. Player.Name .. " has now been whitelisted to use commands";
			 Title = "Nameless Admin";
			 Duration = 15;
			 
			 });
	 else
		 Notify({
			 Description = "No player found";
			 Title = "Nameless Admin";
			 Duration = 15;
			 
			 });
	 end
 end)

 wait();

 });

	 local Players = game:FindService("Players")
 require(game:GetService("Chat"):WaitForChild("ClientChatModules").ChatSettings).PlayerDisplayNamesEnabled = false
 local function rename(character,name)
	 repeat task.wait() until character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	 character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid").DisplayName = name
 end
 for i,v in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
	 if v.Character then
		 v.DisplayName = v.Name
		 rename(v.Character,v.Name)

	 end)
 end

 cmd.add({"anticlientkick", "antickick"}, {"anticlientkick (antickick)", "Makes local scripts not able to kick you"}, function()
	if not hookmetamethod then 
		Notify({
			Description = "Your executor does not support anticlientkick";
			Title = "Nameless Admin";
			Duration = 5;
			
			});
			end
	oldhmmi = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", function(self, method)
		if self == LocalPlayer and method:lower() == "kick" then
			return print("Expected ':' not '.' calling member function Kick")
		end
		return oldhmmi(self, method)
	end)
	oldhmmnc = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
		if self == LocalPlayer and getnamecallmethod():lower() == "kick" then
			return
			Notify({
				Description = "A kick was just attempted but was blocked";
				Title = "Nameless Admin";
				Duration = 5;
				
				});
		end
		return oldhmmnc(self, ...)
			end)
 Notify({
 Description = "Anti kick executed";
 Title = "Nameless Admin";
 Duration = 5;
 
 });
 end)

 cmd.add({"serverhop", "shop"}, {"serverhop (shop)", "Serverhop"}, function()
				 wait();
 
 Notify({
 Description = "Searching";
 Title = "Nameless Admin";
 Duration = 5;
 
 });
				 local Number = 0
				 local SomeSRVS = {}
				 for _, v in ipairs(game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(game:HttpGetAsync("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. game.PlaceId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100")).data) do
					 if type(v) == "table" and v.maxPlayers > v.playing and v.id ~= game.JobId then
						 if v.playing > Number then
							 Number = v.playing
							 SomeSRVS[1] = v.id
						 end
					 end
				 end
				 if #SomeSRVS > 0 then
				 Notify({
 Description = "Searched, please wait while we are teleporting you";
 Title = "Nameless Admin";
 Duration = 5;
 
 });
					 game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, SomeSRVS[1])
				 end
 end)
 
 cmd.add({"autorejoin", "autorj"}, {"autorejoin", "Rejoins the server if you get kicked / disconnected"}, function()
	Players = game.Players

	game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxPromptGui"):FindFirstChild("promptOverlay").DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Err)
			if Err.Name == "ErrorTitle" then
				Err:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
					if Err.Text:sub(0, 12) == "Disconnected" then
						if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 then
							Players.LocalPlayer:Kick("\nRejoining...")
							wait()
							game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId, game.Players.LocalPlayer)
						else
							game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, game.Players.LocalPlayer)
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		Notify({
			Description = "Auto Rejoin is now on!";
			Title = "Nameless Admin";
			Duration = 5;
			
			}); end)
