function NotifFuns.mkHdr(par, z, kind, onPause, owner)
	local state = ctx(owner or par)
	local btnSize = isMobile and 36 or 30
	local gap = 8
	local hh = isMobile and 60 or 56
	local hdr = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(hdr, UI_ATTR.HEADER)
	hdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hdr.Active = kind == "Popup"
	hdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, hh)
	hdr.ZIndex = z + 200
	hdr.Parent = par
	state.hdr = hdr
	state.headH = hh
	local line = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(line)
	line.BorderSizePixel = 0
	line.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Border
	line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
	line.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 1, -1)
	line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAD * 2, 0, 1)
	line.ZIndex = z + 199
	line.Parent = hdr
	local act = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(act)
	act.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	act.Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD, 0.5, 0)
	act.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, btnSize)
	act.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	act.ZIndex = z + 220
	act.Parent = hdr
	local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", act)
	lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, gap)
	lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	local posBtn, setPosSel
	if kind ~= "Popup" then
		posBtn, setPosSel = mkIcn(act, "≡", act.ZIndex + 1, CURF[kind])
		posBtn.LayoutOrder = 40
	end
	local fbtn, setFontSel = mkIcn(act, "Aa", act.ZIndex + 1, CURF[kind])
	local cls = mkIcn(act, "×", act.ZIndex + 1, CURF[kind], "bad")
	fbtn.LayoutOrder = 30
	cls.LayoutOrder = 50
	local ttl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	protectUiInst(ttl)
	ttl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	ttl.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 0.5, 0)
	ttl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAD * 2, 1, -16)
	ttl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ttl.TextWrapped = false
	ttl.TextScaled = false
	ttl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	ttl.ClipsDescendants = true
	ttl.Font = CURF[kind]
	ttl.TextSize = kind == "Popup" and (isMobile and 22 or 20) or (isMobile and 20 or 18)
	ttl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	ttl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	ttl.TextColor3 = TH.Ttl
	ttl.RichText = true
	ttl.ZIndex = z + 210
	ttl.Parent = hdr
	local cnt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	protectUiInst(cnt)
	cnt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	cnt.BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnHover
	cnt.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	cnt.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cnt.Font = CURF[kind]
	cnt.TextScaled = true
	cnt.TextColor3 = TH.Ttl
	cnt.Text = "1x"
	cnt.ZIndex = z + 210
	cnt.Visible = false
	cnt.Parent = hdr
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner", cnt)
	cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	local ccon = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", cnt)
	ccon.MinTextSize = 10
	ccon.MaxTextSize = isMobile and 14 or 12
	local function refTitle()
		if state.closing then return end
		local ax, num = 0, 0
		for _, b in act:GetChildren() do
			if b:IsA("GuiObject") and b.Visible then
				ax += b.Size.X.Offset
				num += 1
			end
		end
		ax += math.max(0, num - 1) * gap
		local as = UDim2.fromOffset(ax, btnSize)
		if act.Size ~= as then act.Size = as end
		local w = owner and owner.Size.X.Offset or par.AbsoluteSize.X / csc(par)
		local room = math.max(0, w - PAD * 2 - ax - gap)
		local cw = 0
		if (state.stackCount or 1) > 1 and room >= 60 then
			cw = math.min(64, room - 32, math.max(32, ts:GetTextSize(cnt.Text, ccon.MaxTextSize, CURF[kind], Vector2.new(200, 24)).X + 12))
		end
		local vis = cw > 0
		local cp = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - ax - gap, 0.5, 0)
		local cs = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, btnSize - 8)
		local titleW = math.max(0, room - (vis and cw + gap or 0))
		local size = UDim2.new(0, titleW, 1, -16)
		if cnt.Visible ~= vis then cnt.Visible = vis end
		if cnt.Position ~= cp then cnt.Position = cp end
		if cnt.Size ~= cs then cnt.Size = cs end
		if ttl.Size ~= size then ttl.Size = size end
		if state.body then
			local bp = UDim2.fromOffset(0, hh)
			local bh = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -hh - (state.footH or 0))
			if state.body.Position ~= bp then state.body.Position = bp end
			if state.body.Size ~= bh then state.body.Size = bh end
		end
	end
	local function watchBtn(b)
		if b:IsA("GuiObject") then
			addConnection(b, b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(refTitle))
			addConnection(b, b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(refTitle))
		end
	end
	for _, b in act:GetChildren() do watchBtn(b) end
	addConnection(act, act.ChildAdded:Connect(function(b)
		watchBtn(b)
		refTitle()
	end))
	addConnection(act, act.ChildRemoved:Connect(refTitle))
	if owner then
		addConnection(owner, owner:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(refTitle))
	end
	state.stackCount = 1
	state.setStackCount = function(n)
		local v = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(n) or 1))
		state.stackCount = v
		cnt.Text = tostring(v) .. "x"
		refTitle()
	end
	state.refTitle = refTitle
	refTitle()
	local function closeCard()
		local p = findCardAncestor(par)
		if p then
			local s = ctx(p)
			if s and s.close then
				s.close()
			end
		end
	end
	addConnection(cls, cls.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		closeCard()
	end))
	local fMenu, fCon, rec
	local pMenu, pCon
	local closePosFn = function() end
	local fNonce = 0
	local pNonce = 0
	local menuGateUntil = 0
	local function canToggleMenu()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now < menuGateUntil then
			return false
		end
		menuGateUntil = now + 0.07
		return true
	end
	local function disconnectMenuConn(conn)
		if not conn then
			return nil
		end
		conn:Disconnect()
		local sp = ctxMap[par]
		if sp and sp.connections then
			sp.connections[conn] = nil
		end
		return nil
	end
	local fontApplyBusy = false
	local dockApplyBusy = false
	local function refreshFonts()
		if not rec then
			return
		end
		for _, r in rec do
			local on = r.font == CURF[kind]
			r.set(on)
		end
	end
	local function closeFont()
		fNonce += 1
		fCon = disconnectMenuConn(fCon)
		if fMenu and fMenu.Parent then
			NotifFuns.hideMenu(fMenu)
		end
		fMenu = nil
		rec = nil
		setFontSel(false)
		if kind == "Notify" and onPause then
			onPause(false)
		end
	end
	local function openFont()
		if state.closing then
			return
		end
		if fMenu and fMenu.Parent then
			closeFont()
			return
		end
		closePosFn()
		if kind == "Notify" and onPause then onPause(true) end
		setFontSel(true)
		fNonce += 1
		local thisNonce = fNonce
		local m = Instance.new("Frame")
		m.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Bg
		m.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		m.BorderSizePixel = 0
		m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(isMobile and 260 or 240, math.max(1, gui.AbsoluteSize.X - 24)), math.min(isMobile and 320 or 270, math.max(1, gui.AbsoluteSize.Y - 24)))
		m.ZIndex = kind == "Popup" and (POPUP_FRAME_Z + 300) or (ov.ZIndex + 10)
		m.Parent = ov
		fMenu = m
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner", m)
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", m)
		s.Color = TH.Border
		s.Thickness = 1
		s.Transparency = 0.8
		local p = Instance.new("UIPadding", m)
		p.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
		p.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
		p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
		p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
		local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
		sf.ScrollBarThickness = 4
		sf.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
		sf.ZIndex = m.ZIndex + 1
		sf.Parent = m
		local lay2 = Instance.new("UIListLayout", sf)
		lay2.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		lay2.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		rec = {}
		for _, pair in FONTS do
			local b = mkMenuBtn(sf, pair[1], sf.ZIndex + 1, CURF[kind])
			local setSel = function(on)
				b:SetAttribute("sel", on)
				local props = {
					BackgroundColor3 = on and TH.BtnSel or TH.Btn,
					BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1,
					TextColor3 = on and TH.Bg or TH.Txt
				}
				if ctxMap[m] and ctxMap[m].shown then
					NotifFuns.tween(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), props)
				else
					for prop, v in props do b[prop] = v end
				end
			end
			table.insert(rec, {
				btn = b,
				font = pair[2],
				set = setSel
			})
			addConnection(b, b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if fontApplyBusy then
					return
				end
				fontApplyBusy = true
				local ok = pcall(function()
					setFontKind(kind, pair[2])
					applyFontTree(par, pair[2])
					refreshFonts()
					refTitle()
				end)
				fontApplyBusy = false
				if not ok then
					return
				end
			end))
		end
		refreshFonts()
		placeMenu(fbtn, m)
		fCon = disconnectMenuConn(fCon)
		fCon = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if thisNonce ~= fNonce then
				fCon = disconnectMenuConn(fCon)
				return
			end
			if fMenu == m and fMenu.Parent and fbtn and fbtn.Parent then
				placeMenu(fbtn, fMenu)
			else
				fCon = disconnectMenuConn(fCon)
			end
		end)
		addConnection(par, fCon)
		NotifFuns.showMenu(m, owner or par)
	end
	addConnection(fbtn, fbtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not canToggleMenu() then
			return
		end
		if state.closing then
			return
		end
		if fMenu then
			closeFont()
		else
			openFont()
		end
	end))
	if posBtn then
		local POS = {
			{ "Top", "top" },
			{ "Bottom", "bottom" },
			{ "Top Right", "topRight" },
			{ "Top Left", "topLeft" },
			{ "Bottom Right", "bottomRight" },
			{ "Bottom Left", "bottomLeft" }
		}
		local function closePos()
			pNonce += 1
			pCon = disconnectMenuConn(pCon)
			if pMenu and pMenu.Parent then
				NotifFuns.hideMenu(pMenu)
			end
			pMenu = nil
			setPosSel(false)
			if kind == "Notify" and onPause then
				onPause(false)
			end
		end
		local function openPos()
			if state.closing then
				return
			end
			if pMenu and pMenu.Parent then
				closePos()
				return
			end
			closeFont()
			if kind == "Notify" and onPause then onPause(true) end
			setPosSel(true)
			pNonce += 1
			local thisNonce = pNonce
			local m = Instance.new("Frame")
			m.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Bg
			m.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			m.BorderSizePixel = 0
			m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(isMobile and 230 or 210, math.max(1, gui.AbsoluteSize.X - 24)), math.min(isMobile and 314 or 266, math.max(1, gui.AbsoluteSize.Y - 24)))
			m.ZIndex = kind == "Popup" and (POPUP_FRAME_Z + 300) or (ov.ZIndex + 10)
			m.Parent = ov
			pMenu = m
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner", m)
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", m)
			s.Color = TH.Border
			s.Thickness = 1
			s.Transparency = 0.8
			local padF = Instance.new("UIPadding", m)
			padF.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
			padF.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
			padF.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
			padF.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
			local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
			sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
			sf.ScrollBarThickness = 3
			sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
			sf.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			sf.ZIndex = m.ZIndex + 1
			sf.Parent = m
			local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", sf)
			list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
			list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			for _, ent in POS do
				local b = mkMenuBtn(sf, ent[1], m.ZIndex + 2, CURF[kind])
				b:SetAttribute("sel", state.dock == ent[2])
				if state.dock == ent[2] then
					b.BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnSel
					b.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					b.TextColor3 = TH.Bg
				end
				addConnection(b, b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					if dockApplyBusy then
						return
					end
					dockApplyBusy = true
					pcall(function()
						local p0 = findCardAncestor(par)
						local s0 = ctx(p0)
						if s0.setDock then
							s0.setDock(ent[2], true)
						end
						closePos()
					end)
					dockApplyBusy = false
				end))
			end
			placeMenu(posBtn, m)
			pCon = disconnectMenuConn(pCon)
			pCon = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if thisNonce ~= pNonce then
					pCon = disconnectMenuConn(pCon)
					return
				end
				if pMenu == m and pMenu.Parent and posBtn and posBtn.Parent then
					placeMenu(posBtn, pMenu)
				else
					pCon = disconnectMenuConn(pCon)
				end
			end)
			addConnection(par, pCon)
			NotifFuns.showMenu(m, owner or par)
		end
		addConnection(posBtn, posBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not canToggleMenu() then
				return
			end
			if state.closing then
				return
			end
			if pMenu then
				closePos()
			else
				openPos()
			end
		end))
		closePosFn = closePos
	end
	state.closeMenus = function()
		closeFont()
		closePosFn()
	end
	return hdr, ttl, act
end
mkHdr = NotifFuns.mkHdr

function NotifFuns.attachTimer(card, fil, dur)
	local hover = uis.MouseEnabled
	local ext = false
	local hov = false
	local s = ctx(card)
	local function closeCard()
		if s and s.close and (not s.closing) then
			s.close()
		end
	end
	if not fil then
		local runDur = dur
		local rem = runDur
		local th
		local function start()
			if th and coroutine.status(th) ~= "dead" then
				return
			end
			th = task.spawn(function()
				local last = os.clock()
				while rem > 0 do
					if s.closing then
						break
					end
					if ext or hov then
						last = os.clock()
						task.wait(0.05)
					else
						local now = os.clock()
						local dt = now - last
						rem -= dt
						last = now
						task.wait(0.05)
					end
				end
				th = nil
				if not ext and (not hov) and (not s.closing) then
					closeCard()
				end
			end)
		end
		start()
		addConnection(card, card.Destroying:Connect(function()
			ext = true
			rem = 0
		end))
		if hover then
			addConnection(card, card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				hov = true
			end))
			addConnection(card, card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				hov = false
			end))
		end
		return {
			pause = function()
				ext = true
			end,
			resume = function()
				if not ext then
					return
				end
				ext = false
				start()
			end,
			reset = function(newDur)
				if typeof(newDur) == "number" and newDur > 0 then
					runDur = newDur
				end
				rem = runDur
				if not ext and (not hov) then
					start()
				end
			end
		}
	end
	local frac = 1
	local runDur = dur
	local tn
	local function stop()
		if tn then
			tn:Cancel()
			tn = nil
		end
	end
	local function playFrom(f)
		if s.closing then
			stop()
			return
		end
		fil.Size = UDim2.new(f, 0, 1, 0)
		stop()
		local d = math.max(0.01, runDur * f)
		tn = tw:Create(fil, TweenInfo.new(d, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		})
		local doneConn
		doneConn = addConnection(fil, tn.Completed:Connect(function()
			if doneConn then
				local sf = ctxMap[fil]
				if sf and sf.connections then
					sf.connections[doneConn] = nil
				end
				pcall(function() doneConn:Disconnect() end)
				doneConn = nil
			end
			if not ext and (not hov) and fil.Size.X.Scale <= 0.001 and (not s.closing) then
				closeCard()
			end
		end))
		tn:Play()
		addTween(fil, tn)
	end
	local function ref()
		if s.closing then
			stop()
			return
		end
		if ext or hov then
			stop()
			frac = fil.Size.X.Scale
		else
			playFrom(frac)
		end
	end
	playFrom(frac)
	if hover then
		addConnection(card, card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hov = true
			ref()
		end))
		addConnection(card, card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hov = false
			ref()
		end))
	end
	return {
		pause = function()
			ext = true
			ref()
		end,
		resume = function()
			ext = false
			ref()
		end,
		reset = function(newDur)
			if typeof(newDur) == "number" and newDur > 0 then
				runDur = newDur
			end
			frac = 1
			fil.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			if ext or hov then
				stop()
			else
				playFrom(1)
			end
		end
	}
end
attachTimer = NotifFuns.attachTimer

function NotifFuns.calcCellH(w, list, font)
	local h = isMobile and 48 or 42
	for _, info in list do
		local t = tostring(info.Text or "")
		local iconSpace = 0
		local raw = info.Image
		if raw ~= nil then
			if typeof(raw) == "number" then
				raw = "rbxassetid://" .. raw
			elseif typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
				raw = nil
			end
		end
		if raw and raw ~= "" then
			iconSpace = isMobile and 36 or 32
		end
		local avail = math.max(10, w - 28 - iconSpace)
		local sz = ts:GetTextSize(t, isMobile and 15 or 14, font, Vector2.new(avail, math.huge))
		h = math.max(h, math.ceil(sz.Y) + (isMobile and 20 or 18))
	end
	return math.clamp(h, isMobile and 48 or 42, isMobile and 140 or 110)
end
calcCellH = NotifFuns.calcCellH

function NotifFuns.mkBtnArea(cntObj, list, owner, z, maxH, font)
	if not list or #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sf.Active = (ctx(owner).kind == "Popup")
	sf.ScrollingEnabled = (ctx(owner).kind == "Popup")
	sf.ScrollBarThickness = (ctx(owner).kind == "Popup") and (isMobile and 8 or 6) or 0
	sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	sf.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	sf.ZIndex = z or 10
	sf.ClipsDescendants = true
	sf.Parent = cntObj
	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout", sf)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, isMobile and 14 or 12, 0, isMobile and 14 or 12)
	grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 1
	grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	local function scv()
		return csc(owner)
	end
	local function fitCells()
		local sca = scv()
		local w = sf.AbsoluteSize.X / sca
		if w <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local gap = isMobile and 14 or 12
		local cols
		if isMobile then
			cols = math.min(3, #list)
		else
			local minCell = 140
			cols = math.floor((w + gap) / (minCell + gap))
			cols = math.clamp(cols, 1, 3)
			cols = math.min(cols, #list)
		end
		grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = cols
		if cols <= 1 then
			local ch = calcCellH(w, list, font)
			grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ch)
		else
			local bw = math.floor((w - (cols - 1) * gap) / cols)
			if (not isMobile) and bw < 80 then
				cols = math.max(1, cols - 1)
				grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = cols
				if cols <= 1 then
					local ch = calcCellH(w, list, font)
					grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ch)
					return
				end
				bw = math.floor((w - (cols - 1) * gap) / cols)
			end
			local ch = calcCellH(bw, list, font)
			grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, bw, 0, ch)
		end
	end
	addConnection(sf, sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		fitCells()
	end))
	local function fitH()
		local sca = scv()
		local need = (grid.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + (isMobile and 10 or 8)) / sca
		local cap = math.min(430, math.max(44, maxH or math.floor(gui.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.52))) / sca
		local h = math.min(need, cap)
		local size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
		if sf.Size ~= size then sf.Size = size end
		sf.ScrollingEnabled = need > cap
		sf.ScrollBarThickness = need > cap and (isMobile and 8 or 6) or 0
		task.defer(function()
			if owner.Parent then NotifFuns.resizeCard(owner) end
		end)
	end
	addConnection(grid, grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		fitH()
	end))
	task.defer(function()
		fitCells()
		fitH()
	end)
	task.defer(function()
		local so = ctx(owner)
		if so and so.sc and so.sc.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			addConnection(owner, so.sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(fitCells)
				task.defer(fitH)
			end))
		end
	end)
	local s = ctx(owner)
	s.sel = s.sel or {}
	s.btns = s.btns or {}
	for _, info in list do
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
		b.AutoButtonColor = false
		b.Text = ""
		b.ZIndex = (z or 10) + 1
		b.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		b.ClipsDescendants = true
		b.Parent = sf
		local cr = Instance.new("UICorner", b)
		cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
		st.Color = TH.Border
		st.Transparency = 0.92
		st.Thickness = 1
		local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", b)
		pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 14 or 12)
		pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 14 or 12)
		pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 18 or 16)
		pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 18 or 16)
		local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", b)
		lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
		lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		local raw = info.Image
		if raw ~= nil then
			if typeof(raw) == "number" then
				raw = "rbxassetid://" .. raw
			elseif typeof(raw) ~= "string" then
				raw = nil
			end
		end
		local hasIcon = raw and raw ~= "" and true or false
		lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, hasIcon and (isMobile and 12 or 10) or 0)
		local ic = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		ic.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ic.Image = raw and raw or ""
		ic.Visible = hasIcon
		ic.ImageTransparency = hasIcon and 0 or 1
		ic.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		ic.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 2
		ic.LayoutOrder = 10
		ic.Size = hasIcon and UDim2.fromOffset((isMobile and 24 or 22), (isMobile and 24 or 22)) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		ic.Parent = b
		local lb = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lb.TextColor3 = TH.Txt
		lb.RichText = true
		lb.TextWrapped = true
		lb.TextScaled = false
		lb.TextSize = isMobile and 15 or 14
		lb.Font = font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
		lb.Text = info.Text or ""
		lb.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 2
		lb.LayoutOrder = 20
		lb.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		lb.TextXAlignment = hasIcon and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		lb.Size = UDim2.new(1, hasIcon and (isMobile and -36 or -32) or 0, 1, 0)
		lb.Parent = b
		local function setSel(on, instant)
			b:SetAttribute("sel", on)
			if instant then
				if on then
					b.BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnSel
					b.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					st.Transparency = 0.7
					lb.TextColor3 = TH.Bg
					if hasIcon then
						ic.ImageColor3 = TH.Bg
					end
				else
					b.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn
					b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					st.Transparency = 0.92
					lb.TextColor3 = TH.Txt
					if hasIcon then
						ic.ImageColor3 = TH.Txt
					end
				end
				return
			end
			if on then
				tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnSel,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0
				}):Play()
				tw:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					Transparency = 0.7
				}):Play()
				tw:Create(lb, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					TextColor3 = TH.Bg
				}):Play()
				if hasIcon then
					tw:Create(ic, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
						ImageColor3 = TH.Bg
					}):Play()
				end
			else
				tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1
				}):Play()
				tw:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					Transparency = 0.92
				}):Play()
				tw:Create(lb, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
					TextColor3 = TH.Txt
				}):Play()
				if hasIcon then
					tw:Create(ic, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
						ImageColor3 = TH.Txt
					}):Play()
				end
			end
		end
		s.btns[b] = {
			info = info,
			set = setSel
		}
		setSel(false, true)
		addConnection(b, b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if b:GetAttribute("sel") then
				return
			end
			tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 0
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnHover
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				Transparency = 0.85
			}):Play()
		end))
		addConnection(b, b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if b:GetAttribute("sel") then
				return
			end
			tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				Transparency = 0.92
			}):Play()
		end))
		addConnection(b, b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if s.multi then
				local i = table.find(s.sel, info)
				if i then
					table.remove(s.sel, i)
					setSel(false)
				else
					table.insert(s.sel, info)
					setSel(true)
				end
				if s.ok then
					s.ok(#s.sel > 0)
				end
			else
				if info.Callback then
					local t = s.inp and s.inp.Text or ""
					info.Callback(t)
				end
				if s.close then
					s.close()
				end
			end
		end))
	end
	return sf
end
mkBtnArea = NotifFuns.mkBtnArea

function NotifFuns.widthForDock(dock, kind)
	if dock == "top" or dock == "bottom" or kind == "Popup" then
		return wW()
	end
	return nW()
end
widthForDock = NotifFuns.widthForDock

function NotifFuns.dirFrom(str)
	local dock = mapDock(str)
	local x = (dock == "topLeft" or dock == "bottomLeft") and -24 or ((dock == "topRight" or dock == "bottomRight") and 24 or 0)
	local y = (dock == "bottom" or dock == "bottomLeft" or dock == "bottomRight") and 12 or -12
	return { dx = x, dy = y }
end
dirFrom = NotifFuns.dirFrom

NotifFuns.NAStyle.rememberTransparency = function(inst, attr, prop)
	local okAttr, stored = pcall(function()
		return inst:GetAttribute(attr)
	end)
	if okAttr and type(stored) == "number" then
		return stored
	end
	local okProp, current = pcall(function()
		return inst[prop]
	end)
	current = (okProp and type(current) == "number") and current or 0
	pcall(function()
		inst:SetAttribute(attr, current)
	end)
	return current
end

function NotifFuns.fadeNACardContent(rootObj, hidden, duration)
	if not (rootObj and rootObj.Parent) then
		return
	end
	local style = NotifFuns.NAStyle
	local props = {}
	NotifFuns.stopSpring(rootObj, "fade")
	local function add(inst, attr, prop)
		local stored = style.rememberTransparency(inst, attr, prop)
		local target = hidden and 1 or stored
		if duration then
			table.insert(props, { inst, prop, inst[prop], target })
		else
			inst[prop] = target
		end
	end
	for _, inst in rootObj:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextBox") then
			add(inst, style.fadeTextAttr, "TextTransparency")
		end
		if inst:IsA("ImageLabel") or inst:IsA("ImageButton") then
			add(inst, style.fadeImageAttr, "ImageTransparency")
		end
		if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst ~= rootObj then
			add(inst, style.fadeBgAttr, "BackgroundTransparency")
		elseif inst:IsA("UIStroke") and inst.Parent ~= rootObj then
			add(inst, style.fadeStrokeAttr, "Transparency")
		end
	end
	if duration then
		NotifFuns.spring(rootObj, "fade", 0, 1, 6 / duration, function(v)
			for _, p in props do
				if p[1].Parent then p[1][p[2]] = p[3] + (p[4] - p[3]) * v end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local STACKED_NOTIFS = {}

function NotifFuns.canStackNotify(p)
	local btns = p and p.Buttons
	return (not (p and p.InputField)) and (type(btns) ~= "table" or #btns == 0)
end
canStackNotify = NotifFuns.canStackNotify

function NotifFuns.notifyStackKey(dock, p)
	return table.concat({
		tostring(dock or "topRight"),
		tostring((p and p.Title) or "Notify"),
		tostring((p and p.Description) or p and p.Content or ""),
		tostring((p and p.Duration) or "")
	}, "\30")
end
notifyStackKey = NotifFuns.notifyStackKey

function NotifFuns.cardSize(card)
	local s = ctx(card)
	local sca = csc(card)
	local tl, br = inz()
	local off = isMobile and 16 or 24
	local room = math.max(1, gui.AbsoluteSize.Y - tl.Y - br.Y - off * 2) / sca
	local hh = s.headH or (isMobile and 60 or 56)
	local fh = (s.trk and s.trk.Visible) and (isMobile and 14 or 12) or 0
	s.footH = fh
	local need = cntH(s.cnt)
	local h = math.min(hh + need + fh, room)
	local bh = math.max(0, h - hh - fh)
	if s.body then
		local pos = UDim2.fromOffset(0, hh)
		local size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -hh - fh)
		if s.body.Position ~= pos then s.body.Position = pos end
		if s.body.Size ~= size then s.body.Size = size end
	end
	if s.cnt then
		s.cnt.ScrollingEnabled = need > bh + 1 or s.kind == "Popup"
		s.cnt.Active = s.cnt.ScrollingEnabled
		s.cnt.ScrollBarThickness = need > bh + 1 and (isMobile and 5 or 3) or 0
	end
	return UDim2.fromOffset(widthForDock(s.dock, s.kind), math.max(1, h))
end

function NotifFuns.resizeCard(card)
	local s = ctxMap[card]
	if not (s and s.opened and card.Parent) or s.closing then
		return
	end
	local size = NotifFuns.cardSize(card)
	if s.wantSize == size then
		return
	end
	s.wantSize = size
	NotifFuns.sizeCard(card, Vector2.new(size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset))
end

function NotifFuns.sizeCard(card, goal, done)
	local size = card.Size
	return NotifFuns.spring(card, "size", Vector2.new(size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset), goal, 28, function(v)
		card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, v.X), math.max(0, v.Y))
	end, done)
end

function NotifFuns.moveCard(card, goal, rate, start)
	local s = ctx(card)
	local shell = s.shell
	local pos = shell.Position
	local r = NotifFuns.spring(card, "pos", start or Vector2.new(pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Offset), goal, rate, function(v)
		shell.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v.X, v.Y)
	end)
	if start then
		r.val = start
		r.step(start)
	end
	return r
end

function NotifFuns.trackCard(card)
	local s = ctxMap[card]
	local pos = card.AbsolutePosition
	local old = s.lastPos
	s.lastPos = pos
	if not old or not s.opened or s.rebase or s.kind == "Popup" then return end
	local d = (old - pos) / csc(card)
	if d.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local r = s.springs and s.springs.pos
	if r then
		r.val += d
		r.step(r.val)
	else
		local p = s.shell.Position
		NotifFuns.moveCard(card, Vector2.new(0, 0), 24, Vector2.new(p.X.Offset, p.Y.Offset) + d)
	end
end

function NotifFuns.stopMotion(card)
	for _, key in { "size", "pos", "bg", "stroke" } do
		NotifFuns.stopSpring(card, key)
	end
end

function NotifFuns.appear(card, sc, st, tgt, from, cntObj)
	local s = ctx(card)
	if s.closing then return end
	NotifFuns.stopMotion(card)
	s.wantSize = tgt
	s.opened = true
	local shell = s.shell or card
	card.Rotation = 0
	card.Size = UDim2.new(tgt.X.Scale, tgt.X.Offset, 0, 0)
	sc.Scale = s.baseScale or 1
	shell.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(from.dx or 0, from.dy or 0)
	shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	st.Transparency = 1
	s.lastPos = card.AbsolutePosition
	NotifFuns.fadeNACardContent(shell, true)
	NotifFuns.sizeCard(card, Vector2.new(tgt.X.Offset, tgt.Y.Offset))
	NotifFuns.moveCard(card, Vector2.new(0, 0), 22)
	NotifFuns.springProp(card, "bg", shell, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.5, 30)
	NotifFuns.springProp(card, "stroke", st, "Transparency", 0.82, 32)
	NotifFuns.fadeNACardContent(shell, false, 0.22)
end
appear = NotifFuns.appear

function NotifFuns.disappear(card, sc, st)
	local s = ctx(card)
	local shell = s.shell or card
	local from = dirFrom(s.dock or "topRight")
	NotifFuns.fadeNACardContent(shell, true, 0.14)
	NotifFuns.moveCard(card, Vector2.new(from.dx * 1.5, from.dy), 26)
	NotifFuns.springProp(card, "bg", shell, "BackgroundTransparency", 1, 36)
	NotifFuns.springProp(card, "stroke", st, "Transparency", 1, 36)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		if ctxMap[card] ~= s or not card.Parent then return end
		NotifFuns.sizeCard(card, Vector2.new(card.Size.X.Offset, 0), function()
			if ctxMap[card] == s and s.finish then s.finish() end
		end)
	end)
end
disappear = NotifFuns.disappear

function NotifFuns.mkCard(w, baseZ, kind, onPause)
	local z = baseZ or 100 + tick() % 1 * 1000
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(card, UI_ATTR.CARD)
	card.LayoutOrder = os.clock() * 1000
	card.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 0)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Bg
	card.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	card.ZIndex = z
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.Active = kind == "Popup"
	card.ClipsDescendants = false
	local shell = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(shell)
	shell.Name = "NAStyleShell"
	shell.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	shell.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shell.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Bg
	shell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	shell.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shell.ClipsDescendants = true
	shell.ZIndex = z
	shell.Parent = card
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner", shell)
	cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", shell)
	st.Color = TH.Border
	st.Thickness = 1
	st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	st.Transparency = 1
	local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", shell)
	grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(210, 213, 222))
	})
	grad.Rotation = 90
	local sc = Instance.new("UIScale", card)
	sc.Scale = mobScale()
	local s0 = ctx(card)
	s0.sc = sc
	s0.baseScale = sc.Scale
	s0.shell = shell
	addConnection(card, card:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(function()
		if ctxMap[card] then NotifFuns.trackCard(card) end
	end))
	local hdrHeight = isMobile and 60 or 56
	local body = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(body)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, hdrHeight)
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -hdrHeight)
	body.ZIndex = z + 110
	body.Parent = shell
	s0.body = body
	local cntObj = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	protectUiInst(cntObj)
	cntObj.Active = kind == "Popup"
	cntObj.ScrollingEnabled = kind == "Popup"
	cntObj.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cntObj.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cntObj.ScrollBarThickness = (kind == "Popup") and (isMobile and 6 or 4) or 0
	cntObj.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	cntObj.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	cntObj.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	cntObj.ClipsDescendants = true
	cntObj.ZIndex = z + 120
	cntObj.Parent = body
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", cntObj)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, PAD)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, PAD)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, PAD)
	local col = Instance.new("UIListLayout", cntObj)
	col.Padding = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 12 or 10)
	col.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	col.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
	col.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	addConnection(card, col:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		NotifFuns.resizeCard(card)
	end))
	local ftr = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(ftr)
	ftr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	ftr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	ftr.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, isMobile and 14 or 12)
	ftr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ftr.ZIndex = z + 130
	ftr.Parent = shell
	local trk = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(trk)
	trk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	trk.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	trk.Size = UDim2.new(1, -PAD * 2, 0, 2)
	trk.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
	trk.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Progress
	trk.BorderSizePixel = 0
	trk.ZIndex = z + 140
	trk.Parent = ftr
	local c1 = Instance.new("UICorner", trk)
	c1.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	local fil = Instance.new("Frame")
	protectUiInst(fil)
	fil.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	fil.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	fil.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	fil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	fil.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Progress
	fil.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fil.ZIndex = z + 141
	fil.Parent = trk
	local c2 = Instance.new("UICorner", fil)
	c2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	local hdr, ttl, act = mkHdr(shell, z, kind, onPause, card)
	return card, hdr, ttl, act, st, sc, cntObj, ftr, trk, fil
end
mkCard = NotifFuns.mkCard

function NotifFuns.openIn(card, par, ftr, trk, st, sc, from, cntObj)
	card.Parent = par
	card.Visible = true
	task.defer(function()
		rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
		rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
		local s = ctxMap[card]
		if not (s and card.Parent and gui) or s.closing then return end
		if s.refTitle then s.refTitle() end
		appear(card, sc, st, NotifFuns.cardSize(card), dirFrom(s.dock), cntObj)
	end)
end
openIn = NotifFuns.openIn

function NotifFuns.enforcePopupFrameZ(rootObj)
	if not rootObj then
		return
	end
	if rootObj:IsA("Frame") then
		rootObj.ZIndex = POPUP_FRAME_Z + 10
	end
	walkDescImpl(rootObj, function(d)
		if d:IsA("Frame") then
			d.ZIndex = POPUP_FRAME_Z
		end
	end)
end
enforcePopupFrameZ = NotifFuns.enforcePopupFrameZ

function NotifFuns.build(kind, p)
	ensureGui()
	p = typeof(p) == "table" and p or {}
	if p.Content and not p.Description then
		p.Description = p.Content
	end
	local def = kind == "Notify" and "topRight" or "top"
	local dock = mapDock(p.Dock or CURD[kind] or def)
	local stackKey
	if kind == "Notify" and canStackNotify(p) then
		stackKey = notifyStackKey(dock, p)
		local exCard = STACKED_NOTIFS[stackKey]
		if exCard and exCard.Parent then
			local exState = ctx(exCard)
			if exState and (not exState.closing) then
				local newCount = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(exState.stackCount) or 1)) + 1
				if exState.setStackCount then
					exState.setStackCount(newCount)
				else
					exState.stackCount = newCount
				end
				exCard.LayoutOrder = os.clock() * 1000
				local newDur = typeof(p.Duration) == "number" and p.Duration > 0 and p.Duration or nil
				if exState.timCtl and exState.timCtl.reset then
					exState.timCtl.reset(newDur)
				end
				return exCard
			end
		end
		STACKED_NOTIFS[stackKey] = nil
	end
	local from
	if dock == "top" then
		from = dirFrom("top")
	elseif dock == "bottom" then
		from = dirFrom("bottom")
	elseif dock == "topRight" then
		from = dirFrom("top right")
	elseif dock == "topLeft" then
		from = dirFrom("top left")
	elseif dock == "bottomRight" then
		from = dirFrom("bottom right")
	else
		from = dirFrom("bottom left")
	end
	local w = widthForDock(dock, kind)
	local baseZ, grp
	local function destroyPopupRoot()
		local rootObj = grp
		grp = nil
		if rootObj and rootObj.Parent then
			cleanup(rootObj)
			pcall(function()
				rootObj:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	if kind == "Popup" then
		grp = Instance.new("Frame")
		protectUiInst(grp, UI_ATTR.POPUPROOT)
		grp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		grp.Active = true
		grp.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		grp.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		grp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 0)
		grp.ZIndex = POPUP_FRAME_Z
		grp.Parent = gui
		baseZ = POPUP_FRAME_Z
	end
	local timCtl
	local card, hdr, ttl, act, st, sc, cntObj, ftr, trk, fil = mkCard(w, baseZ, kind, function(paused)
		if timCtl then
			if paused then
				timCtl.pause()
			else
				timCtl.resume()
			end
		end
	end)
	if kind == "Popup" then
		local function syncGrp()
			if grp and card then
				grp.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(card.AbsoluteSize.X, card.AbsoluteSize.Y)
			end
		end
		addConnection(card, card:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncGrp))
		addConnection(grp, grp.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
			if d:IsA("Frame") then
				d.ZIndex = POPUP_FRAME_Z
			end
		end))
		syncGrp()
	end
	ACT[kind][card] = true
	syncOverlayActive()
	ttl.Text = p.Title or kind
	local s = ctx(card)
	s.kind = kind
	s.cnt = cntObj
	s.ftr = ftr
	s.trk = trk
	s.fil = fil
	s.dock = dock
	s.fromDir = from
	s.multi = false
	s.sel = {}
	s.btns = nil
	s.ok = nil
	s.stackKey = stackKey
	if stackKey then
		STACKED_NOTIFS[stackKey] = card
	end
	if s.setStackCount then
		s.setStackCount(1)
	end
	s.closing = false
	s.finish = function()
		if ctxMap[card] ~= s then return end
		cleanup(card)
		for _, t in ACT do t[card] = nil end
		syncOverlayActive()
		pcall(function() card:Destroy() end)
		destroyPopupRoot()
	end
	s.close = function()
		if s.closing then
			return
		end
		s.closing = true
		if s.stackKey and STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] == card then
			STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] = nil
		end
		if s.closeMenus then
			s.closeMenus()
		end
		disappear(card, sc, st)
	end
	addConnection(card, card.Destroying:Connect(function()
		s.closing = true
		if s.closeMenus then s.closeMenus() end
		if s.stackKey and STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] == card then
			STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] = nil
		end
		for _, t in ACT do
			t[card] = nil
		end
		syncOverlayActive()
		cleanup(card)
		destroyPopupRoot()
	end))
	function s.setDock(newDock, persist)
		newDock = mapDock(newDock)
		if s.closing or s.dock == newDock then return end
		if s.stackKey and STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] == card then
			STACKED_NOTIFS[s.stackKey] = nil
		end
		s.stackKey = nil
		s.dock = newDock
		if persist then
			CURD[kind] = newDock
			saveDocks()
		end
		local pos = s.shell.AbsolutePosition
		s.rebase = true
		card.Parent = getStack(newDock)
		s.lastPos = card.AbsolutePosition
		if s.opened then
			NotifFuns.moveCard(card, Vector2.new(0, 0), 18, (pos - s.lastPos) / csc(card))
		end
		s.rebase = false
		s.wantSize = nil
		NotifFuns.resizeCard(card)
	end
	if p.Description and p.Description ~= "" then
		local d = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		d.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		d.TextColor3 = TH.Txt
		d.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		d.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		d.TextWrapped = true
		d.RichText = true
		d.Font = CURF[kind]
		d.TextScaled = false
		d.TextSize = isMobile and 15 or 14
		d.TextTransparency = 0
		d.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		d.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		d.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 121
		d.Text = p.Description
		d.Parent = cntObj
	end
	if p.InputField then
		local inp = Instance.new("TextBox")
		inp.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, isMobile and 48 or 44)
		inp.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		inp.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		inp.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		inp.Font = CURF[kind]
		inp.TextSize = isMobile and 15 or 14
		inp.TextColor3 = TH.Txt
		inp.RichText = true
		inp.BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn
		inp.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
		inp.Text = ""
		inp.PlaceholderText = p.Placeholder or "Type here…"
		inp.PlaceholderColor3 = TH.Mut
		inp.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 121
		inp.Parent = cntObj
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner", inp)
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		local st2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", inp)
		st2.Color = TH.Border
		st2.Transparency = 0.92
		st2.Thickness = 1
		local p2 = Instance.new("UIPadding", inp)
		p2.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 16 or 14)
		p2.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, isMobile and 16 or 14)
		s.inp = inp
		addConnection(inp, inp.Focused:Connect(function()
			tw:Create(inp, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 0
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(inp, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundColor3 = TH.BtnHover
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(st2, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				Transparency = 0.85
			}):Play()
		end))
		addConnection(inp, inp.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			tw:Create(inp, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(inp, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				BackgroundColor3 = TH.Btn
			}):Play()
			tw:Create(st2, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
				Transparency = 0.92
			}):Play()
		end))
	end
	local btns = p.Buttons or {}
	if #btns > 0 then
		mkBtnArea(cntObj, btns, card, card.ZIndex + 122, math.floor(gui.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.52), CURF[kind])
	end
	if #btns > 2 then
		local mBtn, setMSel = mkIcn(act, "M", act.ZIndex + 3, CURF[kind])
		local okBtn = mkIcn(act, "✓", act.ZIndex + 3, CURF[kind])
		mBtn.LayoutOrder = 10
		okBtn.LayoutOrder = 20
		okBtn.Visible = false
		local function showOK(on)
			on = (s.multi and on) and true or false
			okBtn.Visible = on
			task.spawn(function()
				rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
				rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if s and s.refTitle then
					s.refTitle()
				end
			end)
		end
		setMSel(false)
		addConnection(mBtn, mBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if s.closing then
				return
			end
			s.multi = not s.multi
			setMSel(s.multi)
			if not s.multi then
				s.sel = {}
				if s.btns then
					for _, rec in s.btns do
						if rec and rec.set then
							rec.set(false)
						end
					end
				end
				showOK(false)
			else
				showOK(#(s.sel or {}) > 0)
			end
		end))
		addConnection(okBtn, okBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if s.closing then
				return
			end
			for _, info in s.sel or {} do
				if info.Callback then
					info.Callback(s.inp and s.inp.Text or "")
				end
			end
			if s.close then
				s.close()
			end
		end))
		s.ok = function(vis)
			showOK((s.multi and vis) and true or false)
		end
	end
	local dur = typeof(p.Duration) == "number" and p.Duration > 0 and p.Duration or nil
	local showProg = kind == "Notify" and #btns == 0 and dur ~= nil
	local shouldTimer = kind == "Notify" and dur ~= nil
	local parent = kind == "Popup" and grp or getStack(dock)
	trk.Visible = showProg
	openIn(card, parent, ftr, showProg and trk or nil, st, sc, from, cntObj)
	if kind == "Popup" then
		enforcePopupFrameZ(grp)
	end
	if shouldTimer then
		timCtl = attachTimer(card, showProg and fil or nil, dur)
	end
	s.timCtl = timCtl
	if kind == "Popup" then
		ov.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		trackPopupCenter(grp, card)
		grp.Active = true
		grp.Draggable = true
		card.Draggable = false
		local function markManual()
			ctx(grp).popupManual = true
		end
		if grp.DragBegin then
			addConnection(card, grp.DragBegin:Connect(markManual))
		end
	end
	return card
end
build = NotifFuns.build

function NotifFuns.Notify(p)
	return build("Notify", p)
end
Notify = NotifFuns.Notify

function NotifFuns.Window(p)
	return build("Window", p or {})
end
Window = NotifFuns.Window

function NotifFuns.Popup(p)
	p = p or {}
	p.Dock = p.Dock or CURD.Popup or "top"
	return build("Popup", p)
end
Popup = NotifFuns.Popup

local api = {
	Notify = function(p)
		p = typeof(p) == "table" and p or {}
		if p.Content and not p.Description then
			p.Description = p.Content
		end
		return Notify(p)
	end,
	Window = function(p)
		return Window(p)
	end,
	Popup = function(p)
		return Popup(p)
	end,
	SetFont = function(kind, name)
		for _, pair in FONTS do
			if pair[1] == name then
				setFontKind(kind, pair[2])
				break
			end
		end
	end,
	UI = function()
		local uiFn = rawget(_naNotif_env, "EnhancedNotifsUI")
		if type(uiFn) == "function" then
			local ok, uiRef = pcall(uiFn)
			if ok then
				return uiRef
			end
		end
		if typeof(_naNotif_gui) == "Instance" and _naNotif_gui.Parent then
			return _naNotif_gui
		end
		if typeof(gui) == "Instance" and gui.Parent then
			return gui
		end
		return nil
	end,
	NotifFuns = NotifFuns
}

rawset(api, "__na_owner_token", _naNotif_owner_token)
rawset(api, "__na_ui_rev", UI_REV)
_naNotif_env.EnhancedNotifs = api

return api

		M.serviceResolver = [==[
-- [uh v59] offline STAND-IN for ServiceResolver.luau (the original is not part of the Nameless Admin repo).
-- Implements only what Nameless Admin calls: cm / gs / cs / cv / cloneref.
local host = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
local cr = rawget(host, "cloneref") or cloneref
if type(cr) ~= "function" then cr = nil end
local R = {}
R.cloneref = cr or function(v) return v end
R.cv = function(value)
	if cr and typeof(value) == "Instance" then
		local ok, c = pcall(cr, value)
		if ok and c ~= nil then return c end
	end
	return value
end
R.gs = function(name) return R.cv(game:GetService(name)) end
R.cs = function(name, clone)
	local svc = game:GetService(name)
	if type(clone) == "function" then
		local ok, c = pcall(clone, svc)
		if ok and c ~= nil then return c end
	end
	return svc
end
R.cm = function(target, member, ...)
	local obj = target
	if type(target) == "string" then obj = R.gs(target) end
	local v = obj[member]
	if type(v) == "function" then return v(obj, ...) end
	return v
end
return R
]==]
		M.uiProtector = [==[
-- [uh v59] offline STAND-IN for UIprotector.luau (the original is not part of the Nameless Admin repo).
-- Deliberately has NO protectUI / protectName / protectInstance, so Nameless Admin runs its own built-in fallback for those.
local host = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
local P = { ready = true, build = "session_name_cursed_null_v1", standIn = "uh-v59" }
P.setSessionNameProvider = function(fn) end
P.huiGrabber = function()
	local g = rawget(host, "gethui") or gethui
	if type(g) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(g)
		if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" then return r end
	end
	return nil
end
P.parent = function() return P.huiGrabber() end
P.getFunction = function(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local f = rawget(host, name)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then f = rawget(_G, name) end
	if type(f) == "function" then return f end
	return nil
end
P.cleanup = function() end
P.restore = function() end
P.destroy = function() end
return P

reserveserver debug [placeId] [seed]","Teleports to a reserved server or creates one if code is missing"]]]==]
	local byName = {}

	local function lower(v) return tostring(v or ""):lower() end
	local function host() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G end

	local function ready()
		local env = rawget(host(), "__UhNAEnv")
		if not env then return nil end
		local ok, c = pcall(function() return env.cmd end)
		if ok and type(c) == "table" then
			local okRun, run = pcall(function() return c.run end)
			if okRun and type(run) == "function" then return env, c end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local booting = false
	function NA.Boot()
		if ready() then return true end
		if booting then
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while booting and os.clock() - t0 < 100 do task.wait(0.2) end
			return ready() ~= nil
		end
		booting = true
		NA.Stage = "downloading"
		pcall(Util.Notify, "Loading the Nameless Admin runtime (first NA command)...")
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local loader = loadstring or load
			if type(loader) ~= "function" then error("no loadstring/load available") end
			local E = NA.Embed
			if type(E) ~= "table" or type(E.Source) ~= "string" or #E.Parts == 0 then error("embedded Nameless Admin runtime is missing") end
			rawset(host(), "__UhNAParts", E.Parts)
			rawset(host(), "__UhNAModules", E.Modules)
			local fn, cerr = loader(E.Source, "@NamelessAdmin_Source")
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then error(cerr or "Source.lua failed to compile") end
			NA.Stage = "booting"
			NA.BootError = nil
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok2, e2 = pcall(fn)
				if not ok2 then NA.BootError = tostring(e2) end
			end)
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - t0 < 90 do
				if ready() then return end
				if NA.BootError then error(NA.BootError) end
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
			error("timed out waiting for NA's command core")
		end)
		booting = false
		rawset(host(), "__UhNAParts", nil)
		rawset(host(), "__UhNAModules", nil)
		if not ok then
			NA.Stage, NA.Error = "failed", tostring(err)
			warn("[UhAdmin] Nameless Admin runtime failed: " .. tostring(err))
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Nameless Admin runtime failed to load (see console). v53 commands are unaffected.")
			return false
		end
		NA.Stage = "ready"
		-- best effort: keep only the v53 bar/triangle visible, not NA's own window
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 40 do
				pcall(function()
					local env = rawget(host(), "__UhNAEnv")
					local g = env and env.NAStuff and env.NAStuff.NASCREENGUI
					if g and g.Enabled ~= nil then g.Enabled = false end
				end)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	function NA.Run(primary, args)
		task.spawn(function()
			if not NA.Boot() then return end
			local _, c = ready()
			if not c then return end
			local argv = { primary }
			for i = 1, #args do argv[#argv + 1] = args[i] end
			local ok, err = pcall(c.run, argv)
			if not ok then
				warn("[UhAdmin] NA command '" .. tostring(primary) .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err))
				pcall(Util.Notify, ("Nameless Admin command '%s' failed: %s"):format(tostring(primary), tostring(err)))
			end
		end)
	end

	function NA.exec(line)
		local parts = {}
		if lib and lib.parseText then parts = lib.parseText(tostring(line or ""), " ") end
		if #parts == 0 then for w in tostring(line or ""):gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = w end end
		local name = table.remove(parts, 1)
		if not name then return end
		NA.Run(byName[lower(name)] or lower(name), parts)
	end

	local okJ, list = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(CATALOGUE) end)
	if not okJ or type(list) ~= "table" then
		NA.Error = tostring(list)
		warn("[UhAdmin] NA catalogue failed to decode: " .. tostring(list))
	else
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			local primary, aliases = lower(e[1]), e[2] or {}
			if primary ~= "" then
				byName[primary] = primary
				for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do byName[lower(a)] = primary end
				local names = { primary }
				for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do names[#names + 1] = a end
				if UH.IsBlocked(names) then
					NA.Blocked += 1
				elseif Commands[primary] or Aliases[primary] then
					NA.Native += 1
				else
					local kept = {}
					for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do
						local key = lower(a)
						if key ~= primary and not Commands[key] and not Aliases[key] then kept[#kept + 1] = key end
					end
					local usage = (e[3] and e[3] ~= "") and e[3] or primary
					if #kept > 0 then usage = usage .. " (" .. table.concat(kept, ", ") .. ")" end
					local reg = {
						function(...) return NA.Run(primary, { ... }) end,
						{ usage, (e[4] and e[4] ~= "") and e[4] or "Nameless Admin command." },
						aliases = kept,
					}
					Commands[primary] = reg
					for _, key in ipairs(kept) do Aliases[key] = reg end
					commandcount += 1
					NA.Added += 1
				end
			end
		end
		UH.Stage = "nameless: catalogue registered (" .. tostring(NA.Added) .. ")"
		pcall(function() if gui and gui.loadCommands then gui.loadCommands() end end)
		pcall(Util.Notify, ("Nameless Admin: %d commands added (handlers load on first use), %d already native, %d blocked."):format(NA.Added, NA.Native, NA.Blocked))
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- TELEPORT TRANSITION  (adapted from Nameless Admin's TeleportGui: static handoff via SetTeleportGui, transition
-- token, TeleportInitFailed + 30 s watchdog, instance -> plain-place fallback). The logo is v53's own animated
-- 3D triangle (Util.FX.NewTriangle3D). Styles follow the live UI theme: orbit / radar / prism / scan.
-- ============================================================================
do
	local UH = Util.UhAdmin
	local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local TP = { Active = nil, Token = nil, Since = 0, Styles = { "orbit", "radar", "prism", "scan" } }
	UH.Teleport = TP

	local function new(class, props, parent)
		local o = Instance.new(class)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
		o.Parent = parent
		return o
	end
	local function styleName()
		local ok, s = pcall(function() return SaveData.TeleportStyle end)
		s = ok and tostring(s or "orbit"):lower() or "orbit"
		if s == "random" then return TP.Styles[math.random(1, #TP.Styles)] end
		for _, n in ipairs(TP.Styles) do if n == s then return s end end
		return "orbit"
	end
	local function theme()
		local ok, a, b, c = pcall(UH.Theme, os.clock())
		if ok and typeof(a) == "Color3" then
			return a, (typeof(b) == "Color3" and b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)), (typeof(c) == "Color3" and c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		end
		return Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	local function spaced(s) return (tostring(s or ""):upper():gsub(".", "%0\u{2009}")) end
	local function parentGui(g)
		if gethiddengui then
			local ok, h = pcall(gethiddengui)
			if ok and h and pcall(function() g.Parent = h end) and g.Parent then return true end
		end
		if pcall(function() g.Parent = CoreGui end) and g.Parent then return true end
		return pcall(function() g.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)
	end

	function TP.Clear()
		local ui = TP.Active
		TP.Active = nil
		if not ui then return end
		if ui.conn then pcall(function() ui.conn:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(nil) end)
		local function kill()
			if ui.tri then pcall(function() ui.tri:Destroy() end) end
			pcall(function() ui.gui:Destroy() end)
		end
		if ui.shade and ui.shade.Parent then
			pcall(function() TweenService:Create(ui.shade, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play() end)
			task.delay(0.25, kill)
		else
			kill()
		end
	end

	function TP.Update(action, detail, placeId)
		local ui = TP.Active
		if not ui then return end
		if action and ui.title then ui.title.Text = spaced(action) end
		if detail and ui.detail then ui.detail.Text = tostring(detail) end
		if placeId and ui.place then ui.place.Text = "DESTINATION  //  " .. tostring(placeId) end
	end

	-- static copy handed to Roblox's own teleport loading screen (animations do not survive the place change)
	function TP.Handoff()
		local ui = TP.Active
		if not ui or not ui.gui then return false end
		return pcall(function()
			local copy = ui.gui:Clone()
			copy.Name = "UhTeleportHandoff"
			copy.Enabled = true
			for _, n in ipairs({ "Cancel", "Shade" }) do
				local c = copy:FindFirstChild(n, true)
				if c then c:Destroy() end
			end
			TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(copy)
		end)
	end

	function TP.Create(action, detail, placeId, tag)
		TP.Clear()
		local accent, bg, txt = theme()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 450)
		local mobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
		local S = math.clamp(math.floor(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) * 0.52), 150, 380)
		local ui = { accents = {}, updaters = {}, started = os.clock(), style = styleName() }
		local function acc(o, prop) ui.accents[#ui.accents + 1] = { o, prop }; return o end

		local gui = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "UhTeleport", IgnoreGuiInset = true, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 2147483000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }, nil)
		local root = new("Frame", { Name = "Root", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = 1 }, gui)
		local function band(y, rot)
			local f = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, y), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.38), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root)
			new("UIGradient", { Rotation = rot, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, f)
		end
		band(0, 90); band(1, -90)
		local border = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2 }, root)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }, border)
		acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.82, Color = accent }, border), "Color")

		local stage = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S, S), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, root)
		local function ring(scale, thick, tr, arc)
			local r = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(scale, scale), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, stage)
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, r)
			local st = acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = thick, Transparency = tr, Color = accent }, r), "Color")
			local gr
			if arc then
				gr = new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, st)
			end
			return r, gr, st
		end
		local function dot(size)
			local d = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, d)
			return d
		end
		local function addUpdater(f) ui.updaters[#ui.updaters + 1] = f end

		if ui.style == "orbit" then
			local _, g1 = ring(1.0, 2, 0, true)
			local _, g2 = ring(0.8, 1.5, 0.15, true)
			local _, g3 = ring(0.62, 1, 0.35, true)
			ring(0.46, 1, 0.8, false)
			local dots = {}
			for i = 1, 6 do dots[i] = dot(i % 2 == 0 and 5 or 7) end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				g1.Rotation = (t * 110) % 360
				g2.Rotation = (-t * 160) % 360
				g3.Rotation = (t * 70) % 360
				for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
					local a = t * (1.1 + i * 0.12) * (i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1) + i * 1.05
					local r = (i <= 3 and 0.5 or 0.4) * S
					d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * r, 0.5, math.sin(a) * r)
				end
			end)
		elseif ui.style == "radar" then
			ring(1.0, 2, 0.1, false); ring(0.72, 1, 0.5, false); ring(0.44, 1, 0.6, false)
			local hands = {}
			for i = 0, 6 do
				local h = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, stage)
				local line = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 + i * 0.13, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, h), "BackgroundColor3")
				new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, line)
				hands[#hands + 1] = { h, i }
			end
			local blips = {}
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local b = dot(5)
				local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, (0.18 + math.random() * 0.28) * S
				b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * r, 0.5, math.sin(a) * r)
				blips[i] = b
			end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				for _, e in ipairs(hands) do e[1].Rotation = (t * 140 - e[2] * 7) % 360 end
				for i, b in ipairs(blips) do b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.85 * ((math.sin(t * 2 + i * 1.7) + 1) / 2) end
			end)
		elseif ui.style == "prism" then
			local cols = {}
			local n = math.clamp(math.floor(vp.X / 38), 10, 40)
			for i = 1, n do
				local h = math.random(60, 180)
				local c = acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / n, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(1, 2), 0, h), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
				new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }) }, c)
				cols[i] = { c, math.random(), 0.15 + math.random() * 0.35, h, (i - 0.5) / n }
			end
			local waves = {}
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local r, _, st = ring(1, 1.5, 0.3, false)
				waves[i] = { r, st }
			end
			addUpdater(function(t)
				for _, e in ipairs(cols) do
					e[1].Position = UDim2.new(e[5], 0, 0, ((t * e[3] + e[2]) % 1) * (vp.Y + e[4]) - e[4])
				end
				for i, w in ipairs(waves) do
					local p = (t * 0.35 + (i - 1) / 3) % 1
					local sz = 0.35 + p * 0.85
					w[1].Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
					w[2].Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * p
				end
			end)
		else -- scan
			for i = 1, 11 do
				acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(i / 12, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.93, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			for i = 1, 6 do
				acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, i / 7, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.93, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			local sweep = acc(new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")
			local glow = acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, sweep), "BackgroundColor3")
			new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82) }) }, glow)
			for _, c in ipairs({ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }) do
				local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
				acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
				acc(new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 22), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 }, stage), "BackgroundColor3")
			end
			ring(0.5, 1, 0.7, false)
			addUpdater(function(t) sweep.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, (t * 0.28) % 1, 0) end)
		end

		-- logo: v53's animated 3D triangle (flat rotating one if the 3D build fails)
		local holder = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.42), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6 }, stage)
		local okT, tri = pcall(function()
			return Util.FX.NewTriangle3D(holder, { Interactive = false, ZIndex = 8, LayerSize = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
		end)
		if okT and tri then
			tri.baseSpin, tri.scaleBase = 2.2, 1.25
			ui.tri = tri
			pcall(function() tri:PopIn() end)
		else
			local f = acc(new("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "\u{25B2}", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = accent, ZIndex = 8 }, holder), "TextColor3")
			addUpdater(function(t) f.Rotation = (t * 120) % 360 end)
		end

		-- text block + indeterminate progress bar + elapsed timer
		local W = math.min(vp.X - 36, 460)
		local info = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, S / 2 + 8), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 104), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 7 }, root)
		local function label(y, h, size, font, text, tr, align)
			return new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, Font = font, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = txt, TextTransparency = tr, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 8 }, info)
		end
		ui.title = label(0, 30, mobile and 20 or 26, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, spaced(action), 0)
		ui.detail = label(31, 16, 13, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, tostring(detail or ""), 0.3)
		ui.place = label(49, 14, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "DESTINATION  //  " .. tostring(placeId or game.PlaceId), 0.5)
		local track = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 72), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = txt, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 8 }, info)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, track)
		local fill = acc(new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9 }, track), "BackgroundColor3")
		local fg = new("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, fill)
		ui.timer = label(82, 14, 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "00:00", 0.45, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		label(82, 14, 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, tag and ("JOB  " .. tostring(tag):sub(1, 8)) or "", 0.45, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		new("TextLabel", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = spaced("UH ADMIN") .. "  //  TELEPORT", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = txt, TextTransparency = 0.35, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 8 }, root)
		acc(new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 46), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 2), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8 }, root), "BackgroundColor3")

		local cancel = new("TextButton", { Name = "Cancel", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 34), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, Text = "CANCEL", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = txt, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 10 }, root)
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, cancel)
		acc(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4, Color = accent }, cancel), "Color")
		cancel.Activated:Connect(function() TP.Cancel() end)

		local lastSec = -1
		ui.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local t = os.clock() - ui.started
				local a = theme()
				for _, e in ipairs(ui.accents) do e[1][e[2]] = a end
				fg.Offset = Vector2.new(-1 + ((t * 0.85) % 1) * 2, 0)
				if ui.tri then ui.tri.baseSpin = 2 + 0.6 * math.sin(t * 1.7) end
				for _, f in ipairs(ui.updaters) do f(t, dt) end
				local sec = math.floor(t)
				if sec ~= lastSec then
					lastSec = sec
					ui.timer.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(sec / 60), sec % 60)
				end
			end)
			if not ok and not ui.warned then ui.warned = true; warn("[UhAdmin] teleport screen: " .. tostring(err)) end
		end)

		if not parentGui(gui) then
			pcall(function() ui.conn:Disconnect() end)
			if ui.tri then pcall(function() ui.tri:Destroy() end) end
			pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
			return nil
		end
		ui.gui, ui.root = gui, root
		ui.shade = new("Frame", { Name = "Shade", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 50 }, root)
		pcall(function() TweenService:Create(ui.shade, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play() end)
		TP.Active = ui

		task.spawn(function() -- destination name (same place: game.Name, other place: marketplace lookup)
			local pid = tonumber(placeId) or game.PlaceId
			local name = (pid == game.PlaceId) and tostring(game.Name or "") or ""
			if name == "" then
				local okI, pi = pcall(function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(pid) end)
				if okI and type(pi) == "table" and pi.Name then name = tostring(pi.Name) end
			end
			if name ~= "" and TP.Active == ui and ui.place then ui.place.Text = name:upper() .. "  //  " .. tostring(pid) end
		end)
		return ui
	end

	function TP.Cancel()
		TP.Token = nil
		pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportCancel() end)
		if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
		TP.Clear()
	end

	-- spec = { method, args, action, detail, placeId, tag, reuse, fallback = { method, args, detail } }
	function TP.Go(spec)
		local now = os.clock()
		if TP.Token and (now - TP.Since) < 20 then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport already in progress.")
			return false
		end
		local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
		local token = tostring(now) .. ":" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000))
		TP.Token, TP.Since = token, now
		local function fail(msg)
			if TP.Token == token then
				TP.Token = nil
				if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
				TP.Clear()
			end
			if msg then pcall(Util.Notify, msg) end
		end
		if spec.reuse and TP.Active then
			TP.Update(spec.action, spec.detail, spec.placeId)
		else
			TP.Create(spec.action, spec.detail, spec.placeId, spec.tag)
		end
		if TP.FailConn then pcall(function() TP.FailConn:Disconnect() end); TP.FailConn = nil end
		local okc, conn = pcall(function()
			return TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, result, errMsg)
				if player == lp and TP.Token == token then
					fail(("Teleport failed [%s]: %s"):format(tostring(result), tostring(errMsg)))
				end
			end)
		end)
		if okc then TP.FailConn = conn end
		task.delay(30, function()
			if TP.Token == token then fail("Teleport timed out - overlay removed.") end
		end)
		task.wait(0.15) -- let the triangle render a frame before the static copy is handed to Roblox
		if TP.Token ~= token then return false end
		TP.Handoff()
		local function call(m)
			return pcall(function() return TeleportService[m.method](TeleportService, table.unpack(m.args)) end)
		end
		local ok, err = call(spec)
		if not ok and spec.fallback then
			TP.Update(nil, spec.fallback.detail)
			ok, err = call(spec.fallback)
		end
		if not ok then
			fail("Teleport error: " .. tostring(err))
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	-- rejoin / serverhop / joinjobid keep their v53 names + aliases; only the handler is swapped
	local function setHandler(name, fn)
		local reg = Commands[name]
		if type(reg) == "table" then reg[1] = fn return true end
		return false
	end
	setHandler("rejoin", function()
		local lp, pid, jid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId, game.JobId
		if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 or jid == "" then
			TP.Go({ method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, action = "REJOINING", detail = "Finding a fresh server", placeId = pid })
		else
			TP.Go({ method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, jid, lp }, action = "REJOINING SERVER", detail = "Returning to the current server", placeId = pid, tag = jid,
				fallback = { method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, detail = "Current server unavailable, finding another" } })
		end
	end)
	setHandler("joinjobid", function(id)
		id = tostring(id or ""):gsub("%s", "")
		if id == "" then pcall(Util.Notify, "Usage: joinjobid <jobid>") return end
		local lp, pid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId
		TP.Go({ method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, id, lp }, action = "JOINING SERVER", detail = "Connecting to the requested job id", placeId = pid, tag = id })
	end)
	local searching = false
	setHandler("serverhop", function()
		if searching or (TP.Token and os.clock() - TP.Since < 20) then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport already in progress.")
			return
		end
		searching = true
		local lp, pid = Players.LocalPlayer, game.PlaceId
		TP.Create("SERVER HOP", "Searching public servers", pid)
		local okS, pick = pcall(function()
			local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. pid .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100&excludeFullGames=true"
			local okG, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
			if not okG then body = game:HttpGetAsync(url) end
			local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body)
			local pool = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(data.data or {}) do
				if type(v) == "table" and v.id ~= game.JobId and v.playing < v.maxPlayers then pool[#pool + 1] = v end
			end
			table.sort(pool, function(a, b) return a.playing > b.playing end)
			local top = math.min(#pool, 5)
			return top > 0 and pool[math.random(1, top)] or nil
		end)
		searching = false
		if not okS or not pick then
			TP.Clear()
			pcall(Util.Notify, okS and "No other public server found." or ("Server search failed: " .. tostring(pick)))
			return
		end
		TP.Go({ reuse = true, method = "TeleportToPlaceInstance", args = { pid, pick.id, lp }, action = "SERVER HOP", detail = ("Joining a server with %d/%d players"):format(pick.playing, pick.maxPlayers), placeId = pid, tag = pick.id,
			fallback = { method = "Teleport", args = { pid, lp }, detail = "Server unavailable, letting Roblox pick one" } })
	end)

	cmd.add({"tpstyle"}, {"tpstyle <orbit|radar|prism|scan|random>", "Sets the teleport loading screen style"}, function(s)
		s = tostring(s or ""):lower()
		local valid = (s == "random")
		for _, n in ipairs(TP.Styles) do if n == s then valid = true end end
		if not valid then
			pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport styles: orbit, radar, prism, scan, random")
			return
		end
		SaveData.TeleportStyle = s
		pcall(Util.Notify, "Teleport screen style: " .. s)
	end)
	cmd.add({"tptest", "tpscreen"}, {"tptest (tpscreen)", "Previews the teleport loading screen for 5 seconds (no teleport)"}, function()
		if TP.Token and os.clock() - TP.Since < 20 then return end
		TP.Create("TELEPORT PREVIEW", "Preview only - nothing is being teleported", game.PlaceId)
		local active = TP.Active
		task.delay(5, function() if TP.Active == active and not TP.Token then TP.Clear() end end)
	end)
end

	 Title = "Uh Admin";
