SaveData.SkipIntro = not not SaveData.SkipIntro
SaveData.MuteUIMusic = not not SaveData.MuteUIMusic
SaveData.MuteReanimMusic = not not SaveData.MuteReanimMusic
SaveData.MuteUISound = not not SaveData.MuteUISound

-- [v23] cinematic intro (60 s since v48). It plays the theme song (Modjo - Lady (Hear Me Tonight)); when that file is not
-- available it falls back to Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit). It runs on its own thread, so the UI keeps building / module
-- loading keeps going underneath it and the intro has a SKIP button that opens the UI.
Util.IntroTrackFile = "dm_change.ft2.mp3" -- fallback track
Util.RunIntro = function(preview)
	if Util.IntroRunning then return end
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then -- [v34] low end mode: no cinematic intro (it is the heaviest effect in the script)
		if preview then
			pcall(Util.UINotify, "Intro preview is disabled in Low End UI Mode")
		end
		return
	end
	Util.IntroRunning = true
	Util.IntroMusicReady = false
	Util.IntroTheme = false
	Util.FX.IntroActive = true -- the window boot animation waits for this, so it unfolds right when the intro ends
	task.spawn(function() -- the song loads in parallel; the cinematic clock starts on its first note
		pcall(function()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 0
			local idx = nil
			Util.IntroTheme = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40) -- [v48] first run: wait for the one-time decode / save (cached afterwards; returns at once on a failure)
			if Util.IntroTheme then
				for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
					if entry.Theme then
						idx = i
						break
					end
				end
			end
			for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
				if idx then break end
				if type(entry[1]) == "string" and entry[1]:find(Util.IntroTrackFile, 1, true) then
					idx = i
					break
				end
			end
			if not idx then -- custom Muzik folder replaced the built-in list: put the intro song back at the front
				table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {"UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. Util.IntroTrackFile, "Dubmood - Change (Radio Edit)"})
				idx = 1
			end
			MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(idx)
			local waited = os.clock()
			repeat RunService.RenderStepped:Wait() until UISound.Music.IsLoaded or os.clock() - waited > 3
			UISound.Music:Stop()
			task.wait()
			UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
			UISound.Music:Play()
			UISound.Music.Volume = 1
		end)
		Util.IntroMusicReady = true
	end)
	local okAll, errAll = pcall(Util.FX.Intro, UIMainFrame, UISound.Music, Util.FX.MarqueeText(""), {
		Preview = preview,
		Ready = function() return Util.IntroMusicReady end,
		ReadyWait = 46, -- [v48] first run can include the one-time theme decode / save (the wait ends at once when the song is ready or failed)
		Theme = function() return Util.IntroTheme and Util.ThemeSong or nil end, -- [v48] beat grid of the theme song
		ClickSnd = UISound.Click, -- [v30] lets the intro play its little tick sounds
	})
	if not okAll then
		warn("[Uhhhhhh] intro failed (UI is unaffected): " .. tostring(errAll))
	end
	Util.FX.IntroCamBusy = false -- [v48] always hand the cinematic camera back, even if the intro errored
	Util.FX.IntroActive = false
	if SaveData.MuteUIMusic then
		TweenService:Create(UISound.Music, TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Volume = 0
		}):Play()
	else
		UISound.Music.Volume = 1
	end
	Util.IntroRunning = false
end

if SaveData.SkipIntro or Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then -- [v34] low end mode always skips the intro (SkipIntro itself is not changed)
	task.spawn(MusicPlayer.PlayDefault) -- [v48] theme song (or the old random pick); never blocks the UI build
	if SaveData.MuteUIMusic then
		UISound.Music.Volume = 0
	end
else
	task.spawn(Util.RunIntro, false)
end

-- [v53] DELTA CUSTOMIZER (built in): the complete Delta customization module, merged unchanged into this file as one string.
-- FX.Delta.Boot compiles it with loadstring ONLY when the executor is positively identified as Delta, inside a pcall, so on any
-- other executor it is never compiled and a problem inside it can never break the rest of this script.
Util.FX.Delta.Embedded = [=======[
--!nocheck
local __dcm_boot = {
	hostEnv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G or {},
}

__dcm_boot.getLoader = function()
	local hostLoader = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv) == "table" and rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "loadstring") or nil
	if type(hostLoader) == "function" then
		return hostLoader
	end
	if type(loadstring) == "function" then
		return loadstring
	end
	return nil
end
__dcm_boot.hostGetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv or getfenv
__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv or setfenv
__dcm_boot.debug = rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "debug") or debug
__dcm_boot.getPrivateRegistry = function()
	local registry
	if type(getreg) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = getreg()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug) == "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug.getregistry) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = __dcm_boot.debug.getregistry()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" then
		registry = {}
	end
	return registry
end
__dcm_boot.ensureTable = function(host, key)
	local value = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, key) or nil
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		value = {}
		if type(host) == "table" then
			pcall(rawset, host, key, value)
			if rawget(host, key) ~= value then
				host[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
	return value
end
__dcm_boot.clearHostKey = function(host, key)
	if type(host) == "table" then
		pcall(rawset, host, key, nil)
		pcall(function()
			host[key] = nil
		end)
	end
end
__dcm_boot.clearLegacyGlobals = function(host)
	local keys = {
		"__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded",
		"__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaThemeMenuPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaHubMusicPatch",
		"DeltaIcon",
	}
	for i = 1, #keys do
		__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(host, keys[i])
	end
	local sh = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "shared") or nil
	if type(sh) == "table" and sh ~= host then
		for i = 1, #keys do
			__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(sh, keys[i])
		end
	end
end

local __lt = (function()
	local cached = rawget(__dcm_boot.privateRoot, "serviceResolver")
	if type(cached) == "table" then
		return cached
	end
	local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then
		error("Service resolver loader unavailable")
	end
	local okSrc, src = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet("https://ltseverydayyou.github.io/ServiceResolver.luau")
	end)
	if not (okSrc and type(src) == "string" and src ~= "") then
		error("Service resolver HTTP failed: " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(src) or type(src)))
	end
	local resolver = loader(src, "@ServiceResolver.luau")
	if type(resolver) ~= "function" then
		error("Service resolver failed to compile")
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, resolver, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
	end
	local loaded = resolver()
	if type(loaded) ~= "table" then
		error("Service resolver failed to load")
	end
	__dcm_boot.privateRoot.serviceResolver = loaded
	return loaded
end)()

	end;

local SRV = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(self, n)
		local ok, s = pcall(function()
			return __lt.cs(n, _ref)
		end)
		if ok and s then
			rawset(self, n, s)
			return s
		end
	end,
})
local function Svc(n)
	return SRV[n]
end

httpTxt = function(u, hdr)
	if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then
		return nil, "bad url"
	end
	local rq = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (http and http.request)
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local h = {
			["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
			["Accept"] = "*/*",
		}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			local code = tonumber(res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code) or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
	end
	local ok, body = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(u)
	end)
	if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
		return body
	end
	return nil, "HttpGet returned " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(body) or type(body))
end

local function runUrl(u, name, hdr)
	local ld = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
	if type(ld) ~= "function" then
		return false, "loadstring unavailable"
	end
	local src, er = httpTxt(u, hdr)
	if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
		return false, er or "empty source"
	end
	local fn, er2 = ld(src, name or ("@" .. u))
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		return false, er2 or "compile failed"
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
		pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, fn, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
	end
	return pcall(fn)
end

function NAlib.disconnect(n)
	local t = _naConns[n]
	if t then
		for _, c in t do
			pcall(function()
				c:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		_naConns[n] = nil
	end
end
function NAlib.connect(n, c)
	if not c then
		return
	end
	_naConns[n] = _naConns[n] or {}
	table.insert(_naConns[n], c)
	return c
end
function NAlib.isProperty(o, p)
	return pcall(function()
		return o[p]
	end)
end

	pcall(function()
		o[p] = v
	end)
end
local uiLib = {}
uiLib.draggerV2 = function(ui, dragui)
	dragui = dragui or ui
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	local anchor = ui.AnchorPoint
	local sg = ui:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui") or ui.Parent
	local function sClamp(v, lo, hi)
		if hi < lo then
			hi = lo
		end
		return math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
	end
	local function upd(input)
		pcall(function()
			local p = sg.AbsoluteSize
			local s = ui.AbsoluteSize
			if p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sx = startPos.X.Scale * p.X + startPos.X.Offset
			local sy = startPos.Y.Scale * p.Y + startPos.Y.Offset
			local dx = input.Position.X - dragStart.X
			local dy = input.Position.Y - dragStart.Y
			local minX = anchor.X * s.X
			local maxX = p.X - (1 - anchor.X) * s.X
			local minY = anchor.Y * s.Y
			local maxY = p.Y - (1 - anchor.Y) * s.Y
			local nx = sClamp(sx + dx, minX, maxX)
			local ny = sClamp(sy + dy, minY, maxY)
			ui.Position = UDim2.new(nx / p.X, 0, ny / p.Y, 0)
		end)
	end
	local id = "DraggerV2_" .. ui:GetDebugId()
	NAlib.disconnect(id)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		dragui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					dragging = true
					dragStart = input.Position
					startPos = ui.Position
					local c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
						pcall(function()
							if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
								dragging = false
							end
						end)
					end)
					NAlib.connect(id, c)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		dragui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					dragInput = input
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	NAlib.connect(
		id,
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			pcall(function()
				if input == dragInput and dragging then
					upd(input)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
	local function clampToView()
		pcall(function()
			local p = sg.AbsoluteSize
			local s = ui.AbsoluteSize
			if p.X <= 0 or p.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local pos = ui.Position
			local ax = pos.X.Scale * p.X + pos.X.Offset
			local ay = pos.Y.Scale * p.Y + pos.Y.Offset
			local minX = anchor.X * s.X
			local maxX = p.X - (1 - anchor.X) * s.X
			local minY = anchor.Y * s.Y
			local maxY = p.Y - (1 - anchor.Y) * s.Y
			local nx = sClamp(ax, minX, maxX)
			local ny = sClamp(ay, minY, maxY)
			ui.Position = UDim2.new(nx / p.X, 0, ny / p.Y, 0)
		end)
	end
	NAlib.connect(id, (sg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(clampToView))
	if ui and ui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
		NAlib.connect(id, (ui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(clampToView))
	end
	clampToView()
	if ui and NAlib.isProperty(ui, "Active") then
		NAlib.setProperty(ui, "Active", true)
	end
	if dragui and NAlib.isProperty(dragui, "Active") then
		NAlib.setProperty(dragui, "Active", true)
	end
end
root = gethui and gethui() or CG
local function isGib(n)
	if typeof(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not n:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
end
local function getMain()
	local best
	local bestScore = 0
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			local score = 0
			if g:FindFirstChild("Executor") then
				score += 5
			elseif g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true) then
				score += 2
			end
			if g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") then
				score += 4
			elseif g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true) then
				score += 2
			end
			for _, name in { "Scripthub", "Settings", "Home", "Console" } do
				if g:FindFirstChild(name) then
					score += 2
				elseif g:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
					score += 1
				end
			end
			if g:FindFirstChild("MainScript") then
				score += 1
			end
			if isGib(g.Name) then
				score += 1
			end
			if score > bestScore then
				best = g
				bestScore = score
			end
		end
	end
	if bestScore >= 11 then
		return best
	end
end

local function fixNet(rootGui)
	if not rootGui then
		return
	end
	local side = rootGui:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu", true) or rootGui
	local net = side and side:FindFirstChild("Network", true)
	if not (net and net:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		return
	end
	local over = net:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
	if not (over and over:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		over = Instance.new("Frame")
		over.Name = "Overlay"
		over.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		over.BorderSizePixel = 0
		over.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		over.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		over.ClipsDescendants = false
		over.ZIndex = net.ZIndex + 1
		over.Parent = net
	end
	for _, name in { "Holder", "Information" } do
		local ch = net:FindFirstChild(name)
		if ch and ch ~= over and ch.Parent == net and not over:FindFirstChild(name) then
			ch.Parent = over
		end
	end
	return over
end
local function getIconGui()
	local bestGui
	local bestButton
	local bestScore = -math.huge
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and not g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true) then
			local buttons = {}
			local guiCount = 0
			for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
					guiCount += 1
				end
				if d:IsA("ImageButton") then
					table.insert(buttons, d)
				end
			end
			if #buttons == 1 and guiCount <= 12 then
				local button = buttons[1]
				local score = 0
				if button.Parent == g then
					score += 4
				end
				if type(button.Image) == "string" and button.Image ~= "" then
					score += 3
				end
				local size = button.AbsoluteSize
				if size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0 then
					local ratio = size.X / size.Y
					if ratio >= 0.7 and ratio <= 1.3 then
						score += 3
					end
				end
				if isGib(g.Name) then
					score += 1
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					bestGui = g
					bestButton = button
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestGui, bestButton
end

local function __dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return object[property]
	end)
	if ok then
		values[property] = value
	end
end

local function __dcm_captureObject(object)
	if not object or __dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[object] then
		return
	end
	local values = {}
	for _, property in __dcm_snapshotProperties do
		__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
	end
	if object:IsA("LayerCollector") then
		for _, property in { "Enabled", "ResetOnSpawn", "ZIndexBehavior" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		for _, property in { "DisplayOrder", "IgnoreGuiInset", "ScreenInsets", "SafeAreaCompatibility", "ClipToDeviceSafeArea" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
		for _, property in { "GroupColor3", "GroupTransparency" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
		for _, property in { "AutoButtonColor", "Modal", "Selected" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
		for _, property in __dcm_guiProperties do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
		for _, property in __dcm_textProperties do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
		for _, property in __dcm_imageProperties do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	end
	if object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
		for _, property in __dcm_scrollingProperties do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	elseif object:IsA("UIListLayout") or object:IsA("UIGridLayout") then
		for _, property in { "Padding", "FillDirection", "HorizontalAlignment", "VerticalAlignment", "SortOrder", "Wraps", "HorizontalFlex", "VerticalFlex" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	elseif object:IsA("UIPadding") then
		for _, property in { "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight", "PaddingTop", "PaddingBottom" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	elseif object:IsA("UIGradient") then
		for _, property in { "Color", "Transparency", "Rotation", "Offset", "Enabled" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	elseif object:IsA("UICorner") then
		__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, "CornerRadius")
	elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
		for _, property in { "Color", "Thickness", "Transparency", "Enabled", "ApplyStrokeMode", "LineJoinMode" } do
			__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, property)
		end
	elseif object:IsA("UIScale") then
		__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, "Scale")
	elseif object:IsA("ValueBase") then
		__dcm_captureProperty(object, values, "Value")
	end
	__dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[object] = true
	local attributes = {}
	pcall(function()
		attributes = object:GetAttributes()
	end)
	__dcm_masterRuntime.objects[object] = {
		Parent = object.Parent,
		Values = values,
		Attributes = attributes,
	}
end

local function __dcm_captureRoot(target)
	if not target then
		return
	end
	table.insert(__dcm_masterRuntime.roots, target)
	__dcm_captureObject(target)
	for _, object in target:GetDescendants() do
		__dcm_captureObject(object)
	end
end

local function __dcm_captureMutation(object, property)
	if not (object and type(property) == "string") then
		return
	end
	local state = __dcm_masterRuntime.mutations[object]
	if not state then
		state = {}
		__dcm_masterRuntime.mutations[object] = state
	end
	if state[property] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return object[property]
	end)
	if ok then
		state[property] = { value = value }
	end
end

local function __dcm_setTracked(object, property, value)
	if not object then
		return false
	end
	__dcm_captureMutation(object, property)
	return pcall(function()
		object[property] = value
	end)
end

local function __dcm_registerCustom(object)
	if object then
		__dcm_masterRuntime.customObjects[object] = true
	end
	return object
end

__dcm_masterRuntime.captureMutation = __dcm_captureMutation
__dcm_masterRuntime.setTracked = __dcm_setTracked
__dcm_masterRuntime.registerCustom = __dcm_registerCustom

__dcm_captureRoot(mainGui)
if _iconGui0 and _iconGui0 ~= mainGui then
	__dcm_captureRoot(_iconGui0)
end

local function __dcm_isCustomObject(object)
	local name = object.Name
	if name:sub(1, 3) == "LT_" or name == "LTIcon" or name:sub(1, 11) == "DeltaCustom" then
		return true
	end
	return name == "Section_Customization"
		or name == "Section_Delta"
		or name == "SidebarGestureZone"
		or name == "SidebarGradientColor1"
		or name == "SidebarGradientColor2"
		or name == "IconColorValue"
		or name == "IconSizeValue"
		or name == "IconRgbSpeedValue"
		or name == "DeltaIconCorner"
end

local function __dcm_restoreSnapshot()
	for object in __dcm_masterRuntime.customObjects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				object:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and snapshot.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				object.Parent = snapshot.Parent
			end)
		end
	end
	for _, target in __dcm_masterRuntime.roots do
		if target and target.Parent then
			local settings = target:FindFirstChild("Settings") or target:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
			local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
			if holder then
				for _, child in holder:GetChildren() do
					if not __dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[child] and __dcm_isCustomObject(child) then
						pcall(function()
							child:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			for _, object in target:GetDescendants() do
				if not __dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[object] and __dcm_isCustomObject(object) then
					pcall(function()
						object:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			for property, value in snapshot.Values do
				pcall(function()
					object[property] = value
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	for object, state in __dcm_masterRuntime.mutations do
		if object and object.Parent then
			local baselineSnapshot = __dcm_masterRuntime.objects[object]
			for property, wrapped in state do
				local ownedByBaseline = baselineSnapshot
					and (property == "Parent" or baselineSnapshot.Values[property] ~= nil)
				if not ownedByBaseline then
					pcall(function()
						object[property] = wrapped.value
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				local original = snapshot.Attributes or {}
				for name in object:GetAttributes() do
					if original[name] == nil then
						object:SetAttribute(name, nil)
					end
				end
				for name, value in original do
					object:SetAttribute(name, value)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

__dcm_masterRuntime.stop = function()
	if not __dcm_masterRuntime.alive or __dcm_masterRuntime.stopping then
		return
	end
	__dcm_masterRuntime.stopping = true
	for _, key in { "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime", "__DeltaThemeRuntime", "__DeltaHubMusicPatch" } do
		local current = rawget(__dcm_env, key)
		if type(current) == "table" and current ~= __dcm_masterRuntime and type(current.stop) == "function" then
			pcall(current.stop)
		end
	end
	if type(_naConns) == "table" and type(NAlib) == "table" then
		for name in _naConns do
			NAlib.disconnect(name)
		end
	end
	__dcm_restoreSnapshot()
	__dcm_masterRuntime.alive = false
	__dcm_masterRuntime.stopping = false
	if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime") == __dcm_masterRuntime then
		__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime = nil
	end
	if rawget(__dcm_shared, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime") == __dcm_masterRuntime then
		__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime = nil
	end
	__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = nil
	__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded = nil
	__dcm_env.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded = nil
	__dcm_env.__DeltaThemeMenuPatchLoaded = nil
	__dcm_env.DeltaIcon = nil
	__dcm_env.__NewDeltaUIToggle = nil

	local restoreToken = {}
	__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken = restoreToken
	__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken = restoreToken
	local function stabilizeRestore()
		if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken") ~= restoreToken then
			return
		end
		if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime") ~= nil then
			return
		end
		__dcm_restoreSnapshot()
	end
	task.defer(stabilizeRestore)
	task.delay(0.05, stabilizeRestore)
	task.delay(0.2, stabilizeRestore)
	task.delay(0.6, function()
		stabilizeRestore()
		if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken") == restoreToken then
			__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken = nil
		end
		if rawget(__dcm_shared, "__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken") == restoreToken then
			__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationRestoreToken = nil
		end
		table.clear(__dcm_masterRuntime.mutations)
	end)
end

local managedIcon = {
	deltaGui = _iconGui0,
	deltaBtn = _iconBtn0,
	customGui = nil,
	customBtn = nil,
}
managedIcon.deltaStroke = managedIcon.deltaBtn
	and (
		managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
	)
managedIcon.deltaCorner = managedIcon.deltaBtn

		managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
	)
managedIcon.customStroke = nil
managedIcon.customCorner = nil
local iconGui, iconBtn = managedIcon.deltaGui, managedIcon.deltaBtn
local iconStroke = managedIcon.deltaStroke
local iconCorner = managedIcon.deltaCorner
local iconBaseColor = iconStroke and iconStroke.Color
local iconBaseSize = iconBtn and iconBtn.Size
local iconBaseCorner = iconCorner and iconCorner.CornerRadius
local iconSzLock = false
local iconColorUseCustom = false
local iconApplyBusy = false

local applyIconStrokeState
local applyIconShapeChoice

local bindManagedIconPositionSaver
local bindManagedIconToggle
local ensureManagedIcon
local function MouseButtonFix(button, clickCallback)
	if not button or type(clickCallback) ~= "function" then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	local clickTimeThreshold = 0.45
	local moveThreshold = 10
	local mouseDownTime = 0
	local isPointerDown = false
	local startPosition = nil
	local maxMoveDistance = 0
	local connections = {}
	local function getSignal(obj, signalName)
		local ok, signal = pcall(function()
			return obj[signalName]
		end)
		if ok and signal then
			return signal
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function connectSignal(signal, fn)
		if not signal then
			return false
		end
		local ok, conn = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(fn)
		end)
		if ok and conn then
			connections[#connections + 1] = conn
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	local function isPressInput(inputType)
		return inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end
	local function resetState()
		mouseDownTime = 0
		isPointerDown = false
		startPosition = nil
		maxMoveDistance = 0
	end
	local function beginPointer(input)
		isPointerDown = true
		mouseDownTime = tick()
		maxMoveDistance = 0
		local pos = input and input.Position
		startPosition = pos and Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) or nil
	end
	local function endPointer()
		if not isPointerDown or mouseDownTime == 0 then
			resetState()
			return
		end
		local holdDuration = tick() - mouseDownTime
		local isClick = holdDuration < clickTimeThreshold and maxMoveDistance <= moveThreshold
		resetState()
		if isClick then
			clickCallback()
		end
	end
	local boundPress = false
	local isGuiButton = type(button.IsA) == "function" and button:IsA("GuiButton")
	if isGuiButton then
		local downSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Down")
		local upSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Up")
		local downBound = connectSignal(downSignal, function()
			beginPointer(nil)
		end)
		local upBound = connectSignal(upSignal, function()
			endPointer()
		end)
		boundPress = downBound and upBound
	end
	if not boundPress then
		local beganSignal = getSignal(button, "InputBegan")
		local endedSignal = getSignal(button, "InputEnded")
		local beganBound = connectSignal(beganSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				beginPointer(input)
			end
		end)
		local endedBound = connectSignal(endedSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				endPointer()
			end
		end)
		boundPress = beganBound and endedBound
	end
	local changedSignal = getSignal(button, "InputChanged")
	connectSignal(changedSignal, function(input)
		if not isPointerDown then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end
		local pos = input.Position
		if not pos then
			return
		end
		if not startPosition then
			startPosition = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
			return
		end
		local currentPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
		local delta = (currentPos - startPosition).Magnitude
		if delta > maxMoveDistance then
			maxMoveDistance = delta
		end
	end)
	if not boundPress then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			for _, conn in connections do
				if conn and conn.Disconnect then
					conn:Disconnect()
				end
			end
		end,
	}
end
local function hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
	if managedIcon.deltaGui then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaGui, "Enabled", false)
	end
	if managedIcon.deltaBtn then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "Visible", false)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "Active", false)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "ImageTransparency", 1)
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaBtn, "BackgroundTransparency", 1)
	end
	if managedIcon.deltaStroke then
		__dcm_setTracked(managedIcon.deltaStroke, "Enabled", false)
	end
end
local function refreshIconRefs()
	local prevIconGui = iconGui
	local prevIconBtn = iconBtn
	local ig, ib = getIconGui()
	local deltaChanged = ig ~= managedIcon.deltaGui or ib ~= managedIcon.deltaBtn
	managedIcon.deltaGui = ig
	managedIcon.deltaBtn = ib
	managedIcon.deltaStroke = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		and (
			managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
		)
	managedIcon.deltaCorner = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		and (
			managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			or managedIcon.deltaBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
		)
	if managedIcon.deltaGui or managedIcon.deltaBtn then
		hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
		NAlib.disconnect("DeltaIcon_OriginalHideGui")
		if managedIcon.deltaGui then
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaIcon_OriginalHideGui",
				managedIcon.deltaGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
					if managedIcon.deltaGui.Enabled then
						hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
					end
				end)
			)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("DeltaIcon_OriginalHideBtn")
		if managedIcon.deltaBtn then
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaIcon_OriginalHideBtn",
				managedIcon.deltaBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					if managedIcon.deltaBtn.Visible then
						hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
					end
				end)
			)
		end
	end
	if ensureManagedIcon then
		ensureManagedIcon()
	end
	if managedIcon.customBtn and managedIcon.customBtn.Parent then
		iconGui = managedIcon.customGui
		iconBtn = managedIcon.customBtn
		iconStroke = managedIcon.customStroke
		iconCorner = managedIcon.customCorner
	else
		iconGui = managedIcon.deltaGui
		iconBtn = managedIcon.deltaBtn
		iconStroke = managedIcon.deltaStroke
		iconCorner = managedIcon.deltaCorner
	end
	local changed = deltaChanged or iconGui ~= prevIconGui or iconBtn ~= prevIconBtn
	if iconBtn then
		if changed or not iconBaseSize then
			iconBaseSize = iconBtn.Size
		end
		if iconStroke and not iconColorUseCustom and (changed or not iconBaseColor) then
			iconBaseColor = iconStroke.Color
		end
		if iconCorner and (changed or not iconBaseCorner) then
			iconBaseCorner = iconCorner.CornerRadius
		end
		if changed and applyIconStrokeState then
			task.defer(applyIconStrokeState)
		end
		if changed and applyIconShapeChoice then
			task.defer(applyIconShapeChoice)
		end
		if changed and applySavedManagedIconPosition then
			task.defer(applySavedManagedIconPosition)
		end
		if changed and bindManagedIconPositionSaver then
			task.defer(bindManagedIconPositionSaver)
		end
		if changed and bindManagedIconToggle then
			task.defer(bindManagedIconToggle)
		end
	end
	return changed
end
local function fsOk()
	return type(isfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function"
end
local function gaOk()
	return type(getcustomasset) == "function"
end
local function iconFsOk()
	return fsOk() and gaOk()
end
local function trim(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then
		return ""
	end
	return s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
end
local function sName(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(name)
	t = t:gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
	t = t:gsub("_+", "_")
	t = t:gsub("^_+", "")
	t = t:gsub("_+$", "")
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return t
end
local function getName(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local n = path:gsub("\\", "/")
	return n:match("([^/]+)$")
end
local function fileFromUrl(u)
	if type(u) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return u:match("/([^/%?]+)$")
end
local function iconPreUrl(u)
	if type(u) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(u)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	local q = t:find("%?")
	local base = q and t:sub(1, q - 1) or t
	return t, base
end
local function iconNormUrl(u)
	local t, base = iconPreUrl(u)
	if not t then
		return nil
	end
	local owner, repo, kind, rest = base:match("^https?://github.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
	if owner and repo and kind and rest then
		local s = rest
		if s:sub(1, 11) == "refs/heads/" then
			s = s:sub(12)
		elseif s:sub(1, 10) == "refs/tags/" then
			s = s:sub(11)
		end
		local branch, path = s:match("^([^/]+)/(.+)$")
		if branch and path and (kind == "blob" or kind == "raw") then
			branch = branch:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")
			path = path:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")
			return string.format("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%s/%s/%s/%s", owner, repo, branch, path)
		end
	end
	local rawDir = base:match("^https?://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/.+")
	if rawDir then
		return t
	end
	return t
end
local function ensureDir(path)
	if not fsOk() then
		return false
	end
	if type(isfolder) == "function" then
		local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, path)
		if ok and ex then
			return true
		end
		if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local okMk = pcall(makefolder, path)
		return okMk == true
	end
	return true
end
local function ensureParentDir(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return false
	end
	local dir = path:gsub("\\", "/"):match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
	if not dir or dir == "" then
		return true
	end
	return ensureDir(dir)
end
writeJsonFile = function(path, payload)
	if not (HS and fsOk()) then
		return false
	end
	if not ensureParentDir(path) then
		return false
	end
	local okEnc, enc = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", payload)
	end)
	if not (okEnc and type(enc) == "string") then
		return false
	end
	local okW = pcall(writefile, path, enc)
	if okW then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(writefile, path, enc)
end
local baseDir = "DeltaCustom"
local iconDir = baseDir .. "/DeltaIcons"
local cfgPath = baseDir .. "/delta_icon.json"
local dIcons = {
	entries = {},
	index = 0,
	enabled = false,
	localPath = "",
	assetId = "",
	defaultImage = "",
	pendingInput = "",
}
local function ensureIconDir()
	if not ensureDir(baseDir) then
		return false
	end
	return ensureDir(iconDir)
end
local function loadIconCfg()
	if not fsOk() or not HS then
		return
	end
	if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local okB, exB = pcall(isfolder, baseDir)
		if not (okB and exB) then
			pcall(makefolder, baseDir)
		end
	end
	if type(isfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" then
		if not isfile(cfgPath) then
			pcall(
				writefile,
				cfgPath,
				__lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONEncode", {
					enabled = false,
					assetId = "",
					localPath = "",
					index = 0,
				})
			)
		end
	end
	if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	if not isfile(cfgPath) then
		return
	end
	local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, cfgPath)
	if not (ok and type(raw) == "string") then
		return
	end
	local okD, dec = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, raw)
	if not (okD and type(dec) == "table") then
		return
	end
	if type(dec.enabled) == "boolean" then
		dIcons.enabled = dec.enabled
	end
	if type(dec.assetId) == "string" then
		dIcons.assetId = dec.assetId
	end
	if type(dec.localPath) == "string" then
		dIcons.localPath = dec.localPath
	end
	if type(dec.index) == "number" then
		dIcons.index = dec.index
	end
end
local function saveIconCfg()
	if not fsOk() or not HS then
		return
	end
	local payload = {
		enabled = dIcons.enabled and true or false,
		assetId = type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId or "",
		localPath = type(dIcons.localPath) == "string" and dIcons.localPath or "",
		index = tonumber(dIcons.index) or 0,
	}
	writeJsonFile(cfgPath, payload)
end
local function scanIcons()
	dIcons.entries = {}
	dIcons.index = 0
	if not (fsOk() and type(listfiles) == "function") then
		return
	end
	if not ensureIconDir() then
		return
	end
	local ok, items = pcall(listfiles, iconDir)
	if not (ok and type(items) == "table") then
		return
	end
	local list = {}
	for _, full in items do
		local n = getName(full)
		if n then
			list[#list + 1] = { file = n }
		end
	end
	dIcons.entries = list
	if type(dIcons.localPath) == "string" and dIcons.localPath ~= "" then
		local cur = getName(dIcons.localPath)
		if cur then
			for i, e in list do
				if e.file == cur then
					dIcons.index = i
					if updateIconStatusUI then
						updateIconStatusUI()
					end
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #list > 0 then
		dIcons.index = 1
	end
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
end
local function formatIconStatus()
	local list = dIcons.entries
	local n = #list
	if n == 0 then
		return "No custom icons installed"
	end
	if n == 1 then
		return "1 custom icon installed"
	end
	return tostring(n) .. " custom icons installed"
end
local function resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not gaOk() or type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local tried = {}
	local function tryPath(path)
		if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or tried[path] then
			return nil
		end
		tried[path] = true
		local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
		if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
			return asset
		end
		return nil
	end
	local asset = tryPath(full)
	if asset then
		return asset
	end
	local slash = full:gsub("\\", "/")
	if slash ~= full then
		asset = tryPath(slash)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	local back = full:gsub("/", "\\")
	if back ~= full then
		asset = tryPath(back)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	local name = getName(full)
	if name then
		asset = tryPath(iconDir .. "/" .. name) or tryPath(iconDir .. "\\" .. name) or tryPath(name)
		if asset then
			return asset
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function iconHttpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or (code >= 200 and code < 300)) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end
local function iconSaveFromUrl(url)
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icons require file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	if not ensureIconDir() then
		return false, "Unable to prepare DeltaIcons folder."
	end
	local norm = iconNormUrl(url)
	if not norm then
		return false, "Enter a valid image URL or asset id."
	end
	local data = iconHttpGetBinary(norm)
	if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
		return false, "Unable to download icon image."
	end
	local remote = fileFromUrl(norm) or "DeltaIcon.png"
	local safe = sName(remote) or "icon_" .. tostring(os.time()) .. ".png"
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. safe
	local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
	if not okW then
		return false, errW or "Unable to save icon image."
	end
	local asset = resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return false, "Unable to load icon image."
	end
	dIcons.localPath = full
	local list = dIcons.entries
	local idx
	for i, e in list do
		if e.file == safe then
			idx = i
			break
		end
	end
	if not idx then
		list[#list + 1] = { file = safe }
		idx = #list
	end
	dIcons.entries = list
	dIcons.index = idx
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
	return true, asset
end
local function applyIcon()
	refreshIconRefs()
	if not iconBtn or (not iconBtn:IsA("ImageButton")) then
		return false
	end
	local img
	if dIcons.enabled and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId ~= "" then
		img = dIcons.assetId
	elseif type(dIcons.defaultImage) == "string" and dIcons.defaultImage ~= "" then
		img = dIcons.defaultImage
	end
	iconApplyBusy = true
	if img and img ~= "" then
		iconBtn.Image = img
		iconApplyBusy = false
		return true
	else
		iconBtn.Image = ""
	end
	iconApplyBusy = false
	return false
end
local function setIconEnabled(flag)
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icon requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	flag = flag and true or false
	if flag and (not dIcons.assetId or dIcons.assetId == "") then
		return false, "Add an asset id or image URL before enabling."
	end
	dIcons.enabled = flag
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	return true
end
local function setIconAsset(input, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return false, "Custom icon requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local raw = type(input) == "string" and input or tostring(input)
	if type(raw) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Enter a valid asset id or image URL."
	end
	raw = trim(raw)
	if raw == "" then
		return false, "Enter a valid asset id or image URL."
	end
	local digits = raw:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or raw:match("id=(%d+)") or raw:match("^(%d+)$")
	local newAsset
	dIcons.localPath = ""
	if digits then
		newAsset = "rbxassetid://" .. digits
	else
		local okIcon, res = iconSaveFromUrl(raw)
		if not okIcon then
			return false, res or "Unable to save custom icon."
		end
		newAsset = res
		scanIcons()
	end
	dIcons.assetId = newAsset
	if opts.autoEnable ~= false then
		dIcons.enabled = true
	end
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	if digits then
		return true, digits
	end
	return true, raw
end
local function cycleIcon(delta)
	local list = dIcons.entries
	if #list == 0 then
		return
	end
	delta = delta or 1
	local idx = dIcons.index or 1
	if idx < 1 or idx > #list then
		idx = 1
	end
	idx = (idx - 1 + delta) % #list + 1
	local e = list[idx]
	if not e or not e.file then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. e.file
	if fsOk() and type(isfile) == "function" then
		local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
		if not (okEx and ex) then
			scanIcons()
			return
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return
	end
	dIcons.localPath = full
	dIcons.assetId = asset
	dIcons.index = idx
	dIcons.enabled = true
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	if updateIconStatusUI then
		updateIconStatusUI()
	end
end
local function delIconFile(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return
	end
	if not (fsOk() and type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function") then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. name
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if okEx and ex then
		pcall(delfile, full)
	end
end
local function clearIfCurrent(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return
	end
	local full = iconDir .. "/" .. name
	if dIcons.localPath == full then
		dIcons.localPath = ""
		dIcons.assetId = ""
		dIcons.index = 0
		dIcons.enabled = false
		applyIcon()
		saveIconCfg()
	end
end
local function removeIconEntry(entry)
	if not (entry and entry.file) then
		return
	end
	delIconFile(entry.file)
	clearIfCurrent(entry.file)
	scanIcons()
end
local function removeAllIcons()
	local list = dIcons.entries or {}
	for _, e in list do
		if e and e.file then
			delIconFile(e.file)
		end
	end
	dIcons.entries = {}
	dIcons.index = 0
	dIcons.localPath = ""
	dIcons.assetId = ""
	dIcons.enabled = false
	applyIcon()
	saveIconCfg()
	scanIcons()
end
ensureManagedIcon = function()
	if
		mainGui
		and managedIcon.customBtn
		and managedIcon.customBtn.Parent == mainGui
	then
		managedIcon.customGui = mainGui
		managedIcon.customStroke = managedIcon.customBtn
			and (
				managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				or managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
			)
		managedIcon.customCorner = managedIcon.customBtn
			and (
				managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				or managedIcon.customBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
			)
		return true
	end
	if not (mainGui and managedIcon.deltaGui and managedIcon.deltaBtn) then
		return false
	end
	hideOriginalDeltaIcon()
	local btn = managedIcon.deltaBtn:Clone()
	btn.Name = "LTIcon"
	btn.Visible = true
	btn.Active = true
	btn.ImageTransparency = managedIcon.deltaBtn.ImageTransparency
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = managedIcon.deltaBtn.BackgroundTransparency
	btn.Parent = mainGui
	managedIcon.customGui = mainGui
	managedIcon.customBtn = btn
	managedIcon.customStroke = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or btn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
	managedIcon.customCorner = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or btn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner", true)
	iconGui = managedIcon.customGui
	iconBtn = managedIcon.customBtn
	iconStroke = managedIcon.customStroke
	iconCorner = managedIcon.customCorner
	return true
end
ensureManagedIcon()
refreshIconRefs()
if iconBtn and type(iconBtn.Image) == "string" and iconBtn.Image ~= "" then
	dIcons.defaultImage = iconBtn.Image
end
loadIconCfg()
scanIcons()
local function refreshIconFromPath()
	if not iconFsOk() then
		return
	end
	if type(dIcons.localPath) ~= "string" or dIcons.localPath == "" then
		return
	end
	local full = dIcons.localPath
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		dIcons.localPath = ""
		dIcons.assetId = ""
		dIcons.enabled = false
		saveIconCfg()
		return
	end
	local asset = resolveIconAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		dIcons.assetId = ""
		dIcons.enabled = false
		saveIconCfg()
		return
	end
	dIcons.assetId = asset
	saveIconCfg()
end
refreshIconFromPath()
if dIcons.enabled and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId ~= "" then
	applyIcon()
end
local function bindIconButtonWatcher()
	NAlib.disconnect("DeltaIcon_ImageWatcher")
	if not (iconBtn and iconBtn:IsA("ImageButton")) then
		return
	end
	NAlib.connect(
		"DeltaIcon_ImageWatcher",
		iconBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
			if iconApplyBusy then
				return
			end
			if
				dIcons.enabled
				and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string"
				and dIcons.assetId ~= ""
				and iconBtn.Image ~= dIcons.assetId
			then
				task.defer(applyIcon)
			end
		end)
	)
end
local function refreshIconButtonState()
	local changed = refreshIconRefs()
	if iconBtn and type(iconBtn.Image) == "string" and iconBtn.Image ~= "" then
		if
			not (
				dIcons.enabled
				and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string"
				and dIcons.assetId ~= ""
				and iconBtn.Image == dIcons.assetId
			)
		then
			dIcons.defaultImage = iconBtn.Image
		end
	end
	bindIconButtonWatcher()
	if changed and dIcons.enabled and type(dIcons.assetId) == "string" and dIcons.assetId ~= "" then
		task.defer(applyIcon)
	end
end
refreshIconButtonState()

	root.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(refreshIconButtonState)

			Description = "Overlay frame not found.",
			Duration = 4,

	end
	local sidebar = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
	local toggleUIBtn = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild("ToggleUI", true)
	local activeColorValue = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor")
	local inactiveColorValue = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild("InactiveColor")
	local darkOverlay = mainGui:FindFirstChild("DarkOverlay")
	local sidebarGradient = nil
	local sidebarGrad1 = nil
	local sidebarGrad2 = nil
	local sidebarClosedPos = UDim2.new(1.08, 0, 0.5, 0)
	local sidebarOpenPos = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
	local sidebarNormalizeBusy = false
	local function normalizeSidebarGeometry()

		sidebarNormalizeBusy = true

				sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(sidebar.Position.X.Scale, sidebar.Position.X.Offset, 0.5, 0)

	if sidebar and sidebar:IsA("GuiObject") then
		normalizeSidebarGeometry()

			"Sidebar_NormalizeGeometry",
			sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(normalizeSidebarGeometry)

		NAlib.connect(
			"Sidebar_NormalizeGeometry",
			sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(normalizeSidebarGeometry)
			end)

	end
	if iconGui and iconGui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		__dcm_setTracked(iconGui, "IgnoreGuiInset", true)

	if iconBtn then
		__dcm_setTracked(iconBtn, "Draggable", false)
		uiLib.draggerV2(iconBtn, iconBtn)

				darkOverlay.Visible = false
			end)

	local settingsFrame
	do
		local cand = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		if cand and cand:IsA("Frame") and cand:FindFirstChild("Holder") then
			settingsFrame = cand
		end

	local settingsHolder = settingsFrame and settingsFrame:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	local settingTemplate
	local function saveSettingsEntry(key, payload)
		if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		settingsConfig[key] = payload
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
	end
	local uiScaleState = {
		object = nil,
		value = nil,
		refreshers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	}
	local function getInterfaceViewport()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam and cam.ViewportSize.X > 0 and cam.ViewportSize.Y > 0 then
			return cam.ViewportSize
		end
		return mainGui.AbsoluteSize
	end
	local function suggestInterfaceScale()
		local vp = getInterfaceViewport()
		if not vp then
			return 1
		end
		return 1
	end
	local function ensureInterfaceScale()
		if uiScaleState.object and uiScaleState.object.Parent == mainGui then
			return uiScaleState.object
		end
		local sc = mainGui:FindFirstChild("LT_InterfaceScale")
		if not (sc and sc:IsA("UIScale")) then
			sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
			sc.Name = "LT_InterfaceScale"
			sc.Parent = mainGui
		end
		uiScaleState.object = sc
		return sc
	end
	local function applyInterfaceScale(v)
		local sc = ensureInterfaceScale()
		if not sc then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			sc.Scale = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 0.5, 1.65)
		end)
		task.defer(function()
			for _, delayTime in { 0, 0.03, 0.1 } do
				if delayTime > 0 then
					task.wait(delayTime)
				end
				for sf, refresh in uiScaleState.refreshers do
					if sf and sf.Parent and type(refresh) == "function" then
						pcall(refresh)
					else
						uiScaleState.refreshers[sf] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	uiScaleState.value = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	uiScaleState.value.Name = "InterfaceScaleValue"
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.InterfaceScale
		local def = suggestInterfaceScale()
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.value) == "number" then
			def = math.clamp(cfg.value, 0.5, 1.65)
		end
		uiScaleState.value.Value = def
	end
	applyInterfaceScale(uiScaleState.value.Value)
	local function setupAutoScroll(sf, fixRows, verticalOnly)
		if not (sf and sf:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
			sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
			if verticalOnly then
				sf.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
			end
		end)
		local lay = sf:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout") or sf:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout")
		if not lay then
			return
		end
		local id = "CanvasAuto_" .. sf:GetDebugId()
		NAlib.disconnect(id)
		local boundVerticalGuis = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local function getUiScaleFactor()
			local sc = uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object
			local factor = sc and tonumber(sc.Scale) or 1
			if not factor or factor <= 0 then
				factor = 1
			end
			return factor
		end
		local function isVisibleInScroll(gui)
			local cur = gui
			while cur and cur ~= sf do
				if cur:IsA("GuiObject") and not cur.Visible then
					return false
				end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return cur == sf
		end
		local function descendantBounds()
			local maxX = 0
			local maxY = 0
			local canvasPos = sf.CanvasPosition
			local uiScaleFactor = getUiScaleFactor()
			if verticalOnly then
				for _, child in sf:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("GuiObject") and isVisibleInScroll(child) then
						local relY = ((child.AbsolutePosition.Y - sf.AbsolutePosition.Y) / uiScaleFactor) + canvasPos.Y
						maxY = math.max(maxY, relY + (child.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScaleFactor))
						for _, desc in child:QueryDescendants("GuiObject") do
							if desc.Name == "Dropdown" and isVisibleInScroll(desc) then								local dRelY = ((desc.AbsolutePosition.Y - sf.AbsolutePosition.Y) / uiScaleFactor) + canvasPos.Y
								maxY = math.max(maxY, dRelY + (desc.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScaleFactor))
							end
						end
					end
				end
			else
				for _, desc in sf:QueryDescendants("GuiObject") do
					if isVisibleInScroll(desc) then						local relX = ((desc.AbsolutePosition.X - sf.AbsolutePosition.X) / uiScaleFactor) + canvasPos.X
						local relY = ((desc.AbsolutePosition.Y - sf.AbsolutePosition.Y) / uiScaleFactor) + canvasPos.Y
						maxX = math.max(maxX, relX + (desc.AbsoluteSize.X / uiScaleFactor))
						maxY = math.max(maxY, relY + (desc.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScaleFactor))
					end
				end
			end
			return maxX, maxY
		end
		local function applyRows()
			if not fixRows then
				return
			end
			for _, ch in sf:GetChildren() do
				if
					ch:IsA("GuiObject")
					and ch.Visible
					and not ch:IsA("UIListLayout")
					and not ch:IsA("UIGridLayout")
					and not ch:IsA("UIPadding")
					and ch.Name ~= "LT_SettingDropdown"
				then
					local s = ch.Size
					if s.Y.Scale ~= 0 or s.Y.Offset ~= 50 then
						ch.Size = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale, s.X.Offset, 0, 50)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local function upd()
			if not __dcm_masterRuntime.alive or __dcm_masterRuntime.stopping then
				return
			end
			applyRows()
			local uiScaleFactor = getUiScaleFactor()
			local size = lay.AbsoluteContentSize
			local sizeX = size.X / uiScaleFactor
			local sizeY = size.Y / uiScaleFactor
			local x
			local y
			if verticalOnly then
				local _, descY = descendantBounds()
				x = 0
				y = math.max(0, math.floor(math.max(sizeY + 12.5, descY + 12.5) + 0.5))
			else
				local descX, descY = descendantBounds()
				x = math.max(0, math.floor(math.max(sizeX, descX) + 0.5))
				y = math.max(0, math.floor(math.max(sizeY + 12.5, descY + 12.5) + 0.5))
			end
			pcall(function()
				if verticalOnly then
					sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
				else
					sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
				end
			end)
		end
		uiScaleState.refreshers[sf] = upd
		if verticalOnly then
			local function bindVerticalGui(gui)
				if not (gui and gui:IsA("GuiObject")) or boundVerticalGuis[gui] then
					return
				end
				local isDirectChild = gui.Parent == sf
				local isDropdownGui = gui.Name == "Dropdown" or gui.Name == "LT_SettingDropdown"
				if not (isDirectChild or isDropdownGui) then
					return
				end
				boundVerticalGuis[gui] = true
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
						task.defer(upd)
					end)
				)
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
						task.defer(upd)
					end)
				)
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
						task.defer(upd)
					end)
				)
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
						task.defer(upd)
					end)
				)
			end
			local function bindVerticalRow(row)
				if not (row and row:IsA("GuiObject")) then
					return
				end
				bindVerticalGui(row)
				for _, desc in row:QueryDescendants("GuiObject") do
					if desc.Name == "Dropdown" then						bindVerticalGui(desc)
					end
				end
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					row.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
						if desc:IsA("GuiObject") and desc.Name == "Dropdown" then
							bindVerticalGui(desc)
							task.defer(upd)
						end
					end)
				)
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					row.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
						if desc:IsA("GuiObject") and desc.Name == "Dropdown" then
							task.defer(upd)
						end
					end)
				)
			end
			for _, child in sf:GetChildren() do
				bindVerticalRow(child)
			end
			upd()
			NAlib.connect(id, lay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(upd))
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				sf.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
					if desc.Parent == sf then
						bindVerticalRow(desc)
						task.defer(upd)
					end
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				sf.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
			if uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object and uiScaleState.object.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
				NAlib.connect(
					id,
					uiScaleState.object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
						task.defer(upd)
					end)
				)
			end
			return
		end
		local function bindGui(gui)
			if not (gui and gui:IsA("GuiObject")) then
				return
			end
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
		end
		for _, desc in sf:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
			bindGui(desc)
		end
		upd()
		NAlib.connect(id, lay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(upd))
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sf.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
				bindGui(desc)
				task.defer(upd)
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sf.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
				task.defer(upd)
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(upd)
			end)
		)
		if uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object and uiScaleState.object.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(
				id,
				uiScaleState.object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(upd)
				end)
			)
		end
	end

	local customDropdownMenus = {}
	local function closeCustomDropdowns(exceptMenu)
		for i = #customDropdownMenus, 1, -1 do
			local entry = customDropdownMenus[i]
			local menu = type(entry) == "table" and entry.menu or entry
			if not (menu and menu.Parent) then
				table.remove(customDropdownMenus, i)
			elseif menu ~= exceptMenu then
				if type(entry) == "table" then
					if type(entry.collapse) == "function" then
						pcall(entry.collapse)
					elseif entry.row and entry.row.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							menu.Visible = false
						end)
						local baseHeight = tonumber(entry.baseHeight) or 50
						local s = entry.row.Size
						entry.row.Size = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale, s.X.Offset, 0, baseHeight)
					end
				else
					pcall(function()
						menu.Visible = false
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if settingsHolder then
		for _, c in settingsHolder:GetChildren() do
			if c:IsA("Frame") and c.Name == "Button" then
				settingTemplate = c
				break
			end
		end
	end
	local hiddenStockDropdownTitles = {
		["fps cap"] = true,
		["icon size"] = true,
		["icon color"] = true,
		["icon shape"] = true,
	}
	local hiddenStockDropdownBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function enforceHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
		if not (child and child.Parent and child:IsA("Frame")) then
			return
		end
		local size = child.Size
		__dcm_setTracked(child, "Visible", false)
		__dcm_setTracked(child, "Size", UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, 0))
	end
	local function bindHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
		if not (child and child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "SettingDropdown") then
			return
		end
		local title = child:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local titleText = title and title:IsA("TextLabel") and string.lower(title.Text or "") or ""
		if not hiddenStockDropdownTitles[titleText] then
			return
		end
		enforceHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
		if not hiddenStockDropdownBound[child] then
			hiddenStockDropdownBound[child] = true
			local guardId = "HideManagedStockDropdownRows_" .. child:GetDebugId()
			NAlib.disconnect(guardId)
			NAlib.connect(
				guardId,
				child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					if child.Visible then
						enforceHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
					end
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				guardId,
				child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
					if child.Visible or child.Size.Y.Offset ~= 0 or child.Size.Y.Scale ~= 0 then
						enforceHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
					end
				end)
			)
			child.Destroying:Connect(function()
				hiddenStockDropdownBound[child] = nil
				NAlib.disconnect(guardId)
			end)
		end
	end
	local function hideManagedStockDropdownRows()
		if not settingsHolder then
			return
		end
		for _, child in settingsHolder:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				bindHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
			end
		end
	end
	if settingsHolder then
		task.defer(hideManagedStockDropdownRows)
		NAlib.disconnect("HideManagedStockDropdownRows")
		NAlib.connect(
			"HideManagedStockDropdownRows",
			settingsHolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				task.defer(function()
					bindHiddenStockDropdownRow(child)
				end)
			end)
		)
	end
	if settingsHolder and settingTemplate then
		local function makeSectionTitle(text, order, isCustom)
			local f = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
			f.Name = isCustom and "Section_Customization" or "Section_Delta"
			f.Parent = settingsHolder
			f.LayoutOrder = order
			for _, d in f:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
				d:Destroy()
			end
			local btn = f:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
			if btn then
				btn:Destroy()
			end
			local tLabel = f:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
			local dLabel = f:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
			local baseCol = isCustom and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(112, 118, 132)
			local fillCol = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 35)
			local edgeCol = isCustom and Color3.fromRGB(88, 152, 223) or Color3.fromRGB(63, 68, 80)
			f.BackgroundColor3 = fillCol
			local outline = f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke", true)
			if outline then
				outline.Color = edgeCol
				outline.Transparency = 0.34
				outline.Thickness = 1
			end
			local panelGrad = f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient", true)
			if panelGrad then
				panelGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(28, 31, 38)),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 31)),
				})
				panelGrad.Rotation = 0
			else
				panelGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
				panelGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(28, 31, 38)),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 31)),
				})
				panelGrad.Rotation = 0
				panelGrad.Parent = f
			end
			if tLabel then
				tLabel.Text = isCustom and "Customization" or "Delta settings"
				tLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				tLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
				tLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 18)
				tLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 247)
				tLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
				tLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
				if isCustom then
					local textGrad = tLabel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
					textGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
							0,
							activeColorValue and activeColorValue.Value or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
						),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(235, 244, 255)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
							1,
							inactiveColorValue and inactiveColorValue.Value or Color3.fromRGB(63, 72, 92)
						),
					})
					textGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(-0.8, 0)
					textGrad.Parent = tLabel
					local function refreshCustomSectionColors()
						local activeCol = activeColorValue and activeColorValue.Value or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
						local inactiveCol = inactiveColorValue and inactiveColorValue.Value
							or Color3.fromRGB(63, 72, 92)
						textGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, activeCol),
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(235, 244, 255)),
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, inactiveCol),
						})
						if panelGrad then
							panelGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
								ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, activeCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22), 0.74)),
								ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, inactiveCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22), 0.8)),
							})
						end
					end
					refreshCustomSectionColors()
					if activeColorValue then
						activeColorValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refreshCustomSectionColors)
					end
					if inactiveColorValue then
						inactiveColorValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refreshCustomSectionColors)
					end
					if TS then
						local alive = true
						f.Destroying:Connect(function()
							alive = false
						end)
						local function animateTextGradient()
							if not alive or not textGrad.Parent then
								return
							end
							textGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(-0.8, 0)
							local tw = TS:Create(
								textGrad,
								TweenInfo.new(1.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
								{
									Offset = Vector2.new(0.8, 0),
								}
							)
							tw:Play()
							tw.Completed:Connect(function()
								if alive then
									task.delay(0.12, animateTextGradient)
								end
							end)
						end
						local function animateBackground()
							if not alive or not f.Parent then
								return
							end
							local activeCol = activeColorValue and activeColorValue.Value
								or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
							local inactiveCol = inactiveColorValue and inactiveColorValue.Value
								or Color3.fromRGB(63, 72, 92)
							local a = activeCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 18), 0.78)
							local b = inactiveCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 18), 0.78)
							local tw1 =
								TS:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(1.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
									BackgroundColor3 = a,
								})
							tw1:Play()
							tw1.Completed:Connect(function()
								if not alive or not f.Parent then
									return
								end
								local tw2 = TS:Create(
									f,
									TweenInfo.new(1.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
									{
										BackgroundColor3 = b,
									}
								)
								tw2:Play()
								tw2.Completed:Connect(function()
									if alive then
										animateBackground()
									end
								end)
							end)
						end
						animateTextGradient()
						animateBackground()
					end
				end
			end
			if dLabel then
				dLabel.Text = ""
				dLabel.Visible = false
			end
			return f
		end
		makeSectionTitle("Customization", -3, true)
		makeSectionTitle("Delta settings", -1, false)
	end
	if sidebar then
		local existingGrad = sidebar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
		local c1
		local c2
		if existingGrad then
			local kps = existingGrad.Color.Keypoints
			c1 = kps[1] and kps[1].Value or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
			c2 = kps[#kps] and kps[#kps].Value or Color3.fromRGB(28, 34, 46)
			sidebarGradient = existingGrad
		else
			c1 = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
			c2 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 34, 46)
			sidebarGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			sidebarGradient.Name = "DeltaCustomGradient"
			sidebarGradient.Parent = sidebar
		end
		sidebarGradient.Rotation = 100
		sidebarGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c1),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2),
		})
		sidebarGrad1 = Instance.new("Color3Value")
		sidebarGrad1.Name = "SidebarGradientColor1"
		sidebarGrad1.Value = c1
		sidebarGrad2 = Instance.new("Color3Value")
		sidebarGrad2.Name = "SidebarGradientColor2"
		sidebarGrad2.Value = c2
		local sidebarSnapPending = false
		NAlib.disconnect("Sidebar_OvershootSnap")
		NAlib.connect(
			"Sidebar_OvershootSnap",
			(sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")):Connect(function()
			local p = sidebar.Position
			if p.X.Scale > sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale and not sidebarSnapPending then
				sidebarSnapPending = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local last = p
					local stable = 0
					local step = 0.05
					while stable < 0.1 do
						task.wait(step)
						local cur = sidebar.Position
						if cur ~= last then
							last = cur
							stable = 0
						else
							stable += step
						end
					end
					sidebarSnapPending = false
					if sidebar.Parent and sidebar.Position.X.Scale > sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale then
						setSidebarPosition(sidebarClosedPos)
						normalizeSidebarGeometry()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		)
	end

	local iconSizeValue
	if iconBtn and iconBaseSize then
		iconSizeValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		iconSizeValue.Name = "IconSizeValue"
		iconSizeValue.Value = 1
		local sizeCfg = settingsConfig.IconSize
		if type(sizeCfg) == "table" and type(sizeCfg.value) == "number" then

		local function applyIconSize(v)
			v = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 5)
			if not iconBtn or not iconBaseSize then
				return
			end
			iconSzLock = true
			iconBtn.Size = UDim2.new(
				iconBaseSize.X.Scale * v,
				iconBaseSize.X.Offset * v,
				iconBaseSize.Y.Scale * v,
				iconBaseSize.Y.Offset * v
			)
			iconSzLock = false
		end

			NAlib.connect(
				"IconSizeRebase",
				(mainGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(function()
					task.defer(function()
						if iconBtn and iconSizeValue and not iconSzLock then
							local v = math.clamp(iconSizeValue.Value, 0.5, 5)
							local s = iconBtn.Size
							iconBaseSize = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale / v, s.X.Offset / v, s.Y.Scale / v, s.Y.Offset / v)
							applyIconSize(v)
						end
					end)
				end)
			)
		end
		NAlib.connect(
			"IconSizeValue_Changed",
			iconSizeValue.Changed:Connect(function()
				applyIconSize(iconSizeValue.Value)
				if HS and type(writefile) == "function" then
					settingsConfig.IconSize = { value = math.clamp(iconSizeValue.Value, 0.5, 5) }
						writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
				end
			end)
		)
		applyIconSize(iconSizeValue.Value)
	end
	local function ensureIconCorner()
		refreshIconRefs()
		if not iconBtn then
			return nil
		end
		if not iconCorner then
			iconCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			iconCorner.Name = "DeltaIconCorner"
			iconCorner.Parent = iconBtn
		end
		if not iconBaseCorner then
			iconBaseCorner = iconCorner.CornerRadius
		end
		return iconCorner
	end
	local iconShapeName = "Squircle"
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.IconShape
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.name) == "string" and cfg.name ~= "" then
			iconShapeName = cfg.name
		end
	end
	if iconShapeName == "Default" then
		iconShapeName = "Squircle"
	elseif iconShapeName == "Pill" then
		iconShapeName = "Circle"
	end
	local function getIconShapeCorner(shapeName)
		if shapeName == "Square" then
			return UDim.new(0, 0)
		elseif shapeName == "Rounded" then
			return UDim.new(0, 8)
		elseif shapeName == "Squircle" then
			return UDim.new(0, 12)
		elseif shapeName == "Circle" then
			return UDim.new(1, 0)
		end
		return UDim.new(0, 12)
	end
	applyIconShapeChoice = function()
		local corner = ensureIconCorner()
		if not corner then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			corner.CornerRadius = getIconShapeCorner(iconShapeName)
		end)
	end
	task.defer(applyIconShapeChoice)
	local iconRgbSpeedValue
	if iconStroke then

			sp = math.clamp(spCfg.value, 0.05, 2)
		end
		iconRgbSpeedValue.Value = sp
	end

	do

		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then

	local iconPositionSaveEnabled = false
