	local iconStrokeUserEnabled = true
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.IconStrokeEnabled
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			iconStrokeUserEnabled = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	local iconForcedHidden = false
	local tabNotifEnabled = true
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.TabNotifications
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			tabNotifEnabled = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	local function tweenIconVisual(imgT, bgT, instant)
		if not iconBtn then
			return
		end
		if imgT < 1 or bgT < 1 then
			pcall(function()
				iconBtn.Visible = true
			end)
		end
		if TS and not instant then
			pcall(function()
				(__lt.cm(
					"TweenService",
					"Create",
					iconBtn,
					TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{
						ImageTransparency = imgT,
						BackgroundTransparency = bgT,
					}
				)):Play()
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				iconBtn.ImageTransparency = imgT
				iconBtn.BackgroundTransparency = bgT
			end)
		end
	end
	local function updateManagedIconDisplay(instant)
		if not iconBtn then
			return
		end
		local shouldShow = iconVisible and not iconForcedHidden
		pcall(function()
			iconBtn.Active = true
		end)
		pcall(function()
			iconBtn.Interactable = true
		end)
		if shouldShow then
			pcall(function()
				iconBtn.Visible = true
			end)
			tweenIconVisual(0, 0, instant)
		else
			if not iconForcedHidden then
				pcall(function()
					iconBtn.Visible = true
				end)
			end
			tweenIconVisual(1, 1, instant)
			if iconForcedHidden then
				local stamp = tick()
				task.delay(instant and 0 or 0.2, function()
					if not iconBtn or not iconBtn.Parent then
						return
					end
					if stamp and not iconForcedHidden then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						iconBtn.Visible = false
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		applyIconStrokeState()
	end
	applyIconStrokeState = function()
		if not iconStroke then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			iconStroke.Enabled = iconVisible and iconStrokeUserEnabled and not iconForcedHidden
		end)
	end
	local function saveManagedIconPosition()
		if not (iconPositionSaveEnabled and iconBtn and iconBtn.Parent) then
			return
		end
		saveSettingsEntry("IconPosition", {
			xScale = iconBtn.Position.X.Scale,
			xOffset = iconBtn.Position.X.Offset,
			yScale = iconBtn.Position.Y.Scale,
			yOffset = iconBtn.Position.Y.Offset,
		})
	end
	applySavedManagedIconPosition = function()
		if not (iconPositionSaveEnabled and iconBtn and iconBtn.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local cfg = settingsConfig.IconPosition
		if type(cfg) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local xs = tonumber(cfg.xScale)
		local xo = tonumber(cfg.xOffset)
		local ys = tonumber(cfg.yScale)
		local yo = tonumber(cfg.yOffset)
		if xs and xo and ys and yo then
			pcall(function()
				iconBtn.Position = UDim2.new(xs, xo, ys, yo)
			end)
		end
	end
	bindManagedIconPositionSaver = function()
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedIcon_PositionSave")
		if not (iconBtn and iconBtn.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local stamp = 0
		NAlib.connect(
			"ManagedIcon_PositionSave",
			iconBtn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
				if not iconPositionSaveEnabled then
					return
				end
				stamp += 1
				local cur = stamp
				task.delay(0.2, function()
					if cur == stamp then
						saveManagedIconPosition()
					end
				end)
			end)
		)
	end
	local function applyIconUserVisibility(instant)
		updateManagedIconDisplay(instant)
	end
	local function setIconForcedHidden(hidden)
		iconForcedHidden = hidden and true or false
		if not iconBtn then
			return
		end
		updateManagedIconDisplay(false)
	end
	task.defer(function()
		applySavedManagedIconPosition()
		bindManagedIconPositionSaver()
	end)
	applyIconUserVisibility(true)
	local scriptHubHolder
	local homeHolder
	do
		local sh = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Scripthub")
		if sh then
			scriptHubHolder = sh:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		end
		local ho = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Home")
		if ho then
			homeHolder = ho:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		end
	end
	setupAutoScroll(settingsHolder, true, true)
	setupAutoScroll(scriptHubHolder, false, false)
	setupAutoScroll(homeHolder, true, true)
	local function makeColorSlider(id, tt, dt, cVal)
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and cVal) then
			return
		end
		local key = id or tt or "Color_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000000))
		local slId = "ColorSlider_" .. key
		local isIc = id == "IconColor" and iconStroke ~= nil
		local fr = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		fr.Parent = settingsHolder
		fr.Visible = true
		fr.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in fr:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tL = fr:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dL = fr:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tL then
			tL.Text = tt
		end
		if dL then
			dL.Text = dt
		end
		local ob = fr:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		local ord = 0
		if ob then
			ord = ob.LayoutOrder
			ob:Destroy()
		end
		local pad = 14
		local vbW = 74
		local tgW = 20
		local slW = 190
		local sl = Instance.new("Frame")
		sl.Name = "ColorSlider"
		sl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, slW, 1, 0)
		sl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		sl.LayoutOrder = ord
		sl.Parent = fr
		local vb = Instance.new("TextBox")
		vb.Name = "ColorValue"
		vb.Size = UDim2.new(0, vbW, 0, 18)
		vb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		vb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		vb.BorderSizePixel = 0
		vb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		vb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		vb.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		vb.TextSize = 12
		vb.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		vb.Parent = fr
		local tg = Instance.new("TextButton")
		tg.Name = "Toggle"
		tg.Size = UDim2.new(0, tgW, 0, 18)
		tg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		tg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		tg.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tg.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		tg.TextSize = 11
		tg.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		tg.Text = "C"
		tg.Parent = fr
		local tgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
		tgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		tgc.Parent = tg
		local function lay()
			local y = 0.5
			vb.Position = UDim2.new(1, -pad, y, 0)
			tg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(pad + vbW + 8), y, 0)
			sl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(pad + vbW + 8 + tgW + 8), y, 0)
		end
		lay();
		(fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(lay)
		local function mkBar(nm, yy)
			local b = Instance.new("Frame")
			b.Name = nm
			b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, yy, 0)
			b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 5)
			b.Active = true
			b.Parent = sl
			local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
			bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
			bc.Parent = b
			local k = Instance.new("Frame")
			k.Name = "Knob"
			k.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
			k.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			k.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
			k.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			k.BorderSizePixel = 0
			k.Parent = b
			local kc = Instance.new("UICorner")
			kc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
			kc.Parent = k
			return b, k
		end
		local bH, kH = mkBar("Hue", 0.2)
		local bS, kS = mkBar("Sat", 0.5)
		local bV, kV = mkBar("Val", 0.8)
		local gH = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gH.Rotation = 0
		gH.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.17, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.67, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.83, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
		})
		gH.Parent = bH
		local gS = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gS.Rotation = 0
		gS.Parent = bS
		local gV = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gV.Rotation = 0
		gV.Parent = bV
		local defC = cVal.Value or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local cOn = true
		local lastC = defC
		local sv = colorConfig[key]
		if type(sv) == "table" then
			if type(sv.customColor) == "table" and #sv.customColor == 3 then
				lastC = Color3.new(sv.customColor[1], sv.customColor[2], sv.customColor[3])
			end
			if sv.useCustom ~= nil then
				cOn = sv.useCustom and true or false
			end
		end
		local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(lastC)
		local function boxC(c)
			vb.Text = string.format(
				"%d,%d,%d",
				math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
				math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
				math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
			)
		end
		local function save()
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			colorConfig[key] = {
				useCustom = cOn,
				customColor = { lastC.R, lastC.G, lastC.B },
			}
			writeJsonFile(colorsPath, colorConfig)
		end
		local function updGrad()
			gS.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(h, 0, v)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, v)),
			})
			gV.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 1)),
			})
		end
		local function setVis()
			kH.Position = UDim2.new(h, 0, 0.5, 0)
			kS.Position = UDim2.new(s, 0, 0.5, 0)
			kV.Position = UDim2.new(v, 0, 0.5, 0)
			updGrad()
			boxC(Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v))
		end
		local function applyC(col, st)
			if cVal then
				cVal.Value = col
			end
			if st then
				lastC = col
			end
			save()
		end
		local function setHSV(nh, ns, nv, st)
			h = math.clamp(nh, 0, 1)
			s = math.clamp(ns, 0, 1)
			v = math.clamp(nv, 0, 1)
			setVis()
			applyC(Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v), st)
		end
		local function syncFromC(col)
			h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(col)
			setVis()
		end
		if cOn then
			if isIc then
				iconColorUseCustom = true
			end
			syncFromC(lastC)
			applyC(lastC, false)
			tg.Text = "C"
		else
			if isIc then
				iconColorUseCustom = false
				if iconStroke then
					pcall(function()
						iconStroke.Color = iconBaseColor or iconStroke.Color
					end)
				end
			end
			syncFromC(defC)
			applyC(defC, false)
			tg.Text = "D"
		end
		local drag = nil
		local function relX(bar, inp)
			local w = bar.AbsoluteSize.X
			if w <= 1 then
				return nil
			end
			local x = (inp.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / w
			if x ~= x then
				x = 0
			end
			return math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
		end
		local function useDrag(inp)
			if not drag then
				return
			end
			local a = relX(drag, inp)
			if not a then
				return
			end
			cOn = true
			tg.Text = "C"
			if isIc then
				iconColorUseCustom = true
			end
			if drag == bH then
				setHSV(a, s, v, true)
			elseif drag == bS then
				setHSV(h, a, v, true)
			elseif drag == bV then
				setHSV(h, s, a, true)
			end
		end
		local function beg(bar, inp)
			if
				inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end
			drag = bar
			useDrag(inp)
		end
		bH.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			beg(bH, i)
		end)
		bS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			beg(bS, i)
		end)
		bV.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			beg(bV, i)
		end)
		NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
				if not drag then
					return
				end
				if
					i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					useDrag(i)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
				if
					i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					drag = nil
				end
			end)
		)
		fr.Destroying:Connect(function()
			NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		end)
		vb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local txt = vb.Text or ""
			local r, g, b = txt:match("(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)")
			r, g, b = tonumber(r), tonumber(g), tonumber(b)
			if r and g and b then
				local col =
					Color3.new(math.clamp(r, 0, 255) / 255, math.clamp(g, 0, 255) / 255, math.clamp(b, 0, 255) / 255)
				cOn = true
				tg.Text = "C"
				if isIc then
					iconColorUseCustom = true
				end
				syncFromC(col)
				applyC(col, true)
			else
				boxC(cVal.Value)
			end
		end)
		tg.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if cOn then
				cOn = false
				tg.Text = "D"
				if isIc then
					iconColorUseCustom = false
					if iconStroke then
						pcall(function()
							iconStroke.Color = iconBaseColor or iconStroke.Color
						end)
					end
				end
				syncFromC(defC)
				applyC(defC, false)
			else
				cOn = true
				tg.Text = "C"
				if isIc then
					iconColorUseCustom = true
				end
				syncFromC(lastC or defC)
				applyC(lastC or defC, true)
			end
			save()
		end)
	end
	local function makeSizeSlider(id, titleText, descText, numValue, minV, maxV, opts)
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and numValue) then
			return
		end
		opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {}
		local key = id or titleText or "Size_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000000))
		local slId = "SizeSlider_" .. key
		minV = minV or 0.5
		maxV = maxV or 5
		local fr = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		fr.Parent = settingsHolder
		fr.Visible = true
		fr.LayoutOrder = -2
		local tl = fr:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dl = fr:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tl then
			tl.Text = titleText
		end
		if dl then
			dl.Text = descText
		end
		local ob = fr:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if ob then
			ob:Destroy()
		end
		local dock = mkDock(fr)
		local vb = mkBox(dock)
		local sl, bar, fill, kb = mkSl(dock, 150)
		local sv = settingsConfig[key]
		if type(sv) == "table" and type(sv.value) == "number" then
			numValue.Value = math.clamp(sv.value, minV, maxV)
		end
		local function save(v)
			if opts.persist == false then
				return
			end
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[key] = { value = v }
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVis(v)
			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			local denom = maxV - minV
			local a = denom ~= 0 and ((v - minV) / denom) or 0
			fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
			kb.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
			vb.Text = opts.integer and tostring(v) or string.format("%.2f", v)
		end
		local function commit(v)
			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			numValue.Value = v
			setVis(v)
			save(v)
			if type(opts.apply) == "function" then
				pcall(opts.apply, v)
			end
		end
		setVis(numValue.Value)
		local drag = false
		local pendingValue = numValue.Value
		local function fromIn(input)
			local rel = 0
			pcall(function()
				rel = (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X
			end)
			rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
			local nextV = minV + (maxV - minV) * rel
			if opts.integer then
				nextV = math.floor(nextV + 0.5)
			end
			if opts.applyOnRelease then
				pendingValue = nextV
				setVis(nextV)
			else
				commit(nextV)
			end
		end
		bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				drag = true
				fromIn(input)
			end
		end)
		NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not drag then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					fromIn(input)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			slId,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					if drag and opts.applyOnRelease then
						commit(pendingValue)
					end
					drag = false
				end
			end)
		)
		fr.Destroying:Connect(function()
			NAlib.disconnect(slId)
		end)
		vb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local v = tonumber(vb.Text or "")
			if v then
				commit(v)
			else
				setVis(numValue.Value)
			end
		end)
		local function updDock()
			local w = math.clamp(math.floor(fr.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.46), 240, 380)
			dock.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
			local sw = math.clamp(w - 78, 140, 280)
			sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, sw, 0, 18)
		end
		updDock()
		fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(updDock)
		end)
	end
	local function makeEnumDropdown(id, titleText, descText, enumItems, getCurrentName, setSelectedName, opts)
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and type(setSelectedName) == "function") then
			return
		end
		opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {}
		local names = {}
		for _, item in enumItems or {} do
			if typeof(item) == "EnumItem" then
				names[#names + 1] = item.Name
			elseif type(item) == "string" and item ~= "" then
				names[#names + 1] = item
			end
		end
		if #names == 0 then
			return
		end
		local baseHeight = 50
		local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
		fr.Name = "LT_SettingDropdown"
		fr.Parent = settingsHolder
		fr.Visible = true
		fr.LayoutOrder = -2
		fr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fr.ClipsDescendants = false
		fr.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, baseHeight)
		local card = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		card.Name = "Card"
		card.Parent = fr
		card.Visible = true
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, baseHeight)
		card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		for _, d in card:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tl = card:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dl = card:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tl then
			tl.Text = titleText
			tl.TextScaled = false
			tl.TextWrapped = false
			tl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			tl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		end
		if dl then
			dl.Text = descText
			dl.TextScaled = false
			dl.TextWrapped = false
			dl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			dl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		end
		local ob = card:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if ob then
			ob:Destroy()
		end
		local dock = mkDock(card)
		local dockLayout = dock:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout")
		if dockLayout then
			dockLayout:Destroy()
		end
		dock.Size = UDim2.new(0, 168, 0, 30)
		local openBg = Instance.new("Frame")
		openBg.Name = "DropdownBackground"
		openBg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		openBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)

		arrowLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
		arrowLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		arrowLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		arrowLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)

		local upArrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		upArrow.Name = "Up"

		downArrow.Name = "Down"

		local menu = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		menu.Name = "Dropdown"
		menu.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		menu.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, baseHeight + 6)
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(0, 168, 0, math.min(132, #names * 30 + 8))
		menu.Visible = false
		menu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 47, 58)
		menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
		menu.ScrollBarThickness = 3
		menu.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
		menu.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		menu.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		menu.ZIndex = 26
		menu.Parent = fr
		local menuCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		menuCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
		menuCorner.Parent = menu
		local menuPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		menuPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
		menuPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
		menuPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
		menuPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
		menuPad.Parent = menu

		menuLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
		menuLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

		local dropdownEntry = {
			menu = menu,
			row = fr,
			baseHeight = baseHeight,
		}
		table.insert(customDropdownMenus, dropdownEntry)
		local selectedName
		local optionButtons = {}
		local hover = false
		local dropdownOpen = false
		local function getDropdownScale()
			local sc = uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object
			local factor = sc and tonumber(sc.Scale) or 1
			if not factor or factor <= 0 then
				factor = 1
			end
			return factor
		end
		local function syncExpandedHeight()
			local s = fr.Size
			local menuLogicalHeight = menu.Size.Y.Offset
			local uiScaleFactor = getDropdownScale()
			if menu.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
				menuLogicalHeight = math.max(menuLogicalHeight, math.floor((menu.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScaleFactor) + 0.5))
			end
			local expandedHeight = baseHeight + menuLogicalHeight + 6
			fr.Size = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale, s.X.Offset, 0, dropdownOpen and expandedHeight or baseHeight)
		end
		local function setExpanded(open)
			dropdownOpen = open and true or false
			menu.Visible = dropdownOpen
			upArrow.TextColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 180) or Color3.fromRGB(104, 110, 124)
			downArrow.TextColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(104, 110, 124) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 180)
			syncExpandedHeight()
			openBg.BackgroundColor3 = open and Color3.fromRGB(48, 52, 64)
				or (hover and Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(39, 42, 52))
		end
		dropdownEntry.collapse = function()
			setExpanded(false)
		end
		local function refreshOptions()
			for name, btn in optionButtons do
				if btn and btn.Parent then
					btn.TextColor3 = name == selectedName and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						or Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 252)
					local check = btn:FindFirstChild("Check")
					if check and check:IsA("TextLabel") then
						check.Visible = name == selectedName
					end
				end
			end
			openBtn.Text = selectedName or "Select"
		end
		local function applySelection(name)
			if not table.find(names, name) then
				return
			end
			selectedName = name
			pcall(function()
				setSelectedName(name)
			end)
			if opts.persist and id then
				saveSettingsEntry(id, { name = name })
			end
			refreshOptions()
		end
		for idx, name in names do
			local option = Instance.new("TextButton")
			option.Name = name
			option.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
			option.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			option.BorderSizePixel = 0
			option.AutoButtonColor = false
			option.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			option.TextSize = 12
			option.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			option.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			option.Text = name
			option.LayoutOrder = idx
			option.ZIndex = 27
			option.Parent = menu
			local optionPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			optionPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 24)
			optionPad.Parent = option
			local divider = Instance.new("Frame")
			divider.Name = "Divider"
			divider.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
			divider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
			divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, idx < #names and 1 or 0)
			divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(66, 96, 128)
			divider.BorderSizePixel = 0
			divider.ZIndex = 27
			divider.Parent = option
			local check = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			check.Name = "Check"
			check.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			check.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			check.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
			check.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
			check.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			check.TextSize = 15
			check.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
			check.Text = "✓"
			check.Visible = false
			check.ZIndex = 28
			check.Parent = option
			optionButtons[name] = option
			option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				closeCustomDropdowns(menu)
				setExpanded(false)
				applySelection(name)
			end)
		end
		openBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			hover = true
			if not menu.Visible then
				openBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 60)
			end
		end)
		openBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hover = false
			if not menu.Visible then
				openBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(39, 42, 52)
			end
		end)
		openBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local willOpen = not menu.Visible
			closeCustomDropdowns(menu)
			setExpanded(willOpen)
		end)
		menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
		end)
		menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
		end)
		if uiScaleState and uiScaleState.object and uiScaleState.object.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			uiScaleState.object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(syncExpandedHeight)
			end)
		end
		local initialName
		if opts.persist and id then
			local saved = settingsConfig[id]
			if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.name) == "string" then
				initialName = saved.name
			end
		end
		if type(getCurrentName) == "function" then
			initialName = initialName or getCurrentName()
		end
		if not table.find(names, initialName) then
			initialName = names[1]
		end
		setExpanded(false)
		applySelection(initialName)
	end
	local function makeIconRgbToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn and iconStroke) then
			return
		end
		local key = "IconRGB"
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "RGB icon"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Rainbow outline on the Delta icon."
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local saved = settingsConfig[key]
		local enabled = false
		if type(saved) == "table" and saved.enabled ~= nil then
			enabled = saved.enabled and true or false
		end
		local hue = 0
		local function saveState()
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[key] = { enabled = enabled }
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVisualToggle()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		local function startLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("IconRGB_Loop")
			NAlib.connect(
				"IconRGB_Loop",
				RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
					local spd = iconRgbSpeedValue and math.clamp(iconRgbSpeedValue.Value, 0.05, 2) or 0.2
					hue = (hue + dt * spd) % 1
					pcall(function()
						iconStroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
					end)
				end)
			)
		end
		local function stopLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("IconRGB_Loop")
			pcall(function()
				if iconColorUseCustom and iconColorValue then
					iconStroke.Color = iconColorValue.Value
				else
					iconStroke.Color = iconBaseColor or iconStroke.Color
				end
			end)
		end
		local function applyState()
			setVisualToggle()
			if enabled then
				startLoop()
			else
				stopLoop()
			end
			saveState()
		end
		applyState()
		local function toggleClick()
			enabled = not enabled
			applyState()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local function makeDestroyUIButton()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Destroy Delta UI"
			tLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Deletes Delta's UI and icon until you rejoin."
			dLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "KILL"
		end
		btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local function click()
			if iconGui and iconGui ~= mainGui then
				pcall(function()
					iconGui:Destroy()
				end)
				iconGui = nil
			end
			if mainGui then
				pcall(function()
					mainGui:Destroy()
				end)
				mainGui = nil
			end
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(click)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					click()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeIconEnableToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn) then
			return
		end
		local key = "IconEnabled"
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Use custom icon"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and "Toggle between default and custom Delta icon"
				or "Requires file system + getcustomasset support"
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local enabled = dIcons.enabled and true or false
		local function setVisual()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		setVisual()
		local function toggleClick()
			local target = not enabled
			local ok, err = setIconEnabled(target)
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = err or "Failed to toggle custom icon.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			enabled = target
			setVisual()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeIconInputRow()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and iconBtn) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Icon source"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Asset id or image URL (GitHub/External supported)"
		end
		local oldBtn = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		local pos
		if oldBtn then
			pos = oldBtn.Position
			oldBtn:Destroy()
		end
		local basePos = pos or UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.5, 0)
		local bx, bo = basePos.X.Scale, basePos.X.Offset
		local by, byo = basePos.Y.Scale, basePos.Y.Offset
		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = "IconInput"
		box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 18)
		box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		box.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo, by, byo)
		box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = true
		box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		box.TextSize = 12
		box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		box.Text = ""
		box.PlaceholderText = "ID or image URL"
		box.Parent = frame
		local setBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		setBtn.Name = "Apply"
		setBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
		setBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		setBtn.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo - 170, by, byo)
		setBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
		setBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		setBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		setBtn.TextSize = 11
		setBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		setBtn.Text = "SET"
		setBtn.Parent = frame
		local setCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		setCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		setCorner.Parent = setBtn
		local defBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		defBtn.Name = "Default"
		defBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
		defBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		defBtn.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo - 230, by, byo)
		defBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		defBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		defBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		defBtn.TextSize = 11
		defBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		defBtn.Text = "DEF"
		defBtn.Parent = frame
		local defCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		defCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		defCorner.Parent = defBtn
		local function applyInput()
			if not iconFsOk() then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = "Custom icons require file system + getcustomasset.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			local txt = trim(box.Text or "")
			if txt == "" then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = "Enter an asset id or image URL.",
					Duration = 4,
				})
				return
			end
			local ok, msg = setIconAsset(txt, { autoEnable = true })
			if not ok then
				notify({
					Title = "Delta Icon",
					Description = msg or "Failed to set custom icon.",
					Duration = 5,
				})
				return
			end
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			box.Text = ""
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Custom icon updated.",
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		local function resetDefault()
			dIcons.enabled = false
			dIcons.assetId = ""
			dIcons.localPath = ""
			applyIcon()
			saveIconCfg()
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Reverted to default icon.",
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(applyInput)
		defBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(resetDefault)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
			if enter then
				applyInput()
			end
		end)
	end
	local function makeIconManagerRow()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Icon manager"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and formatIconStatus() or "File system/getcustomasset not supported."
		end
		local oldBtn = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		local pos
		if oldBtn then
			pos = oldBtn.Position
			oldBtn:Destroy()
		end
		local basePos = pos or UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.5, 0)
		local bx, bo = basePos.X.Scale, basePos.X.Offset
		local by, byo = basePos.Y.Scale, basePos.Y.Offset
		local function mkMgrBtn(nm, w, xOff, bgColor, txt)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
			b.Name = nm
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo + xOff, by, byo)
			b.BackgroundColor3 = bgColor
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0
			b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			b.TextSize = 11
			b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			b.Text = txt
			b.Parent = frame
			local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
			c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
			c.Parent = b
			return b
		end
		local gray = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		local prevBtn = mkMgrBtn("Prev", 24, -210, gray, "<")
		local nextBtn = mkMgrBtn("Next", 24, -180, gray, ">")
		local delBtn = mkMgrBtn("Del", 32, -140, Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 40), "DEL")
		local clrBtn = mkMgrBtn("Clr", 36, -95, Color3.fromRGB(60, 30, 30), "CLR")
		local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		statusLabel.Name = "Status"
		statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 18)
		statusLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(bx, bo, by, byo)
		statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		statusLabel.TextSize = 11
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
		statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		statusLabel.Text = "-/-"
		statusLabel.Parent = frame
		function updateIconStatusUI()
			if not statusLabel then
				return
			end
			local n = #dIcons.entries
			local idx = dIcons.index
			if dLabel then
				dLabel.Text = iconFsOk() and formatIconStatus() or "File system/getcustomasset not supported."
			end
			if n <= 0 then
				statusLabel.Text = "-/-"
			else
				if idx < 1 or idx > n then
					idx = 1
				end
				statusLabel.Text = tostring(idx) .. "/" .. tostring(n)
			end
		end
		updateIconStatusUI()
		local function chkFs()
			if iconFsOk() then
				return true
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Icon",
				Description = "Custom icon manager requires file system + getcustomasset.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to cycle.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			cycleIcon(-1)
		end)
		nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to cycle.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			cycleIcon(1)
		end)
		delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			local list = dIcons.entries
			local idx = dIcons.index
			if #list == 0 or idx < 1 or idx > #list then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No icon selected to delete.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			local e = list[idx]
			if not e or not e.file then
				return
			end
			removeIconEntry(e)
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
		end)
		clrBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not chkFs() then
				return
			end
			if #dIcons.entries == 0 then
				notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "No custom icons to clear.", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			removeAllIcons()
			if updateIconStatusUI then
				updateIconStatusUI()
			end
			notify({ Title = "Delta Icon", Description = "Cleared all custom icons.", Duration = 4 })
		end)
	end
	local sidebarGestureEnabled = false
	local sidebarGestureVisible = true
	local sidebarGestureWidth = 18
	local sidebarGestureHeight = 120
	local sidebarGestureFrame
	local sidebarDragActive = false
	local sidebarDragStartX = 0
	local sidebarDragStartAlpha = 0
	local sidebarDragAlpha = 0
	local getCurrentSectionName
	local sidebarCurrentSection = nil
	local autoCloseOnLoad = true
	local sectionsList = { "Executor", "Home", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" }
	local gestureWidthValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	gestureWidthValue.Name = "GestureWidthValue"
	gestureWidthValue.Value = sidebarGestureWidth
	local gestureHeightValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	gestureHeightValue.Name = "GestureHeightValue"
	gestureHeightValue.Value = sidebarGestureHeight
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.GestureWidth
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.value) == "number" then
			gestureWidthValue.Value = math.clamp(cfg.value, 6, 80)
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.GestureHeight
		if type(cfg) == "table" and type(cfg.value) == "number" then
			gestureHeightValue.Value = math.clamp(cfg.value, 60, 400)
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.SidebarGesture
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.SidebarGestureVisible
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			sidebarGestureVisible = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	do
		local cfg = settingsConfig.AutoCloseOnLoad
		if type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.enabled ~= nil then
			autoCloseOnLoad = cfg.enabled and true or false
		end
	end
	local gestCol = Instance.new("Color3Value")
	gestCol.Name = "GestureColorValue"
	gestCol.Value = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	gestCol.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureFrame.BackgroundColor3 = gestCol.Value
		end
	end)
	local function closeDeltaSidebar()
		if sidebar then
			setSidebarPosition(sidebarClosedPos)
			normalizeSidebarGeometry()
		end
		if mainGui then
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
					fr.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
	end
	local function openDeltaFromIcon()
		if not sidebar then
			return
		end
		local curSec = getCurrentSectionName()
		if curSec then
			sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
		end
		if not sidebarCurrentSection then
			sidebarCurrentSection = sectionsList[1]
		end
		if TS and sidebar then
			local tw = __lt.cm(
				"TweenService",
				"Create",
				sidebar,
				TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{
					Position = UDim2.new(sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale, sidebarOpenPos.X.Offset, 0.5, 0),
				}
			)
			tw:Play()
		else
			setSidebarPosition(sidebarOpenPos)
		end
		normalizeSidebarGeometry()
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		if mainGui and sidebarCurrentSection then
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
					fr.Visible = n == sidebarCurrentSection
				end
			end
		end
	end
	bindManagedIconToggle = function()
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedIcon_Toggle")
		if not (iconBtn and iconBtn:IsA("GuiButton")) then
			return
		end
		NAlib.connect("ManagedIcon_Toggle", MouseButtonFix(iconBtn, function()
			local override = rawget(__dcm_env, "__NewDeltaUIToggle")
			if type(override) == "function" then
				local ok, handled = pcall(override)
				if ok and handled ~= false then
					return
				end
			end
			if not sidebar then
				return
			end
			local isOpen = math.abs(sidebar.Position.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale) <= 0.001
			if isOpen then
				closeDeltaSidebar()
			else
				openDeltaFromIcon()
			end
		end))
	end
	bindManagedIconToggle()
	local function saveSidebarGesture()
		if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		settingsConfig.SidebarGesture = { enabled = sidebarGestureEnabled }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
	end
	local function saveSidebarGestureVisible()
		if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		settingsConfig.SidebarGestureVisible = { enabled = sidebarGestureVisible }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
	end
	local function applyGestureVisual()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureFrame.BackgroundTransparency = sidebarGestureVisible and 0.4 or 1
		end
	end
	local function applyGestureSize()
		if not sidebarGestureFrame then
			return
		end
		local h = math.clamp(gestureHeightValue and gestureHeightValue.Value or sidebarGestureHeight, 60, 400)
		local w = math.clamp(gestureWidthValue and gestureWidthValue.Value or sidebarGestureWidth, 6, 80)
		if UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled then
			w = math.floor(w * 1.6)
		end
		sidebarGestureFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
	end
	gestureWidthValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			applyGestureSize()
		end
	end)
	gestureHeightValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		if sidebarGestureFrame then
			applyGestureSize()
		end
	end)
	local function ensureSidebarGestureFrame()
		if sidebarGestureFrame or not (sidebar and mainGui) then
			return
		end
		local f = Instance.new("Frame")
		sidebarGestureFrame = f
		f.Name = "SidebarGestureZone"
		f.BackgroundColor3 = gestCol.Value
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		f.Size = UDim2.new(0, sidebarGestureWidth, 0, sidebarGestureHeight)
		f.Active = false
		f.Visible = false
		f.Parent = mainGui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		corner.Parent = f
		applyGestureSize()
		applyGestureVisual()
	end
	local function makeSidebarGestureToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and sidebar) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Sidebar gesture"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Drag from the right edge to open/close the sidebar"
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local function setVisual()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = sidebarGestureEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
				or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		setVisual()
		local function toggleClick()
			sidebarGestureEnabled = not sidebarGestureEnabled
			setVisual()
			saveSidebarGesture()
			setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
			task.defer(function()
				if applySidebarGestureState then
					applySidebarGestureState()
				end
			end)
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeSidebarGestureBarVisibilityToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate) then
			return
		end
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Gesture bar visible"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Hide the sidebar gesture bar but keep it usable"
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local function setVisual()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = sidebarGestureVisible and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
				or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		setVisual()
		applyGestureVisual()
		local function toggleClick()
			sidebarGestureVisible = not sidebarGestureVisible
			setVisual()
			applyGestureVisual()
			saveSidebarGestureVisible()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local function makeAutoCloseToggle()
		if not (settingsHolder and settingTemplate and sidebar) then
			return
		end
		local key = "AutoCloseOnLoad"
		local frame = __dcm_registerCustom(settingTemplate:Clone())
		frame.Parent = settingsHolder
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.LayoutOrder = -2
		for _, d in frame:QueryDescendants("LocalScript") do
			d:Destroy()
		end
		local tLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local dLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if tLabel then
			tLabel.Text = "Auto-close on load"
		end
		if dLabel then
			dLabel.Text = "Close the Delta sidebar right after it loads"
		end
		local btnFrame = frame:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if not btnFrame then
			return
		end
		local btnLabel = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
		if btnLabel then
			btnLabel.Text = "Toggle"
		end
		local clickable = btnFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or btnFrame
		local function saveState()
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[key] = { enabled = autoCloseOnLoad }
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVisual()
			btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = autoCloseOnLoad and Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		end
		setVisual()
		local function toggleClick()
			autoCloseOnLoad = not autoCloseOnLoad
			setVisual()
			saveState()
		end
		if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
			clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleClick)
		else
			clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					toggleClick()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	function getCurrentSectionName()
		if not mainGui then
			return nil
		end
		local cur
		for _, name in sectionsList do
			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(name)
			if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") and fr.Visible then
				cur = name
			end
		end
		return cur
	end
	do
		local iconApi = rawget(__dcm_env, "DeltaIcon")
		if type(iconApi) == "table" then
			iconApi.getCurrentSectionName = getCurrentSectionName
			iconApi.setForcedHidden = setIconForcedHidden
			iconApi.openClassic = openDeltaFromIcon
			iconApi.closeClassic = closeDeltaSidebar
			iconApi.setCurrentSection = function(name)
				if table.find(sectionsList, name) then
					sidebarCurrentSection = name
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function bindSidebarSectionMemory()
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarSectionMemory")
		if not mainGui then
			return
		end
		local current = getCurrentSectionName()
		if current then
			sidebarCurrentSection = current
		end
		for _, name in sectionsList do
			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(name)
			if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
				NAlib.connect(
					"SidebarSectionMemory",
					fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
						if fr.Visible then
							sidebarCurrentSection = name
						end
					end)
				)
			end
		end
	end
	bindSidebarSectionMemory()
	function applySidebarGestureState()
		if not sidebar then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		ensureSidebarGestureFrame()
		if not sidebarGestureFrame then
			sidebarGestureEnabled = false
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("ImageButton") then
			pcall(function()
				toggleUIBtn.Visible = not sidebarGestureEnabled
			end)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = false
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = false
		if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
			setIconForcedHidden(false)
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = true
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = true
		applyGestureVisual()
		applyGestureSize()
		local id = "SidebarGesture"
		local function recalcGesturePosition()
			if not (mainGui and sidebar and sidebarGestureFrame) then
				return
			end
			local sgSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if sgSize.X <= 0 or sgSize.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sbPos = sidebar.AbsolutePosition
			local sbSize = sidebar.AbsoluteSize
			local px = sbPos.X - 8
			sidebarGestureFrame.Position = UDim2.new(px / sgSize.X, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local function getSidebarAlpha()
			if not sidebar then
				return 0
			end
			local sx = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
			local denom = sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale
			if denom == 0 then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sx) / denom, 0, 1)
		end
		recalcGesturePosition()
		NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		if sidebar.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		if mainGui and mainGui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (mainGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		local function updateSidebarFromInput(input)
			if not sidebar or not mainGui then
				return
			end
			local dx = input.Position.X - sidebarDragStartX
			local guiSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			local dist = guiSize.X * math.abs(sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale)
			if dist <= 0 then
				dist = 100
			end
			local alpha = math.clamp(sidebarDragStartAlpha - dx / dist, 0, 1)
			sidebarDragAlpha = alpha
			setSidebarPosition(
				UDim2.new(
					sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale + (sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale - sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale) * alpha,
					0,
					0.5,
					0
				)
			)
		end
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sidebarGestureFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragAlpha = getSidebarAlpha()
				sidebarDragStartAlpha = sidebarDragAlpha
				sidebarDragStartX = input.Position.X
				sidebarDragActive = true
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					updateSidebarFromInput(input)
				end
			end)
		)
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarDragActive or not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragActive = false
				local curSec = getCurrentSectionName()
				if curSec then
					sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
				end
				local targetPos = sidebarDragAlpha > 0.5 and sidebarOpenPos or sidebarClosedPos
				if TS and sidebar then
					local tw = __lt.cm(
						"TweenService",
						"Create",
						sidebar,
						TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{
							Position = UDim2.new(targetPos.X.Scale, targetPos.X.Offset, 0.5, 0),
						}
					)
					tw:Play()
				elseif sidebar then
					setSidebarPosition(targetPos)
				end
				if targetPos == sidebarOpenPos then
					if not sidebarCurrentSection then
						sidebarCurrentSection = getCurrentSectionName()
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(true)
					if mainGui and sidebarCurrentSection then
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = n == sidebarCurrentSection
							end
						end
					end
				else
					if mainGui then
						if curSec then
							sidebarCurrentSection = curSec
						end
						for _, n in sectionsList do
							local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
							if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
								fr.Visible = false
							end
						end
					end
					setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
				end
			end)
		)
		saveSidebarGesture()
	end
	if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("GuiButton") then
		NAlib.disconnect("ManagedToggleUI_ForcedHidden")
		NAlib.connect(
			"ManagedToggleUI_ForcedHidden",
			toggleUIBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				setIconForcedHidden(sidebarGestureEnabled)
			end)
		)
	end

			"LightingTechnology",

				if lighting and enumItem then
					pcall(function()
						lighting.Technology = enumItem
					end)
				end
			end,

		)

	do
		local selectedCameraType

		local function applyCameraType(name)
			local enumItem = Enum.CameraType[name]

				return
			end

			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

		end

			"CameraType",
			"Camera Type",
			"Set CurrentCamera.CameraType from Delta settings",
			camItems,
			function()
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				return cam and cam.CameraType and cam.CameraType.Name or camItems[1] and camItems[1].Name
			end,
			applyCameraType,
			{ persist = false }
		)
		NAlib.disconnect("CameraType_Reapply")
		NAlib.connect(
			"CameraType_Reapply",
			workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(function()
					if selectedCameraType then
						applyCameraType(selectedCameraType)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)
	end
	do
		local soundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
		local reverbItems = Enum.ReverbType:GetEnumItems()
		makeEnumDropdown(
			"SoundReverb",
			"Sound Reverb",
			"Set SoundService.AmbientReverb from Delta settings",
			reverbItems,
			function()
				return soundService and soundService.AmbientReverb and soundService.AmbientReverb.Name
					or reverbItems[1] and reverbItems[1].Name
			end,
			function(name)
				local enumItem = Enum.ReverbType[name]
				if soundService and enumItem then
					pcall(function()
						soundService.AmbientReverb = enumItem
					end)
				end
			end,
			{ persist = false }
		)
	end
	if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
		local fpsCapValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		fpsCapValue.Name = "FpsCapValue"
		local fpsSaved = settingsConfig.FpsCap
		local fpsHasSaved = type(fpsSaved) == "table" and type(fpsSaved.value) == "number"
		fpsCapValue.Value = fpsHasSaved and math.clamp(math.floor(fpsSaved.value + 0.5), 30, 999) or 60
		local fpsCapTarget = fpsCapValue.Value
		local function applyFpsCap(v)
			local n = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 60) + 0.5), 30, 999)
			if fpsCapValue.Value ~= n then
				fpsCapValue.Value = n
			end
			fpsCapTarget = n
			pcall(setfpscap, n)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("FpsCap_Enforce")
		local function reapplyFpsCap()
			if fpsCapTarget then
				pcall(setfpscap, fpsCapTarget)
			end
		end
		if UIS and UIS.WindowFocused then
			NAlib.connect("FpsCap_Reapply", UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(reapplyFpsCap))
		end
		makeSizeSlider("FpsCap", "FPS cap", "set your FPS cap to anything you like", fpsCapValue, 1, 999, {
			integer = true,
			apply = applyFpsCap,
		})
		if fpsHasSaved then
			task.defer(function()
				applyFpsCap(fpsCapValue.Value)
			end)
		end
	end
	if sidebarGrad1 and sidebarGrad2 and sidebarGradient then
		makeColorSlider("SidebarGradient1", "Sidebar Gradient 1", "First sidebar gradient color", sidebarGrad1)
		makeColorSlider("SidebarGradient2", "Sidebar Gradient 2", "Second sidebar gradient color", sidebarGrad2)
		local function updateSidebarGradient()
			sidebarGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, sidebarGrad1.Value),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, sidebarGrad2.Value),
			})
		end
		updateSidebarGradient();
		(sidebarGrad1:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value")):Connect(updateSidebarGradient);
		(sidebarGrad2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value")):Connect(updateSidebarGradient)

	makeIconVisibilityToggle()

	applySidebarGestureState()
	if autoCloseOnLoad and sidebar then
		task.defer(function()
			task.wait(1.5)
			closeDeltaSidebar()
		end)
	end
	local sidemenu = execFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidemenu", true)
	if sidemenu then
		local oldCard = sidemenu:FindFirstChild("Script", true)
		if oldCard and oldCard:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			local parent = oldCard.Parent
			local newCard = oldCard:Clone()
			__dcm_setTracked(oldCard, "Parent", nil)
			newCard.Name = "LT_FeaturedScriptCard"
			newCard.Parent = parent
			local labs = {}
			for _, d in newCard:QueryDescendants("TextLabel") do
				table.insert(labs, d)
			end
			if #labs >= 3 then
				table.sort(labs, function(a, b)
					return a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y
				end)
				local bigHeader = labs[1]
				local subTitle = labs[2]
				local desc = labs[3]
				if bigHeader then
					bigHeader.Text = "Featured"
				end
				if subTitle then
					subTitle.Text = "Nameless Admin"
				end
				if desc then
					desc.Text =
						"continuation of Nameless Admin with advanced features, fixed commands and lots of customization."
				end
			end
			local clickable = nil
			for _, d in newCard:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
				if d:IsA("LocalScript") then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("TextButton") then
					clickable = d
				end
			end
			if not clickable then
				clickable = newCard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
					or newCard:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)
					or newCard
			end
			local function runNA()
				fixNet(mainGui)
				local ok, er = runUrl(
					"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/main/Source.lua",
					"@NamelessAdminSource.lua"
				)
				if not ok then
					toast("ScriptHub", tostring(er))
				end
			end
			if clickable:IsA("GuiButton") then
				clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runNA)
			else
				clickable.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						runNA()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	local pingLabel
	do
		local nFrame = sidemenu and sidemenu:FindFirstChild("Network", true)
		if nFrame then
			local overlayNet = nFrame:FindFirstChild("Overlay", true)
			local holderNet = overlayNet and overlayNet:FindFirstChild("Holder", true)
			local infoNet = holderNet and holderNet:FindFirstChild("Information", true)
			pingLabel = infoNet and infoNet:FindFirstChild("Ping")
		end
	end
	if pingLabel and Stats and RS then
		local net = Stats.Network
		local item = net and net.ServerStatsItem and net.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
		if item then
			pingLabel.RichText = true
			local pingId = "DeltaCustom_Ping"
			NAlib.disconnect(pingId)
			local function updatePing()
				local v = 0
				pcall(function()
					if item.GetValue then
						v = item:GetValue()
					elseif item.Value ~= nil then
						v = item.Value
					end
				end)
				pingLabel.Text = string.format('<font color="#4FA4F2">%d</font> MS Ping', math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0))
			end
			updatePing()
			local pingAccum = 0
			NAlib.connect(
				pingId,
				RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
					pingAccum += dt
					if pingAccum < 0.5 then
						return
					end
					pingAccum = 0
					updatePing()
				end)
			)
		end
	end

		and type(makefolder) == "function"
		and type(isfile) == "function"
		and type(writefile) == "function"
		and type(readfile) == "function"
		and type(listfiles) == "function"
