	local function parseIndex(nm)
		return tonumber(nm:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$"))
	end
	local function isScriptName(nm)
		return parseIndex(nm) ~= nil
	end
	local function getCodeBoxes()
		local t = {}
		for _, c in codeSf:QueryDescendants("TextBox") do
			if isScriptName(c.Name) then				table.insert(t, c)
			end
		end
		table.sort(t, function(a, b)
			return (parseIndex(a.Name) or 0) < (parseIndex(b.Name) or 0)
		end)
		return t
	end
	local function getSavedNames()
		local list = {}
		for _, p in listfiles(tabsDir) do
			local nm = p:match("([^/\\]+)$")
			if nm and isScriptName(nm) then
				table.insert(list, nm)
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			return (parseIndex(a) or 0) < (parseIndex(b) or 0)
		end)
		return list
	end
	local saved = getSavedNames()
	local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
	if tabNotifEnabled then
		if #saved > 0 then
			local desc
			if #saved > #boxes then
				desc = "Saved tabs: "
					.. tostring(#saved)
					.. "\nCreate your tabs in Delta and the saved code will load automatically."
			else
				desc = "Saved tabs: "
					.. tostring(#saved)
					.. "\nYour saved code will load into matching tabs automatically."
			end
			notify({ Title = "Delta Customization", Description = desc, Duration = 8 })
		else
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "No saved tabs yet. Anything you type will be saved automatically.",
				Duration = 6,
			})
		end
	end
	local hooked = {}
	local function hookBox(box)
		if not box or hooked[box] then
			return
		end
		hooked[box] = true
		local ready = false
		local function setupForName(nm)
			if ready then
				return
			end
			if not isScriptName(nm) then
				return
			end
			ready = true
			local path = tabsDir .. "/" .. nm
			if isfile(path) then
				local ok, data = pcall(readfile, path)
				if ok and type(data) == "string" then
					box.Text = data
				end
			else
				pcall(writefile, path, box.Text or "")
			end
			local last = 0
			(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text")):Connect(function()
				last = tick()
				local id = last
				task.delay(0.4, function()
					if id ~= last then
						return
					end
					local txt = box.Text
					pcall(writefile, path, txt)
				end)
			end)
		end
		setupForName(box.Name);
		(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name")):Connect(function()
			setupForName(box.Name)
		end)
	end
	for _, b in boxes do
		hookBox(b)
	end
	codeSf.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
			task.wait(0.05)
			hookBox(obj)
		end
	end)
	codeSf.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj)
		if not (obj:IsA("TextBox") and isScriptName(obj.Name) and type(delfile) == "function") then
			return
		end
		local txt = ""
		pcall(function()
			txt = obj.Text
		end)
		if type(txt) ~= "string" or txt:match("^%s*$") then
			local path = tabsDir .. "/" .. obj.Name
			if isfile(path) then
				pcall(delfile, path)
			end
		end
	end)
end)


__lt.deltaPatchState = __lt.deltaPatchState or {}
__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv = __dcm_env
if type(__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv) == "table" and not __lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded then
	__lt.deltaPatchState.visualEnv.__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded = true
	task.defer(function()
		if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() ~= "delta" then
			return
		end
		local function S(n)
			local ok, s = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cs(n, cloneref and cloneref or function(v)
					return v
				end)
			end)
			if ok then
				return s
			end
		end
		local HS = S("HttpService")
		local TS = S("TweenService")
		local CG = S("CoreGui")
		local root = gethui and gethui() or CG
		local function isGib(n)
			if typeof(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then
				return false
			end
			return not n:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
		end
		local function getMain()
			for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
				if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and isGib(g.Name) then
					if
						g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
						and g:FindFirstChild("Scripthub", true)
						and g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
					then
						return g
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local mainGui = getMain()
		if not mainGui then
			return
		end
		do
			local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled and (vp.X <= 1100 or vp.Y <= 820) then
				local darkOverlay = mainGui:FindFirstChild("DarkOverlay")
				if darkOverlay then
					pcall(function()
						darkOverlay.Visible = false
						darkOverlay.Active = false
					end)
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local sectionsList = { "Executor", "Home", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Console", "Music" }
		local settingsPath = "DeltaCustom/Settings.json"
		local settingsConfig = {}
		if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(settingsPath) then
			local ok, data = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
			if ok and data then
				local ok2, dec = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
				end)
				if ok2 and type(dec) == "table" then
					settingsConfig = dec
				end
			end
		end
		local function saveCfg(k, t)
			if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return
			end
			settingsConfig[k] = t
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local darkOverlay = mainGui:FindFirstChild("DarkOverlay")
		NAlib.disconnect("DarkOverlay_Hide")
		local dimFr = darkOverlay
		if not dimFr then
			dimFr = Instance.new("Frame")
			dimFr.Name = "DarkOverlay"
			dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			dimFr.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dimFr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			dimFr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			dimFr.ZIndex = 1
			dimFr.Visible = false
			dimFr.Active = false
			dimFr.Parent = mainGui
		end
		pcall(function()
			dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			dimFr.BorderSizePixel = 0
			dimFr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			dimFr.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			dimFr.ZIndex = 1
			dimFr.Active = false
		end)
		local base = { cor = {}, pan = {}, str = {}, got = false }
		local okNm = {
			Sidebar = true,
			Overlay = true,
			Popup = true,
			Searchbar = true,
			Script = true,
			Network = true,
			Information = true,
			RobloxConsole = true,
			RConsole = true,
			Source = true,
			Title = true,
			Executor = true,
			Console = true,
			Home = true,
			Scripthub = true,
			Settings = true,
			Dropdown = true,
			SettingDropdown = true,
			SettingTextbox = true,
			SettingSwitch = true,
			SettingSwitchOn = true,
			Button = true,
			InputText = true,
			LT_ScriptHub = true,
			LT_Music = true,
			Top = true,
			Bottom = true,
			List = true,
			Card = true,
			Card1 = true,
		}
		local skip = {
			Knob = true,
			Hue = true,
			Sat = true,
			Val = true,
			Fill = true,
			DarkOverlay = true,
			SidebarGestureZone = true,
		}
		local function capUi()
			if not mainGui then
				return
			end
			for _, o in mainGui:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
				if o:IsA("UICorner") then
					local p = o.Parent
					if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and not skip[p.Name] then
						local s = p.AbsoluteSize
						if okNm[p.Name] or (s.X >= 44 and s.Y >= 18) then
							if base.cor[o] == nil then
								base.cor[o] = o.CornerRadius
							end
						end
					end
				elseif o:IsA("UIStroke") then
					if base.str[o] == nil then
						base.str[o] = o.Thickness
					end
				elseif
					o:IsA("Frame")
					or o:IsA("ImageLabel")
					or o:IsA("TextBox")
					or o:IsA("TextButton")
					or o:IsA("ImageButton")
					or o:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
				then
					if not skip[o.Name] then
						local s = o.AbsoluteSize
						if okNm[o.Name] or s.X >= 120 or s.Y >= 28 then
							local pr = (o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and "ImageTransparency"
								or "BackgroundTransparency"
							if base.pan[o] == nil then
								base.pan[o] = { pr, o[pr] }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			base.got = true
		end
		local radVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		radVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiRound) == "table" and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiRound.value or 0, 0, 18)
			or 0
		local panVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		panVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiAlpha) == "table"
				and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiAlpha.value or 0, 0, 0.35)
			or 0
		local stkVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		stkVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiStroke) == "table"
				and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiStroke.value or 1, 0, 2.5)
			or 1
		local dimVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
		dimVal.Value = type(settingsConfig.UiDim) == "table" and math.clamp(settingsConfig.UiDim.value or 0.28, 0, 0.65)
			or 0.28
		local dimDesiredVisible = false
		local dimDesiredTransparency = 1
		local dimGuardBusy = false
		local function applyDimState(force)
			if dimGuardBusy then
				return
			end
			dimGuardBusy = true
			pcall(function()
				if force or dimFr.Visible ~= dimDesiredVisible then
					dimFr.Visible = dimDesiredVisible
				end
				if force or math.abs(dimFr.BackgroundTransparency - dimDesiredTransparency) > 0.001 then
					dimFr.BackgroundTransparency = dimDesiredTransparency
				end
				dimFr.Active = false
				if force or dimFr.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.new(0, 0, 0) then
					dimFr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
			end)
			dimGuardBusy = false
		end
		local function syncDimLoop()
			NAlib.disconnect("DeltaCustom_DimGuard")
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaCustom_DimGuard",
				dimFr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					if not dimGuardBusy and dimFr.Visible ~= dimDesiredVisible then
						task.defer(applyDimState, false)
					end
				end)
			)
			NAlib.connect(
				"DeltaCustom_DimGuard",
				dimFr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency"):Connect(function()
					if
						not dimGuardBusy
						and math.abs(dimFr.BackgroundTransparency - dimDesiredTransparency) > 0.001
					then
						task.defer(applyDimState, false)
					end
				end)
			)
		end
		local function apRad()
			capUi()
			local v = math.floor(math.clamp(radVal.Value, 0, 18) + 0.5)
			for o, b in base.cor do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o.CornerRadius = UDim.new(b.Scale, math.max(b.Offset, v))
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function apPan()
			capUi()
			local a = math.clamp(panVal.Value, 0, 0.35)
			for o, b in base.pan do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o[b[1]] = math.clamp(b[2] + a, 0, 1)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function apStk()
			capUi()
			local m = math.clamp(stkVal.Value, 0, 2.5)
			for o, b in base.str do
				if o and o.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						o.Thickness = b * m
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function uiOpen()
			for _, n in sectionsList do
				local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
				if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") and fr.Visible then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function fxSync()
			local on = uiOpen()
			dimDesiredVisible = on and dimVal.Value > 0.01
			dimDesiredTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(dimVal.Value, 0, 0.85)
			applyDimState(true)
			syncDimLoop()
		end
		capUi()
		apRad()
		apPan()
		apStk()
		fxSync()
		radVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apRad()
			saveCfg("UiRound", { value = math.clamp(radVal.Value, 0, 18) })
		end)
		panVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apPan()
			saveCfg("UiAlpha", { value = math.clamp(panVal.Value, 0, 0.35) })
		end)
		stkVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			apStk()
			saveCfg("UiStroke", { value = math.clamp(stkVal.Value, 0, 2.5) })
		end)
		dimVal.Changed:Connect(function()
			fxSync()
			saveCfg("UiDim", { value = math.clamp(dimVal.Value, 0, 0.65) })
		end)
		for _, n in sectionsList do
			local fr = mainGui:FindFirstChild(n)
			if fr and fr.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
				fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(fxSync)
				end)
			end
		end
		local settings = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		local template
		if holder then
			for _, c in holder:GetChildren() do
				if c:IsA("Frame") and c.Name == "Button" then
					template = c
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if holder and template then
			local function mkDock(fr)
				local d = Instance.new("Frame")
				d.Name = "Dock"
				d.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
				d.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0)
				d.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 18)
				d.Parent = fr
				local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
				l.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
				l.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
				l.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
				l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
				l.Parent = d
				return d
			end
			local function mkBox(par)
				local b = Instance.new("TextBox")
				b.Name = "ValueBox"
				b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 18)
				b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0
				b.ClearTextOnFocus = false
				b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
				b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
				b.TextSize = 12
				b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				b.Parent = par
				return b
			end
			local function mkSl(par, w)
				local s = Instance.new("Frame")
				s.Name = "Slider"
				s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				s.Size = UDim2.new(0, w or 150, 0, 18)
				s.Parent = par
				local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
				bar.Name = "Bar"
				bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
				bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
				bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
				bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
				bar.Parent = s
				local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
				bc.Parent = bar
				local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
				fill.Name = "Fill"
				fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
				fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				fill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
				fill.Parent = bar
				local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
				fc.Parent = fill
				local kb = Instance.new("Frame")
				kb.Name = "Knob"
				kb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
				kb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				kb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				kb.BorderSizePixel = 0
				kb.Parent = bar
				local kc = Instance.new("UICorner")
				kc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				kc.Parent = kb
				return s, bar, fill, kb
			end
			local function makeSizeSlider(id, titleText, descText, numValue, minV, maxV)
				local fr = __dcm_registerCustom(template:Clone())
				fr.Parent = holder
				fr.Visible = true
				fr.LayoutOrder = -2
				local tl = fr:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
				local dl = fr:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
				if tl then
					tl.Text = titleText
				end
				if dl then
					dl.Text = descText
				end
				local ob = fr:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
				if ob then
					ob:Destroy()
				end
				local dock = mkDock(fr)
				local vb = mkBox(dock)
				local sl, bar, fill, kb = mkSl(dock, 150)
				local function setVis(v)
					v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
					local a = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
					fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
					kb.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
					vb.Text = string.format("%.2f", v)
				end
				local function apply(v)
					v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
					numValue.Value = v
					setVis(v)
					saveCfg(id, { value = v })
				end
				setVis(numValue.Value)
				local drag = false
				local function fromIn(input)
					local rel = 0
					pcall(function()
						rel = (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X
					end)
					rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
					apply(minV + (maxV - minV) * rel)
				end
				bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						drag = true
						fromIn(input)
					end
				end)
				local ui = S("UserInputService")
				if ui then
					ui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
						if
							drag
							and (
								input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
								or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
							)
						then
							fromIn(input)
						end
					end)
					ui.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
						if
							input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
							or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
						then
							drag = false
						end
					end)
				end
				vb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local v = tonumber(vb.Text or "")
					if v then
						apply(v)
					else
						setVis(numValue.Value)
					end
				end)
				local function updDock()
					local w = math.clamp(math.floor(fr.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.46), 240, 380)
					dock.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 18)
					local sw = math.clamp(w - 78, 140, 280)
					sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, sw, 0, 18)
				end
				updDock()
				fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
					task.defer(updDock)
				end)
			end
			makeSizeSlider("UiRound", "UI roundness", "Adds extra roundness to panels and cards", radVal, 0, 18)
			makeSizeSlider(
				"UiAlpha",
				"Panel transparency",
				"Makes the heavy panels cleaner and less chunky",
				panVal,
				0,
				0.35
			)
			makeSizeSlider("UiStroke", "Stroke scale", "Scales borders and outlines across Delta", stkVal, 0, 2.5)
			makeSizeSlider("UiDim", "Open dim", "Darkens the game behind Delta while it is open", dimVal, 0, 0.65)
		end
	end)
end


end

do
local __lt = __lt

if (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor() or ""):lower() ~= "delta" then
	return
end

local env = __dcm_env
if type(env) ~= "table" then
	return
end

if env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch and type(env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch.stop) == "function" then
	pcall(env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch.stop)
end

local ref = cloneref and type(cloneref) == "function" and cloneref or function(v)
	return v
end

local srv = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(t, k)
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return __lt.cs(k, ref)
		end)
		if ok and v then
			rawset(t, k, v)
			return v
		end
	end,
})

local function S(n)
	return srv[n]
end

local UIS = S("UserInputService")
local TS = S("TweenService")
local RS = S("RunService")
local SS = S("SoundService")
local HS = S("HttpService")
local CG = S("CoreGui")

local root = gethui and gethui() or CG
local rq = request or http_request or syn and syn.request

local st = {
	con = {},
	pg = {},
	snd = nil,
	muted = {},
	gui = nil,
	fn = {},
}

local function con(c)
	if c then
		st.con[#st.con + 1] = c
	end
	return c
end

local function disc()
	for _, c in st.con do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	st.con = {}
end

local function stop()
	disc()
	if st.snd then
		pcall(function()
			st.snd:Destroy()
		end)
		st.snd = nil
	end
	if st.pg.music then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.music:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	if st.pg.musicButton then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.musicButton:Destroy()
		end)
		st.pg.musicButton = nil
	end
	if st.pg.sh and st.pg.sh:FindFirstChild("LT_ScriptHub") then
		pcall(function()
			st.pg.sh.LT_ScriptHub:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	for o, v in st.muted do
		if o and o.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				o.Visible = v
			end)
		end
	end
	st.muted = {}
	env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch = nil
end

env.__DeltaHubMusicPatch = {
	stop = stop,
}

local function trim(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then
		return ""
	end
	return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

local function isg(s)
	if typeof(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not s:match("^[%w _%-]+$")
end

local function getMain()
	for _, g in root:GetChildren() do
		if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and isg(g.Name) then
			if
				g:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
				and g:FindFirstChild("Scripthub", true)
				and g:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
			then
				return g
			end
		end
	end
end

local gui = getMain()
if not gui then
	return
end
st.gui = gui

local sb = gui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
local sh = gui:FindFirstChild("Scripthub")
local ex = gui:FindFirstChild("Executor")
local hm = gui:FindFirstChild("Home")
local se = gui:FindFirstChild("Settings")
local co = gui:FindFirstChild("Console")

if not (sb and sh) then
	return
end

st.pg.sh = sh

local sec = {
	"Executor",
	"Home",
	"Scripthub",
	"Settings",
	"Console",
	"Music",
}

local musicState = {
	openPos = UDim2.new(0.476246715, 0, 0.508232415, 0),
	closedPos = UDim2.new(0.400000006, 0, 0.508232415, 0),
	frame = nil,
	button = nil,
	tween = nil,
	activeTab = nil,
	icon = {
		sheetUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/main/NAimages/sheet.png",
		sheetAsset = nil,
		rectOffset = Vector2.new(371, 806),
		rectSize = Vector2.new(23, 33),
	},
}
local syncTabColors
local function tweenMusic(toPos, show, hideAfter)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if musicState.tween then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.tween:Cancel()
		end)
		musicState.tween = nil
	end
	if show then
		musicState.frame.Visible = true
	end
	if TS then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.frame.Position
		musicState.tween =
			TS:Create(musicState.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Position = toPos,
			})
		if hideAfter then
			con(musicState.tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if musicState.frame then
					musicState.frame.Visible = false
				end
			end))
		end
		musicState.tween:Play()
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = toPos
		if hideAfter then
			musicState.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function openMusic()
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = "Music"
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p ~= musicState.frame then
			p.Visible = false
		end
	end
	musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
	tweenMusic(musicState.openPos, true, false)
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors("Music")
	end)
end

local function closeMusic(anim)
	if not musicState.frame then
		return
	end
	if not musicState.frame.Visible then
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		return
	end
	if anim then
		tweenMusic(musicState.closedPos, false, true)
	else
		musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
	end
end

local function hideAll(exn)
	if exn == "Music" then
		musicState.activeTab = "Music"
		openMusic()
		return
	end
	musicState.activeTab = exn
	closeMusic(true)
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and n ~= "Music" then
			p.Visible = n == exn
		end
	end
	task.defer(function()
		syncTabColors(exn)
	end)
end

local function txtOf(o)
	for _, d in o:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			return d
		end
	end
end

local function gbtn(nm)
	for _, d in sb:QueryDescendants("GuiButton") do
		if d.Name == nm then			return d
		end
	end
end

local sidebarRefs = {
	home = gbtn("Home"),
	scripthub = gbtn("Scripthub"),
	settings = gbtn("Settings"),
	executor = gbtn("Executor"),
	console = gbtn("Console"),
	toggle = gbtn("ToggleUI"),
	activeColor = sb:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor"),
	inactiveColor = sb:FindFirstChild("InactiveColor"),
}

local function imgOf(btn)
	if not btn then
		return nil
	end
	return btn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
end

local function improveSidebarTouch(btn)
	if not (btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") and UIS and UIS.TouchEnabled) then
		return btn
	end
	if btn:GetAttribute("LT_TouchSized") then
		return btn
	end
	btn:SetAttribute("LT_TouchSized", true)
	pcall(function()
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(btn.Size.X.Scale, btn.Size.X.Offset + 8, btn.Size.Y.Scale, btn.Size.Y.Offset + 14)
	end)
	return btn
end

local offBg = sidebarRefs.scripthub and sidebarRefs.scripthub.BackgroundColor3 or Color3.fromRGB(41, 45, 58)
local offImg = imgOf(sidebarRefs.scripthub) and imgOf(sidebarRefs.scripthub).ImageColor3
	or Color3.fromRGB(138, 145, 164)
local onImg = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.home)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.scripthub)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.settings)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.executor)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.console)
improveSidebarTouch(sidebarRefs.toggle)

local function bgOn()
	return sidebarRefs.activeColor and sidebarRefs.activeColor.Value or col.ac
end

local function bgOff()
	return sidebarRefs.inactiveColor and sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Value or offBg
end

local function applyBtnState(btn, on)
	if not btn then
		return
	end
	local targetBg = on and bgOn() or bgOff()
	local targetImg = on and onImg or offImg
	local img = imgOf(btn)
	if TS then
		pcall(function()
			TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				BackgroundColor3 = targetBg,
			}):Play()
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				TS:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					ImageColor3 = targetImg,
				}):Play()
			end)
		end
	else
		pcall(function()
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = targetBg
		end)
		if img then
			pcall(function()
				img.ImageColor3 = targetImg
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function visibleTab()
	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.Visible then
			return n
		end
	end
end

function syncTabColors(forceTab)
	local curTab = forceTab or visibleTab()
	local map = {
		Home = sidebarRefs.home,
		Executor = sidebarRefs.executor,
		Scripthub = sidebarRefs.scripthub,
		Settings = sidebarRefs.settings,
		Console = sidebarRefs.console,
		Music = musicState.button,
	}
	for n, b in map do
		applyBtnState(b, curTab == n)
	end
end

local function muteObj(d)
	if not (d and d:IsA("GuiObject")) then
		return
	end
	local keep = false
	if d == sh then
		keep = true
	elseif d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
		keep = true
	end
	if keep then
		return
	end
	if st.muted[d] == nil then
		st.muted[d] = d.Visible
	end
	local master = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime")
	if type(master) == "table" and type(master.setTracked) == "function" then
		master.setTracked(d, "Visible", false)
	else
		pcall(function()
			d.Visible = false
		end)
	end
	if d.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
		con(d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if d.Parent and not d:FindFirstAncestor("LT_ScriptHub") then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end))
	end
end

local function muteSh()
	for _, d in sh:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
		muteObj(d)
	end
end

local col = {
	bg = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26),
	bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 33, 40),
	cd = Color3.fromRGB(26, 29, 36),
	st = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85),

	td = Color3.fromRGB(186, 192, 205),
	su = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153),
	wa = Color3.fromRGB(255, 179, 71),
	er = Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94),

local function mk(class, props, kids)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in props or {} do
		o[k] = v
	end
	for _, c in kids or {} do
		c.Parent = o
	end
	return o
end

local function req(u)
	local body
	local status = 0
	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			},
		})
		if ok and r then
			body = r.Body or r.body
			status = r.StatusCode or r.Status or r.status_code or 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		local ok2, r2 = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(u)
		end)
		if ok2 and type(r2) == "string" and r2 ~= "" then
			body = r2
			status = 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil, status
	end
	local ok3, dec = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", body)
	end)
	if ok3 then
		return dec, status
	end
	return nil, status
end

local SCRIPTBLOX_BASE = "https://scriptblox.com"
local RSCRIPTS_BASE = "https://rscripts.net"
local HAXHELL_BASE = "https://haxhell.com"
local IMAGE_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/ScriptHubImages"
local MUSIC_CACHE_DIR = "DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic"
local MUSIC_CFG_PATH = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/_config.json"
local MUSIC_EXTS = {
	mp3 = true,
	ogg = true,
	flac = true,
	wav = true,
}
local musicCfg = {}

local function sanitizeFileName(str)
	return tostring(str or ""):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
end

local function hashString(str)
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #str do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(str, i)) % 4294967296
	end
	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function clearImageCache()
	if
		type(isfolder) ~= "function"
		or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or type(delfile) ~= "function"
	then
		return false
	end
	local okExists, exists = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okExists or not exists then
		return false
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" then
			pcall(delfile, path)
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ensureImageFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function ensureMusicFolder()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, ex = pcall(isfolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if ok and ex then
		return true
	end
	return pcall(makefolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR) == true
end

local function getAudioExt(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local clean = path:match("([^?#]+)") or path
	local ext = clean:match("%.([%w]+)$")
	if not ext then
		return nil
	end
	ext = ext:lower()
	return MUSIC_EXTS[ext] and ext or nil
end

local function normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	t = t:gsub(
		"^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$",
		"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%1/%2/%3/%4"
	)
	return t
end

local function deriveAudioFileName(url, ext)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "track"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", ""))
	base = base ~= "" and base or "track"
	return string.format("%s_%s.%s", base, hashString(url), ext)
end

local function resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		return nil
	end
	local okAsset, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadMusicCfg()
	if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH) then
		local ok, data = pcall(readfile, MUSIC_CFG_PATH)
		if ok and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
			local okDec, dec = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
			end)
			if okDec and type(dec) == "table" then
				musicCfg = dec
				return
			end
		end
	end
	musicCfg = {}
end

local function saveMusicCfg()
	if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function" and ensureMusicFolder()) then
		return false
	end
	return writeJsonFile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH, musicCfg)
end

local function scanMusicFiles()
	local list = {}
	if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not ensureMusicFolder() then
		return list
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return list
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" then
			local ext = getAudioExt(path)
			if ext then
				local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
				list[#list + 1] = {
					path = path,
					name = name,
					asset = resolveMusicAsset(path),
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or ""):lower() < (b.name or ""):lower()
	end)
	return list
end

local function findLocalMusicEntry(query)
	query = trim(query)
	if query == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local lower = query:lower()
	for _, item in scanMusicFiles() do
		local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
		local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
		if lower == nm or lower == base then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local httpGetBinary
local function downloadMusicAsset(url)
	if
		type(getcustomasset) ~= "function"
		or type(writefile) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or not ensureMusicFolder()
	then
		return nil, "Custom music requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local norm = normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	local ext = getAudioExt(norm)
	if not norm or not ext then
		return nil, "Unsupported audio format. Use mp3, ogg, flac, or wav."
	end
	local full = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveAudioFileName(norm, ext)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local data = httpGetBinary(norm)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil, "Failed to download audio."
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil, "Failed to save audio."
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return nil, "Failed to load audio asset."
	end
	return {
		asset = asset,
		name = full:match("([^/\\]+)$") or full,
		path = full,
	}, nil
end

loadMusicCfg()

local function deriveImageFileName(url)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "image"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:match("(.+)%.") or name)
	return string.format("%s_%s.bin", base ~= "" and base or "image", hashString(url))
end

clearImageCache()

local function normalizeImageUrl(url, base)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^rbxassetid://") or t:match("^rbxthumb://") then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^https?://") then
		return t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 2) == "//" then
		return "https:" .. t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return (base or "") .. t
	end
	return base and (base .. "/" .. t) or t
end

local function isMeaningfulImageUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not url:lower():find("no%-script")
end

function httpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end

local function downloadImageAsset(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if not ensureImageFolder() then
		return nil
	end
	local full = IMAGE_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveImageFileName(url)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
		local hdr
		if host:find("rscripts%.net") then
			hdr = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif host:find("robloxscripts%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif host:find("haxhell%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		elseif host:find("rbxcdn%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://www.roblox.com/" }
		end
		local data = httpGetBinary(url, hdr)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, SCRIPTBLOX_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.coverImage,
		d.icon,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.coverImage,
		d.game and d.game.icon,
	})
end

local function resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, RSCRIPTS_BASE)
			if n then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.cover,
		d.banner,
		d.img,
		d.game and d.game.imgurl,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.cover,
		d.game and d.game.banner,
		d.game and d.game.gameLogo,
	})
end

local function resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local media = type(d.media) == "table" and d.media or {}
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or {}
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, HAXHELL_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		media.thumbnailUrl,
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		gameData.thumbnailUrl,
		gameData.iconUrl,
		gameData.imageUrl,
		gameData.image,
	})
end

local function buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	local id = tostring(placeId or "")
	if id == "" or id == "0" then
		return nil
	end
	return "https://www.roblox.com/Thumbs/PlaceThumbnail.ashx?width=420&height=270&format=png&placeId=" .. id
end

local function toast(a, b)
	if type(env.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(env.Notify, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
		return
	end
	if type(env.nt) == "function" then
		pcall(env.nt, {
			Title = a,
			Description = b,
			Duration = 4,
		})
	end
end

local eng = "RScripts"
local flt = "all"
local cur = 1
local maxp = 1
local q = ""
local tr = false
local busy = false
local data = {}

local function pass(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	if flt == "all" then
		return true
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		return not k
	else
		return k
	end
end

local function shClr()
	for _, c in list:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function shMsg(t, c3)
	local lb = mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),

		TextColor3 = c3 or col.td,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 14,
		Parent = list,
	})
	return lb
end

	return mk("TextButton", {

		}),
	})
end

local function getRw(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", true
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		local source = d.script or ""
		if source ~= "" then
			return source, false
		end
		local url = d.rawScriptUrl or d.scriptLink or d.raw or ""
		return url, url ~= ""
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local links = type(d.links) == "table" and d.links or {}
		local sourceData = type(d.source) == "table" and d.source or {}
		local source = links.raw or sourceData.rawUrl or sourceData.code or d.rawScriptUrl or d.script or ""
		return source, type(source) == "string" and source:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	end
	return d.script or d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", false
end

local function getTi(d)
	return d.title or d.name or "Untitled Script"
end

local function getGa(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.game and d.game.title or "Unknown Game"
	end
	return d.game and d.game.name or "Unknown Game"
end

local function keyReq(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	return k
end

local function getInfo(d)
	local stats = type(d.stats) == "table" and d.stats or {}
	local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
	local v = tostring(d.views or d.viewCount or stats.views or 0)
	local l = tostring(d.likes or d.likeCount or stats.likes or 0)
	local k = keyReq(d) and "Key" or "Keyless"
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		local access = d.accessType:lower()
		if access == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		elseif access == "free" then
			k = "Free"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and flags.isPaid == true then
		k = "Paid"
	end
	local s = eng == "RobloxScripts" and "Published" or (d.isPatched == true or flags.patched == true) and "Patched" or "Working"
	local info = string.format("%s | Views %s | Likes %s | %s", k, v, l, s)
	if eng == "RScripts" and d.discord and d.discord ~= "" then
		info = info .. " | Discord"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and d.author and d.author.verified == true then
		info = info .. " | Verified"
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local verified = flags.verified == true or type(d.author) == "table" and d.author.isScripterVerified == true
		if verified then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if flags.mobileSupported == true then
			info = info .. " | Mobile"
		end
	end
	return info
end

local function mkCard(par, i, d)
	local rw, rwIsUrl = getRw(d)
	local placeId
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.gameId
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		placeId = d.game and (d.game.placeId or d.game.gameLink and d.game.gameLink:match("/games/(%d+)"))
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.placeId or d.placeId
	end
	placeId = tonumber(placeId)

	local bgUrl
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		bgUrl = resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		bgUrl = resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		bgUrl = resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	else
		local candidates = {
			d.image,
			d.imageUrl,
			d.thumbnail,
			d.game and d.game.iconUrl,
			d.game and d.game.image,
		}
		for _, value in candidates do
			local normalized = normalizeImageUrl(value, "https://robloxscripts.com")
			if normalized and isMeaningfulImageUrl(normalized) then
				bgUrl = normalized
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not bgUrl and placeId then
		bgUrl = buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	end
	local bgAsset = bgUrl and downloadImageAsset(bgUrl) or nil
	local bgImg = bgAsset or bgUrl

	local cd = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Card" .. tostring(i),
		BackgroundColor3 = col.cd,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.333333343, -7, 1, 0),
		LayoutOrder = i,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = par,
	}, {
		mk("UICorner", {
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
		mk("UIStroke", {
			Color = col.st,
			Transparency = 0.35,
		}),
	})

	if bgImg then
		mk("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Cover",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Image = bgImg,
			ImageTransparency = 0.1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 0,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
		})
		mk("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 1,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
			mk("UIGradient", {
				Rotation = 90,
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45),
				}),
			}),
		})
	end

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = col.tx,
		Text = getTi(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 30),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = col.ac,
		Text = getGa(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50),
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = col.td,
		Text = getInfo(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	local row = mk("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -36),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	}, {
		mk("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		}),
	})

	local run = mkb(row, "Run", col.su)
	run.ZIndex = 3
	local cp = setclipboard and mkb(row, "Copy", Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75)) or nil
	if cp then
		cp.ZIndex = 3
	end
	local dc = eng == "RScripts"
			and d.discord
			and d.discord ~= ""
			and setclipboard
			and mkb(row, "Discord", Color3.fromRGB(28, 116, 224))
		or nil
	if dc then
		dc.ZIndex = 3
	end

	con(run.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local ok, er = pcall(function()
			local ld = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
			if type(ld) ~= "function" then
				error("loadstring unavailable")
			end
			local src = rw
			if rwIsUrl then
				local headers
				if eng == "RScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
				elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
				elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
					headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
				end
				local got, gotEr = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				if type(got) ~= "string" or got == "" then
					error(gotEr or "empty script source")
				end
				src = got
			end
			if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
				error("script source must be a string, got " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(src) or type(src)))
			end
			local fn, cer = ld(src, "@ScriptHubEntry")
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then
				error(cer or "compile failed")
			end
			if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
				pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, fn, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
			end
			fn()
		end)
		if ok then
			toast("ScriptHub", "Executed script.")
		else
			toast("ScriptHub", tostring(er))
		end
	end))

	if cp then
		con(cp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				local src = rw
				if rwIsUrl then
					local headers
					if eng == "RScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
					elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
					elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
						headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
					end
					src = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				end
				if type(src) == "string" and src ~= "" then
					setclipboard(src)
				end
			end)
			cp.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if cp and cp.Parent then
					cp.Text = "Copy"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end

	if dc then
		con(dc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				setclipboard(d.discord)
			end)
			dc.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if dc and dc.Parent then
					dc.Text = "Discord"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end
end

local function ren()
	shClr()
	pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
	if not data or #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local row
	local coln = 0
	for _, d in data do
		if pass(d) then
			if not row or coln >= 3 then
				row = mkRow()
				coln = 0
			end
			n += 1
			coln += 1
			mkCard(row, n, d)
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then
		if flt == "keyless" then
			shMsg("No keyless scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		elseif flt == "key" then
			shMsg("No key-required scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		else
			shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		end
	end
end

local function setBusy(v)
	busy = v and true or false
	gob.Active = not busy
	prev.Active = not busy
	nextb.Active = not busy
	gob.Text = busy and "Loading" or "Search"
end

local function fetch(q2, tr2, p2)
	if busy then
		return
	end
	clearImageCache()
	q2 = trim(q2 or "")
	tr2 = eng == "ScriptBlox" and tr2 == true or false
	p2 = math.max(tonumber(p2) or 1, 1)
	q = q2
	tr = tr2
	cur = p2
	maxp = 1
	data = {}
	setBusy(true)
	shClr()
	shMsg("Loading...", col.td)
	local requestQuery = q2
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and #requestQuery > 100 then
		requestQuery = requestQuery:sub(1, 100)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and requestQuery ~= "" and #requestQuery < 2 then
		shClr()
		shMsg("HaxHell search requires at least 2 characters", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local enc = __lt.cm("HttpService", "UrlEncode", requestQuery)
	local u
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		u = string.format("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?page=%d&orderBy=date&sort=desc", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		p2 = math.min(p2, 200)
		cur = p2
		u = string.format("https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=newest", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/search/scripts?q=%s&page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif tr2 then
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=%d", p2)
	else
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=%s&page=%d", enc, p2)
	end
	local dec, status = req(u)
	shClr()
	if status == 429 then
		shMsg("Rate limit reached. Try again shortly", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status == 503 then
		shMsg("API temporarily unavailable", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status ~= 0 and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
		shMsg("Request failed (" .. tostring(status) .. ")", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif not dec then
		shMsg("Request failed", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local arr
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		arr = dec.scripts
		maxp = math.max(dec.info and dec.info.maxPages or 1, 1)
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		maxp = math.min(math.max(pages or 1, 1), 200)
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
		if not pages then
			pages = pg.hasMore == true and (cur + 1) or cur
		end
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
	else
		local r = dec.result or {}
		arr = r.scripts
		maxp = math.max(r.totalPages or 1, 1)
	end
	data = arr or {}
	if #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	ren()
	setBusy(false)
end

	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		eng = "RScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 58)

	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		eng = "RobloxScripts"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 52, 68)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (robloxscripts.com)"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		eng = "HaxHell"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 42, 74)
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (haxhell.com)"
	else
		eng = "ScriptBlox"
		engb.BackgroundColor3 = col.bg
		sbox.PlaceholderText = "Search for scripts (scriptblox.com)"
	end

end))

local function buildMusicTab()
	musicState.frame = gui:FindFirstChild("Music")
	if musicState.frame then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	local tpl = sh or hm or se or ex or co
	if tpl and tpl:IsA("GuiObject") then
		musicState.frame = tpl:Clone()
		musicState.frame.Name = "Music"
		musicState.frame.Visible = false
		musicState.frame.Parent = gui
		pcall(function()
			musicState.frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			musicState.frame.Position = musicState.closedPos
			musicState.frame.Size = sh.Size
			musicState.frame.ZIndex = sh.ZIndex
		end)
		for _, d in musicState.frame:QueryDescendants("Instance") do
			if d:IsA("LocalScript") then
				d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") and d ~= musicState.frame then
				pcall(function()
					d.Visible = false
				end)
			end
		end
	else
		musicState.frame = mk("Frame", {
			Name = "Music",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = musicState.closedPos,
			Size = sh and sh.Size or UDim2.new(0.848344803, 0, 0.892481446, 0),
			Visible = false,
			Parent = gui,
			ZIndex = sh and sh.ZIndex or 100,
		})
	end

	st.pg.music = musicState.frame

	local localPicker
	local function relayoutMusic(extra)
		extra = math.max(0, tonumber(extra) or 0)
		inputCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, inputBaseHeight + extra)
		controlCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, controlBaseY + extra)
		mixCard.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, mixBaseY + extra)
		mr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, canvasBaseHeight + extra)
	end

	local function syncLocalPicker(raw)
		if not localPicker then
			return
		end
		local entry = raw and findLocalMusicEntry(raw) or nil
		if entry and entry.name then
			localPicker.setText(entry.name)
		else
			localPicker.setText("")
		end
	end

	local savedVol = tonumber(musicCfg.volume)
	if savedVol and savedVol >= 0 and savedVol <= 1 then
		savedVol *= 10
	end
	local vl = math.clamp(savedVol or 1, 0, 10)
	local spd = math.clamp(tonumber(musicCfg.playbackSpeed) or 1, 0.5, 2)
	local mixSaveStamp = 0
	local mixReady = false
	local function queueMixSave()
		if not mixReady then
			return
		end
		mixSaveStamp += 1
		local cur = mixSaveStamp
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if cur ~= mixSaveStamp then
				return
			end
			musicCfg.volume = vl
			musicCfg.playbackSpeed = spd
			saveMusicCfg()
		end)
	end
	local function formatTime(sec)
		sec = tonumber(sec) or 0
		if sec < 0 or sec ~= sec or sec == math.huge then
			sec = 0
		end
		local total = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
		local m = math.floor(total / 60)
		local s = total % 60
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", m, s)
	end

	local function setStatusText(text, accent)
		stat.Text = text
		heroStatus.Text = string.upper(text)
		if accent then
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 250)
		else
			heroStatus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 42)
			heroStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(199, 208, 221)
		end
	end

	local function setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
		alpha = math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
		pfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		pkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		progressInfo.Text = string.format("%s / %s", formatTime(pos or 0), formatTime(len or 0))
	end

	local function syncLoopButton()
		local on = st.snd and st.snd.Looped
		loopb.Text = on and "Loop On" or "Loop Off"
		loopb.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
	end
	local function syncPauseButtons()
		local paused = st.musicPaused and st.snd ~= nil
		pauseb.Visible = not paused
		resumeb.Visible = paused
	end
	local function syncCycleButton()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "order" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Order"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 93, 73)
		elseif mode == "random" then
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Random"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 74, 112)
		else
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Off"
			cycleb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 61)
		end
	end
	local function getNextCycleTrack()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode ~= "order" and mode ~= "random" then
			return nil
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local currentRaw = trim(st.musicRaw or "")
		if currentRaw == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local currentLower = currentRaw:lower()
		local currentIndex
		for i, item in items do
			local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
			local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
			if currentLower == nm or currentLower == base then
				currentIndex = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not currentIndex then
			return nil
		end
		if mode == "random" then
			if #items == 1 then
				return items[1]
			end
			local idx = currentIndex
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				idx = math.random(1, #items)
				if idx ~= currentIndex then
					break
				end
			end
			if idx == currentIndex then
				idx = (currentIndex % #items) + 1
			end
			return items[idx]
		end
		return items[(currentIndex % #items) + 1]
	end

	local function apVol(v)
		vl = math.clamp(v, 0, 10)
		local alpha = vl / 10
		vfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		vkn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		vt.Text = string.format("Volume  %.2f", vl)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.Volume = vl
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	local function apSpeed(v)
		spd = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 2)
		local alpha = (spd - 0.5) / 1.5
		sfill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		skn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		spLabel.Text = string.format("Playback speed  %.2fx", spd)
		if st.snd then
			st.snd.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	apVol(vl)
	apSpeed(spd)
	st.musicPaused = false
	st.musicCycleMode = st.musicCycleMode or "off"
	mixReady = true
	setStatusText("Stopped")
	setProgress(0, 0, 0)
	relayoutMusic(0)
	syncPauseButtons()
	syncCycleButton()

	local dragging = false
	local speedDragging = false
	local progressDragging = false

	local function setBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - vbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(vbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apVol(math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 10)
	end

	local function setSpeedBar(inp)
		local x = (inp.Position.X - sbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(sbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		apSpeed(0.5 + math.clamp(x, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	end

	local function setProgressBar(inp)
		if not (st.snd and st.snd.TimeLength and st.snd.TimeLength > 0) then
			return
		end
		local x = (inp.Position.X - pbar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(pbar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
		x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
		local len = st.snd.TimeLength
		local pos = len * x
		pcall(function()
			st.snd.TimePosition = pos
		end)
		setProgress(x, pos, len)
	end

	con(vbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			setBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(sbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			speedDragging = true
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(pbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			progressDragging = true
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if
			dragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setBar(inp)
		end
		if
			speedDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setSpeedBar(inp)
		end
		if
			progressDragging
			and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
		then
			setProgressBar(inp)
		end
	end))

	con(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
			speedDragging = false
			progressDragging = false
		end
	end))

	if RS then
		con(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local snd = st.snd
			if not snd then
				return
			end
			local len = snd.TimeLength or 0
			local pos = snd.TimePosition or 0
			local alpha = 0
			if len > 0 then
				alpha = math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1)
			end
			if not progressDragging then
				setProgress(alpha, pos, len)
			end
		end))
	end

	local function getId(t)
		t = trim(t)
		if t == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local n = t:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or t:match("id=(%d+)") or t:match("^(%d+)$")
		if n then
			return "rbxassetid://" .. n, n
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function mkSnd(id, raw)
		if st.snd then
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.Name = "LT_MusicSound"
		s.SoundId = id
		s.Volume = vl
		s.Looped = false
		s.PlaybackSpeed = spd
		s.Parent = gui
		local function clearSoundGroup()
			if not (s and s.Parent) then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if s.SoundGroup ~= nil then
					s.SoundGroup = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		clearSoundGroup()
		st.snd = s
		st.musicPaused = false
		st.musicRaw = tostring(raw)
		now.Text = tostring(raw)
		assetChip.Text = tostring(raw)
		setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
		setProgress(0, 0, 0)
		syncLoopButton()
		syncPauseButtons()
		con(s.Loaded:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(53, 83, 125))
			setProgress(0, s.TimePosition or 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Ended:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Ended", Color3.fromRGB(88, 64, 48))
			syncPauseButtons()
			local nextTrack = getNextCycleTrack()
			if nextTrack and nextTrack.asset then
				task.defer(function()
					if st.snd ~= s then
						return
					end
					mb.Text = nextTrack.name or ""
					mkSnd(nextTrack.asset, nextTrack.name)
					syncLocalPicker(nextTrack.name)
					if st.snd then
						pcall(function()
							st.snd:Play()
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
		end))
		con(s.Played:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Playing", Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Paused:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = true
			setStatusText("Paused", Color3.fromRGB(92, 105, 123))
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s.Stopped:Connect(function()
			if st.snd ~= s then
				return
			end
			st.musicPaused = false
			setStatusText("Stopped")
			setProgress(0, 0, s.TimeLength or 0)
			syncPauseButtons()
		end))
		con(s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundGroup"):Connect(function()
			task.defer(clearSoundGroup)
		end))
	end

	local function resolveTrackInput(text)
		local q = trim(text)
		if q == "" then
			return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
		end
		local localEntry = findLocalMusicEntry(q)
		if localEntry and localEntry.asset then
			return localEntry.asset, localEntry.name
		end
		local sid, raw = getId(q)
		if sid then
			return sid, raw
		end
		if q:match("^https?://") or q:match("^www%.") then
			local entry, err = downloadMusicAsset(q:match("^www%.") and ("https://" .. q) or q)
			if not entry then
				return nil, nil, err or "Failed to download audio."
			end
			return entry.asset, entry.name
		end
		if getAudioExt(q) then
			return nil, nil, "Local track not found in DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic."
		end
		return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
	end

	local loadCurrentTrack
	localPicker = makeMusicFolderDropdown(inputCard, 74, 53, function(item)
		mb.Text = item.name or ""
		task.defer(function()
			if loadCurrentTrack then
				loadCurrentTrack()
			end
		end)
	end, function(open, menuHeight)
		relayoutMusic(open and (menuHeight + 10) or 0)
	end)

	function loadCurrentTrack()
		if localPicker then
			localPicker.close()
		end
		local sid, raw, err = resolveTrackInput(mb.Text)
		if not sid then
			toast("Music", err or "Enter a valid track.")
			return false
		end
		mkSnd(sid, raw)
		syncLocalPicker(raw)
		toast("Music", "Loaded audio.")
		return true
	end

	con(loadb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(loadCurrentTrack))

	con(mb.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter then
			loadCurrentTrack()
		end
	end))

	con(playb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Play()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(pauseb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = true
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Pause()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(resumeb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			local ok = pcall(function()
				st.snd:Resume()
			end)
			if not ok then
				pcall(function()
					st.snd:Play()
				end)
			end
		end
	end))

	con(stopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if st.snd then
			st.musicPaused = false
			syncPauseButtons()
			pcall(function()
				st.snd:Stop()
			end)
		end
	end))

	con(loopb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not st.snd then
			return
		end
		st.snd.Looped = not st.snd.Looped
		syncLoopButton()
	end))
	con(cycleb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode == "off" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "order"
		elseif mode == "order" then
			st.musicCycleMode = "random"
		else
			st.musicCycleMode = "off"
		end
		syncCycleButton()
	end))
end

musicState.setupSidebar = function()
	musicState.icon.sheetAsset = downloadImageAsset(musicState.icon.sheetUrl)

	musicState.button = gbtn("Music")
	if musicState.button then
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	musicState.sourceButton = sidebarRefs.console
		or sidebarRefs.scripthub
		or sidebarRefs.home
		or sidebarRefs.settings
		or sidebarRefs.executor
	if musicState.sourceButton then
		musicState.button = musicState.sourceButton:Clone()
		musicState.button.Name = "Music"
		musicState.button.Parent = musicState.sourceButton.Parent
		st.pg.musicButton = musicState.button
		musicState.textLabel = txtOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.textLabel then
			musicState.textLabel.Text = "Music"
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle and sidebarRefs.toggle:IsA("GuiButton") then
				local to = sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 999
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button and d.LayoutOrder and d.LayoutOrder >= to then
						d.LayoutOrder += 1
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = to
			else
				local lo = 0
				for _, d in sb:GetChildren() do
					if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= musicState.button then
						lo = math.max(lo, d.LayoutOrder or 0)
					end
				end
				musicState.button.LayoutOrder = lo + 1
			end
		end)
		musicState.imageLabel = imgOf(musicState.button)
		if musicState.imageLabel then
			pcall(function()
				if musicState.icon.sheetAsset then
					musicState.imageLabel.Image = musicState.icon.sheetAsset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = musicState.icon.rectOffset
					musicState.imageLabel.ImageRectSize = musicState.icon.rectSize
					musicState.imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
				end
				musicState.imageLabel.ImageColor3 = offImg
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			musicState.button.BackgroundColor3 = bgOff()
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton = function()
		if not (musicState.button and sidebarRefs.toggle and musicState.button.Parent == sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent) then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			if sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") == nil then
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO", sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset)
				sidebarRefs.toggle:SetAttribute("LT_OrigLay", sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end
			local op = UDim2.new(
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosXO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.X.Offset,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYS") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Scale,
				sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigPosYO") or sidebarRefs.toggle.Position.Y.Offset
			)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = op
			local togLo = sidebarRefs.toggle:GetAttribute("LT_OrigLay") or sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder or 0
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo
			local above
			local ay = -math.huge
			local ty = op.Y.Scale + op.Y.Offset / 100000
			for _, d in sidebarRefs.toggle.Parent:GetChildren() do
				if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d ~= sidebarRefs.toggle and d ~= musicState.button then
					local py = d.Position.Y.Scale + d.Position.Y.Offset / 100000
					if py < ty and py > ay then
						ay = py
						above = d
					end
				end
			end
			local gapS = 0.11
			local gapO = 0
			if above then
				gapS = op.Y.Scale - above.Position.Y.Scale
				gapO = op.Y.Offset - above.Position.Y.Offset
			end
			musicState.button.Position = op
			musicState.button.LayoutOrder = togLo - 1
			sidebarRefs.toggle.Position = UDim2.new(op.X.Scale, op.X.Offset, op.Y.Scale + gapS, op.Y.Offset + gapO)
			sidebarRefs.toggle.LayoutOrder = togLo + 1
		end)
	end

	musicState.placeButton()

	musicState.bindHide = function(b, nm)
		improveSidebarTouch(b)
		if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") then
			con(b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				closeMusic(true)
				task.defer(function()
					syncTabColors(nm or b.Name)
				end)
			end))
		end
	end

	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.home, "Home")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.scripthub, "Scripthub")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.settings, "Settings")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.executor, "Executor")
	musicState.bindHide(sidebarRefs.console, "Console")

	improveSidebarTouch(musicState.button)
	if musicState.button and musicState.button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		con(musicState.button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			openMusic()
			task.defer(function()
				syncTabColors("Music")
			end)
		end))
	end

	for _, n in sec do
		local p = gui:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("GuiObject") and p.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			con(p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				task.defer(syncTabColors)
			end))
		end
	end

	if sidebarRefs.activeColor and sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.activeColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	if sidebarRefs.inactiveColor and sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed then
		con(sidebarRefs.inactiveColor.Changed:Connect(function()
			task.defer(syncTabColors)
		end))
	end

	task.defer(syncTabColors)
end

musicState.setupSidebar()
end
