end

function MG.NewRig(scene, o)
	o = o or {}
	local s = o.scale or 1
	local skin, shirt, pants = o.skin or C3(0.96, 0.8, 0.6), o.shirt or C3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8), o.pants or C3(0.15, 0.2, 0.3)
	local r = setmetatable({scene = scene, s = s, gun = nil, acc = {}}, Rig)
	r.torso = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(2, 2, 1) * s, shirt)
	r.head = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(1.2, 1.2, 1.2) * s, skin)
	r.armL = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(1, 2, 1) * s, o.sleeve or skin)
	r.armR = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(1, 2, 1) * s, o.sleeve or skin)
	r.legL = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(1, 2, 1) * s, pants)
	r.legR = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(1, 2, 1) * s, pants)
	r.parts = {r.torso, r.head, r.armL, r.armR, r.legL, r.legR}
	local hostOf = {head = r.head, torso = r.torso, armL = r.armL, armR = r.armR}
	r.hostOf = hostOf
	if o.face ~= false and o.kit ~= "balaclava" and o.kit ~= "knight" then
		pcall(function() new("Decal", r.head, {Texture = "rbxasset://textures/face.png", Face = Enum.NormalId.Front}) end)
	end
	if o.gun ~= false then
		r.gun = scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.3, 0.4, 1.6) * s, o.gunColor or C3(0.12, 0.12, 0.12))
		r.parts[#r.parts + 1] = r.gun
	end
	if o.kit and KITS[o.kit] then pcall(KITS[o.kit], r, o) end
	return r
end
-- pos = feet position. yaw faces forward. phase = walk cycle. amp = swing 0..1. aim = pitch for gun arms (nil = relaxed). crouch 0..1
-- extra: {armUp = true, fall = radians (death topple backwards)}
function Rig:Pose(pos, yaw, phase, amp, aim, crouch, extra)
	local s = self.s
	crouch = crouch or 0
	local base = CFrame.new(pos + V3(0, -crouch * 0.8 * s, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	if extra and extra.fall then base = base * CFrame.Angles(extra.fall, 0, 0) end
	local sw = math.sin(phase) * amp * 0.9
	local function limb(part, off, ang, len)
		part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(off * s) * CFrame.Angles(ang, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -len * 0.5 * s, 0)
	end
	limb(self.legL, V3(-0.5, 2, 0), sw, 2)
	limb(self.legR, V3(0.5, 2, 0), -sw, 2)
	self.torso.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 3 * s, 0)
	self.head.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 4.7 * s, 0)
	local armUp = extra and extra.armUp
	if armUp then
		limb(self.armR, V3(1.5, 4, 0), pi * 0.95, 2)
		limb(self.armL, V3(-1.5, 4, 0), -sw, 2)
	elseif aim ~= nil then
		local raise = pi / 2 + aim
		limb(self.armR, V3(1.5, 4, 0), raise, 2)
		limb(self.armL, V3(-1.5, 4, 0), raise - 0.2, 2)
	else
		limb(self.armR, V3(1.5, 4, 0), -sw, 2)
		limb(self.armL, V3(-1.5, 4, 0), sw, 2)
	end
	if self.gun then
		if aim ~= nil and not armUp then self.gun.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0.9 * s, 4 * s, -1.2 * s) * CFrame.Angles(aim, 0, 0)
		else self.gun.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(1.6 * s, 2.5 * s, -0.4 * s) end
	end
	local hostOf = self.hostOf
	local acc = self.acc
	for i = 1, #acc do
		local a = acc[i]
		a.p.CFrame = hostOf[a.host].CFrame * a.off
	end
end
function Rig:Tint(color) for i = 1, 2 do self.parts[i].Color = color end self.armL.Color = color self.armR.Color = color end
function Rig:Flash(color)
	if self._f then return end
	self._f = true
	local old = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(self.parts) do old[i] = p.Color p.Color = color end
	task.delay(0.08, function() for i, p in ipairs(self.parts) do if p.Parent and old[i] then p.Color = old[i] end end self._f = false end)
end
function Rig:SetVisible(v) for _, p in ipairs(self.parts) do p.Transparency = v and 0 or 1 end end
function Rig:Destroy() for _, p in ipairs(self.parts) do if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end end
Rig.Kits = KITS
MG.Rig = Rig

MG.UIRef = UI

-- ═════ INPUT: keyboard+mouse on PC, joystick + look pad + buttons on mobile, switches live ═════
local TOUCH_SLOTS = {{100, 112, 88}, {218, 96, 60}, {178, 196, 60}, {92, 230, 60}, {302, 58, 52}, {284, 168, 52}, {336, 130, 46}, {246, 262, 46}}
local SINK_KEYS = {"W", "A", "S", "D", "Up", "Down", "Left", "Right", "Space", "LeftShift", "LeftControl", "E", "Q", "R", "F", "G", "C", "V", "Z", "X", "T", "B", "H", "J", "K", "L", "U", "I", "O", "M", "N", "Y", "Tab", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine", "Zero", "P"}

local Input = {}
Input.__index = Input

local function keyLabel(a)
	local parts = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(a.keys or {}) do parts[#parts + 1] = k.Name end
	if a.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then parts[#parts + 1] = "LMB"
	elseif a.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then parts[#parts + 1] = "RMB"
	elseif a.mouse == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then parts[#parts + 1] = "MMB" end
	return table.concat(parts, " / ")
end

function MG.NewInput(ctx, root)
	local I = setmetatable({}, Input)
	I.ctx, I.root = ctx, root
	I.scheme, I.byKey, I.byMouse, I.held, I.pressed, I.keys = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	I.dx, I.dy, I.wheel = 0, 0, 0
	I.joy = V2(0, 0)
	I.mode = MG.DetectPlatform()
	I.lockMouse = true
	I.opts = {look = true, joystick = true, dpad = false, noMove = false}
	I.conns = {}
	I.touchGui = nil
	I.connsMade = false
	return I
end

function Input:SetScheme(list, opts)
	self.scheme, self.byKey, self.byMouse = {}, {}, {}
	for k, v in pairs(opts or {}) do self.opts[k] = v end
	for i, a in ipairs(list) do
		a.slot = a.slot or i
		self.scheme[#self.scheme + 1] = a
		for _, k in ipairs(a.keys or {}) do self.byKey[k] = a.id end
		if a.mouse then self.byMouse[a.mouse] = a.id end
	end
	self:Rebuild()
end

function Input:Press(id, on)
	if on then
		if not self.held[id] then self.pressed[id] = (self.pressed[id] or 0) + 1 end
		self.held[id] = true
	else
		self.held[id] = nil
	end
end
function Input:Down(id) return self.held[id] == true end
function Input:Pressed(id)
	local n = self.pressed[id]
	if n and n > 0 then self.pressed[id] = n - 1 return true end
	return false
end
function Input:Axis()
	local x, y = 0, 0
	if not self.opts.noMove then
		local k = self.keys
		local KC = Enum.KeyCode
		if k[KC.W] or k[KC.Up] then y = y + 1 end
		if k[KC.S] or k[KC.Down] then y = y - 1 end
		if k[KC.D] or k[KC.Right] then x = x + 1 end
		if k[KC.A] or k[KC.Left] then x = x - 1 end
	end
	if self.opts.dpad then
		if self.held.right then x = x + 1 end
		if self.held.left then x = x - 1 end
		if self.held.up then y = y + 1 end
		if self.held.down then y = y - 1 end
	end
	x, y = x + self.joy.X, y + self.joy.Y
	local m = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
	if m > 1 then x, y = x / m, y / m end
	return V2(x, y)
end
-- returns yaw/pitch deltas in radians (already scaled by sensitivity)
function Input:Look()
	local s = (MG.Settings and MG.Settings.sens or 1) * (self.mode == "Mobile" and 0.0042 or 0.0030)
	local dx, dy = self.dx * s, self.dy * s
	self.dx, self.dy = 0, 0
	return dx, dy
end
function Input:Wheel() local w = self.wheel self.wheel = 0 return w end
function Input:EndFrame() if next(self.pressed) ~= nil then self.pressed = {} end end -- no table churn on idle frames
function Input:Help()
	local out = {}
	if not self.opts.noMove then
		if self.opts.dpad then out[#out + 1] = {"A D / Arrows", "Move"} else out[#out + 1] = {"W A S D", "Move"} end
	end
	if self.opts.look then out[#out + 1] = {"Mouse", "Look"} end
	for _, a in ipairs(self.scheme) do
		if a.name then out[#out + 1] = {keyLabel(a), a.name} end
	end
	out[#out + 1] = {"P / Esc", "Pause"}
	return out
end

function Input:Rebuild()
	if self.touchGui then self.touchGui:Destroy() self.touchGui = nil end
	local root = self.root
	local tg = new("Frame", root, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 20, Visible = self.mode == "Mobile"})
	self.touchGui = tg
	local I = self
	-- look pad (right side) and joystick zone (left side)
	if self.opts.look then
		local pad = new("Frame", tg, {Position = U2(0.4, 0, 0, 0), Size = U2(0.6, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, ZIndex = 21})
		pad.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not I.lookTouch then I.lookTouch = input end
		end)
	end
	if not self.opts.dpad and not self.opts.noMove then
		local zone = new("Frame", tg, {Position = U2(0, 0, 0.25, 0), Size = U2(0.4, 0, 0.75, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, ZIndex = 21})
		local base = new("Frame", tg, {Size = U2(0, 120, 0, 120), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = U2(0, 110, 1, -110), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 22})
		new("UICorner", base, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
		local bs = new("UIStroke", base, {Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.35, Color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
		UI.Theme(bs, "Color", "Accent")
		local knob = new("Frame", base, {Size = U2(0, 52, 0, 52), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 23})
		new("UICorner", knob, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
		UI.Theme(knob, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
		self.joyBase, self.joyKnob = base, knob
		zone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not I.joyTouch then
				I.joyTouch = input
				I.joyOrigin = V2(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
				base.Position = U2(0, I.joyOrigin.X, 0, I.joyOrigin.Y - 0)
				base.AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5)
				base.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
			end
		end)
	end
	if self.opts.dpad then
		local function dbtn(id, label, ox, oy)
			I:TouchButton(tg, {id = id, label = label}, U2(0, ox, 1, -oy), 62, true)
		end
		dbtn("left", "<", 60, 90) dbtn("right", ">", 190, 90) dbtn("up", "^", 125, 155) dbtn("down", "v", 125, 40)
	end
	for _, a in ipairs(self.scheme) do
		if not a.noTouch then
			local sl = a.pos or TOUCH_SLOTS[a.slot] or TOUCH_SLOTS[#TOUCH_SLOTS]
			self:TouchButton(tg, a, U2(1, -sl[1], 1, -sl[2]), sl[3], false)
		end
	end
	local pb = UI.Button(tg, "II", U2(1, -12, 0, 12), U2(0, 46, 0, 46), function() I.ctx.TogglePause() end, {anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 24})
	self:ApplyMouse()
end

function Input:TouchButton(parent, a, pos, size, isDpad)
	local I = self
	local b = new("TextButton", parent, {Position = pos, Size = U2(0, size, 0, size), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = C3(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 24})
	new("UICorner", b, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
	local st = new("UIStroke", b, {Thickness = 2.5, Transparency = 0.1, Color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
	UI.Theme(st, "Color", "Accent")
	UI.Label(b, a.label or a.id, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(1, 0, 1, 0), {xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, size = math.max(11, size * 0.22), z = 25, wrap = true})
	local function down(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if a.toggle then
				I:Press(a.id, not I.held[a.id])
			else
				I:Press(a.id, true)
			end
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
			b.Size = U2(0, size * 0.92, 0, size * 0.92)
		end
	end
	local function up(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			if not a.toggle then I:Press(a.id, false) end
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
			b.Size = U2(0, size, 0, size)
		end
	end
	b.InputBegan:Connect(down)
	b.InputEnded:Connect(up)
	return b
end

function Input:ApplyMouse()
	local lock = self.lockMouse and not self.neverLock and self.mode == "PC" and self.opts.look
	pcall(function()
		UIS.MouseBehavior = lock and Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter or Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		UIS.MouseIconEnabled = not lock
	end)
end

function Input:Connect()
	if self.connsMade then return end
	self.connsMade = true
	local I = self
	local c = self.conns
	c[#c + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		local ut = input.UserInputType
		if ut == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			I.keys[input.KeyCode] = true
			local id = I.byKey[input.KeyCode]
			if id then I:Press(id, true) end
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then I.ctx.TogglePause() end
		elseif I.byMouse[ut] then
			I:Press(I.byMouse[ut], true)
		end
	end)
	c[#c + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local ut = input.UserInputType
		if ut == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			I.keys[input.KeyCode] = nil
			local id = I.byKey[input.KeyCode]
			if id then I:Press(id, false) end
		elseif I.byMouse[ut] then
			I:Press(I.byMouse[ut], false)
		elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if input == I.lookTouch then I.lookTouch = nil end
			if input == I.joyTouch then
				I.joyTouch = nil
				I.joy = V2(0, 0)
				if I.joyKnob then
					I.joyKnob.Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
					I.joyBase.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
					I.joyBase.Position = U2(0, 110, 1, -110)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	c[#c + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		local ut = input.UserInputType
		if ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			if I.mode == "PC" and (I.lockMouse or (I.opts.dragLook and (not I.opts.rmbLook or I.held.aim))) then I.dx = I.dx + input.Delta.X I.dy = I.dy + input.Delta.Y end
		elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
			I.wheel = I.wheel + input.Position.Z
		elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if input == I.lookTouch then
				I.dx = I.dx + input.Delta.X
				I.dy = I.dy + input.Delta.Y
			elseif input == I.joyTouch and I.joyOrigin then
				local d = V2(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - I.joyOrigin
				local r = 55
				local m = d.Magnitude
				if m > r then d = d * (r / m) end
				I.joy = V2(d.X / r, -d.Y / r)
				I.joyKnob.Position = U2(0.5, d.X, 0.5, d.Y)
			end
		end
	end)
	c[#c + 1] = UIS.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(last)
		local pref = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg and Util.FX.Cfg.MiniControls or 1
		if pref ~= 1 then return end
		local newMode = nil
		if last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then newMode = "Mobile"
		elseif last == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then newMode = "PC" end
		if newMode and newMode ~= I.mode and (newMode == "PC" or UIS.TouchEnabled) then
			I.mode = newMode
			I.held, I.keys, I.joy, I.pressed = {}, {}, V2(0, 0), {}
			I.lookTouch, I.joyTouch = nil, nil -- a touch that began in the other mode must not stay captured
			if I.joyKnob then I.joyKnob.Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) I.joyBase.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 I.joyBase.Position = U2(0, 110, 1, -110) end
			if I.touchGui then I.touchGui.Visible = (newMode == "Mobile") end
			I:ApplyMouse()
			I.ctx.Toast("Controls: " .. newMode)
			if I.ctx.OnModeChanged then safe(I.ctx.OnModeChanged, newMode) end
		end
	end)
	-- alt-tab / focus loss: drop every held input (no stuck keys) and open the pause menu on PC
	c[#c + 1] = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		I.held, I.keys, I.pressed, I.joy = {}, {}, {}, V2(0, 0)
		I.lookTouch, I.joyTouch = nil, nil
		local act = MG.Active
		if act and act.input == I and not act.paused and not act.cover and I.mode == "PC" then I.ctx.TogglePause() end
	end)
	-- sink movement keys so the real character doesn't walk around while playing
	pcall(function()
		local list = {Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2}
		for _, n in ipairs(SINK_KEYS) do list[#list + 1] = Enum.KeyCode[n] end
		ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("MGSink" .. tostring(self), function() return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, 3000, unpack(list))
		I.sinkName = "MGSink" .. tostring(self)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local pm = Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
		if pm then I.controls = require(pm):GetControls() I.controls:Disable() end
	end)
end

local function lockCenter() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter end
function Input:Flush()
	-- called every frame by the runner: touch-driven look/joystick need no polling; just keep the mouse locked (only touch the property when it drifted)
	if self.mode == "PC" and self.lockMouse and not self.neverLock and self.opts.look and UIS.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
		pcall(lockCenter)
	end
end
function Input:Destroy()
	for _, c in ipairs(self.conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	self.conns = {}
	self.connsMade = false
	pcall(function() if self.sinkName then ContextActionService:UnbindAction(self.sinkName) end end)
	pcall(function() if self.controls then self.controls:Enable() end end)
	pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
end

-- ═════ RUNNER ═════
MG.Settings = {sens = 1}
local function restoreUI()
	pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = true end)
	if MG.Arena and MG.Arena.Show then safe(MG.Arena.Show) end
end
-- keepHidden (used by Restart) skips re-showing the menus so there is no one-frame flash between quit and relaunch
function MG.Quit(keepHidden)
	local A = MG.Active
	if not A then return end
	MG.Active = nil
	A.dead = true
	if A.conn then A.conn:Disconnect() end
	for _, fn in ipairs(A.cleanups) do safe(fn) end
	if A.game and A.game.Destroy then safe(A.game.Destroy, A.game) end
	A.input:Destroy()
	pcall(function() A.sg:Destroy() end)
	UI.ghosts = {}
	pcall(UI.Retheme, os.clock()) -- prunes themed entries that belonged to the destroyed HUD
	if keepHidden ~= true then restoreUI() end
end

local function buildPause(A)
	local ctx = A.ctx
	local ov = UI.Frame(A.root, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(1, 0, 1, 0), {tr = 0.45, z = 50})
	ov.Visible = false
	ov.Active = true
	local panel = UI.Frame(ov, U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), U2(0, 420, 0, 330), {tr = 0.15, round = 10, stroke = 2, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 51})
	A.pauseScale = new("UIScale", panel)
	UI.Label(panel, "<b>PAUSED</b>", U2(0, 0, 0, 8), U2(1, 0, 0, 30), {size = 26, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, z = 52, theme = "Accent"})
	UI.Label(panel, A.def.name, U2(0, 0, 0, 38), U2(1, 0, 0, 18), {size = 14, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, z = 52})
	local help = UI.Label(panel, "", U2(0, 18, 0, 64), U2(1, -36, 0, 130), {size = 13, ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, z = 52, wrap = true})
	local function fill()
		local lines = {}
		for _, h in ipairs(A.input:Help()) do lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("<b>%s</b>  %s", h[1], h[2]) end
		help.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end
	A.fillHelp = fill
	local sensLbl = UI.Label(panel, "Look sensitivity: 1.0", U2(0, 18, 0, 200), U2(1, -36, 0, 18), {size = 14, z = 52})
	local function sens(d)
		MG.Settings.sens = clamp(math.floor((MG.Settings.sens + d) * 10 + 0.5) / 10, 0.3, 3)
		sensLbl.Text = "Look sensitivity: " .. string.format("%.1f", MG.Settings.sens)
	end
	UI.Button(panel, "-", U2(1, -90, 0, 196), U2(0, 32, 0, 26), function() sens(-0.1) end, {z = 52})
	UI.Button(panel, "+", U2(1, -50, 0, 196), U2(0, 32, 0, 26), function() sens(0.1) end, {z = 52})
	UI.Button(panel, "Resume", U2(0, 18, 1, -88), U2(0.5, -24, 0, 34), function() ctx.TogglePause() end, {z = 52})
	UI.Button(panel, "Restart", U2(0.5, 6, 1, -88), U2(0.5, -24, 0, 34), function() ctx.Restart() end, {z = 52})
	UI.Button(panel, "Quit to Arcade", U2(0, 18, 1, -46), U2(1, -36, 0, 34), function() ctx.Exit() end, {z = 52})
	A.pause = ov
end

function MG.Launch(def)
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then -- [v34] Low End UI Mode: minigames are locked (also covers the search bar + the arcade cards)
		pcall(Util.UINotify, "Minigames are disabled in Low End UI Mode")
		return false
	end
	if MG.Active then MG.Quit() end
	local sg, root = MG.NewStage()
	local A = {def = def, sg = sg, root = root, cleanups = {}, updates = {}, paused = false, time = 0}
	MG.Active = A
	pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = false end)
	if MG.Arena and MG.Arena.Hide then safe(MG.Arena.Hide) end
	local ctx = {Root = root, Stage = sg, MG = MG, HUD = UI, Settings = MG.Settings, Services = {Players = Players, RunService = RunService, UserInputService = UIS, TweenService = TweenService, Debris = Debris}}
	A.ctx = ctx
	ctx.Rand = Random.new(os.time())
	ctx.Time = 0
	ctx.Paused = false
	local input = MG.NewInput(ctx, root)
	A.input = input
	ctx.Input = input
	function ctx.IsMobile() return input.mode == "Mobile" end
	function ctx.Palette(t) return MG.Palette(t) end
	function ctx.Toast(text, s) return UI.Toast(root, text, s) end
	function ctx.Sound(kind, pitch, vol) if Util.FX and Util.FX.Play then pcall(Util.FX.Play, kind or "hit", pitch, vol) end end
	function ctx.Data() return MG.Data(def.id) end
	function ctx.OnUpdate(fn) A.updates[#A.updates + 1] = fn end
	function ctx.OnCleanup(fn) A.cleanups[#A.cleanups + 1] = fn end
	function ctx.NewScene(o) local s = MG.NewScene(root, o) ctx.OnCleanup(function() s:Destroy() end) return s end
	ctx.NewFX, ctx.NewRig, ctx.NewBoxes, ctx.NewVoxels = MG.NewFX, MG.NewRig, MG.NewBoxes, MG.NewVoxels
	-- every session-bound callback is ignored once its session is gone, so timers/buttons of a closed game can never hit the next one
	function ctx.Exit() if MG.Active == A then MG.Quit() end end
	function ctx.Restart()
		if MG.Active ~= A then return end
		local d = def
		MG.Quit(true)
		task.defer(function()
			if MG.Active then return end
			if not MG.Launch(d) and not MG.Active then restoreUI() end
		end)
	end
	-- ctx.Delay(secs, fn): task.delay that is dropped (and error-isolated) when the game has been closed or replaced
	function ctx.Delay(secs, fn) task.delay(secs or 0, function() if MG.Active == A then safe(fn) end end) end
	function ctx.TogglePause()
		if MG.Active ~= A or A.cover then return end
		A.paused = not A.paused
		ctx.Paused = A.paused
		A.pause.Visible = A.paused
		input.lockMouse = not A.paused
		input:ApplyMouse()
		if A.paused then A.fillHelp() end
	end
	input:Connect()
	buildPause(A)

	-- title card (animated, fades out as the game starts)
	local cover = UI.Frame(root, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(1, 0, 1, 0), {tr = 0, z = 60})
	A.cover = cover
	local pal = MG.Palette(0)
	local title = UI.Label(cover, "<b>" .. string.upper(def.name) .. "</b>", U2(0.5, 0, 0.42, 0), U2(1, 0, 0, 60), {size = 46, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 61, theme = "Accent"})
	title.TextTransparency = 1
	local sub = UI.Label(cover, def.tagline or "", U2(0.5, 0, 0.54, 0), U2(1, 0, 0, 24), {size = 18, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 61})
	sub.TextTransparency = 1
	local tip = UI.Label(cover, "", U2(0.5, 0, 0.66, 0), U2(0.8, 0, 0, 22), {size = 14, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 61})
	tip.TextTransparency = 1
	TweenService:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(sub, TweenInfo.new(0.7), {TextTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(tip, TweenInfo.new(0.9), {TextTransparency = 0.3}):Play()
	-- genre colour stripe + loading line so the card reads as "loading", not "frozen"
	local stripe = new("Frame", cover, {Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.485, 0), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Size = U2(0, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = def.color or C3(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 61})
	TweenService:Create(stripe, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = U2(0, 220, 0, 3)}):Play()
	local prog = new("Frame", cover, {Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.78, 0), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Size = U2(0, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 61})
	UI.Theme(prog, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
	TweenService:Create(prog, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = U2(0, 220, 0, 3)}):Play()
	ctx.Sound("open", 0.9, 1)

	local ok, g = pcall(def.Start, ctx)
	if not ok then
		MG.Errors[#MG.Errors + 1] = tostring(g)
		warn("[Minigames] " .. def.name .. " failed to start: " .. tostring(g))
		Util.UINotify("Minigame failed to start: " .. tostring(g):sub(1, 80))
		MG.Quit()
		return false
	end
	A.game = g
	input:Rebuild()
	tip.Text = ctx.IsMobile() and (def.controlsMobile or "Left thumb: move   Right thumb: look   Buttons: actions") or (def.controlsPC or "WASD move  -  Mouse look  -  P pause")
	A.t0 = os.clock()
	local errCount, lastErr = 0, -10
	local acc = 0
	-- keep the pause panel inside small / landscape-phone screens
	local function fit()
		local sc = A.pauseScale
		if not sc then return end
		local sz = root.AbsoluteSize
		local want = clamp(math.min(sz.Y / 380, sz.X / 460), 0.5, 1)
		if sc.Scale ~= want then sc.Scale = want end
	end
	-- the opaque title card is dropped from here AND from a timer, so it can never get stuck as a black screen
	local function dropCover()
		local cv = A.cover
		if not cv then return end
		A.cover = nil
		pcall(function()
			for _, o in ipairs(cv:GetChildren()) do
				if o:IsA("TextLabel") then TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
				elseif o:IsA("Frame") then TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play() end
			end
			TweenService:Create(cv, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end)
		task.delay(0.6, function() if cv.Parent then cv:Destroy() end end)
	end
	task.delay(2.2, function() if MG.Active == A then dropCover() end end)
	A.conn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)
		acc = acc + dt
		if acc > 0.08 then acc = 0 pcall(UI.Retheme, os.clock()) pcall(fit) end
		pcall(UI.Tick, dt)
		pcall(input.Flush, input)
		if A.paused then input.dx, input.dy, input.wheel = 0, 0, 0 end
		if A.cover and os.clock() - A.t0 > 1.5 then dropCover() end
		if not A.diag and A.time > 2 then
			A.diag = true
			pcall(function()
				local vp = A.root:FindFirstChildOfClass("ViewportFrame")
				if vp then
					warn(string.format("[Minigames][diag] %s mode=%s vp=%s size=%s parts=%d cam=%s parent=%s", def.name, tostring(input.mode), tostring(vp.Visible), tostring(vp.AbsoluteSize), #vp:GetChildren(), tostring(vp.CurrentCamera and vp.CurrentCamera.CFrame), tostring(A.sg.Parent)))
				end
			end)
		end
		if not A.paused then
			A.time = A.time + dt
			ctx.Time = A.time
			local okk, err = pcall(function()
				if A.game and A.game.Update then A.game:Update(dt) end
				for _, fn in ipairs(A.updates) do fn(dt) end
			end)
			if not okk then
				-- only errors that arrive in quick succession count (3 within ~2s each): a rare one-off must not end a long session
				if os.clock() - lastErr > 2 then errCount = 0 end
				lastErr = os.clock()
				errCount = errCount + 1
				if #MG.Errors < 40 then MG.Errors[#MG.Errors + 1] = tostring(err) end
				warn("[Minigames] " .. def.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
				if errCount >= 3 then
					Util.UINotify(def.name .. " crashed: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 90))
					MG.Quit()
					return
				end
			end
		end
		input:EndFrame()
	end)
	return true
end

-- ═════ registration + plugin loader ═════
function MG.Register(def)
	if type(def) ~= "table" or type(def.id) ~= "string" or type(def.name) ~= "string" or type(def.Start) ~= "function" then
		return false, "a minigame needs id (string), name (string) and Start(ctx) (function)"
	end
	if MG.ByID[def.id] then return false, "duplicate id " .. def.id end
	def.tags = def.tags or {"3D"}
	def.color = def.color or C3(0.3, 0.6, 1)
	MG.Games[#MG.Games + 1] = def
	MG.ByID[def.id] = def
	return true
end
function MG.Unregister(id)
	local d = MG.ByID[id]
	if not d then return end
	MG.ByID[id] = nil
	local i = table.find(MG.Games, d)
	if i then table.remove(MG.Games, i) end
end

MG.PluginFolder = "UhhhhhhReanim/Minigames"
local README = [==[
MINIGAME PLUGINS  (drop .lua files in this folder, then press "Reload Plugins" on the Minigames page)

Files starting with _ and files ending in .txt are ignored (see _example.lua.txt - rename it to example.lua to try it).
A plugin file receives the Minigames API as its first argument (...) and returns a minigame table, or a list of them:

  local API = ...
  return {
      id = "my_game",              -- unique, a-z 0-9 _
      name = "My Game",
      tagline = "One line shown on the card",
      tags = {"2D", "PC", "Mobile"},
      color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255),
      controlsPC = "WASD move - Click shoot",
      controlsMobile = "Joystick move - Button shoot",
      Start = function(ctx)        -- called once when the player presses Play
          -- build your game here, return nothing or a table with Update(self, dt) / Destroy(self)
      end,
  }

API (== ctx passed to Start, plus API.Register for plugins that register themselves):
  ctx.Root                 fullscreen Frame (parent your 2D UI here)
  ctx.Input                :SetScheme({{id="fire", name="Fire", keys={Enum.KeyCode.F}, mouse=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, label="FIRE"}, ...}, {look=true, dpad=false})
                           :Axis() -> Vector2 (x right, y forward) | :Down(id) | :Pressed(id) | :Look() -> yawDelta, pitchDelta | :Wheel()
                           Touch buttons, joystick, look pad and key help are generated from the scheme automatically
  ctx.IsMobile()           current control mode (switches live)
  ctx.NewScene({sky=Color3, fov=75})  -> scene: :Part(pos,size,color,{mat=,shape=,tr=}) :SetCam(pos,yaw,pitch) :LookAt(a,b)
  ctx.NewBoxes()           collision boxes (:Add(center,size,tag) :Ray(o,dir,max)); API.Move(world,pos,vel,halfSize,dt) does swept AABB movement
  ctx.NewVoxels(x,y,z)     voxel grid (:Get/:Set/:Ray)
  ctx.NewRig(scene,{shirt=,pants=,skin=})  blocky character :Pose(feetPos,yaw,walkPhase,swing,aimPitchOrNil)
  ctx.NewFX(scene)         tracers / sparks / flashes (:Update(dt) every frame)
  ctx.HUD                  Frame/Label/Bar/Button helpers that follow the user's dynamic colour theme
  ctx.Palette(t)           {Accent, Secondary, Tertiary, Bg, Text}  (the user's live colour system)
  ctx.Data()               table that is saved between sessions (numbers/strings/booleans only)
  ctx.OnUpdate(fn(dt)) ctx.OnCleanup(fn) ctx.Toast(text) ctx.Sound(kind) ctx.Exit() ctx.Restart() ctx.Time ctx.Paused
Errors inside a plugin never crash the script: the game is closed and the error is listed on the Minigames page.
]==]
local EXAMPLE = [==[
-- _example.lua.txt : a tiny "click the orbs" 2D game. Rename to example.lua and press Reload Plugins.
local API = ...
return {
	id = "example_orbs", name = "Orb Clicker", tagline = "Example plugin: click the orbs", tags = {"2D", "PC", "Mobile"},
	color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200), controlsPC = "Click the orbs", controlsMobile = "Tap the orbs",
	Start = function(ctx)
		local H, root, score, orbs = ctx.HUD, ctx.Root, 0, {}
		local lbl = H.Label(root, "Score: 0", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 30), {size = 24, theme = "Accent"})
		ctx.Input:SetScheme({}, {look = false, noMove = true})
		local timer = 0
		ctx.OnUpdate(function(dt)
			timer = timer - dt
			if timer <= 0 then
				timer = 0.6
				local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
				b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
				b.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random() * 0.9, math.random() * 0.8 + 0.1)
				b.Text = ""
				b.ZIndex = 10
				b.Parent = root
				Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				H.Theme(b, "BackgroundColor3", "Secondary")
				b.Activated:Connect(function() score = score + 1 lbl.Text = "Score: " .. score b:Destroy() end)
				task.delay(2, function() if b.Parent then b:Destroy() end end)
			end
		end)
	end,
}
]==]
function MG.ReloadPlugins()
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then return end -- [v34] Low End UI Mode: plugin files are not read or run
	for _, d in ipairs({unpack(MG.Games)}) do if d.plugin then MG.Unregister(d.id) end end
	MG.Plugins = {}
	pcall(makefolder, "UhhhhhhReanim")
	pcall(makefolder, MG.PluginFolder)
	pcall(function() if not isfile(MG.PluginFolder .. "/README.txt") then writefile(MG.PluginFolder .. "/README.txt", README) end end)
	pcall(function() if not isfile(MG.PluginFolder .. "/_example.lua.txt") then writefile(MG.PluginFolder .. "/_example.lua.txt", EXAMPLE) end end)
	local files = {}
	pcall(function() files = listfiles(MG.PluginFolder) end)
	local curRec = nil
	local function regPlugin(d, fname)
		if type(d) ~= "table" then return false, "not a table" end
		if type(d.id) == "string" and d.id:sub(1, 7) ~= "plugin_" then d.id = "plugin_" .. d.id:gsub("[^%w_]", "") end
		d.plugin = true
		d.file = fname
		d.tags = d.tags or {"Plugin"}
		return MG.Register(d)
	end
	local api = setmetatable({Register = function(d)
		local okR, why = regPlugin(d, curRec and curRec.file or "?")
		if okR and curRec then curRec.games = curRec.games + 1 end
		return okR, why
	end, Move = MG.Move, Version = MG.Version}, {__index = MG})
	for _, path in ipairs(files) do
		local fname = tostring(path):gsub("\\", "/"):match("([^/]+)$") or tostring(path)
		local low = fname:lower()
		if (low:sub(-4) == ".lua" or low:sub(-5) == ".luau") and fname:sub(1, 1) ~= "_" then
			local rec = {file = fname, ok = false, err = nil, games = 0}
			MG.Plugins[#MG.Plugins + 1] = rec
			curRec = rec
			local okRead, src = pcall(readfile, path)
			if not okRead then
				rec.err = "cannot read file"
			else
				local fn, perr = loadstring(src, "=mg_plugin:" .. fname)
				if not fn then
					rec.err = "syntax: " .. tostring(perr)
				else
					local okRun, ret = pcall(fn, api)
					if not okRun then
						rec.err = "runtime: " .. tostring(ret)
					else
						local defs = {}
						if type(ret) == "table" then
							if ret.Start then defs[1] = ret else for _, d in ipairs(ret) do defs[#defs + 1] = d end end
						end
						for _, d in ipairs(defs) do
							local okReg, why = api.Register(d)
							if not okReg then rec.err = why end
						end
						rec.ok = rec.games > 0
						if not rec.ok and not rec.err then rec.err = "returned no minigame (registered itself? check API.Register)" end
					end
				end
			end
			if rec.err then MG.Errors[#MG.Errors + 1] = fname .. ": " .. rec.err warn("[Minigames] plugin " .. fname .. ": " .. rec.err) end
		end
	end
	return #MG.Plugins
end

-- ═════ SHARED 3D SHOOTER ENGINE (used by DOOM / CoD / CS:GO / Red Dead / GTA) ═════
-- cfg: sky, ambient, fov, map(function(world, scene)), spawn(Vector3), weapons{...}, hud options, tp=false (third person)
local FPS = {}
FPS.__index = FPS
local EYE = 4.6
local HALF = V3(1.1, 2.6, 1.1)

local function hasLOS(world, a, b)
	local d = b - a
	local m = d.Magnitude
	if m < 0.01 then return true end
	return world:Ray(a, d / m, m - 0.3) == nil
end
MG.hasLOS = hasLOS

function MG.NewFPS(ctx, cfg)
	local self = setmetatable({ctx = ctx, cfg = cfg, bots = {}, projs = {}, pickups = {}, kills = 0, deaths = 0, score = {a = 0, b = 0}, t = 0}, FPS)
	local scene = ctx.NewScene({sky = cfg.sky, ambient = cfg.ambient, lightColor = cfg.lightColor, lightDir = cfg.lightDir, fov = cfg.fov or 80})
	self.scene = scene
	self.world = ctx.NewBoxes()
	self.fx = ctx.NewFX(scene)
	self.fov0 = cfg.fov or 80
	self.hp, self.maxhp, self.armor = cfg.hp or 100, cfg.hp or 100, 0
	self.pos, self.vel, self.yaw, self.pitch = cfg.spawn or V3(0, 3, 0), V3(0, 0, 0), cfg.yaw or 0, 0
	self.onGround, self.crouch, self.bob, self.recoil, self.kick = false, 0, 0, 0, 0
	self.dead, self.respawnT = false, 0
	self.team = cfg.team or "a"
	self.weapons = {}
	for _, w in ipairs(cfg.weapons or {}) do
		local c = {}
		for k, v in pairs(w) do c[k] = v end
		c.mag = c.mag or c.magSize or 0
		c.magSize = c.magSize or c.mag
		c.reserve = c.reserve or 0
		self.weapons[#self.weapons + 1] = c
	end
	self.cur = 1
	self.cool, self.reloadT, self.ads = 0, 0, 0
	self.tp = cfg.tp == true
	self.camDist = 9
	self.speed = cfg.speed or 17
	if cfg.map then cfg.map(self.world, scene, self) end
	-- HUD
	local R = ctx.Root
	local H = MG.HUD
	self.hud = {}
	local h = self.hud
	h.vig = H.Frame(R, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(1, 0, 1, 0), {tr = 1, color = C3(0.8, 0, 0), z = 3})
	h.cross = H.Frame(R, U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), U2(0, 4, 0, 4), {tr = 0, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 10, color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
	H.Theme(h.cross, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
	h.ring = new("Frame", R, {Position = U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = U2(0, 30, 0, 30), AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 10})
	local rs = new("UIStroke", h.ring, {Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.2, Color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
	new("UICorner", h.ring, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
	H.Theme(rs, "Color", "Accent")
	h.hit = H.Label(R, "X", U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), U2(0, 40, 0, 40), {size = 30, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 11, color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
	h.hit.TextTransparency = 1
	local bottom = H.Frame(R, U2(0, 14, 1, -14), U2(0, 250, 0, 74), {anchor = V2(0, 1), tr = 0.45, round = 8, stroke = 1.5, z = 9})
	h.hpBar = H.Bar(bottom, U2(0, 10, 0, 10), U2(1, -20, 0, 14), {color = C3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2), z = 10})
	h.arBar = H.Bar(bottom, U2(0, 10, 0, 30), U2(1, -20, 0, 8), {theme = "Secondary", z = 10})
	h.hpTxt = H.Label(bottom, "100", U2(0, 10, 0, 42), U2(1, -20, 0, 26), {size = 22, z = 10})
	local ammo = H.Frame(R, U2(1, -14, 1, -14), U2(0, 190, 0, 74), {anchor = V2(1, 1), tr = 0.45, round = 8, stroke = 1.5, z = 9})
	h.ammoTxt = H.Label(ammo, "", U2(0, 10, 0, 6), U2(1, -20, 0, 36), {size = 30, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, z = 10, theme = "Accent"})
	h.wepTxt = H.Label(ammo, "", U2(0, 10, 0, 44), U2(1, -20, 0, 24), {size = 15, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, z = 10})
	h.ammoBox = ammo
	if ctx.IsMobile() then ammo.Position = U2(0.5, 120, 0, 8) ammo.AnchorPoint = V2(0, 0) bottom.Position = U2(0.5, -120, 0, 8) bottom.AnchorPoint = V2(1, 0) end
	h.info = H.Label(R, "", U2(0, 14, 0, 12), U2(0.5, 0, 0, 60), {size = 18, ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, z = 10, theme = "Accent", wrap = true})
	h.feed = H.Label(R, "", U2(1, -14, 0, 12), U2(0.4, 0, 0, 120), {size = 14, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 10, wrap = true})
	h.msg = H.Label(R, "", U2(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0), U2(0.8, 0, 0, 50), {size = 36, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 12, theme = "Accent"})
	self.feedLines = {}
	-- viewmodel
	self.vm = {}
	self:BuildViewmodel()
	-- input scheme
	local sch = {
		{id = "fire", name = "Fire", mouse = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, label = "FIRE", slot = 1},
		{id = "jump", name = "Jump", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.Space}, label = "JUMP", slot = 2},
		{id = "reload", name = "Reload", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.R}, label = "R", slot = 3},
		{id = "aim", name = "Aim / Zoom", mouse = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, label = "AIM", slot = 4, toggle = true},
		{id = "swap", name = "Next weapon", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.Q}, label = "SWAP", slot = 5},
		{id = "crouch", name = "Crouch", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, Enum.KeyCode.C}, label = "DUCK", slot = 6, toggle = true},
		{id = "use", name = "Use / Interact", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.E}, label = "USE", slot = 7},
	}
	for i = 1, 5 do table.insert(sch, {id = "w" .. i, keys = {Enum.KeyCode[({"One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five"})[i]]}, noTouch = true}) end
	table.insert(sch, {id = "sprint", name = "Sprint", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift}, noTouch = true})
	if cfg.extraKeys then for _, a in ipairs(cfg.extraKeys) do table.insert(sch, a) end end
	ctx.Input:SetScheme(sch, {look = true, dragLook = cfg.rmbLook, rmbLook = cfg.rmbLook})
	if cfg.rmbLook then ctx.Input.neverLock = true ctx.Input.lockMouse = false ctx.Input:ApplyMouse() end
	ctx.OnModeChanged = function() self:RefreshHud() end
	self:RefreshHud()
	return self
end

function FPS:BuildViewmodel()
	for _, p in ipairs(self.vm) do if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end
	self.vm = {}
	local w = self.weapons[self.cur]
	if not w or self.tp then return end
	local c = w.vmColor or C3(0.15, 0.15, 0.17)
	local s = self.scene
	local len = w.vmLen or 2.2
	self.vm.body = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.35, 0.55, len), c)
	self.vm.barrel = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.18, 0.18, len * 0.5), C3(0.05, 0.05, 0.06))
	self.vm.grip = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.3, 0.8, 0.35), w.vmGrip or C3(0.35, 0.22, 0.12))
	self.vm.hand = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.55, 0.55, 0.9), C3(0.95, 0.75, 0.6))
	self.vm.flash = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.6, 0.6, 0.6), C3(1, 0.85, 0.3), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, tr = 1})
	self.vm.sight = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.12, 0.16, 0.5), C3(0.05, 0.05, 0.06), {mat = Enum.Material.Metal})
	self.vm.mag = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.24, 0.7, 0.3), w.vmMag or C3(0.1, 0.1, 0.11), {mat = Enum.Material.Metal})
	self.vm.sleeve = s:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), V3(0.7, 0.7, 1.6), w.vmSleeve or C3(0.22, 0.28, 0.2), {mat = Enum.Material.Fabric})
	if w.melee then self.vm.sight.Transparency, self.vm.mag.Transparency = 1, 1 end
	self.vmSolid = {self.vm.body, self.vm.barrel, self.vm.grip, self.vm.hand, self.vm.sight, self.vm.mag, self.vm.sleeve}
	self.vmMelee = w.melee == true
	for _, k in ipairs({"body", "barrel", "grip", "hand", "flash", "sight", "mag", "sleeve"}) do self.vm[#self.vm + 1] = self.vm[k] end
end

function FPS:RefreshHud()
	local h = self.hud
	if self.ctx.IsMobile() then
		h.ammoBox.AnchorPoint = V2(0, 0) h.ammoBox.Position = U2(0.5, 120, 0, 8)
	else
		h.ammoBox.AnchorPoint = V2(1, 1) h.ammoBox.Position = U2(1, -14, 1, -14)
	end
end

function FPS:Log(text)
	table.insert(self.feedLines, 1, text)
	while #self.feedLines > 5 do table.remove(self.feedLines) end
	self.hud.feed.Text = table.concat(self.feedLines, "\n")
	local n = #self.feedLines
	task.delay(5, function() if #self.feedLines == n then self.feedLines = {} self.hud.feed.Text = "" end end)
end
function FPS:Msg(text, secs)
	self.hud.msg.Text = text
	self.msgT = secs or 2
end

function FPS:Eye() return self.pos + V3(0, EYE - self.crouch * 1.4, 0) end
function FPS:Aim()
	local cp, cy = math.cos(self.pitch), math.sin(self.pitch)
	return V3(-math.sin(self.yaw) * cp, cy, -math.cos(self.yaw) * cp)
end

-- ═════ actors (bots) ═════
-- def: {hp, speed, team, rig={shirt,pants,skin,scale}, weapon={dmg,rate,spread,range,proj=true,projSpeed,melee}, name, reaction, score}
function FPS:AddBot(pos, def)
	local b = {pos = pos, vel = V3(0, 0, 0), hp = def.hp or 100, maxhp = def.hp or 100, def = def, team = def.team or "b", yaw = 0, phase = math.random() * 6,
		cool = 1 + math.random(), alive = true, state = "idle", react = 0, strafe = (math.random() < 0.5) and 1 or -1, strT = 1, ground = false, moving = 0, name = def.name or "Bot", wanderYaw = math.random() * 6.28}
	b.rig = self.ctx.NewRig(self.scene, def.rig or {})
	if def.rig and def.rig.scale then b.half = V3(1.1 * def.rig.scale, 2.6 * def.rig.scale, 1.1 * def.rig.scale) else b.half = HALF end
	self.bots[#self.bots + 1] = b
	return b
end

function FPS:DamageBot(b, dmg, byPlayer, head, killer)
	if not b.alive then return end
	b.hp = b.hp - dmg
	b.rig:Flash(C3(1, 0.2, 0.2))
	b.react = 0
	if b.hp <= 0 then
		b.alive = false
		b.dieT = 0
		if byPlayer then
			self.kills = self.kills + 1
			if self.cfg.onKill then safe(self.cfg.onKill, self, b, head) end
			self:Log(string.format("%s %s%s", "You killed", b.name, head and " [HS]" or ""))
		end
		if self.cfg.onBotDead then safe(self.cfg.onBotDead, self, b, byPlayer, killer) end
	end
end

function FPS:DamagePlayer(dmg, from)
	if self.dead or self.god then return end
	if self.armor > 0 then
		local a = math.min(self.armor, dmg * 0.5)
		self.armor = self.armor - a
		dmg = dmg - a
	end
	self.hp = self.hp - dmg
	self.hud.vig.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(0.35, 1 - dmg / 40)
	self.scene.shake = math.max(self.scene.shake, math.min(dmg * 0.05, 1.2))
	self.ctx.Sound("hit", 0.7, 1)
	if self.hp <= 0 then
		self.hp = 0
		self.dead = true
		self.deaths = self.deaths + 1
		self.respawnT = self.cfg.respawn or 3
		if self.cfg.onPlayerDead then safe(self.cfg.onPlayerDead, self, from) end
	end
end

-- ray against bots + world. returns dist, bot, point, headshot
function FPS:Trace(o, d, maxd, team)
	local wt, wn, wbox = self.world:Ray(o, d, maxd)
	local best, bb, head = wt or maxd, nil, false
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bots) do
		if b.alive and (team == nil or b.team ~= team) then
			local h = b.half
			local t = rayBox(o, d, V3(b.pos.X - h.X, b.pos.Y, b.pos.Z - h.X), V3(b.pos.X + h.X, b.pos.Y + h.Y * 2, b.pos.Z + h.X), best)
			if t and t < best then
				best, bb = t, b
				local hp = o + d * t
				head = hp.Y > b.pos.Y + h.Y * 2 - 1.1 * (b.rig.s or 1)
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bb, o + d * best, head, wt ~= nil and (bb == nil), (bb == nil) and wbox or nil
end

function FPS:Shoot()
	local w = self.weapons[self.cur]
	if not w or w.tool or self.cool > 0 or self.reloadT > 0 or self.dead then return end
	if w.melee then
		self.cool = 1 / w.rate
		self.kick = 0.6
		local o, d = self:Eye(), self:Aim()
		local t, b = self:Trace(o, d, w.range or 5, self.team)
		if b then self:DamageBot(b, w.dmg, true, false) self.fx:Spark(o + d * t, C3(1, 0.3, 0.2), 6, 8) self.hud.hit.TextTransparency = 0 end
		self.ctx.Sound("hit", 1.4, 0.8)
		return
	end
	if w.mag <= 0 then
		if w.reserve > 0 then self:Reload() else self.ctx.Sound("tick", 1.5, 0.5) self.cool = 0.25 end
		return
	end
	w.mag = w.mag - 1
	self.cool = 1 / w.rate
	self.kick = 1
	self.recoil = self.recoil + (w.recoil or 0.012)
	self.flashT = 0.05
	self.ctx.Sound("hit", (w.pitch or 1) * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.2), 1)
	local o = self:Eye()
	local base = self:Aim()
	local spread = (w.spread or 0.01) * (1 - self.ads * 0.7) * (self.onGround and 1 or 2) * (self.crouch > 0.5 and 0.7 or 1)
	local right = base:Cross(V3(0, 1, 0))
	if right.Magnitude < 0.01 then right = V3(1, 0, 0) end
	right = right.Unit
	local up = right:Cross(base)
	for _ = 1, (w.pellets or 1) do
		local d = (base + right * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spread) + up * ((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * spread)).Unit
		if w.proj then
			self:AddProj(o + base * 1.5, d * w.projSpeed, w.dmg, "player", w.projColor, w.splash, w.grav)
		else
			local t, b, p, head, _, wbox = self:Trace(o, d, w.range or 400, self.team)
			local muzzle = o + base * 2 + right * 0.6 - up * 0.5
			self.fx:Tracer(muzzle, p, w.tracer or C3(1, 0.9, 0.5), 0.06)
			if b then
				self:DamageBot(b, head and w.dmg * (w.hs or 2) or w.dmg, true, head)
				self.fx:Spark(p, C3(1, 0.1, 0.1), 4, 7)
				self.hud.hit.TextTransparency = 0
				self.hud.hit.TextColor3 = head and C3(1, 0.2, 0.2) or C3(1, 1, 1)
			else
				self.fx:Spark(p, C3(1, 0.85, 0.4), 3, 5)
				if wbox and self.cfg.onWorldHit then safe(self.cfg.onWorldHit, self, wbox, p, d, w) end
			end
		end
	end
	if w.mag <= 0 and w.reserve > 0 and (w.autoReload ~= false) then self.autoRel = true end
end

function FPS:Reload()
	local w = self.weapons[self.cur]
	if not w or w.melee or self.reloadT > 0 or w.mag >= w.magSize or w.reserve <= 0 then return end
	self.reloadT = w.reload or 1.6
	self.reloadFull = self.reloadT
	self.ctx.Sound("tick", 0.8, 1)
end

function FPS:AddProj(pos, vel, dmg, owner, color, splash, grav)
	local p = self.scene:Part(pos, V3(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), color or C3(1, 0.4, 0.1), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, shape = Enum.PartType.Ball})
	self.projs[#self.projs + 1] = {pos = pos, vel = vel, dmg = dmg, owner = owner, part = p, life = 6, splash = splash or 0, col = color, grav = grav}
end

function FPS:Explode(pos, dmg, radius, byPlayer)
	self.fx:Flash(pos, C3(1, 0.6, 0.2), radius * 1.6, 0.3)
	self.fx:Spark(pos, C3(1, 0.5, 0.1), 10, 12, 0.6)
	self.fx:Ring(pos, C3(1, 0.7, 0.3), radius * 2.2, 0.35)
	self.fx:Smoke(pos + V3(0, 1, 0), radius * 0.7, 1.0)
	self.scene.shake = math.max(self.scene.shake, 0.6)
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bots) do
		if b.alive then
			local d = (b.pos + V3(0, 2.5, 0) - pos).Magnitude
			if d < radius then self:DamageBot(b, dmg * (1 - d / radius), byPlayer, false) end
		end
	end
	if byPlayer ~= nil then
		local d = (self:Eye() - pos).Magnitude
		if d < radius then self:DamagePlayer(dmg * 0.5 * (1 - d / radius), "explosion") end
	end
end

function FPS:AddPickup(pos, kind, amount, color)
	local p = self.scene:Part(pos + V3(0, 1.4, 0), V3(1.4, 1.4, 1.4), color or C3(0.3, 1, 0.4), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon})
	self.pickups[#self.pickups + 1] = {pos = pos, kind = kind, amount = amount, part = p, t = math.random() * 6}
end

function FPS:Respawn()
	self.dead = false
	self.hp = self.maxhp
	self.armor = self.cfg.keepArmor and self.armor or 0
	self.pos = self.cfg.respawnPos and self.cfg.respawnPos(self) or (self.cfg.spawn or V3(0, 3, 0))
	self.vel = V3(0, 0, 0)
	self.hud.vig.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	if self.cfg.onRespawn then safe(self.cfg.onRespawn, self) end
end

function FPS:Give(kind, amount)
	if kind == "hp" then
		if self.hp >= self.maxhp then return false end
		self.hp = math.min(self.maxhp, self.hp + amount)
	elseif kind == "armor" then
		if self.armor >= 100 then return false end
		self.armor = math.min(100, self.armor + amount)
	elseif kind == "ammo" then
		for _, w in ipairs(self.weapons) do if not w.melee then w.reserve = w.reserve + math.floor(w.magSize * amount) end end
	end
	self.ctx.Sound("click", 1.6, 0.8)
	return true
end

function FPS:SelectWeapon(i)
	if i < 1 or i > #self.weapons or i == self.cur or self.weapons[i].locked then return end
	self.cur = i
	self.reloadT = 0
	self.ads = 0
	self:BuildViewmodel()
	self.ctx.Sound("tick", 1.2, 0.7)
end

-- ═════ bot AI ═════
function FPS:UpdateBot(b, dt)
	local def = b.def
	if not b.alive then
		b.dieT = b.dieT + dt
		local k = math.min(b.dieT * 3, 1)
		b.rig:Pose(b.pos, b.yaw, 0, 0, nil, 0, {fall = k * 1.5})
		if b.dieT > 2.5 then b.rig:Destroy() b.gone = true end
		return
	end
	-- pick target
	local target, tpos, tdist = nil, nil, 1e9
	if not self.dead and b.team ~= self.team and (def.hostileToPlayer ~= false) then
		local d = (self.pos - b.pos).Magnitude
		target, tpos, tdist = "player", self.pos + V3(0, 3.5, 0), d
	end
	if def.fights then
		for _, o in ipairs(self.bots) do
			if o.alive and o.team ~= b.team then
				local d = (o.pos - b.pos).Magnitude
				if d < tdist then target, tpos, tdist = o, o.pos + V3(0, 3.5, 0), d end
			end
		end
	end
	local eye = b.pos + V3(0, 4, 0)
	local see = false
	if target ~= nil and tdist < (def.sight or 120) then
		b.losT = (b.losT or 0) - dt
		if b.losT <= 0 or b.losTarget ~= target then
			b.losT = 0.12 + math.random() * 0.06
			b.losTarget = target
			b.losOK = hasLOS(self.world, eye, tpos)
		end
		see = b.losOK == true
	else
		b.losOK = false
	end
	local want = V3(0, 0, 0)
	if see then
		b.state = "fight"
		b.react = b.react + dt
		local to = tpos - b.pos
		local flat = V3(to.X, 0, to.Z)
		local fy = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z)
		b.yaw = b.yaw + wrapang(fy - b.yaw) * math.min(1, dt * 9)
		local dir = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or V3(0, 0, 0)
		local w = def.weapon
		if w.melee then
			if flat.Magnitude > (w.range or 4) * 0.8 then want = dir * (def.speed or 12) end
		else
			local keep = def.keep or 30
			b.strT = b.strT - dt
			if b.strT <= 0 then b.strT = 0.7 + math.random() * 1.2 b.strafe = -b.strafe end
			if flat.Magnitude > keep + 8 then want = dir * (def.speed or 12)
			elseif flat.Magnitude < keep - 8 then want = -dir * (def.speed or 12) * 0.7 end
			want = want + V3(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X) * b.strafe * (def.speed or 12) * 0.6
		end
		b.cool = b.cool - dt
		if b.cool <= 0 and b.react > (def.reaction or 0.4) and flat.Magnitude < (w.range or 200) then
			b.cool = 1 / w.rate * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.5)
			if w.melee then
				if flat.Magnitude < (w.range or 4) then
					if target == "player" then self:DamagePlayer(w.dmg, b) elseif target then self:DamageBot(target, w.dmg, false, false, b) end
				end
			else
				local aimp = tpos + V3((math.random() - 0.5), (math.random() - 0.5), (math.random() - 0.5)) * ((w.spread or 0.05) * tdist * 1.2)
				local d = (aimp - eye).Unit
				self.fx:Tracer(eye + d * 1.5, eye + d * math.min(tdist, 60), w.tracer or C3(1, 0.5, 0.3), 0.05)
				if w.proj then
					self:AddProj(eye + d * 2, d * w.projSpeed, w.dmg, b, w.projColor, 0)
				elseif math.random() < (def.acc or 0.4) then
					if target == "player" then self:DamagePlayer(w.dmg, b) elseif target then self:DamageBot(target, w.dmg, false, false, b) end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		b.react = 0
		b.state = "wander"
		if def.patrol then
			-- head toward last known/player position slowly
			local to = self.pos - b.pos
			if not self.dead and to.Magnitude < (def.hear or 90) then
				local flat = V3(to.X, 0, to.Z)
				if flat.Magnitude > 3 then want = flat.Unit * (def.speed or 12) * 0.8 b.yaw = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z) end
			end
		end
		if b.goal then
			local to = b.goal - b.pos
			local flat = V3(to.X, 0, to.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude > (b.goalR or 4) then
				local dir = flat.Unit
				if (b.sideT or 0) > 0 then
					b.sideT = b.sideT - dt
					dir = (dir * 0.3 + V3(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X) * (b.sideDir or 1)).Unit
				end
				want = dir * (def.speed or 12)
				b.yaw = math.atan2(-dir.X, -dir.Z)
			else
				b.atGoal = true
			end
		end
		if want.Magnitude == 0 and def.wander ~= false and not b.goal then
			b.wanderT = (b.wanderT or 0) - dt
			if b.wanderT <= 0 then b.wanderT = 1 + math.random() * 2 b.wanderYaw = math.random() * 6.28 end
			want = fwd(b.wanderYaw) * (def.speed or 12) * 0.4
			b.yaw = b.wanderYaw
		end
	end
	-- movement
	local cur = V3(b.vel.X, 0, b.vel.Z)
	cur = cur + (want - cur) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
	local vy = b.vel.Y - 60 * dt
	local np, nv, g, blocked = MG.Move(self.world, b.pos, V3(cur.X, vy, cur.Z), b.half, dt, 1.2)
	if blocked then
		if b.goal and (b.sideT or 0) <= 0 then b.sideT = 0.7 b.sideDir = (math.random() < 0.5) and 1 or -1 end
		if b.state == "wander" then b.wanderT = 0 end
		if g and b.state == "fight" and math.random() < 0.05 then nv = V3(nv.X, 24, nv.Z) end
	end
	b.pos, b.vel, b.ground = np, nv, g
	if b.pos.Y < -60 then b.hp = 0 b.alive = false b.dieT = 0 end
	b.phase = b.phase + dt * 11 * (cur.Magnitude / 12)
	b.rig:Pose(b.pos, b.yaw, b.phase, math.min(1, cur.Magnitude / 12), (b.state == "fight" and not def.weapon.melee) and 0 or nil, 0, (def.weapon.melee and b.state == "fight") and {armUp = true} or nil)
end

-- ═════ main update ═════
function FPS:Update(dt)
	self.t = self.t + dt
	local ctx, inp, h = self.ctx, self.ctx.Input, self.hud
	local w = self.weapons[self.cur]
	if self.cool > 0 then self.cool = self.cool - dt end
	if self.msgT then self.msgT = self.msgT - dt if self.msgT <= 0 then h.msg.Text = "" self.msgT = nil end end
	h.hit.TextTransparency = math.min(1, h.hit.TextTransparency + dt * 5)
	if h.vig.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then h.vig.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, h.vig.BackgroundTransparency + dt * 0.8) end
	-- low-health warning: a slow red pulse that never covers the screen
	if not self.dead and self.hp > 0 and self.hp < self.maxhp * 0.3 then
		local pulse = 0.84 + 0.05 * math.sin(self.t * 5)
		if h.vig.BackgroundTransparency > pulse then h.vig.BackgroundTransparency = pulse end
	end
	-- look
	local dx, dy = inp:Look()
	if not self.dead then
		local sens = 1 - self.ads * 0.55
		self.yaw = self.yaw - dx * sens
		self.pitch = clamp(self.pitch - dy * sens, -1.45, 1.45)
	end
	if self.recoil > 0 then
		local r = math.min(self.recoil, dt * 0.9)
		self.pitch = clamp(self.pitch + r * 0.7, -1.45, 1.45)
		self.recoil = self.recoil - r
	end
	-- weapon select
	for i = 1, 5 do if inp:Pressed("w" .. i) then self:SelectWeapon(i) end end
	if inp:Pressed("swap") then
		local n = self.cur
		for _ = 1, #self.weapons do n = n % #self.weapons + 1 if not self.weapons[n].locked then break end end
		self:SelectWeapon(n)
	end
	local wh = inp:Wheel()
	if wh ~= 0 then self:SelectWeapon(clamp(self.cur + (wh > 0 and -1 or 1), 1, #self.weapons)) end
	if self.dead then
		self.respawnT = self.respawnT - dt
		if self.respawnT <= 0 and not self.cfg.noAutoRespawn then self:Respawn() end
		self.scene:SetCam(self.pos + V3(0, 1.5, 0), self.yaw, -0.5, 0.3)
	else
		-- movement
		local ax = inp:Axis()
		local crouching = inp:Down("crouch")
		self.crouch = approach(self.crouch, crouching and 1 or 0, dt * 6)
		local spd = self.speed * (crouching and 0.55 or 1) * ((inp:Down("sprint") and not crouching) and 1.5 or 1) * (1 - self.ads * 0.35)
		if self.cfg.slowWhileShooting and self.cool > 0 then spd = spd * 0.6 end
		local f, r = fwd(self.yaw), rgt(self.yaw)
		local want = (f * ax.Y + r * ax.X) * spd
		local cur = V3(self.vel.X, 0, self.vel.Z)
		local accel = self.onGround and 14 or 3.5
		cur = cur + (want - cur) * math.min(1, dt * accel)
		local vy = self.vel.Y - (self.cfg.gravity or 62) * dt
		if inp:Pressed("jump") and self.onGround then vy = self.cfg.jump or 24 self.onGround = false end
		local half = V3(HALF.X, HALF.Y - self.crouch * 0.7, HALF.Z)
		local np, nv, g = MG.Move(self.world, self.pos, V3(cur.X, vy, cur.Z), half, dt, 1.0)
		self.pos, self.vel, self.onGround = np, nv, g
		if self.pos.Y < -80 then self:DamagePlayer(1000, "void") end
		if cur.Magnitude > 2 and self.onGround then self.bob = self.bob + dt * cur.Magnitude * 0.55 end
		-- aim down sights
		local wantAds = (inp:Down("aim") and w and w.zoom) and 1 or 0
		self.ads = approach(self.ads, wantAds, dt * 8)
		self.scene.fov = lerp(self.fov0, (w and w.zoom) and self.fov0 / w.zoom or self.fov0, self.ads)
		-- fire
		if w then
			if w.auto then if inp:Down("fire") then self:Shoot() end
			elseif inp:Pressed("fire") then self:Shoot() end
			if inp:Pressed("reload") then self:Reload() end
			if self.autoRel then self.autoRel = false self:Reload() end
			if self.reloadT > 0 then
				self.reloadT = self.reloadT - dt
				if self.reloadT <= 0 then
					local need = w.magSize - w.mag
					local take = math.min(need, w.reserve)
					w.mag = w.mag + take
					w.reserve = w.reserve - take
				end
			end
		end
		-- pickups
		for i = #self.pickups, 1, -1 do
			local p = self.pickups[i]
			p.t = p.t + dt
			p.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.pos + V3(0, 1.6 + math.sin(p.t * 3) * 0.3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, p.t * 2, 0)
			if (p.pos - self.pos).Magnitude < 3.2 and self:Give(p.kind, p.amount) then
				p.part:Destroy()
				table.remove(self.pickups, i)
			end
		end
		-- camera
		local eye = self:Eye()
		if self.tp then
			local back = self:Aim() * -(self.camDist * (1 - self.ads * 0.5)) + rgt(self.yaw) * ((self.cfg.camSide or 1.8) + 1.0 * self.ads) + V3(0, 1.4, 0)
			local m = back.Magnitude
			local t = self.world:Ray(eye, back / m, m)
			local dist = t and math.max(t - 0.6, 1.5) or m
			self.scene.fov = self.fov0 * (1 - self.ads * 0.3)
			self.scene:SetCam(eye + back / m * dist, self.yaw, self.pitch)
		else
			self.scene:SetCam(eye + V3(0, math.sin(self.bob * 2) * 0.12, 0), self.yaw, self.pitch, math.sin(self.bob) * 0.008)
		end
		if self.cfg.fpUpdate then self.cfg.fpUpdate(self, dt) end
	end
	-- viewmodel
	if not self.tp and self.vm.body then
		local cam = self.scene.cam.CFrame
		local k = self.kick
		self.kick = math.max(0, k - dt * 9)
		local sway = V3(math.sin(self.bob) * 0.04, -math.abs(math.cos(self.bob)) * 0.04, 0)
		local adsOff = self.ads
		local off = CFrame.new(lerp(0.9, 0.0, adsOff) + sway.X, lerp(-0.85, -0.45, adsOff) + sway.Y, lerp(-2.2, -1.6, adsOff) + k * 0.35)
		local base = cam * off * CFrame.Angles(k * 0.06 + (self.reloadT > 0 and 0.5 or 0), 0, 0)
		local len = self.weapons[self.cur].vmLen or 2.2
		if self.weapons[self.cur].melee then
			base = cam * CFrame.new(0.9, -0.9 + k * 0.4, -2 - k * 0.8) * CFrame.Angles(-k * 1.0, 0, -0.3)
		end
		self.vm.body.CFrame = base
		self.vm.barrel.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -len * 0.5 - len * 0.2)
		self.vm.grip.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, -0.55, 0.4) * CFrame.Angles(0.2, 0, 0)
		self.vm.hand.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0.8)
		self.flashT = (self.flashT or 0) - dt
		self.vm.flash.Transparency = (self.flashT or 0) > 0 and 0 or 1
		self.vm.flash.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -len)
		self.vm.sight.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.36, -len * 0.25)
		self.vm.mag.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, -0.55, -0.2) * CFrame.Angles(-0.12, 0, 0)
		self.vm.sleeve.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0.15, -0.55, 1.5) * CFrame.Angles(0.35, 0, 0)
		local vis = self.dead and 1 or 0
		local solid = self.vmSolid
		for i = 1, #solid do
			local pt = solid[i]
			if not (self.vmMelee and (pt == self.vm.sight or pt == self.vm.mag)) then pt.Transparency = vis end
		end
	end
	-- projectiles
	for i = #self.projs, 1, -1 do
		local p = self.projs[i]
		p.life = p.life - dt
		if p.grav then p.vel = p.vel - V3(0, p.grav * dt, 0) end
		local step = p.vel * dt
		local m = step.Magnitude
		local hitT, hb = nil, nil
		local wt = self.world:Ray(p.pos, p.vel.Unit, m)
		if wt then hitT = wt end
		if p.owner == "player" then
			for _, b in ipairs(self.bots) do
				if b.alive and (p.pos + step * 0.5 - (b.pos + V3(0, 2.5, 0))).Magnitude < 2.8 then hb = b break end
			end
		elseif not self.dead and (p.pos + step * 0.5 - (self.pos + V3(0, 2.5, 0))).Magnitude < 2.6 then
			hb = "player"
		end
		if hitT or hb or p.life <= 0 then
			if p.splash > 0 then self:Explode(p.pos, p.dmg, p.splash, p.owner == "player" and true or nil)
			elseif hb == "player" then self:DamagePlayer(p.dmg, p.owner) self.fx:Spark(p.pos, p.col or C3(1, 0.4, 0.1), 6, 8)
			elseif hb then self:DamageBot(hb, p.dmg, true) self.fx:Spark(p.pos, C3(1, 0.3, 0.1), 6, 8)
			else self.fx:Spark(p.pos, p.col or C3(1, 0.4, 0.1), 5, 6) end
			p.part:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.projs, i)
		else
			p.pos = p.pos + step
			p.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.pos)
		end
	end
	-- bots
	for i = #self.bots, 1, -1 do
		local b = self.bots[i]
		self:UpdateBot(b, dt)
		if b.gone then table.remove(self.bots, i) end
	end
	self.fx:Update(dt)
	-- hud text
	local hpv = math.floor(self.hp + 0.5)
	h.hpBar:Set(self.hp / self.maxhp)
	h.arBar:Set(self.armor / 100)
	local hpS = string.format("HP <b>%d</b>   AR <b>%d</b>", hpv, math.floor(self.armor))
	if hpS ~= self._hpS then self._hpS = hpS h.hpTxt.Text = hpS end
	if w then
		local at = w.melee and "--" or string.format("%d / %d", w.mag, w.reserve)
		if at ~= self._atS then self._atS = at h.ammoTxt.Text = at end
		local wt = (self.reloadT > 0 and "RELOADING  " or "") .. w.name
		if wt ~= self._wtS then self._wtS = wt h.wepTxt.Text = wt end
	end
	local spr = 30 + (self.onGround and 0 or 14) + self.kick * 14
	spr = math.floor(spr + 0.5)
	if spr ~= self._spr then self._spr = spr h.ring.Size = U2(0, spr, 0, spr) end
	h.cross.Visible = not (self.cfg.noCrosshair or (self.ads > 0.5 and w and w.scope))
	h.ring.Visible = not self.cfg.noCrosshair
	if self.cfg.hudUpdate then self.cfg.hudUpdate(self, dt) end
end

function FPS:Block(center, size, color, o)
	local b = self.world:Add(center, size, o and o.tag)
	local p = self.scene:Part(center, size, color, o)
	self.objs = self.objs or {}
	self.objs[#self.objs + 1] = {p = p, b = b}
	return b, p
end
function FPS:ClearLevel()
	for _, o in ipairs(self.objs or {}) do if o.p.Parent then o.p:Destroy() end end
	self.objs = {}
	self.world.list = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bots) do b.rig:Destroy() end
	self.bots = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(self.projs) do p.part:Destroy() end
	self.projs = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(self.pickups) do p.part:Destroy() end
	self.pickups = {}
end
function FPS:AliveCount(team)
	local n = 0
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bots) do if b.alive and (team == nil or b.team == team) then n = n + 1 end end
	return n
end
function FPS:Destroy() end
MG.FPS = FPS

-- ═════ GAME 1: DOOM-style (original assets) ═════
do
	local RED, DARK = C3(0.45, 0.1, 0.08), C3(0.2, 0.17, 0.16)
	local function buildLevel(F, n)
		F:ClearLevel()
		local S = 130

		end
		for i = 1, 14 + n * 2 do
			local w, d = 6 + rnd() * 16, 6 + rnd() * 16
			local x, z = (rnd() - 0.5) * (S * 1.7), (rnd() - 0.5) * (S * 1.7)

				local hgt = 8 + rnd() * 14
				F:Block(V3(x, hgt / 2, z), V3(w, hgt, d), (i % 3 == 0) and C3(0.35, 0.12, 0.1) or DARK)
				F:Block(V3(x, hgt + 0.2, z), V3(w + 0.4, 0.4, d + 0.4), C3(1, 0.3, 0.1), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, tag = "deco"})
			end
		end

		F.yaw = 0

				if (p - F.pos).Magnitude > 55 and not F.world:Overlaps(p - V3(2, 0, 2), p + V3(2, 6, 2)) then return p end
			end
			return V3(60, 3, 60)
		end
		local imp = {name = "Imp", hp = 60, speed = 11, reaction = 0.5, sight = 160, patrol = true, keep = 38, weapon = {dmg = 12 + n, rate = 0.55, proj = true, projSpeed = 48, projColor = C3(1, 0.5, 0.1), range = 150},

		local demon = {name = "Demon", hp = 140, speed = 24, reaction = 0.2, sight = 120, patrol = true, weapon = {dmg = 16 + n, rate = 1.5, melee = true, range = 5},
			rig = {shirt = C3(0.8, 0.4, 0.5), pants = C3(0.6, 0.25, 0.35), skin = C3(0.85, 0.5, 0.55), scale = 1.15, gun = false, kit = "horns", accent = C3(0.95, 0.9, 0.8)}}
		local baron = {name = "Baron", hp = 420, speed = 10, reaction = 0.6, sight = 200, patrol = true, keep = 45, weapon = {dmg = 28, rate = 0.8, proj = true, projSpeed = 58, projColor = C3(0.3, 1, 0.3), range = 200},
			rig = {shirt = C3(0.3, 0.55, 0.25), pants = C3(0.2, 0.4, 0.18), skin = C3(0.4, 0.65, 0.3), scale = 1.7, gun = false, kit = "horns", spikes = true, accent = C3(0.8, 0.85, 0.6), accent2 = C3(0.18, 0.35, 0.15)}}
		for _ = 1, 3 + n * 2 do F:AddBot(farPos(), imp) end
		for _ = 1, 2 + n do F:AddBot(farPos(), demon) end
		if n >= 3 then for _ = 1, math.floor(n / 2) do F:AddBot(farPos(), baron) end end

		for _ = 1, 5 do F:AddPickup(farPos(), "ammo", 0.8, C3(1, 0.8, 0.2)) end
		F.total = F:AliveCount()
		-- exit portal
		F.exitPos = V3(0, 0, 100)
		F.exitPart = F.scene:Part(F.exitPos + V3(0, 6, 0), V3(10, 12, 1.5), C3(0.3, 1, 0.5), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, tr = 0.55})

	MG.Register({

				},

				face.Text = self2.dead and "x_x" or (hp > 0.75 and "8-)" or hp > 0.45 and "8-|" or hp > 0.2 and "8-(" or "8-O")

				self2.hud.info.Text = string.format("E1M%d   Demons: %d / %d   Kills: %d   Best level: %d", self2.level, left, self2.total, self2.kills, hi)

					if left == 0 and not self2.dead and (self2.pos - self2.exitPos).Magnitude < 9 and not self2.leaving then

						self2.ctx.Delay(1.2, function()
							self2.level = self2.level + 1
							self2.hp = math.min(self2.maxhp, self2.hp + 25)
							buildLevel(self2, self2.level)
							self2.leaving = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			return F
		end,
	})

-- ═════ GAME 4: Call of Duty-style team deathmatch ═════
do
	local function house(F, cx, cz, col)
		local W, D, H = 30, 22, 12
		local t = 1.5
		F:Block(V3(cx, H, cz), V3(W + 2, 1, D + 2), C3(0.25, 0.2, 0.2))
		F:Block(V3(cx, 0.3, cz), V3(W, 0.6, D), C3(0.45, 0.4, 0.35))
		F:Block(V3(cx, H / 2, cz - D / 2), V3(W, H, t), col)
		F:Block(V3(cx - W / 2, H / 2, cz), V3(t, H, D), col)
		F:Block(V3(cx + W / 2, H / 2, cz), V3(t, H, D), col)
		local door = 9
		F:Block(V3(cx - (W / 2 + door / 2) / 2 - door / 4, H / 2, cz + D / 2), V3(W / 2 - door / 2, H, t), col)
		F:Block(V3(cx + (W / 2 + door / 2) / 2 + door / 4, H / 2, cz + D / 2), V3(W / 2 - door / 2, H, t), col)
		F:Block(V3(cx, H - 2.5, cz + D / 2), V3(door, 5, t), col)
		F:Block(V3(cx - 6, 3, cz - 5), V3(8, 6, 2), C3(0.3, 0.2, 0.1))
	end
	local function codMap(world, scene, F)
		F:Block(V3(0, -1, 0), V3(220, 2, 170), C3(0.45, 0.62, 0.35))
		F:Block(V3(0, 0.05, 0), V3(26, 0.2, 170), C3(0.28, 0.28, 0.3), {tag = "deco"})
		for _, w in ipairs({{0, 85, 220, 4}, {0, -85, 220, 4}, {110, 0, 4, 170}, {-110, 0, 4, 170}}) do F:Block(V3(w[1], 7, w[2]), V3(w[3], 14, w[4]), C3(0.55, 0.5, 0.42)) end
		house(F, -55, -18, C3(0.7, 0.62, 0.45))
		house(F, 55, -18, C3(0.45, 0.55, 0.7))
		for i = 1, 12 do
			local x, z = (math.random() - 0.5) * 180, (math.random() - 0.5) * 120
			if math.abs(x) > 14 then F:Block(V3(x, 2, z), V3(4 + math.random() * 4, 4, 4 + math.random() * 4), C3(0.4, 0.3, 0.18)) end
		end
		F:Block(V3(-8, 2.2, 8), V3(11, 4.4, 5), C3(0.7, 0.1, 0.1))
		F:Block(V3(10, 2.2, -10), V3(5, 4.4, 11), C3(0.15, 0.3, 0.6))
		F:Block(V3(0, 1.5, 30), V3(30, 3, 1.2), C3(0.35, 0.35, 0.35))
		F:Block(V3(0, 1.5, -45), V3(30, 3, 1.2), C3(0.35, 0.35, 0.35))
	end
