			for i, b in ipairs(HOT) do
				local f = H.Frame(bar, U2(0, 6 + (i - 1) * 54, 0, 6), U2(0, 48, 0, 48), {tr = 0.2, round = 4, stroke = 1, color = PAL[b].color, z = 10})
				slots[i] = {f = f, l = H.Label(f, "", U2(0, 0, 1, -16), U2(1, 0, 0, 16), {size = 12, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, z = 11})}
			end
			local info = H.Label(ctx.Root, "", U2(0, 14, 0, 12), U2(0.7, 0, 0, 50), {size = 18, z = 10, theme = "Accent", ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, wrap = true})
			local hl = scene:Part(V3(0, -50, 0), V3(1.05, 1.05, 1.4), C3(1, 1, 1), {tr = 0.6, mat = Enum.Material.Neon})
			local craftOv
			local function toggleCraft()
				if craftOv then craftOv:Destroy() craftOv = nil return end
				craftOv = H.Frame(ctx.Root, U2(0.5, 0, 0.45, 0), U2(0, 320, 0, 220), {anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), tr = 0.15, round = 8, stroke = 2, z = 30})
				H.Label(craftOv, "<b>CRAFTING</b>", U2(0, 0, 0, 6), U2(1, 0, 0, 24), {size = 20, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, z = 31, theme = "Accent"})
				local function row(i, text, cb) H.Button(craftOv, text, U2(0, 10, 0, 34 + (i - 1) * 44), U2(1, -20, 0, 38), cb, {z = 31}) end
				row(1, "Planks x4  (1 Wood)", function() if inv[4] >= 1 then inv[4] = inv[4] - 1 inv[8] = inv[8] + 4 else ctx.Toast("Need 1 wood") end end)
				row(2, "Copper Pickaxe (8 Copper) - faster", function() if inv[6] >= 8 and tier < 2 then inv[6] = inv[6] - 8 tier = 2 ctx.Toast("Copper pickaxe!") else ctx.Toast("Need 8 copper") end end)
				row(3, "Iron Pickaxe (10 Iron) - fastest", function() if inv[7] >= 10 and tier < 3 then inv[7] = inv[7] - 10 tier = 3 ctx.Toast("Iron pickaxe!") else ctx.Toast("Need 10 iron") end end)
				row(4, "Iron Sword (8 Iron) - more damage", function() if inv[7] >= 8 and sword < 2 then inv[7] = inv[7] - 8 sword = 2 ctx.Toast("Iron sword!") else ctx.Toast("Need 8 iron") end end)
			end
			local enemies = {}
			local acc = 0
			local function spawnEnemy(day)
				local x = clamp(pos.X + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * math.random(14, 24), 2, W - 3)
				local e = {pos = V3(x, surf[math.floor(x)] + 3, 0.5), vel = V3(0, 0, 0), hp = day and 14 or 22, slime = day, t = 0, atk = 0}
				e.part = scene:Part(e.pos, e.slime and V3(1.6, 1.2, 1) or V3(0.9, 1.8, 0.8), e.slime and C3(0.3, 0.8, 0.4) or C3(0.35, 0.5, 0.35), {tr = e.slime and 0.25 or 0})
				enemies[#enemies + 1] = e
			end
			local function screenToWorld()
				local sz = ctx.Root.AbsoluteSize
				local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
				local halfH = math.tan(math.rad(scene.cam.FieldOfView) / 2) * DIST
				local wx = camPos.X + (m.X - sz.X / 2) / (sz.Y / 2) * halfH
				local wy = camPos.Y - (m.Y - sz.Y / 2) / (sz.Y / 2) * halfH
				return V3(wx, wy, 0.5)
			end
			return {
				Update = function(self, dt)
					if inp:Pressed("craft") then toggleCraft() end
					for i = 1, 6 do if inp:Pressed("s" .. i) then sel = i end end
					if inp:Pressed("swap") then sel = sel % 6 + 1 end
					local w = inp:Wheel()
					if w ~= 0 then sel = (sel - (w > 0 and 1 or -1) - 1) % 6 + 1 end
					local ax = inp:Axis()
					local want = ax.X * 9
					local cx = vel.X + (want - vel.X) * math.min(1, dt * (onGround and 14 or 5))
					local vy = vel.Y - 55 * dt
					if inp:Down("jump") and onGround then vy = 20 end
					pos, vel, onGround = MG.Move(vox, V3(pos.X, pos.Y, 0.5), V3(cx, vy, 0), half, dt, 0.0)
					pos = V3(pos.X, pos.Y, 0.5)
					if pos.Y < -10 then hp = 0 end
					-- camera
					camPos = camPos + (V3(pos.X, pos.Y + 2, DIST) - camPos) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
					scene.cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, V3(camPos.X, camPos.Y, 0))
					scene.cam.FieldOfView = 55
					ren:Range(math.floor(camPos.X - 34), math.floor(camPos.X + 34))
					-- player visual
					if not self.body then
						self.body = ctx.NewRig(scene, {shirt = C3(0.2, 0.5, 0.9), pants = C3(0.25, 0.25, 0.4), scale = 0.36, gun = false})
					end
					self.body:Pose(pos + V3(0, 0, 0), ax.X >= 0 and -pi / 2 or pi / 2, ctx.Time * 10, math.abs(ax.X) * 0.8, nil)
					self.body.head.CFrame = self.body.head.CFrame
					-- cursor
					if ctx.IsMobile() then
						local dx, dy = inp:Look()
						cursor = V3(clamp(cursor.X + dx * 14, pos.X - 12, pos.X + 12), clamp(cursor.Y - dy * 14, pos.Y - 9, pos.Y + 9), 0.5)
						if (cursor - pos).Magnitude < 0.1 then cursor = pos + V3(2, 0, 0) end
					else
						cursor = screenToWorld()
						inp:Look()
					end
					local reach = 6.5
					local cx2, cy2 = math.floor(cursor.X), math.floor(cursor.Y)
					local inReach = (V3(cx2 + 0.5, cy2 + 0.5, 0.5) - (pos + V3(0, 1, 0))).Magnitude <= reach
					hl.CFrame = CFrame.new(V3(cx2 + 0.5, cy2 + 0.5, 0.5))
					hl.Transparency = inReach and 0.6 or 0.92
					-- attack enemy under cursor, else mine
					local hitEnemy = false
					if inp:Pressed("fire") then
						for _, e in ipairs(enemies) do
							if (e.pos + V3(0, 0.6, 0) - cursor).Magnitude < 1.6 and (e.pos - pos).Magnitude < 5 then
								e.hp = e.hp - (sword == 2 and 14 or 7)
								e.vel = V3((e.pos.X > pos.X) and 14 or -14, 12, 0)
								hitEnemy = true
								ctx.Sound("hit", 1.1, 0.9)
							end
						end
					end
					local c = vox:Get(cx2, cy2, 0)
					if inp:Down("fire") and not hitEnemy and inReach and c and c ~= 0 then
						local key = cx2 .. "," .. cy2
						if key ~= mineKey then mineKey, mineT = key, 0 end
						mineT = mineT + dt * (tier == 1 and 1 or tier == 2 and 1.8 or 3)
						if mineT >= PAL[c].hard then
							vox:Set(cx2, cy2, 0, nil)
							ren:RefreshAround(cx2, cy2, 0)
							if c == 2 then c = 1 end
							if c == 5 then c = nil end
							if c and inv[c] ~= nil then inv[c] = inv[c] + 1 end
							mineKey = nil mineT = 0
							ctx.Sound("tick", 0.9, 0.7)
						end
					else
						mineKey, mineT = nil, 0
					end
					if inp:Pressed("place") and inReach and vox:Get(cx2, cy2, 0) == nil then
						local bid = HOT[sel]
						local overlap = (cx2 + 1 > pos.X - half.X and cx2 < pos.X + half.X and cy2 + 1 > pos.Y and cy2 < pos.Y + half.Y * 2)
						if inv[bid] > 0 and not overlap then vox:Set(cx2, cy2, 0, bid) ren:RefreshAround(cx2, cy2, 0) inv[bid] = inv[bid] - 1 ctx.Sound("click", 1.2, 0.7) end
					end
					-- day night
					tod = (tod + dt / 200) % 1
					local sky, amb, day = dayColor(tod)
					scene.vp.BackgroundColor3 = sky
					scene.vp.Ambient = amb
					-- enemies
					acc = acc + dt
					if acc > (day > 0.2 and 4 or 2.5) and #enemies < 7 then acc = 0 spawnEnemy(day > 0.2) end
					for i = #enemies, 1, -1 do
						local e = enemies[i]
						local dirx = (pos.X > e.pos.X) and 1 or -1
						local near = math.abs(pos.X - e.pos.X) < 22
						local ms = near and (e.slime and 4 or 5) or 0
						local cvx = e.vel.X + (dirx * ms - e.vel.X) * math.min(1, dt * 4)
						local eh = V3(e.slime and 0.8 or 0.45, e.slime and 0.6 or 0.9, 0.3)
						local np, nv, g, blocked = MG.Move(vox, e.pos, V3(cvx, e.vel.Y - 55 * dt, 0), eh, dt, 0)
						e.t = e.t + dt
						if g and (blocked or (e.slime and math.floor(e.t * 1.2) ~= math.floor((e.t - dt) * 1.2))) and near then nv = V3(nv.X, 17, 0) end
						e.pos, e.vel = V3(np.X, np.Y, 0.5), nv
						e.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(e.pos + V3(0, eh.Y, 0))
						e.atk = e.atk - dt
						if math.abs(e.pos.X - pos.X) < 1.2 and math.abs(e.pos.Y - pos.Y) < 1.8 and e.atk <= 0 then
							e.atk = 0.9 hp = hp - (e.slime and 8 or 12) vel = V3(dirx * -12, 14, 0) scene.shake = 0.4 ctx.Sound("hit", 0.7, 1)
						end
						if e.hp <= 0 or e.pos.Y < -10 or (not e.slime and day > 0.5 and math.random() < dt * 0.3) then e.part:Destroy() table.remove(enemies, i) end
					end
					if hp <= 0 then
						hp = 100 pos = V3(W / 2 + 0.5, surf[W // 2] + 2, 0.5) vel = V3(0, 0, 0)
						for i = #enemies, 1, -1 do enemies[i].part:Destroy() table.remove(enemies, i) end
						ctx.Toast("You died - respawned")
					end
					hp = math.min(100, hp + dt * 0.8)
					for i, b in ipairs(HOT) do
						slots[i].f.BackgroundTransparency = (i == sel) and 0 or 0.6
						slots[i].l.Text = tostring(inv[b])
					end
					info.Text = string.format("HP %d   %s   Pickaxe T%d   Sword %s   Depth %d   [C] craft", math.ceil(hp), day > 0.2 and "Day" or "NIGHT", tier, sword == 2 and "Iron" or "Wood", math.max(0, surf[math.floor(clamp(pos.X, 0, W - 1))] - math.floor(pos.Y)))
				end,
				Destroy = function(self) end,
			}
		end,
	})
end

-- ═════ GAME 3: Roblox 2014-style (classic baseplate obby, studs, smiley, sword) ═════
do
	MG.Register({
		id = "roblox", name = "Roblox 2014", tagline = "Classic baseplate, studs and a sword - finish the obby, collect coins", tags = {"3D", "TPS", "Classic", "PC", "Mobile"},
		color = C3(0.2, 0.55, 0.95), controlsPC = "WASD move - Hold RMB to rotate camera - Wheel zoom - Space jump - LMB swing sword",
		controlsMobile = "Left stick move - Drag right side to rotate camera - JUMP / SWORD",
		Start = function(ctx)
			local H = MG.HUD
			local data = ctx.Data()
			local coins, stage, checkpoint = 0, 0, V3(0, 3, 40)
			local movers, lavas, coinParts, pads = {}, {}, {}, {}
			local F
			local function stud(p) p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs return p end
			local function map(world, scene, self2)
				local _, base = self2:Block(V3(0, -1, 0), V3(512, 2, 512), C3(0.4, 0.62, 0.3), {mat = Enum.Material.Plastic})
				stud(base)
				self2:Block(V3(0, 0.05, 40), V3(14, 0.2, 14), C3(0.2, 0.6, 1), {tag = "deco", solid = false})
				local x, y, z = 0, 2, 20
				local cols = {C3(0.96, 0.8, 0.19), C3(0.77, 0.16, 0.11), C3(0.05, 0.41, 0.67), C3(0.29, 0.59, 0.29), C3(0.41, 0.25, 0.63), C3(0.85, 0.52, 0.25)}
				local seq = 0
				for i = 1, 34 do
					local gap = 11 + math.random() * 4
					local rise = (i % 4 == 0) and 3 or ((i % 3 == 0) and 1.5 or 0)
					z = z - gap
					x = clamp(x + (math.random() - 0.5) * 12, -35, 35)
					y = y + rise
					local sz = V3(8 - (i > 20 and 3 or 0), 1.2, 8 - (i > 20 and 3 or 0))
					local kind = (i % 9 == 0) and "lava" or ((i % 7 == 0) and "move" or "plain")
					if kind == "lava" then
						-- safe platforms either side of a lava pool
						self2:Block(V3(x, y, z + 8), V3(8, 1.2, 8), cols[(i % #cols) + 1])
						local b = self2.world:Add(V3(x, y - 0.3, z), V3(12, 0.6, 12), "lava")
						b.solid = false
						local p = self2.scene:Part(V3(x, y - 0.3, z), V3(12, 0.6, 12), C3(1, 0.3, 0.05), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon})
						self2.objs[#self2.objs + 1] = {p = p, b = b}
						lavas[#lavas + 1] = b
						self2:Block(V3(x, y, z - 8), V3(8, 1.2, 8), cols[(i % #cols) + 1])
						z = z - 8
					elseif kind == "move" then
						local b, p = self2:Block(V3(x, y, z), sz, C3(0.9, 0.9, 0.95), {mat = Enum.Material.Plastic})
						movers[#movers + 1] = {box = b, part = p, base = V3(x, y, z), amp = 10, spd = 1 + math.random() * 0.8, ph = math.random() * 6}
					else
						local b, p = self2:Block(V3(x, y, z), sz, cols[(i % #cols) + 1], {mat = Enum.Material.Plastic})
						stud(p)
					end
					if i % 6 == 0 then
						seq = seq + 1
						local cp = self2.scene:Part(V3(x, y + 0.75, z), V3(6, 0.3, 6), C3(0.2, 1, 0.5), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon})
						self2.objs[#self2.objs + 1] = {p = cp, b = self2.world:Add(V3(0, -90, 0), V3(1, 1, 1), "dummy")}
						pads[#pads + 1] = {pos = V3(x, y + 2, z), part = cp, n = seq}
					end
					if i % 2 == 0 then
						local cn = self2.scene:Part(V3(x, y + 3.5, z), V3(1.6, 1.6, 0.3), C3(1, 0.85, 0.1), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder})
						coinParts[#coinParts + 1] = {part = cn, pos = V3(x, y + 3.5, z), t = math.random() * 6}
					end
					if i == 34 then
						self2:Block(V3(x, y, z - 10), V3(16, 1.2, 16), C3(1, 0.85, 0.2), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon})
						pads.win = V3(x, y + 3, z - 10)
					end
				end
				for _, d in ipairs(self2.world.list) do if d.tag == "dummy" then self2.world:Remove(d) end end
			end
			F = MG.NewFPS(ctx, {
				sky = C3(0.45, 0.68, 0.95), ambient = C3(0.7, 0.7, 0.72), fov = 70, speed = 16, gravity = 196, jump = 50, tp = true, camSide = 0, rmbLook = true, noCrosshair = true,
				respawn = 1.5, team = "a", hp = 100, spawn = V3(0, 3, 40),
				weapons = {{name = "Linked Sword", dmg = 30, rate = 2, melee = true, range = 9, vmLen = 1.4, vmColor = C3(0.6, 0.6, 0.7)}},
				map = map,
				respawnPos = function() return checkpoint end,
				onBotDead = function(self2, b, byPlayer) coins = coins + 5 ctx.Delay(6, function() if F.bots then F:AddBot(V3((math.random() - 0.5) * 80, 3, 30 + math.random() * 30), F.zdef) end end) end,
			})
			F.zdef = {name = "Zombie", hp = 60, speed = 11, team = "b", reaction = 0.3, sight = 80, patrol = true, hear = 70, weapon = {dmg = 10, rate = 1.2, melee = true, range = 5},
				rig = {shirt = C3(0.3, 0.5, 0.3), pants = C3(0.2, 0.3, 0.5), skin = C3(0.5, 0.7, 0.4), gun = false, kit = "zombie"}}
			for i = 1, 4 do F:AddBot(V3((i - 2.5) * 20, 3, 70 + i * 6), F.zdef) end
			local rig = ctx.NewRig(F.scene, {shirt = C3(0.05, 0.41, 0.67), pants = C3(0.29, 0.59, 0.29), skin = C3(0.97, 0.8, 0.2), gun = false, kit = "blocky", hair = C3(0.2, 0.15, 0.1)})
			local faceYaw = 0
			local coinLbl = H.Label(ctx.Root, "", U2(1, -14, 0, 14), U2(0, 260, 0, 60), {size = 18, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 10})
			F.cfg.fpUpdate = function(self2, dt)
				-- moving platforms carry the player
				for _, m in ipairs(movers) do
					local old = (m.box.min + m.box.max) * 0.5
					local nx = m.base.X + math.sin(self2.t * m.spd + m.ph) * m.amp
					local c = V3(nx, m.base.Y, m.base.Z)
					local sz = m.box.max - m.box.min
					local top = old.Y + sz.Y / 2
					if self2.onGround and math.abs(self2.pos.Y - top) < 0.5 and math.abs(self2.pos.X - old.X) < sz.X / 2 and math.abs(self2.pos.Z - old.Z) < sz.Z / 2 then
						self2.pos = self2.pos + (c - old)
					end
					m.box.min, m.box.max = c - sz * 0.5, c + sz * 0.5
					self2.world:Sync(m.box)
					m.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(c)
				end
				for _, l in ipairs(lavas) do
					if self2.pos.X > l.min.X and self2.pos.X < l.max.X and self2.pos.Z > l.min.Z and self2.pos.Z < l.max.Z and self2.pos.Y < l.max.Y + 0.4 and self2.pos.Y > l.min.Y - 3 then self2:DamagePlayer(1000, "lava") end
				end
				for _, p in ipairs(pads) do
					if p.part and (p.pos - self2.pos).Magnitude < 5 and p.n > stage then
						stage = p.n checkpoint = p.pos + V3(0, 1, 0)
						p.part.Color = C3(1, 0.9, 0.2)
						ctx.Toast("Checkpoint " .. stage)
					end
				end
				for i = #coinParts, 1, -1 do
					local c = coinParts[i]
					c.t = c.t + dt
					c.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.pos + V3(0, math.sin(c.t * 3) * 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, c.t * 3, pi / 2)
					if (c.pos - (self2.pos + V3(0, 2.5, 0))).Magnitude < 3 then coins = coins + 1 c.part:Destroy() table.remove(coinParts, i) ctx.Sound("click", 1.8, 0.8) end
				end
				if pads.win and (pads.win - self2.pos).Magnitude < 10 and not self2.won then
					self2.won = true
					coins = coins + 50
					data.wins = (data.wins or 0) + 1
					self2:Msg("YOU WIN THE OBBY! +50", 3)
					ctx.Delay(3.5, function() ctx.Restart() end)
				end
				if coins > (data.best or 0) then data.best = coins end
				-- character faces the walking direction, like the old days
				local v = V3(self2.vel.X, 0, self2.vel.Z)
				if v.Magnitude > 2 then faceYaw = math.atan2(-v.X, -v.Z) end
				local swing = self2.kick > 0.1
				rig:Pose(self2.pos, faceYaw, self2.bob * 1.5, math.min(1, v.Magnitude / 12), nil, 0, swing and {armUp = true} or nil)
				rig:SetVisible(not self2.dead)
				coinLbl.Text = string.format("<b>Coins:</b> %d   <b>Best:</b> %d\nCheckpoint: %d   Wins: %d", coins, data.best or 0, stage, data.wins or 0)
			end
			return F
		end,
	})
end

-- ═════ GAME 6: Garry's Mod-style sandbox ═════
do
	local KINDS = {
		{"Crate", V3(4, 4, 4), C3(0.6, 0.42, 0.22), 1},
		{"Barrel", V3(3, 4.5, 3), C3(0.75, 0.15, 0.12), 0.8},
		{"Ball", V3(4, 4, 4), C3(0.2, 0.55, 0.95), 1.4},
		{"Plank", V3(12, 1, 3), C3(0.7, 0.55, 0.3), 0.8},
		{"Pillar", V3(2, 10, 2), C3(0.8, 0.8, 0.85), 0.5},
		{"Cube", V3(2, 2, 2), C3(0.3, 0.9, 0.5), 1},
	}
	local TOOLS = {"Remove", "Paint", "Grow", "Shrink", "Rocket", "Freeze"}
	MG.Register({
		id = "gmod", name = "Garry's Mod", tagline = "Sandbox: spawn props & NPCs, Physgun, Toolgun - build anything", tags = {"3D", "FPS", "Sandbox", "PC", "Mobile"},
		color = C3(0.95, 0.6, 0.1), controlsPC = "WASD - Mouse - E spawn menu - 1 Physgun (hold LMB, wheel distance, RMB freeze) - 2 Toolgun (R mode) - 3 Pistol",
		controlsMobile = "Left stick - Right side look - USE (spawn menu) / FIRE / TOOL MODE / SWAP",
		Start = function(ctx)
			local H = MG.HUD
			local F
			local props = {}
			local held, holdDist, toolMode, menuOv = nil, 20, 1, nil
			local function lockMouse(on) local i = ctx.Input i.lockMouse = on i:ApplyMouse() end
			local function propOf(box) return box and box.data end
			local function addProp(kind, pos)
				local k = KINDS[kind]
				local size = k[2]
				local p = {kind = kind, size = size, pos = pos, vel = V3(0, 0, 0), bounce = k[4] == 1.4 and 0.6 or 0.15, frozen = false, rot = 0}
				p.part = F.scene:Part(pos + V3(0, size.Y / 2, 0), size, k[3], {shape = kind == 3 and Enum.PartType.Ball or nil})
				p.box = F.world:Add(pos + V3(0, size.Y / 2, 0), size, "prop", p)
				props[#props + 1] = p
				return p
			end
			local function removeProp(p)
				if p.part.Parent then p.part:Destroy() end
				F.world:Remove(p.box)
				local i = table.find(props, p)
				if i then table.remove(props, i) end
				if held == p then held = nil end
			end
			local function map(world, scene, self2)
				self2:Block(V3(0, -1, 0), V3(400, 2, 400), C3(0.35, 0.37, 0.4))
				for i = -4, 4 do
					self2:Block(V3(i * 40, 0.05, 0), V3(0.4, 0.1, 400), C3(0.55, 0.57, 0.6), {tag = "deco", solid = false})
					self2:Block(V3(0, 0.05, i * 40), V3(400, 0.1, 0.4), C3(0.55, 0.57, 0.6), {tag = "deco", solid = false})
				end
				for _, w in ipairs({{0, 200, 400, 4}, {0, -200, 400, 4}, {200, 0, 4, 400}, {-200, 0, 4, 400}}) do self2:Block(V3(w[1], 10, w[2]), V3(w[3], 20, w[4]), C3(0.25, 0.27, 0.3)) end
				self2:Block(V3(40, 8, -60), V3(30, 16, 20), C3(0.5, 0.5, 0.58))
			end
			F = MG.NewFPS(ctx, {
				sky = C3(0.55, 0.7, 0.85), ambient = C3(0.7, 0.7, 0.72), fov = 80, speed = 20, gravity = 70, jump = 28, team = "a", respawn = 2, spawn = V3(0, 3, 30),
				weapons = {
					{name = "Physgun", tool = true, magSize = 0, mag = 0, vmColor = C3(0.9, 0.5, 0.1), vmLen = 2.4},
					{name = "Toolgun", tool = true, magSize = 0, mag = 0, vmColor = C3(0.2, 0.7, 0.9), vmLen = 2.2},
					{name = "Pistol", dmg = 30, rate = 4, spread = 0.01, mag = 18, reserve = 400, reload = 1.2, vmLen = 1.6, recoil = 0.01},
				},
				map = map,
				onWorldHit = function(self2, box, p, d)
					local pr = propOf(box)
					if pr and not pr.frozen then pr.vel = pr.vel + d * 25 + V3(0, 6, 0) end
				end,
				extraKeys = {},
			})
			-- the FPS scheme already has E as "use": reuse as spawn menu
			local function spawnMenu()
				if menuOv then menuOv:Destroy() menuOv = nil lockMouse(true) return end
				lockMouse(false)
				menuOv = H.Frame(ctx.Root, U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), U2(0, 360, 0, 40 + math.ceil((#KINDS + 4) / 2) * 44), {anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), tr = 0.15, round = 8, stroke = 2, z = 30})
				H.Label(menuOv, "<b>SPAWN MENU</b>", U2(0, 0, 0, 6), U2(1, 0, 0, 24), {size = 20, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, z = 31, theme = "Accent"})
				local items = {}
				for i, k in ipairs(KINDS) do items[#items + 1] = {k[1], function() local at = F.pos + fwd(F.yaw) * 14 + V3(0, 6, 0) addProp(i, at) end} end
				items[#items + 1] = {"Friendly NPC", function() F:AddBot(F.pos + fwd(F.yaw) * 16, {name = "NPC", hp = 100, speed = 8, team = "npc", hostileToPlayer = false, wander = true, weapon = {dmg = 0, rate = 1, melee = true, range = 1}, rig = {gun = false, shirt = C3(0.4, 0.8, 0.5)}}) end}
				items[#items + 1] = {"Hostile NPC", function() F:AddBot(F.pos + fwd(F.yaw) * 30, {name = "Zombie", hp = 80, speed = 11, team = "b", patrol = true, reaction = 0.3, weapon = {dmg = 8, rate = 1.2, melee = true, range = 5}, rig = {gun = false, skin = C3(0.5, 0.7, 0.4)}}) end}
				items[#items + 1] = {"Clear all props", function() for i = #props, 1, -1 do removeProp(props[i]) end end}
				items[#items + 1] = {"Close", function() spawnMenu() end}
				for i, it in ipairs(items) do
					local col, row = (i - 1) % 2, (i - 1) // 2
					H.Button(menuOv, it[1], U2(0, 10 + col * 175, 0, 34 + row * 44), U2(0, 165, 0, 38), it[2], {z = 31})
				end
			end
			local baseUpdate = F.Update
			local status = H.Label(ctx.Root, "", U2(0.5, 0, 0, 14), U2(0.6, 0, 0, 24), {size = 18, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0), z = 12, theme = "Accent"})
			local beam = F.scene:Part(V3(0, -90, 0), V3(0.1, 0.1, 1), C3(1, 0.6, 0.1), {mat = Enum.Material.Neon, tr = 1})
			F.Update = function(self2, dt)
				if ctx.Input:Pressed("use") then spawnMenu() end
				baseUpdate(self2, menuOv and 0 or dt)
				if menuOv then return end
				local inp = ctx.Input
				local w = self2.weapons[self2.cur]
				local o, d = self2:Eye(), self2:Aim()
				beam.Transparency = 1
				if w.name == "Physgun" then
					if inp:Down("fire") then
						if not held then
							local best, bp = 70, nil
							for _, p in ipairs(props) do
								local t = rayBox(o, d, p.box.min, p.box.max, best)
								if t and t < best then best, bp = t, p end
							end
							if bp then held, holdDist = bp, math.max(6, best) bp.frozen = false end
						end
						if held then
							holdDist = clamp(holdDist + inp:Wheel() * 2, 5, 70)
							local target = o + d * holdDist
							local cur = held.pos + V3(0, held.size.Y / 2, 0)
							held.vel = (target - cur) * 12
							local tp = o + d * holdDist
							beam.Transparency = 0.3
							local mid = (o + V3(0, -0.8, 0) + cur) * 0.5
							beam.Size = V3(0.12, 0.12, (cur - o).Magnitude)
							beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, cur)
						end
					else
						held = nil
					end
					if held and inp:Down("aim") then held.frozen = true held.vel = V3(0, 0, 0) held = nil ctx.Toast("Frozen") end
				else
					held = nil
				end
				if w.name == "Toolgun" then
					if inp:Pressed("reload") then toolMode = toolMode % #TOOLS + 1 ctx.Toast("Tool: " .. TOOLS[toolMode]) end
					if inp:Pressed("fire") then
						local best, bp = 90, nil
						for _, p in ipairs(props) do
							local t = rayBox(o, d, p.box.min, p.box.max, best)
							if t and t < best then best, bp = t, p end
						end
						if bp then
							local m = TOOLS[toolMode]
							if m == "Remove" then removeProp(bp)
							elseif m == "Paint" then local pal = MG.Palette(os.clock()) bp.part.Color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.7, 1)
							elseif m == "Grow" then bp.size = bp.size * 1.25
							elseif m == "Shrink" then bp.size = bp.size * 0.8
							elseif m == "Rocket" then bp.frozen = false bp.vel = bp.vel + V3(0, 60, 0) + d * 30
							elseif m == "Freeze" then bp.frozen = not bp.frozen bp.vel = V3(0, 0, 0) end
							if m == "Grow" or m == "Shrink" then bp.part.Size = bp.size bp.box.min = bp.pos - V3(bp.size.X / 2, 0, bp.size.Z / 2) bp.box.max = bp.pos + V3(bp.size.X / 2, bp.size.Y, bp.size.Z / 2) end
							self2.fx:Spark(o + d * best, C3(0.3, 0.9, 1), 8, 8)
						end
					end
				end
				-- prop physics
				for _, p in ipairs(props) do
					if not p.frozen then
						local v = p.vel - V3(0, 60 * dt, 0)
						local adapter = {Solid = function(_, mn, mx) return F.world:OverlapsExcept(mn, mx, p.box) ~= nil end}
						local half = V3(p.size.X / 2, p.size.Y / 2, p.size.Z / 2)
						local np, nv, g = MG.Move(adapter, p.pos, v, half, dt, 0)
						if g then nv = V3(nv.X * 0.92, nv.Y, nv.Z * 0.92) end
						if p.bounce > 0.2 and math.abs(v.Y) > 8 and nv.Y == 0 then nv = V3(nv.X, -v.Y * p.bounce, nv.Z) end
						p.pos, p.vel = np, nv
						if p.pos.Y < -50 then removeProp(p) break end
					end
					local c = p.pos + V3(0, p.size.Y / 2, 0)
					p.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(c)
					p.box.min, p.box.max = c - p.size * 0.5, c + p.size * 0.5
				end
				-- player pushes props
				for _, p in ipairs(props) do
					if not p.frozen and (V3(self2.pos.X, 0, self2.pos.Z) - V3(p.pos.X, 0, p.pos.Z)).Magnitude < p.size.X / 2 + 2.2 and math.abs(p.pos.Y - self2.pos.Y) < 4 then
						local push = V3(self2.vel.X, 0, self2.vel.Z)
						if push.Magnitude > 3 then p.vel = p.vel + push * 0.4 end
					end
				end
				status.Text = string.format("Tool: %s%s   Props: %d   [E] spawn menu", w.name, w.name == "Toolgun" and (" (" .. TOOLS[toolMode] .. ")") or "", #props)
			end
			addProp(1, V3(10, 0, 10)) addProp(2, V3(16, 0, 10)) addProp(3, V3(-8, 6, 12))
			return F
		end,
	})
end

-- ═════ GAME 7: Mortal Kombat-style arcade fighter (2D, original ninjas, no gore) ═════
do
	local ROSTER = {
		{name = "EMBER", color = C3(0.95, 0.45, 0.1), proj = C3(1, 0.5, 0.1), diff = 0.25, spd = 1.0},
		{name = "FROST", color = C3(0.3, 0.7, 1), proj = C3(0.6, 0.9, 1), diff = 0.4, spd = 1.05},
		{name = "VOLT", color = C3(0.95, 0.9, 0.2), proj = C3(1, 1, 0.5), diff = 0.55, spd = 1.15},
		{name = "VENOM", color = C3(0.4, 0.85, 0.3), proj = C3(0.5, 1, 0.3), diff = 0.7, spd = 1.1},
		{name = "SHADOW KING", color = C3(0.55, 0.15, 0.75), proj = C3(0.8, 0.3, 1), diff = 0.9, spd = 1.25},
	}
	local ATK = {
		punch = {dur = 0.32, hit0 = 0.1, hit1 = 0.2, dmg = 7, reach = 78, high = true, push = 60, stun = 0.28},
		kick = {dur = 0.46, hit0 = 0.16, hit1 = 0.28, dmg = 10, reach = 100, high = false, push = 110, stun = 0.38},
		special = {dur = 0.55, hit0 = 0.25, hit1 = 0.26, dmg = 0, reach = 0, push = 0, stun = 0},
		uppercut = {dur = 0.55, hit0 = 0.12, hit1 = 0.3, dmg = 14, reach = 70, high = true, push = 40, stun = 0.6},
	}
	local function newFighter(color, x, facing, ai)
		return {x = x, y = 0, vy = 0, face = facing, hp = 100, state = "idle", st = 0, color = color, ai = ai, atk = nil, atkT = 0, hitDone = false, combo = 0, sp = 0, spCool = 0,
			stun = 0, block = false, crouch = false, ko = false, vx = 0, aiT = 0, wins = 0, walk = 0, win = false}
	end
	MG.Register({
		id = "mk", name = "Mortal Kombat Arcade", tagline = "Ladder fighter: 5 opponents, best of 3, special moves and a finishing move", tags = {"2D", "Fighter", "PC", "Mobile"},
		color = C3(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), controlsPC = "A/D move - W jump - S crouch - J punch - K kick - L block - U special - W+J uppercut",
		controlsMobile = "D-pad move/jump/crouch - PUNCH / KICK / BLOCK / SPECIAL buttons",
		Start = function(ctx)
			local H = MG.HUD
			local data = ctx.Data()
			local root = ctx.Root
			local inp = ctx.Input
			inp:SetScheme({
				{id = "punch", name = "Punch", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.J}, mouse = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, label = "PUNCH", slot = 1},
				{id = "kick", name = "Kick", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.K}, label = "KICK", slot = 2},
				{id = "block", name = "Block", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.L, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift}, label = "BLOCK", slot = 3},
				{id = "special", name = "Special", keys = {Enum.KeyCode.U, Enum.KeyCode.E}, mouse = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, label = "SPEC", slot = 4},
			}, {look = false, dpad = true})
			-- background
			local bg = new("Frame", root, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.1, 0.05, 0.12), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1})
			local grad = new("UIGradient", bg, {Rotation = 90})
			local moon = new("Frame", bg, {Size = U2(0, 120, 0, 120), Position = U2(0.7, 0, 0.12, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 0.9, 0.8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2})
			new("UICorner", moon, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
			local hills = {}
			for i = 1, 6 do
				local h = new("Frame", bg, {Size = U2(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Position = U2((i - 1) * 0.2 - 0.1, 0, 0.5 + (i % 2) * 0.05, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.15, 0.06, 0.16), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3})
				new("UICorner", h, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
				hills[i] = h
			end
			local floor = new("Frame", bg, {Size = U2(1, 0, 0.22, 0), Position = U2(0, 0, 0.78, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.1, 0.07, 0.09), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4})
			local line = new("Frame", floor, {Size = U2(1, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5})
			H.Theme(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
			local embers = {}
			for i = 1, 22 do
				local e = new("Frame", bg, {Size = U2(0, 3, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 0.6, 0.2), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3})
				embers[i] = {f = e, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), s = 0.03 + math.random() * 0.06}
			end
			local layer = new("Frame", root, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 10})
			local function mkFighter(f)
				local parts = {}
				local function P(name, z, round)
					local p = new("Frame", layer, {BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10 + z, AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5)})
					if round then new("UICorner", p, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(round, 0)}) end
					new("UIStroke", p, {Thickness = 1.5, Color = C3(0, 0, 0), Transparency = 0.2})
					parts[name] = p
					return p
				end
				P("legB", 1, 0.2) P("armB", 2, 0.3) P("torso", 3, 0.15) P("head", 4, 0.5) P("mask", 5) P("legF", 6, 0.2) P("armF", 7, 0.3)
				f.parts = parts
			end
			local P1, P2
			local S, W, Hh = 1, 800, 450
			local function gx(x) return W / 2 + x * S end
			local function layoutFighter(f, dark)
				local gy = Hh * 0.86
				local fy = gy - f.y * S
				local fc = f.face
				local th = (f.state == "ko") and (math.min(f.st * 4, 1) * 85 * fc * -1) or 0 -- body rotation (deg, CW screen)
				local rad = math.rad(th)
				local drop = (f.crouch and 34) or 0
				local lean = 0
				local aF, aB, lF, lB = 0, 0, 0, 0
				local st = f.state
				if st == "idle" then
					local b = math.sin(ctx.Time * 4 + f.x) * 6
					aF, aB = 12 + b, -8 - b
				elseif st == "walk" then
					local s = math.sin(f.walk * 9)
					aF, aB, lF, lB = -s * 40, s * 40, s * 45, -s * 45
				elseif st == "jump" then
					aF, aB, lF, lB = 40, 40, 55, -25
				elseif st == "block" then
					aF, aB = 150, 140 lean = -5
				elseif st == "punch" then
					aF, aB, lean = 92, -20, 12
				elseif st == "uppercut" then
					aF, aB, lean = 170, -20, 8
				elseif st == "kick" then
					lF, lB, aF, aB, lean = 88, 0, -30, 35, -12
				elseif st == "special" then
					aF, aB, lean = 95, 95, 6
				elseif st == "hit" then
					aF, aB, lean = -40, -35, -14
				elseif st == "win" then
					aF, aB = 170 + math.sin(ctx.Time * 8) * 12, 170 - math.sin(ctx.Time * 8) * 12
				end
				if f.crouch and st ~= "kick" then lF, lB = 60, 60 end
				local function tr(lx, ly)
					-- local (facing-right, y-up) -> screen offset, with body rotation
					local x, y = lx * fc, ly - drop
					local rx = x * math.cos(rad) - (-y) * math.sin(rad)
					local ry = x * math.sin(rad) + (-y) * math.cos(rad)
					return gx(f.x) + rx * S, fy + ry * S
				end
				local function put(p, lx, ly, w, h, rot)
					local x, y = tr(lx, ly)
					p.Position = U2(0, x, 0, y)
					p.Size = U2(0, w * S, 0, h * S)
					p.Rotation = rot + th
				end
				local function limb(p, lx, ly, len, w, phi)
					-- pivot at (lx,ly); the frame centre sits half a length along the limb direction
					local dx, dy = math.sin(math.rad(phi)), -math.cos(math.rad(phi))
					put(p, lx + dx * len * 0.5, ly + dy * len * 0.5, w, len, -phi * fc)
				end
				local c, dk = f.color, f.color:Lerp(C3(0, 0, 0), 0.55)
				local pr = f.parts
				put(pr.torso, math.sin(math.rad(lean)) * 12, 115, 46, 72, -lean * fc)
				put(pr.head, math.sin(math.rad(lean)) * 22, 166, 36, 36, 0)
				put(pr.mask, math.sin(math.rad(lean)) * 22 + 6, 170, 34, 9, 0)
				limb(pr.legB, -9, 80, 80, 20, lB) limb(pr.legF, 9, 80, 80, 20, lF)
				limb(pr.armB, -22, 147, 62, 16, aB) limb(pr.armF, 22, 147, 62, 16, aF)
				pr.torso.BackgroundColor3 = c pr.head.BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.95, 0.78, 0.62)
				pr.mask.BackgroundColor3 = dk pr.legB.BackgroundColor3 = dk pr.legF.BackgroundColor3 = dk
				pr.armB.BackgroundColor3 = c:Lerp(dk, 0.4) pr.armF.BackgroundColor3 = c
				if f.hitFlash and f.hitFlash > 0 then for _, p in pairs(pr) do p.BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1) end end
			end
			-- HUD
			local hudL = H.Bar(root, U2(0, 20, 0, 18), U2(0.42, 0, 0, 22), {color = C3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2), z = 20})
			local hudR = H.Bar(root, U2(1, -20, 0, 18), U2(0.42, 0, 0, 22), {color = C3(0.9, 0.2, 0.2), z = 20, anchor = V2(1, 0)})
			local nameL = H.Label(root, "", U2(0, 22, 0, 42), U2(0.4, 0, 0, 20), {size = 16, z = 21, theme = "Accent"})
			local nameR = H.Label(root, "", U2(1, -22, 0, 42), U2(0.4, 0, 0, 20), {size = 16, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 21, theme = "Accent"})
			local timerL = H.Label(root, "60", U2(0.5, 0, 0, 12), U2(0, 80, 0, 36), {size = 32, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0), z = 21})
			local msg = H.Label(root, "", U2(0.5, 0, 0.35, 0), U2(1, 0, 0, 80), {size = 60, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 30, theme = "Accent"})
			local comboL = H.Label(root, "", U2(0, 22, 0.3, 0), U2(0.3, 0, 0, 40), {size = 28, z = 21, color = C3(1, 0.85, 0.2)})
			local pips = H.Label(root, "", U2(0.5, 0, 0, 52), U2(0, 200, 0, 20), {size = 16, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, anchor = V2(0.5, 0), z = 21})
			local flash = H.Frame(root, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(1, 0, 1, 0), {tr = 1, color = C3(1, 1, 1), z = 40})
			local rung, round, timeLeft, phase, phaseT, shake = 1, 1, 60, "intro", 2, 0
			local projs = {}
			local finishReady = false
			local opp
			local function setupMatch()
				local r = ROSTER[rung]
				P1 = newFighter(MG.Palette(0).Accent, -200, 1, false)
				P2 = newFighter(r.color, 200, -1, true)
				for _, f in ipairs({P1, P2}) do if f.parts then for _, p in pairs(f.parts) do p:Destroy() end end mkFighter(f) end
				P2.cfg = r
				nameL.Text = "YOU" nameR.Text = r.name
				round, timeLeft, phase, phaseT = 1, 60, "intro", 2
				msg.Text = "ROUND 1"
				finishReady = false
			end
			local function resetRound()
				for _, f in ipairs({P1, P2}) do f.hp, f.x, f.y, f.vy, f.state, f.stun, f.atk, f.ko, f.crouch, f.block = 100, f == P1 and -200 or 200, 0, 0, "idle", 0, nil, false, false, false end
				P1.face, P2.face = 1, -1
				for _, p in ipairs(projs) do p.f:Destroy() end
				projs = {}
				timeLeft, phase, phaseT = 60, "intro", 1.8
				msg.Text = "ROUND " .. round
			end
			local function spark(x, y, col)
				local f = H.Frame(layer, U2(0, gx(x), 0, Hh * 0.86 - y * S), U2(0, 30, 0, 30), {tr = 0, color = col or C3(1, 0.9, 0.4), anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 25, round = 15})
				TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Size = U2(0, 70, 0, 70), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
				task.delay(0.3, function() if f.Parent then f:Destroy() end end)
			end
			local function startAtk(f, kind)
				if f.atk or f.stun > 0 or f.ko or f.y > 5 and kind == "special" then return end
				local a = ATK[kind]
				if kind == "special" and f.spCool > 0 then return end
				f.atk, f.atkT, f.hitDone, f.state = kind, 0, false, kind
				f.block = false
				if kind == "special" then f.spCool = 2.2 end
			end
			local function hurt(t, src, a, kind)
				local dmg = a.dmg
				local blocked = t.block and (t.face == -src.face)
				if blocked then dmg = dmg * 0.2 end
				t.hp = math.max(0, t.hp - dmg)
				t.hitFlash = 0.08
				src.combo = blocked and 0 or src.combo + 1
				if not blocked then t.state, t.stun, t.atk = "hit", a.stun, nil end
				t.x = t.x + src.face * (blocked and a.push * 0.25 or a.push) * 0.08
				shake = math.max(shake, blocked and 2 or 7)
				spark(t.x, 110, blocked and C3(0.6, 0.8, 1) or C3(1, 0.85, 0.4))
				ctx.Sound("hit", blocked and 1.4 or (kind == "kick" and 0.7 or 0.95), 1)
				if src == P1 and src.combo > 1 then comboL.Text = src.combo .. " HIT COMBO!" end
			end
			local function aiThink(f, o, dt)
				local cfg = f.cfg
				f.aiT = f.aiT - dt
				local dist = math.abs(o.x - f.x)
				f.face = (o.x > f.x) and 1 or -1
				f.block = false
				f.crouch = false
				if f.atk or f.stun > 0 or f.ko then return 0, false end
				-- react to incoming attacks
				if o.atk and dist < 140 and math.random() < cfg.diff * dt * 6 then f.block = true f.aiT = 0.3 end
				if f.block then return 0, false end
				if f.aiT > 0 then return f.dirHold or 0, false end
				f.aiT = 0.15 + math.random() * (0.5 - cfg.diff * 0.3)
				local r = math.random()
				f.dirHold = 0
				if dist > 260 then
					if r < 0.45 * (0.5 + cfg.diff) then startAtk(f, "special") else f.dirHold = f.face end
				elseif dist > 110 then
					if r < 0.55 then f.dirHold = f.face elseif r < 0.8 then startAtk(f, "kick") else f.dirHold = -f.face end
				else
					if r < 0.35 then startAtk(f, "punch") elseif r < 0.6 then startAtk(f, "kick") elseif r < 0.7 then startAtk(f, "uppercut") elseif r < 0.82 then f.dirHold = -f.face elseif r < 0.9 and cfg.diff > 0.5 then f.crouch = true end
				end
				return f.dirHold, false
			end
			local function updateFighter(f, o, dt, dirx, jump, crouch, blockIn)
				f.spCool = math.max(0, f.spCool - dt)
				f.hitFlash = f.hitFlash and f.hitFlash - dt or nil
				if f.ko then f.st = f.st + dt return end
				if f.stun > 0 then f.stun = f.stun - dt if f.stun <= 0 then f.state = "idle" end
				elseif f.atk then
					f.atkT = f.atkT + dt
					local a = ATK[f.atk]
					if f.atk == "special" then
						if not f.hitDone and f.atkT >= a.hit0 then
							f.hitDone = true
							local pf = H.Frame(layer, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(0, 46, 0, 26), {tr = 0.1, color = f == P1 and MG.Palette(0).Accent or f.cfg.proj, anchor = V2(0.5, 0.5), z = 22, round = 13})
							projs[#projs + 1] = {f = pf, x = f.x + f.face * 60, y = 100, dir = f.face, owner = f, life = 2.2}
							ctx.Sound("hit", 1.5, 0.8)
						end
					elseif not f.hitDone and f.atkT >= a.hit0 and f.atkT <= a.hit1 then
						local d = (o.x - f.x) * f.face
						local airDodge = o.y > 70
						local duck = o.crouch and a.high
						if d > 0 and d < a.reach and not airDodge and not duck and not o.ko then f.hitDone = true hurt(o, f, a, f.atk) end
					end
					if f.atkT >= a.dur then f.atk = nil f.state = "idle" end
				else
					f.block = blockIn and f.y == 0
					f.crouch = crouch and f.y == 0
					if f.block then f.state = "block"
					elseif f.crouch then f.state = "idle"
					elseif f.y > 0 then f.state = "jump"
					elseif dirx ~= 0 then f.state = "walk" f.walk = f.walk + dt else f.state = "idle" end
					local sp = (f.cfg and f.cfg.spd or 1) * 230
					if not f.block and not f.crouch then f.x = f.x + dirx * sp * dt end
					if jump and f.y == 0 and not f.crouch then f.vy = 640 end
					if (dirx ~= 0) == false and f.y == 0 then f.walk = 0 end
				end
				f.vy = f.vy - 1800 * dt
				f.y = math.max(0, f.y + f.vy * dt)
				if f.y == 0 and f.vy < 0 then f.vy = 0 end
				local lim = (W / S) / 2 - 60
				f.x = clamp(f.x, -lim, lim)
				-- separation
				if math.abs(f.x - o.x) < 40 and f.y < 60 and o.y < 60 then f.x = f.x - (o.x > f.x and 1 or -1) * 120 * dt end
			end
			setupMatch()
			return {
				Update = function(self, dt)
					local sz = root.AbsoluteSize
					W, Hh = math.max(sz.X, 320), math.max(sz.Y, 240)
					S = Hh / 480
					-- background (palette)
					local pal = MG.Palette(os.clock())
					grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(pal.Bg:Lerp(pal.Accent, 0.25), C3(0.03, 0.02, 0.05))
					bg.BackgroundColor3 = pal.Bg
					for i, e in ipairs(embers) do
						e.y = e.y - e.s * dt
						e.x = e.x + math.sin(ctx.Time + i) * 0.01 * dt
						if e.y < 0 then e.y = 1 e.x = math.random() end
						e.f.Position = U2(e.x, 0, e.y, 0)
						e.f.BackgroundColor3 = pal.Secondary
					end
					for i, h in ipairs(hills) do h.BackgroundColor3 = pal.Bg:Lerp(pal.Accent, 0.08 + 0.02 * i) end
					moon.BackgroundColor3 = pal.Text:Lerp(pal.Accent, 0.3)
					if shake > 0.1 then layer.Position = U2(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake) shake = shake * 0.85 else layer.Position = U2(0, 0, 0, 0) end
					P1.color = pal.Accent
					-- phases
					phaseT = phaseT - dt
					local ax = inp:Axis()
					if phase == "intro" then
						if phaseT <= 0 then phase = "fight" msg.Text = "FIGHT!" phaseT = 0 task.delay(0.8, function() if msg.Text == "FIGHT!" then msg.Text = "" end end) end
						updateFighter(P1, P2, dt, 0, false, false, false) updateFighter(P2, P1, dt, 0, false, false, false)
					elseif phase == "fight" then
						timeLeft = timeLeft - dt
						P1.face = (P2.x > P1.x) and 1 or -1
						if inp:Pressed("punch") then if ax.Y > 0.5 then startAtk(P1, "uppercut") else startAtk(P1, "punch") end end
						if inp:Pressed("kick") then startAtk(P1, "kick") end
						if inp:Pressed("special") then startAtk(P1, "special") end
						updateFighter(P1, P2, dt, ax.X, ax.Y > 0.5, ax.Y < -0.5, inp:Down("block"))
						local d2 = aiThink(P2, P1, dt)
						updateFighter(P2, P1, dt, d2, false, P2.crouch, P2.block)
						for i = #projs, 1, -1 do
							local p = projs[i]
							p.x = p.x + p.dir * 520 * dt
							p.life = p.life - dt
							local t = (p.owner == P1) and P2 or P1
							local hit = math.abs(p.x - t.x) < 34 and not t.ko and not (t.crouch and p.y > 80) and t.y < 120
							if hit then
								hurt(t, p.owner, {dmg = 12, push = 160, stun = 0.4}, "special")
								p.life = 0
							end
							if p.life <= 0 or math.abs(p.x) > (W / S) / 2 + 40 then p.f:Destroy() table.remove(projs, i)
							else p.f.Position = U2(0, gx(p.x), 0, Hh * 0.86 - p.y * S) p.f.Size = U2(0, 46 * S, 0, 26 * S) end
						end
						if P1.combo > 0 and (P1.stun > 0) then P1.combo = 0 end
						if P2.stun <= 0 and P2.state ~= "hit" and P1.combo > 0 and not P2.atk then comboL.Text = comboL.Text end
						if P1.combo == 0 or P2.stun <= 0 then if P2.stun <= 0 then P1.combo = 0 comboL.Text = "" end end
						local over = nil
						if P1.hp <= 0 then over = P2 elseif P2.hp <= 0 then over = P1 elseif timeLeft <= 0 then over = (P1.hp >= P2.hp) and P1 or P2 end
						if over then
							local lose = (over == P1) and P2 or P1
							lose.state, lose.ko, lose.st = "ko", true, 0
							over.wins = over.wins + 1
							over.state = "win"
							phase, phaseT = "ko", 2.4
							msg.Text = (lose.hp <= 0) and "K.O.!" or "TIME UP"
							flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
							ctx.Sound("boom", 1, 1)
							if over == P1 and over.wins >= 2 then
								finishReady = true msg.Text = "FINISH HIM!" phaseT = 3.5
							end
						end
					elseif phase == "ko" then
						updateFighter(P1, P2, dt, 0, false, false, false) updateFighter(P2, P1, dt, 0, false, false, false)
						if finishReady and (inp:Pressed("special") or inp:Pressed("punch")) then
							finishReady = false
							msg.Text = "FINISHED!"
							P1.state = "special"
							flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
							shake = 25
							data.finishers = (data.finishers or 0) + 1
							phaseT = math.min(phaseT, 1.2)
						end
						if phaseT <= 0 then
							finishReady = false
							flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							if P1.wins >= 2 then
								rung = rung + 1
								if rung > #ROSTER then
									msg.Text = "YOU ARE THE GRAND CHAMPION"
									data.champ = (data.champ or 0) + 1
									phase, phaseT = "end", 4
								else
									data.ladder = math.max(data.ladder or 1, rung)
									setupMatch()
								end
							elseif P2.wins >= 2 then
								msg.Text = "GAME OVER"
								phase, phaseT = "end", 3.5
							else
								round = round + 1
								resetRound()
							end
						end
					elseif phase == "end" then
						if phaseT <= 0 then ctx.Restart() end
					end
					if flash.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then flash.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, flash.BackgroundTransparency + dt * 1.5) end
					layoutFighter(P1) layoutFighter(P2)
					hudL:Set(P1.hp / 100) hudR:Set(P2.hp / 100)
					hudR.fill.AnchorPoint = V2(1, 0) hudR.fill.Position = U2(1, 0, 0, 0)
					timerL.Text = tostring(math.max(0, math.ceil(timeLeft)))
					pips.Text = string.format("%s    ROUND %d    %s", string.rep("* ", P1.wins), round, string.rep("* ", P2.wins))
					if phase == "fight" and msg.Text ~= "FIGHT!" then msg.Text = msg.Text end
				end,
			}
		end,
	})
end

-- ═════ ARCADE LAUNCHER (fullscreen, animated, palette-driven) ═════
do
	local A = {}
	MG.Arena = A
	local sg, root, grid, layout, title, sub, reloadBtn, reloadLbl, bgGrad = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	local filterTag = "All"
	local FILTERS = {"All", "3D", "2D", "FPS", "Sandbox", "PC", "Mobile", "Plugin"}
	local chips = {}
	local motes = {}
	local conn, tickAcc, lastW, launching = nil, 0, -1, false
	local TI_HOVER = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local function best(def)
		local d = MG.Data(def.id)
		return d.best or d.wins or d.ladder or d.champ
	end
	MG.BestOf = best
	local function card(parent, def, idx, order)
		local c = new("TextButton", parent, {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.05, 0.05, 0.08), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = idx, ZIndex = 5})
		new("UICorner", c, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)})
		local st = new("UIStroke", c, {Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.3, Color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
		UI.Theme(st, "Color", "Accent")
		local banner = new("Frame", c, {Size = U2(1, 0, 0, 56), BackgroundColor3 = def.color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6})
		new("UICorner", banner, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)})
		new("UIGradient", banner, {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 0.55)})
		UI.Label(banner, "<b>" .. string.upper(def.name) .. "</b>", U2(0, 10, 0, 0), U2(1, -20, 1, 0), {size = 18, z = 7, wrap = true})
		UI.Label(c, def.tagline or "", U2(0, 10, 0, 60), U2(1, -20, 0, 44), {size = 12, ya = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, z = 7, wrap = true})
		local tags = {}
		for _, t in ipairs(def.tags or {}) do tags[#tags + 1] = t end
		if def.plugin then tags[#tags + 1] = "PLUGIN" end
		UI.Label(c, table.concat(tags, " | "), U2(0, 10, 1, -40), U2(1, -20, 0, 16), {size = 11, z = 7, theme = "Secondary"})
		local b = best(def)
		UI.Label(c, b and ("Best / wins: " .. tostring(b)) or "New!", U2(0, 10, 1, -22), U2(1, -20, 0, 16), {size = 11, z = 7})
		UI.Label(c, "<b>PLAY</b>", U2(0, 10, 1, -22), U2(1, -20, 0, 16), {size = 11, z = 7, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, theme = "Accent"})
		-- pop-in / hover / press all go through one UIScale: UIGridLayout overrides a cell's Size, so size tweens never worked
		local sc = new("UIScale", c, {Scale = 0.01})
		TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, order * 0.035), {Scale = 1}):Play()
		local function look(scale, bg, thick, tr)
			TweenService:Create(sc, TI_HOVER, {Scale = scale}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(c, TI_HOVER, {BackgroundTransparency = bg}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(st, TI_HOVER, {Thickness = thick, Transparency = tr}):Play()
		end
		c.MouseEnter:Connect(function() look(1.04, 0, 3, 0) end)
		c.MouseLeave:Connect(function() look(1, 0.15, 1.5, 0.3) end)
		c.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			local t = i.UserInputType
			if t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then look(0.97, 0, 3, 0) end
		end)
		c.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then look(1, 0.15, 1.5, 0.3) end
		end)
		c.Activated:Connect(function()
			if launching or MG.Active then return end -- double taps must not start (and tear down) a game twice
			launching = true
			Util.FX.Play("open", 1, 1)
			task.defer(function() launching = false MG.Launch(def) end)
		end)
		return c
	end
	-- responsive layout: column count / card width follow the screen, header shrinks on phones
	local function fit()
		if not (grid and root) then return end
		local w = root.AbsoluteSize.X
		if w == lastW or w <= 0 then return end
		lastW = w
		local usable = w - 56
		local cols = math.max(1, math.floor((usable + 14) / 224))
		local cw = clamp(math.floor((usable - (cols - 1) * 14) / cols), 150, 320)
		layout.CellSize = U2(0, cw, 0, 150)
		local small = w < 640
		title.TextSize = small and 26 or 38
		sub.Visible = not small
		reloadBtn.Size = small and U2(0, 74, 0, 44) or U2(0, 140, 0, 44)
		reloadLbl.Text = small and "Reload" or "Reload Plugins"
	end
	local function loop(dt)
		local t = os.clock()
		for i = 1, #motes do
			local m = motes[i]
			m.y = m.y - m.s * dt
			if m.y < 0 then m.y = 1 m.x = math.random() end
			m.f.Position = U2(m.x, 0, m.y, 0)
		end
		tickAcc = tickAcc + dt
		if tickAcc > 0.08 then -- palette work is throttled; positions stay per-frame for smooth motion
			tickAcc = 0
			local pal = MG.Palette(t)
			bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(pal.Bg:Lerp(pal.Accent, 0.18), pal.Bg:Lerp(pal.Secondary, 0.1))
			for i = 1, #motes do motes[i].f.BackgroundColor3 = pal.Accent end
			UI.Retheme(t)
			fit()
		end
	end
	-- the animation loop only exists while the arcade is on screen (it used to run forever, even during games)
	local function startLoop()
		if conn or not sg then return end
		tickAcc = 1
		conn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) pcall(loop, math.min(dt, 0.05)) end)
	end
	local function stopLoop()
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
	end
	function A.Build()
		if sg then return end
		sg, root = MG.NewStage()
		root.BackgroundColor3 = C3(0.02, 0.02, 0.04)
		sg.DisplayOrder = 2147482000
		bgGrad = new("UIGradient", root, {Rotation = 120})
		for i = 1, 22 do
			local m = new("Frame", root, {Size = U2(0, 2 + (i % 3), 0, 2 + (i % 3)), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, ZIndex = 2})
			motes[i] = {f = m, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), s = 0.01 + math.random() * 0.03}
		end
		title = UI.Label(root, "<b>A R C A D E</b>", U2(0, 24, 0, 14), U2(0.6, 0, 0, 44), {size = 38, z = 6, theme = "Accent"})
		sub = UI.Label(root, "10 built-in minigames + your plugins  -  controls adapt to PC / mobile automatically", U2(0, 26, 0, 58), U2(0.8, 0, 0, 20), {size = 14, z = 6})
		UI.Button(root, "X", U2(1, -16, 0, 14), U2(0, 44, 0, 44), function() A.Close() end, {anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 10})
		reloadBtn, reloadLbl = UI.Button(root, "Reload Plugins", U2(1, -68, 0, 14), U2(0, 140, 0, 44), function() MG.ReloadPlugins() A.Refresh() end, {anchor = V2(1, 0), z = 10, size = 14})
		-- filter chips: scrollable (8 chips do not fit a phone), the active one carries an accent underline
		local row = new("ScrollingFrame", root, {Position = U2(0, 24, 0, 86), Size = U2(1, -48, 0, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 0, ZIndex = 6,
			CanvasSize = U2(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X})
		new("UIListLayout", row, {FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
		for i, t in ipairs(FILTERS) do
			local b, l = UI.Button(row, t, U2(0, 0, 0, 0), U2(0, 22 + #t * 10, 1, -4), function() filterTag = t A.Refresh() end, {z = 7, size = 14})
			b.LayoutOrder = i
			local ind = UI.Frame(b, U2(0.12, 0, 1, -6), U2(0.76, 0, 0, 3), {tr = 0, round = 2, z = 9, color = C3(1, 1, 1)})
			UI.Theme(ind, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
			chips[t] = {l = l, ind = ind}
		end
		grid = new("ScrollingFrame", root, {Position = U2(0, 24, 0, 132), Size = U2(1, -48, 1, -172), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 4, ZIndex = 5,
			CanvasSize = U2(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y})
		layout = new("UIGridLayout", grid, {CellSize = U2(0, 230, 0, 150), CellPadding = U2(0, 14, 0, 14), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
		new("UIPadding", grid, {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)})
		A.status = UI.Label(root, "", U2(0, 26, 1, -30), U2(1, -52, 0, 22), {size = 12, z = 6})
		fit()
		A.Refresh()
	end
	function A.Refresh()
		if not grid then return end
		for _, c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end end
		for t, ch in pairs(chips) do
			local on = t == filterTag
			ch.ind.Visible = on
			ch.l.Text = on and ("<b>" .. t .. "</b>") or t
		end
		local n = 0
		for i, def in ipairs(MG.Games) do
			local show = filterTag == "All"
			for _, t in ipairs(def.tags or {}) do if t == filterTag then show = true end end
			if filterTag == "Plugin" and def.plugin then show = true end
			if show then
				n = n + 1
				card(grid, def, i, n)
			end
		end
		local errs = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(MG.Plugins) do if p.err then errs = errs + 1 end end
		A.status.Text = string.format("%d games shown   |   plugins: %d file(s), %d error(s)   |   folder: %s   |   input: %s", n, #MG.Plugins, errs, MG.PluginFolder, MG.DetectPlatform())
	end
	function A.Open()
		if MG.Active then return end
		if not MG.loaded then MG.loaded = true MG.ReloadPlugins() end
		local fresh = sg == nil
		A.Build()
		sg.Enabled = true
		pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = false end)
		root.Position = U2(0, 0, 0.08, 0)
		root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = U2(0, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
		if not fresh then A.Refresh() end -- replays the card pop-in and refreshes best scores
		startLoop()
	end
	function A.Hide()
		if sg and sg.Enabled then A.wasOpen = true end -- sticky: Restart hides twice without showing in between
		if sg then sg.Enabled = false end
		stopLoop()
	end
	function A.Show()
		if A.wasOpen and sg then
			sg.Enabled = true
			pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = false end)
			A.Refresh() -- new best scores
			startLoop()
		else
			pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = true end)
		end
		A.wasOpen = false
	end
	function A.Close()
		A.wasOpen = false
		stopLoop()
		if sg then sg.Enabled = false end
		pcall(function() UIMainFrame.Visible = true end)
	end
end

function MG.Launcher()
	if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then -- [v34] Low End UI Mode: the arcade does not open
		pcall(Util.UINotify, "The Arcade is disabled in Low End UI Mode")
		return
	end
	MG.Arena.Open()
end

return MG
end)()

-- [custom] per-axis character proportions (width / height / depth), saved in SaveData
Util.CharAxis = {
	W = math.clamp(tonumber(SaveData.CharAxisW) or 1, 0.5, 3),
	H = math.clamp(tonumber(SaveData.CharAxisH) or 1, 0.5, 3),
	D = math.clamp(tonumber(SaveData.CharAxisD) or 1, 0.5, 3),
}
Util.ApplyAxis = function(cf)
	local a = Util.CharAxis
	if a.W == 1 and a.H == 1 and a.D == 1 then return cf end
	local p = cf.Position
	return cf.Rotation + Vector3.new(p.X * a.W, p.Y * a.H, p.Z * a.D)
end
do -- [rbxvis] Roblox icon + chat visuals: on by default, follow the active UI theme palette
	local FX = Util.FX
	local RV = {}
	Util.RbxVis = RV
	local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
	local TCS = game:GetService("TextChatService")
	local origIcon = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local origChat = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local lastScan = 0
	local origBg = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local origStroke = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local barBg, barGlyph, barLogo = {}, {}, nil
	local function pal()
		local ok, p = pcall(Util.Color.Palette, os.clock())
		return ok and p or nil
	end
	local function setChat(obj, prop, val)
		if not obj then return end
		local ok, cur = pcall(function() return obj[prop] end)
		if not ok then return end
		origChat[obj] = origChat[obj] or {}
		if origChat[obj][prop] == nil then origChat[obj][prop] = cur end
		if cur ~= val then pcall(function() obj[prop] = val end) end
	end
	local function isRound(d)
		local c = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if not c then return false end
		local r = c.CornerRadius
		return r.Scale >= 0.4 or r.Offset >= d.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 - 1
	end
	-- finds the top bar pieces: round Roblox button (leftmost circle), the menu/chat pill(s) and their glyph images
	local function scanBar()
		barBg, barGlyph, barLogo = {}, {}, nil
		local root = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("TopBarApp")
		if not root then return end
		local logoX = math.huge
		local all = root:GetDescendants()
		for _, d in ipairs(all) do
			if d:IsA("GuiObject") and d.Visible then
				local sz = d.AbsoluteSize
				if sz.Y >= 20 and sz.Y <= 64 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y < 120 and d.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and isRound(d) then
					barBg[#barBg + 1] = d
					if math.abs(sz.X - sz.Y) <= 2 and d.AbsolutePosition.X < logoX then
						logoX = d.AbsolutePosition.X
						barLogo = d
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(all) do
			if (d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) and d.Visible and d.Image ~= "" and d.ScaleType ~= Enum.ScaleType.Slice then
				local sz = d.AbsoluteSize
				if sz.X > 0 and sz.X <= 48 and sz.Y <= 48 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y < 120 and d.BackgroundTransparency >= 1 then
					barGlyph[#barGlyph + 1] = d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function restore(t, prop)
		for d, c in pairs(t) do
			pcall(function() d[prop] = c end)
			t[d] = nil
		end
	end
	local function stepIcon(iconOn, bgOn)
		if not (iconOn or bgOn) then
			restore(origIcon, "ImageColor3")
			restore(origBg, "BackgroundColor3")
			restore(origStroke, "Color")
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastScan > 3 then
			lastScan = now
			scanBar()
		end
		local p = pal()
		if not p then return end
		if iconOn then
			for _, d in ipairs(barGlyph) do
				if d.Parent then
					if origIcon[d] == nil then origIcon[d] = d.ImageColor3 end
					d.ImageColor3 = (barLogo and d:IsDescendantOf(barLogo)) and p.Bg or p.Accent
				end
			end
		else
			restore(origIcon, "ImageColor3")
		end
		if bgOn then
			for _, d in ipairs(barBg) do
				if d.Parent then
					if origBg[d] == nil then origBg[d] = d.BackgroundColor3 end
					d.BackgroundColor3 = (d == barLogo) and p.Accent or p.Bg
					if d == barLogo and iconOn and (d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) then
						if origIcon[d] == nil then origIcon[d] = d.ImageColor3 end
						d.ImageColor3 = p.Bg
					end
					local st = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
					if st then
						if origStroke[st] == nil then origStroke[st] = st.Color end
						st.Color = p.Accent
					end
				end
			end
		else
			restore(origBg, "BackgroundColor3")
			restore(origStroke, "Color")
		end
	end
	local function stepChat(on)
		if not on then
			if next(origChat) then
				for obj, props in pairs(origChat) do
					for prop, v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() obj[prop] = v end) end
					origChat[obj] = nil
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local p = pal()
		if not p then return end
		local C = FX.Cfg
		local win = TCS:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration")
		local tabs = TCS:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChannelTabsConfiguration")
		local inp = TCS:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
		local bub = TCS:FindFirstChildOfClass("BubbleChatConfiguration")
		setChat(win, "TextColor3", p.Text)
		setChat(win, "BackgroundColor3", p.Bg)
		setChat(win, "TextStrokeColor3", p.Accent)
		setChat(win, "TextSize", C.ChatTextSize)
		setChat(win, "BackgroundTransparency", C.ChatBgTr)
		setChat(win, "WidthScale", C.ChatWinW)
		setChat(win, "HeightScale", C.ChatWinH)
		setChat(tabs, "BackgroundColor3", p.Bg)
		setChat(tabs, "HoverBackgroundColor3", p.Secondary)
		setChat(tabs, "TextColor3", p.Text)
		setChat(tabs, "SelectedTabTextColor3", p.Accent)
		setChat(tabs, "UnselectedTabTextColor3", p.Text)
		setChat(inp, "BackgroundColor3", p.Bg)
		setChat(inp, "TextColor3", p.Text)
		setChat(inp, "PlaceholderColor3", p.Secondary)
		setChat(bub, "BackgroundColor3", p.Bg)
		setChat(bub, "TextColor3", p.Text)
		setChat(bub, "BubbleDuration", C.BubbleDur)
		setChat(bub, "MaxDistance", C.BubbleDist)
		setChat(bub, "TailVisible", C.BubbleTail)
	end
	function RV.Apply()
		pcall(stepIcon, FX.Cfg.RbxIconTheme == true, FX.Cfg.RbxBarTheme == true)
		pcall(stepChat, FX.Cfg.ChatStyle == true)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while Util.RbxVis == RV and task.wait(0.5) do
			RV.Apply()
		end
	end)
end
do -- [custom] CUSTOMIZATION PAGE: 10 triangle + 10 intro + 10 notification + 5 extra UI options
	local FX = Util.FX
	local CPage = UI.CreatePage()
	CPage.ZIndex = 1
	CPage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
	CPage.Interactable = false
	CPage.Visible = false
	Util.FCMark("visual")
	UI.CreateButton(MainPage, "Customization &gt;", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
		CPage.Interactable = false
		CPage.Visible = true
		MainPage.Interactable = false
		local tween = TweenService:Create(CPage, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			CPage.Interactable = true
		end)
	end)
	UI.CreateButton(CPage, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
		CPage.Interactable = false
		MainPage.Interactable = false
		local tween = TweenService:Create(CPage, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0),
		})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			MainPage.Interactable = true
			CPage.Visible = false
		end)
	end)
	UI.CreateText(CPage, "<b>CUSTOMIZATION</b>", 15, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	UI.CreateText(CPage, "Everything here is saved and applies instantly. Triangle changes show on the cool scene (home) and the loading screen. Intro changes show on the next start, or press Preview Intro.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	local Canvas = UI.CreateCanvas(CPage)
	local previewing = false

	local function build()
		local function section(title)
			UI.CreateSeparator(Canvas)
			UI.CreateText(Canvas, "<b>" .. title .. "</b>", 14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		end
		local function sw(label, key)
			UI.CreateSwitch(Canvas, label, FX.Cfg[key]).Changed:Connect(function(val)
				FX.SetCfg(key, val)
			end)
		end
		local function sl(label, key, min, max, step)
			UI.CreateSlider(Canvas, label, FX.Cfg[key], min, max, step).Changed:Connect(function(val)
				FX.SetCfg(key, math.clamp(val, min, max))
			end)
		end
		local function dd(label, key, list)
			UI.CreateDropdown(Canvas, label, list, FX.Cfg[key]).Changed:Connect(function(val)
				FX.SetCfg(key, val)
			end)
		end
		-- kind: nil = plain text, "hex" = required #RRGGBB, "hexopt" = optional #RRGGBB (empty = follow the theme)
		local function tb(label, key, placeholder, maxlen, kind)
			UI.CreateText(Canvas, label, 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
			local box = UI.CreateTextbox(Canvas, tostring(FX.Cfg[key]), placeholder, 18)
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local s = (box.Text:gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, maxlen or 40)
				if kind then
					if s == "" and kind == "hexopt" then
						-- empty = follow the UI theme
					elseif not Util.ParseHex(s) then
						box.Text = tostring(FX.Cfg[key])
						Util.UINotify("Invalid color, use hex like #FF8800")
						return
					elseif s:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
						s = "#" .. s
					end
				end
				box.Text = s
				FX.SetCfg(key, s)
			end)
		end

		local function cp(label, key, allowTheme)
			UI.CreateColorPicker(Canvas, label, FX.Cfg[key], allowTheme).Changed:Connect(function(val)
				FX.SetCfg(key, val)
			end)
		end
		-- ═════ [v24] DYNAMIC COLOR SYSTEM ═════
		section("COLOR SYSTEM (dynamic)")
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "The UI, every minigame and the Arcade follow ONE live palette. Choose a mode, then a base color with the picker. No typing needed.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		dd("Accent mode", "AccentMode", Util.Color.Modes)
		dd("Color harmony (secondary + tertiary colors)", "HarmonyMode", Util.Color.Harmonies)
		sl("Dynamic color speed", "ColorSpeed", 0.1, 4, 0.1)
		sl("Saturation", "ColorSat", 0.2, 1.5, 0.05)
		sl("Brightness", "ColorBright", 0.4, 1.3, 0.05)
		cp("Base / picked color (used by Picked, Harmony, Aurora, Music modes)", "UIAccent", true)
		do
			local strip = Util.Instance("Frame", Canvas)
			strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
			strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			strip.LayoutOrder = #Canvas:GetChildren()
			local sw = {}
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local f = Util.Instance("Frame", strip)
				f.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 5, 6, 0, 4)
				f.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -8, 1, -8)
				f.BorderSizePixel = 0
				Stylize(f)
				sw[i] = f
			end
			AddToRenderStep(function(t)
				local p = Util.Color.Palette(t)
				sw[1].BackgroundColor3, sw[2].BackgroundColor3, sw[3].BackgroundColor3, sw[4].BackgroundColor3, sw[5].BackgroundColor3 = p.Accent, p.Secondary, p.Tertiary, p.Bg, p.Text
			end, strip)
			UI.CreateText(Canvas, "Live palette: accent / secondary / tertiary / background / text", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		end

		-- ═════ TRIANGLE (10) ═════
		section("TRIANGLE")
		dd("Triangle Color Mode", "TriColorMode", {"Theme (follows UI color)", "Custom color", "Rainbow", "Dynamic palette"})
		cp("Triangle custom color (used by Custom color)", "TriColor", false)
		sl("Triangle Size", "TriSize", 0.5, 1.5, 0.05)
		sl("Triangle Spin Speed", "TriSpin", 0, 3, 0.1)
		sl("Face Transparency", "TriFaceTr", 0, 1, 0.02)
		sl("Edge Thickness", "TriEdge", 0.5, 3, 0.1)
		sw("Show Vertex Orbs", "TriNodes")
		sw("Show Faces (off = wireframe)", "TriFaces")
		sw("React To Music", "TriMusic")
		sw("Hold 5s To Explode", "TriExplode")

		-- ═════ INTRO (10) ═════
		section("INTRO")
		tb("Intro title text (max 20 characters)", "IntroTitle", "STEVETHEREALONE", 20)
		tb("Intro subtitle (empty = default)", "IntroSub", "default subtitle", 80)
		tb("Intro scrolling text (empty = random)", "IntroMarquee", "random", 80)
		dd("Intro Color", "IntroColorMode", {"Disco palette", "Custom color", "White", "Dynamic palette"})
		cp("Intro custom color (used by Custom color)", "IntroColor", false)
		sw("Warp Starfield", "IntroStars")
		sw("God Rays", "IntroRays")
		sw("Scanline + Letterbox Bars", "IntroScan")
		sw("HUD Brackets + Counter", "IntroHud")
		sl("Effects Intensity (shake / flash)", "IntroIntensity", 0, 2, 0.1)
		UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Preview Intro", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
			if previewing then return end
			previewing = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, err = pcall(Util.RunIntro, true) -- [v23] the real 60s intro incl. the theme song (v48)
				if not ok then
					warn("[Customization] intro preview failed: " .. tostring(err))
				end
				previewing = false
			end)
		end)

		-- ═════ NOTIFICATIONS (10) ═════
		section("NOTIFICATIONS")
		dd("Notification Mode", "NotifMode", {
			"Default (Roblox popup + UI bar)",
			"Everything in the UI bar",
			"Everything as Roblox popup",
			"Silent",
		})
		sl("Duration (seconds)", "NotifDuration", 1, 15, 1)
		tb("Roblox popup title", "NotifTitle", "Nooby's uh modded reanimation v1.1.1", 40)
		dd("UI bar position", "NotifPos", {"Below window", "Above window", "Top of screen", "Bottom of screen"})
		sl("UI bar width", "NotifWidth", 200, 600, 10)
		sl("UI bar text size", "NotifSize", 12, 26, 1)
		sw("Show progress bar", "NotifProgress")
		cp("Notification bar color", "NotifColor", true)
		sw("Play sound on notification", "NotifSound")
		sl("Slide animation speed", "NotifSpeed", 0.5, 3, 0.1)
		UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Test Notification", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
			Util.UINotify("This is a test notification")
			Util.Notify("This is a test notification")
		end)

		-- ═════ EXTRA UI (5) ═════
		section("EXTRA UI")
		sl("Background Transparency", "UIBgTr", 0, 0.8, 0.05)
		sl("Border Thickness", "UIBorder", 0.5, 4, 0.5)
		sl("Corner Roundness", "UIRound", 0, 16, 1)
		sw("Glow Effect", "UIGlow")
		-- [v24] six more UI options
		UI.CreateSlider(Canvas, "UI Scale (zoom)", FX.Cfg.UIScale, 1, 1.5, 0.05).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("UIScale", math.clamp(val, 1, 1.5))
			pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplyScale)
		end)
		UI.CreateDropdown(Canvas, "UI Font", Util.UIPlus.FontNames, FX.Cfg.UIFont).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("UIFont", val)
			pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplyFont)
		end)
		sl("Animation speed (effects, transitions)", "UIAnimSpeed", 0.4, 3, 0.1)
		UI.CreateSwitch(Canvas, "Ambient Particles (palette colored)", FX.Cfg.UIParticles).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("UIParticles", val)
			pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplyParticles)
		end)
		UI.CreateSwitch(Canvas, "Accent Sheen (animated gradient)", FX.Cfg.UIGradient).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("UIGradient", val)
			pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplySheen)
		end)
		UI.CreateSwitch(Canvas, "Cursor Trail / Touch Ripples", FX.Cfg.UITrail).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("UITrail", val)
			pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplyTrail)
		end)

		-- ═════ ROBLOX ICON + CHAT (on by default, follow the UI theme) ═════
		section("ROBLOX ICON / TOP BAR")
		sw("Theme-colored top bar icons (Roblox, menu, chat)", "RbxIconTheme")
		sw("Theme-colored top bar background (Roblox button + menu/chat pill)", "RbxBarTheme")
		section("CHAT")
		sw("Chat styling (follows the UI theme)", "ChatStyle")
		sl("Chat text size", "ChatTextSize", 8, 24, 1)
		sl("Chat background transparency", "ChatBgTr", 0, 1, 0.05)
		sl("Chat window width", "ChatWinW", 0.5, 2, 0.05)
		sl("Chat window height", "ChatWinH", 0.5, 2, 0.05)
		sl("Bubble duration (seconds)", "BubbleDur", 3, 30, 1)
		sl("Bubble max distance", "BubbleDist", 10, 500, 10)
		sw("Bubble tail visible", "BubbleTail")
		-- ═════ CHARACTER PROPORTIONS ═════
		section("CHARACTER PROPORTIONS")
		local axisselects = {}
		for _,a in {{"Width (sides)", "W"}, {"Height", "H"}, {"Depth", "D"}} do
			local sel = UI.CreateSlider(Canvas, a[1], Util.CharAxis[a[2]], 0.5, 3, 0.05)
			sel.Changed:Connect(function(val)
				val = math.clamp(val, 0.5, 3)
				Util.CharAxis[a[2]] = val
				SaveData["CharAxis" .. a[2]] = val
			end)
			table.insert(axisselects, sel)
		end
		UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Reset Proportions", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
			for _,sel in axisselects do sel.Value = 1 end
		end)
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "Stretches how far the limbs and hats sit from each other on the reanimate character (1 = normal). It does not resize the hat meshes themselves.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

		-- ═════ COMMAND TRIANGLE ═════
		section("COMMAND TRIANGLE")
		sw("Hide Command Triangle", "AdminTriHidden")
		sw("Restore tab while hidden", "AdminTriTab")
		UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Reset Triangle Position", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
			FX.SetCfg("AdminTriPos", "")
			if Util.UhAdmin and Util.UhAdmin.ResetTriPos then Util.UhAdmin.ResetTriPos() end
			Util.UINotify("Triangle moved back to the top centre")
		end)
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "Drag the triangle anywhere (mouse or finger). Hold it for a moment to hide it. A small tab stays at the top edge: tap it to bring the triangle back (or type showtri / flip the switch above). The command bar also opens with the prefix key.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		-- ═════ [v51] DELTA CUSTOMIZATION (listed only when the executor is positively identified as Delta) ═════
		if FX.Delta and FX.Delta.Detected then
			section("DELTA CUSTOMIZATION")
			UI.CreateText(Canvas, "Delta detected. Status: " .. tostring(FX.Delta.Status) .. ". The Delta customizer is built into this script and only runs on Delta. Toggles and speed are live; the master switch and the source override apply on the next start. Triangle color / spin, intro title / intensity / color, blur and Low End mode are shared with the options above. A 5-second Delta mini-intro plays after Nooby's intro.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
			local function dsw(label, key)
				UI.CreateSwitch(Canvas, label, FX.Cfg[key]).Changed:Connect(function(val)
					FX.SetCfg(key, val)
					pcall(FX.Delta.Apply)
				end)
			end
			dsw("Delta customizer (built in, applies on next start)", "DeltaEnabled")
			dsw("Nooby triangle as Delta icon", "DeltaLogo")
			dsw("Smooth Delta page transitions", "DeltaMotion")
			dsw("Subtle blur during transitions", "DeltaBlur")
			dsw("5-second Delta mini-intro (after Nooby's intro)", "DeltaIntro")
			sl("Delta page animation speed", "DeltaSpeed", 0.5, 2, 0.1)
			tb("Delta customizer source override (file path or https URL, optional - empty = built-in)", "DeltaSource", "UhhhhhhReanim/Plugins/DeltaCustomization.lua", 200)
			UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Preview Delta Intro", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
				if FX.Delta.Active then
					FX.Delta.PlayIntro(true)
				else
					Util.UINotify("Delta customization is not active: " .. tostring(FX.Delta.Status))
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	build()
	UI.CreateButton(CPage, "Reset All Customization", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
		FX.ResetCfg()
		Util.CharAxis.W, Util.CharAxis.H, Util.CharAxis.D = 1, 1, 1
		pcall(Util.FX.Delta.Apply) -- [v51]
		SaveData.CharAxisW, SaveData.CharAxisH, SaveData.CharAxisD = 1, 1, 1
		pcall(Util.UIPlus.Apply)
		Util.ClearAllChildrenGui(Canvas)
		build()
		Util.UINotify("Customization reset to default")
	end)
end

do -- [v24] MINIGAMES PAGE (Main UI > Minigames)
	local FX = Util.FX
	local Mini = Util.Mini
	local MPage = UI.CreatePage()
	MPage.ZIndex = 1
	MPage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
	MPage.Interactable = false
	MPage.Visible = false
	Util.FCMark("mini")
	local MiniNavBtn = UI.CreateButton(MainPage, "Minigames &gt;", 20) -- [v34] kept so Low End UI Mode can hide it
	MiniNavBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if FX.IsLowEnd() then
			Util.UINotify("Minigames are disabled in Low End UI Mode")
			return
		end
		MPage.Interactable = false
		MPage.Visible = true
		MainPage.Interactable = false
		local tween = TweenService:Create(MPage, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Connect(function() MPage.Interactable = true end)
	end)
	UI.CreateButton(MPage, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
		MPage.Interactable = false
		MainPage.Interactable = false
		local tween = TweenService:Create(MPage, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)})
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			MainPage.Interactable = true
			MPage.Visible = false
		end)
	end)
	UI.CreateText(MPage, "<b>MINIGAMES</b>", 15, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	UI.CreateText(MPage, "10 built-in games + plugins. Controls adapt to your device automatically (keyboard + mouse on PC, joystick / look pad / buttons on mobile) and switch live if you change input.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	UI.CreateButton(MPage, "Open Arcade (fullscreen)", 20).Activated:Connect(function() Mini.Launcher() end)
	local Canvas = UI.CreateCanvas(MPage)
	-- best score / wins shown next to each built-in game (read-only, never throws)
	local function bestTxt(def)
		local ok, b = pcall(function() return Mini.BestOf and Mini.BestOf(def) end)
		if ok and b ~= nil then return "  -  best " .. tostring(b):gsub("<", "&lt;") end
		return ""
	end
	local function build()
		-- [v34] in Low End UI Mode the plugin folder is not read; the lists are rebuilt when the mode is turned off
		if not Mini.loaded and not FX.IsLowEnd() then Mini.loaded = true pcall(Mini.ReloadPlugins) end
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "<b>BUILT-IN</b>", 14, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		for _, def in ipairs(Mini.Games) do
			if not def.plugin then
				UI.CreateButton(Canvas, def.name .. "  [" .. table.concat(def.tags or {}, " / ") .. "]" .. bestTxt(def), 16).Activated:Connect(function() Mini.Launch(def) end)
			end
		end
		UI.CreateSeparator(Canvas)
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "<b>PLUGINS</b>  (folder: " .. Mini.PluginFolder .. ")", 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		local any = false
		for _, def in ipairs(Mini.Games) do
			if def.plugin then
				any = true
				UI.CreateButton(Canvas, def.name .. "  [plugin: " .. tostring(def.file) .. "]", 16).Activated:Connect(function() Mini.Launch(def) end)
			end
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(Mini.Plugins) do
			if p.err then UI.CreateText(Canvas, "<font color=\"#ff6060\">" .. p.file .. ": " .. tostring(p.err):sub(1, 140):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;") .. "</font>", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left) end
		end
		if not any then UI.CreateText(Canvas, "No plugins loaded. Drop .lua files into the folder above (README.txt and _example.lua.txt were created for you).", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center) end
		UI.CreateButton(Canvas, "Reload Plugins", 18).Activated:Connect(function()
			if FX.IsLowEnd() then Util.UINotify("Plugins are disabled in Low End UI Mode") return end
			pcall(Mini.ReloadPlugins)
			Util.ClearAllChildrenGui(Canvas)
			build()
			Util.UINotify("Plugins reloaded: " .. #Mini.Plugins .. " file(s)")
		end)
		UI.CreateSeparator(Canvas)
		UI.CreateDropdown(Canvas, "Minigame controls", {"Auto (detect + switch live)", "Force PC (keyboard + mouse)", "Force Mobile (touch layout)"}, FX.Cfg.MiniControls).Changed:Connect(function(val)
			FX.SetCfg("MiniControls", val)
		end)
		UI.CreateText(Canvas, "Detected right now: " .. Mini.DetectPlatform() .. ". Inside a game press P (or the II button) for the pause menu with a generated controls list and look sensitivity.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
	end
	build()

	-- [v34] LOW END UI MODE: the Minigames button disappears from the main page, a running game / the arcade is closed,
	-- and everything comes back (including the plugin lists) when the mode is turned off.
	local function applyMiniLowEnd()
		pcall(function()
			MiniNavBtn.Parent.Visible = not FX.IsLowEnd() -- the button sits inside a layout container; hide the container so no gap is left
		end)
	end
	applyMiniLowEnd()
	FX.OnLowEnd(function(on)
		if on then
			pcall(Mini.Quit)
			pcall(function()
				if Mini.Arena and Mini.Arena.Close then Mini.Arena.Close() end
			end)
		elseif not Mini.loaded then
			Util.ClearAllChildrenGui(Canvas)
			build()
		end
		applyMiniLowEnd()
	end)
end
